tei:div.tei:p: ra 6 77777 /rgya 7 rgya0770 0 ba ṇaca gli ciX ba bab jaX ma —7 jib 'ji
(80)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ (mi (8༷)0440 kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 3brtag pa dang po/ 3dang po/ rdo rje rigs kyi le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ sngags kyi le'u// 7gsum pa/ lha'i le'u/ 10bzhi pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 13lnga pa/ de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 13drug pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 15bdun pa/ brda dang gnas gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 18brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'du ba'i le'u/ 21dgu pa/ rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 26bcu pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 28bcu gcig pa/ 32brtag pa gnyis pa/ 3331

dang po/ rab gnas kyi le'u/ 33gnyis pa/ dngos grub gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35gsum pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dang gsang ba'i skad ces bya ba'i le'u/ 41bzhi pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 48lnga pa/ kye rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 58drug pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i le'u/ 64bdun pa/ bza' ba'i le'u/ 65brgyad pa/ 'dul ba'i le'u/ 67dgu pa/ sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 68bcu pa/ bzlas pa'i le'u/ 72bcu gcig pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba don gyi le'u/ nebacu gnyis pa/ 74rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slar yang lots+tsha ba gzhon nu dpal gyis 'gyur chad bsabs shing dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(75) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(92) 0441 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa/ 93dang po/ thams cad kyi rnam pa mchog tu zhi ba sems can la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 93gnyis pa/ glu sna tshogs dang rol mo'i sgra dang gar dang 'dul bar 'jug pa dang char dbab pa dang mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u/ 972

gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u/ 103bzhi pa/ khro bo chen po 'khor lo'i snying po'i sngags la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 106lnga pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 122drug pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po snang ba'i le'u/ 125bdun pa/ sngags thams cad rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi lnga mchog tu byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 129brgyad pa/ bzhengs pa dang las sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba dang sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 132dgu pa/ las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 145bcu pa/ rdo rje skye mched rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 150bcu gcig pa/ las thams cad pa'i le'u/ 151bcu gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 151bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje sdom pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 154bcu bzhi pa/ dngos po sna tshogs rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 156bco lnga pa/ 174rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(183) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(207)0442 dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i mnga' bdag 208dang po/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyu zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 208gnyis pa/ slob dpon dang slob ma brtag pa dang / yon dbul ba dang / dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 2103

gsum pa/ sbyor ba drug gi mtshan nyid dang 'khor lo drug gi rang gi ngo bo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 213bzhi pa/ 'khor lo drug gi rtsa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 214lnga pa/ srog dang mtshan mo dang / nyin mo dang mtshams dang / shar ba dang nub pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 218drug pa/ ā li kā li 'byung ba dang dus kyi mtshan nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 220bdun pa/ rdo rje'i mtshan nyid dang / bdag sgra'i nges pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 222brgyad pa/ gsang ba dang dga' ba bzhi dang / rigs lnga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 223dgu pa/ phyag rgya'i brda dang mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 225bcu pa/ dkyil 'khor dang / lha mo dang / gnas dang / dur khrod dang —/ shing dang / mchod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 227bcu gcig pa/ don dam pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 230bcu gnyis pa/ bdud rtsi lnga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 231bcu gsum pa/ rnal 'byor ma 'dus pa'i gnas su gsang ba'i skad bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ snye 235bcu bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi yan lag gi phyag rgya la sogs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 237bco lnga pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs dang / mtshan nyid dang / rigs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 238bcu drug pa/ dkyil 'khor dang / dga' ba'i bye brag dang / thig le'i mtshan nyid dang / bskyed pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 240

bcu bdun pa/ tshul dang / char yang dang / thig le dang / ye shes kyi gnas dang / rtsa'i kun spyod ces bya ba'i le'u/ 247bco brgyad pa/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa dang / bsam gtan brtan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 2dzibacu dgu pa/ dbang gi ye shes dang / ā li kā li'i rgyu 'bras dang / zla ba 'byung ba dang / rtsa dang / thig le dang / dga' ba bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ naganyi shu pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 252nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'khor lo drug gi sa bon dang / sngags btu ba dang /bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba dang / spyad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 253nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gtor ma'i las zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 258nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i yan lag gi mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 259nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ las kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 264nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 265nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ dus kyi don gyi rang bzhin gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 266nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ sbas pa'i sngags gsal ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 268nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ rmad du byung ba'i rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 269rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal sngar/ ka ma chos kyi ye shes dang /phyug mtshams dgra bcom gyis dad cing gus pas zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(272) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(2875

0443 dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po/ 285dang po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 285gnyis pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang / dbang bskur ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 289gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 291bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 294rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(302)0444 dpal ye shes thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po mchog tu rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/ 303dang po/ 'pho ba'i dus shar ba dang nub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 303gnyis pa/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid dang zla ba mchog gi bde ba dang phyag rgya chen po'i mtha' la sogs pa'i phyogs tsam bstan pa'i le'u/ 310gsum pa/ yon dbul ba dang bcas pa'i dbang gi rim pa zhes bya ba'i le'u / 311bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 315lnga pa/ sngags btu ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 318drug pa/ mchod sbyin gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 323bdun pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 324brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 325

dgu pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / gtor ma chen po dang /rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan nyid dang / gsang ba'i tshig dang / phyag rgya'i brda zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 330bcu pa/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 336bcu gcig pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i rim pa dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor skyed pa'i rim pa dang / gnas kyi don dang rtsa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi don bstan pa'i le'u/ 342bcu gnyis pa/ mchod pa'i rim pa dang gsang ba'i skad ces bya ba'i le'u/ 350bcu gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba'i nges pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 354bcu bzhi pa/ mchod pa sna tshogs nges par bstan pa dang nang gi sbyin sreg ces bya ba'i le'u/ 357bco lnga pa/ 'byung ba bsrung ba'i don du gtor ma chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 360bcu drug pa/ de kho na nyid gsum la sogs pa'i rgyas pa nges par bstan pa'i rang bzhin gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 361bcu bdun pa/ dur khrod kyi nges par bstan pa'i don dang / nang gi bsam gtan gyi nye bar 'gro ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 365bco brgyad pa/ dpal ye shes thig le'i tshad dang / gnas dang / sa bstan pa'i don dang / phung po rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 370bcu dgu pa/ bla ma dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 375nyi shu pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rim pa dang / don zhes bya ba'i le'u / 376nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dpal phyag rgya chen po bcom ldan 'das ma'i rang gi ngo bo bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 3777

nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gsang ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 378nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 380nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ dbang bskur ba blang ba dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 384nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ tshig rgyas par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 387nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 390nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 391nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i sgom pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 393nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 397sum cu pa/ mchog chen po nang gi rnam par shes pa drug gi bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 398rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī pradz+nyā gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su zhu thig g.yar khral bgyis/bsdur mchan/(399) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(415) 0445 dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 416rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po pradz+nyā shrī gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/dus phyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su bsgyur cing zhug te dag par byas/bsdur mchan/(431) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(433)8

0446 dpal sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 434dang po/ dngos grub thams cad dang ye shes gtan la dbab pa dang /thod pa kha phye ba las glegs bam byung ba'i le'u/ 434gnyis pa/ thal ba'i sbyor ba dang las sna tshogs gtan la dbab pa dang /sngags kyi le'u/ 441gsum pa/ lha bskyed pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 446bzhi pa/ sha li ku'i sbyor ba dang / chu'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 451lnga pa/ sman bzang po dang / dgongs pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 463drug pa/ dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri ba dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 466bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor dang ho ru ka bskyed pa dang sgom pa'i le'u/ 468brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 471dgu pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 475bcu pa/ sman chen po khyad par can dang / mo sham gyi khrus kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 476bcu gcig pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba'i man ngag nges pa'i le'u/ 480bcu gnyis pa/ sngags sna tshogs kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 481bcu gsum pa/ sems rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 486bcu bzhi pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / shes rab ma gsol ba gdab pa dang —/ rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 488rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(gon) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(505)9

0447 dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 506dang po/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 506gnyis pa/ sbyor ba gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 509gsum pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo rnams kyi dgongs pa mchog tu gsang ba gsang ba chen po nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ 511rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na pa ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(515) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(517)0448 rdo rje ā ra li zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 518dang po/ lha'i le'u/ 518gnyis pa/ gtor ma'i bya ba'i le'u/ 519gsum pa/ las thams cad pa'i le'u/ 520bzhi pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 521lnga pa/ 'khrul 'khor dang / las kyi phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ 522drug pa/ las sna tshogs bstan pa'i le'u/ 524bdun pa/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 526brgyad pa/ phan yon gyi le'u/ 528dgu pa/ yon tan rjes su bsngags pa'i le'u/ 528bcu pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 529rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā yas pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/10

bsdur mchan/(530) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(532)04go ri gi ā ra li'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 533dang po/ sbyor ba'i le'u/ 533gnyis pa/ las thams cad rab tu bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 535gsum pa/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi gtan la dbab pa dang / brda'i le'u/ 538bzhi pa/ rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas su bshad pa'i le'u/ 540lnga pa/ cho ga'i mtshan nyid dang nges pa'i le'u/ 542rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā yas pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(545) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(548)0450 rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ 5gabadag gi gdan gyi rab ngu byed pa/ 5gorim par phye ba dang po/ 5garim par phye ba gnyis pa/ 558rim par phye ba gsum pa/ 566rim par phye ba bzhi pa/ 567gzhan gyi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa/ 570rim par phye ba dang po/ 570rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ 577rim par phye ba gsum pa/ 57911

rim par phye ba bzhi pa/ 593smyor ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa/ 603rim par phye ba dang po/ 603rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ 610rim par phye ba gsum pa/ 616rim par phye ba bzhi pa/ 622gsang ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa/ 633rim par phye ba dang po/ 633rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ 639rim par phye ba gsum pa/ 646rim par phye ba bzhi pa/ 652rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po ga ya dha ra dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(662) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(685)0451 dpal gdan bzhi pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sngags kyi cha zhes bya ba/ 686lnga pa'am lnga pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba bstan pa/ 686le'u bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ 698shes rab rdo rje yang dag par sbyor ba'i le'u/ 702khro bo'i lus rnam par bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 714brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnam par bstan pa'i le'u/ 735rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 740las kyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 74112

gsang ba'i snying po'i mchog mdor bsdus pa bstan pa/ 744rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(748) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(761)0452 dpal gdan bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 762dang po/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 762gnyis pa/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u/ 765gsum pa/ sbyor ba'i le'u/ 766bzhi pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 767lnga pa/ bdud rtsi lnga mdor bsdus le'u/ 773drug pa/ 'chi ba'i mtshan ma yongs su brtag pa'i le'u/ 775bdun pa/ rtsa bskyed pa'i le'u/ 777brgyad pa/ rgyas pa'i le'u/ 778dgu pa/ las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 780bcu pa/ mtha' yas pa'i sgo'i lha mo'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 781bcu gcig pa/ sbyor ba'i tshig gi le'u/ 784dang po/ rtsa'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i le'u/ 786gnyis pa/ sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 788gsum pa/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 790bzhi pa/ dam tshig dang gtor ma dang mchod pa'i le'u/ 790lnga pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 79213

drug pa/ bslab pa'i le'u/ 793bdun pa/ mngal na gnas pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 794brgyad pa/ nang gi le'u/ 795dgu pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 796bcu pa/ snang ba'i le'u/ 797bcu gcig pa/ gzhan gyi sems kyi le'u/ 797bcu gnyis pa/ 'pho ba sbyang ba'i le'u/ 798bcu gsum pa/ mod la 'pho ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 798bcu bzhi pa/ zhi ba'i le'u/ 799bco lnga pa/ bdun gyi bdun pa zhes bya ba/ 799le'u dang po/ 800le'u gnyis pa/ 801le'u gsum pa/ 801le'u bzhi pa/ 801le'u lnga pa/ 802le'u drug pa/ 802le'u bdun pa/ 803le'u brgyad pa/ 80 le'u dang po/ 804le'u gnyis pa/ 804le'u gsum pa/ 805le'u bzhi pa/ 805le'u lnga pa/ 805le'u drug pa/ 80514

la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan 91 rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni ra ba dang / /gur bcing ba yang rnam par bsgom pa nyid/ /dang por ro ni rnam bsgoms pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid brjod/ /de stengs 90rnal 'byor pa gnas nas/ /he ru ka nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rang gi snying gar rin re pha bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i nyi cadakyil 'khor / /der ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin can/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje ni/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus gnas par/ /yang ni hūm̐ gi de nyid bsgom/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa 5gyur bltas nas / /zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje skye ba nag po che6/ /'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba'i mdog /yang na sngo dang nyi ma'i mdog /dad pas nges par rnam par bsgom/ /nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod / /dkar mo ri dgas 57rimatshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī 8ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī 9)ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po 1 rjes chags pas1lha / /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ /sa bon nang du son gyur pa/ /de nyid sems dpa' zhes byar brjod/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa yi/ /rang gi sna lus mtshungs rnam par spro/ /bsdus nas snying gar dgug pa na/ /yo gi zhe sdang 80—11

bdag nyid 'gyur/ /sngo dang nyi ma mtshungs pa'i mdog /ban+dha (1)dmar po'i spyan dang ldan/ /skra ser gyen du 'khyil ba dang / /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan na / /'khor lo rna cha nor bu dang / /lag gdub dang ni ska (5)rags nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /'di rnams phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /sdang mig brgyad gnyis lo yi tshul/ /g.yon na rdo rje thod pa dang / /g.yon pa nas kyang kha ṭ+wāṃ cag /g.yas na rdo rje nag po nyid/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge 'don pa'i bdag /rnal 'byor ma brgyad yongs bskor nas/ /dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /dbugs rgyu zhes bya'i rigs pa 'dis/ /dur khrod ces ni mngon par brjod/ /phyag bzhi ni bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba rnam par dag pa ste/ gong du brjod pa'i gzugs dang / sku mdog dang hūm̐ las byung ba'o/ /phyag g.yon gyi dang po na skyes pa'i thod pa lha dang lha ma yin gyi khrag gis bkang ba/ de bzhin du g.yas kyi phyag na rdo rje/ phyag lhag ma dag gis shes rab la 'khyud pa(5ci/ shes rab 6rdo rje phag mo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rgya gzugs can no/ /phyag drug pa / zhal gsum pa/ g.yon dmar ban/ g.yas zla ba dang nyi ma lta bu dang po sngon po / gcer 9bu gong du 1 tshobarjod pa'i sku mdog dang gzugs can/ phyag rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug 11rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyag g.yon gyi dang po na rtse gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ phyag g.yon gyi gnyis pa na dril bu / phyag g.yas kyi gnyis pa na gri gug /phyag lhag ma dag gis rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma 1 la snyoms par 'jug pa12/ bcom zhen 'das ji lta ba de ltar shes rab ste/g.yas pa dang g.yon pa na gri gug dang thod pa/ khams gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi ro mnan 1 pa'o/ /lha'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //863—12

bon bsam mo/ /sa bon las (kye'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis phyung nas/ des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la ma mo (8)brgyad kyis yang dag par mchod nas gsol ba gdab 4par bya'o / /oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu (5)mā sarba (6)ta thā ga ta zhes sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ku'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi 7 bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas (8)dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gur gum gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs porapa rnams kyis blang bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur nas spyi bor rang gi rigs kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni he ru ka rdzogs pa nyid do/ /thun gsum du byin gyis brlabs 7pa'i bsgom pa rnam par bsgoms 4glenas langs te lha'i gzugs su gzhag go/ /dbang gi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas de kho na nyid kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /ngo bos gzugs med mthong ba po/ /sgra med thos pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/ /ro med myong rbe po yang med/ /reg med reg pa po yang med/ /sems med sems las byung ba'ang tsho med/ /skyed byed ma dang sring mo nyid/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /gdol ma de bzhin bram ze mo/ /thabs 80—13

dang shes rab cho ga yis/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /ji ltar bye bar mi 'gyur bar/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsten pa nyid/ /ma gsang sbrul dang chom rkun dang / /sa spyod me yis sdug bsngal byed/ /rigs lnga'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ /thar zhi)pa'i rgyur ni brjod par bya/ /rdo rje 'dis ni gdab pa nyid/ /des na phyag rgyar brjod par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma de bzhin las/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rin chen nyid/ /snying rje chen po dam pa yi/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru brjod/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya (nagayung mo nyid/ /de bzhin pad+ma'i gar ma nyid/ /las ni tshos mar rab tu bshad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bram ze mo/ /rin chen gdol mar shes par bya/ /phyag rgya lngar ni rnam par nges/ /'di rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /mdor bsdus pas ni brjod par bya/ /dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /de bzhin slar yang gshegs pa nyid/ /'dis ni shes rab rigs pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs zhes brjod par bya/ /rigs ni rnam pa drug brjod cing / /mdor bsdus pas ni rnam pa lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /phyi nas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /rigs dang 'byung ba lnga rnams dang / /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyi(5)/ /rigs dang bgrang bya 'di yis ni / /rigs zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /sgom (4dpa po med bsgom pa'ang med / /lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin las/ / sngags dang lha (57ni yang dag gnas/ /rnam snang mi bskyod 6)don yod dang / /rin chen dpag med sems dpa' bo(7)/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug zhi ba dang / /thams cad sangs rgyas de nyid brjod(she/ /tshangs pa sgrib bral sangs rgyas nyid/ /'jug phyir khyab 'jug brjod par bya/ /rtag tu dge bas zhi ba nyid/ /thams 80—14

cad kun gyi bdag nyid gnas/ /dam pa'i bde bas de nyid de/ /bde ba rtogs phyir rnam hunyesangs rgyas/ /gang phyir lus las byung ba nyid/ /lha zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'di la bha ga mnga'/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes brjod par bya/ /bha ga rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /dbang phyug la sogs yon tan kun/ /yang na nyon mongs la sogs bdud/ /bcom rin)phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes brjod(8)/ /gang phyir skye 'gro skyed pa yis(47/ /shes rab ma zhes brjod par bya/ /gang phyir skal ba ston pa yis(snye/ /shes rab sring mo zhes bya nyid/ /btso blag ⑥ma dang bu mo dang / /gar mkhan mar yang (7)brjod par bya/ /sems can thams cad 'tshod (kyepa'i phyir/ /btso blag (9)ma zhes de bzhin brjod/ /yon tan 'jo phyir shes rab ni/ /bu mo zhes ni brjod par bya//snying rje chen po g.yo ba'i phyir/ /shes rab gar mar brjod par bya/ /gang phyir bcom ldan mi reg yipa/ /de phyir g.yung mor brjod par bya/ /ā li kā li rab brtags pas/ /brjod pa bzlas par yang dag bshad/ /rkang pa'i rjes ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /nyid phyir dkyil 'khor brjod par bya/ /lag pa sgyur sna ba phyag rgya yin/ /sor mo nyed tu)pa'ang de bzhin no/ /gang phyir rnam sems bsam gtan ni/ /gang bsams tugede ni bsam gtan no/ /ji ltar pha rnyilas bde thob pa / /de yi bde ba rang gis bza'/ /bde ba gang gis 'chi tshab 'di/ /de yi bde ba bsam gtan brjod/ /de kho na nyid kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /spyod pa pha rol phyin mchog nyid/ /gang gis dngos grub mthar 'gro ba/ / kye yi rdo rjes tshedangos grub rgyus/ /sgom nyu 80—15

pa po yis rnam 'dzin pa/ /rna ba dag la rna ༄1cha bzang / /spyi bor 'khor lo rnam par 'dzin/ /lag pa dag la lag gdub gnyis55)/ /rked pa la yang ska (sne)rags nyid/ /rkang par de bzhin rkang gdub bo/ /lag pa'i rtsa bar dpung rgyan nyid / /mgrin par rus pa'i phreng ba ste/ /bgo ba stag gi pags 95)pa nyid / /bza' ba mi 'chi'i phyirabacu phyed de/ /he ru ka sbyor skyes bu ste/ /kha dog lnga la rnam par gnas/ /rigs lnga dag dang mnyam ldan pa/ /rigs ni gcig tu rnam par brtag /kha dog du ma nyid kyis ni/ /gang phyir dbye ba mtshon mi bya / /shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ /bsgom pa bzang por brjod par bya/ /cung zad drod ni thob pa na/ /gal te spyod pa byed 'dod pas/ /gal te 'grub 'gyur 'dod yod na/ /'dis 7ni spyod pa spyad pa 8)nyid/ /shin tu bzhin bzangs 9mig yangs ma/ /rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje'i bu mo 'di khyer nas/ /spyod pa 1 bya bar rtogs par bya/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dngos med na / /rang 'dod lha yi rigs kyis bya/ /yang na gzhan gyi 11rigs byung ba/ /byang chub sa bon gdab pa dang / /sbyang ba yis ni gzung 12bar bya/ /gal te dga' bas glu blang ste/ /de tshe rdo rje mchog ldan no/ /gal te dga' ba skyes pa na / /thar pa'i rgyur ni gar bya ste/ /de tshe rdo rje rkang pas gar/ /yo gis mnyam par bzhag pas byed/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod 12pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag gdub rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska 1 rags la ni don yod gnas/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzugs shes rab ste/ /thabs kyi gzugs kyis cang te'u nyid/ /zhe sdang 80—16

rnam dag rnal 'byor pa/ /glu ni rnam dag sngags su gnas/ /gar ni bsgom 3pa byas pa nyid/ /de yi phyir na glu dang gar/ /yo gis (nartag tu rtag tu byedadzodakyi/ /sman ni rnam par bza' ba ste/ /chu ni rtag par btung ba nyid/ /rga shis zil gyis mi non (4)cing / /rtag tu bsrung (57bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rkun ma'i skra las cod pan byas/ de la hūm̐ byung sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi 6)thod pa rnams//rnal 'byor spyod pas rnam par 'dzin/ /thod pa sor lnga pa yi tshad/ /byas pas cod pan 'dzin par byed/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /skra yi ska 7rags nyis skor 58nyid/ /thal ba skra yi mchod phyir thogs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spyod pas 'dzin/ /cang te'u sgra ni bzlas 59ripa ste/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sgom 7shes rab nyid / /rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor /stob yis/ /'di dag bzlas dang sgom 51 pa yin/ /brkam dang rmongs dang 'jigs dang khro/ /ngo tsha'i 'bras bu rnam par spang / /bdag nyid kyis (1geni gnyid spangs nas/ /the tshom 1 med par spyod pa dbya/ /lus kyi 7sbyin pa byin nas ni/ /phyi nas spyod pa yang dag spyad/ /skal dang skal min rnam dpyad 1 3pas/ /de phyir sbyin pa sbyin mi bya/ /bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa rab tu bza'/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog phyir / /zhen pa tsam du mi bya'o/ /bza' dang bza' min spyod pa dang / /de bzhin btung dang btung nyu8min nyid/ /bgrod dang bgrod min sngags pa yis/ /rnam rtog nyid du mi bya'o/ /dngos grub rnyed pa'i slob ma gang / /yang dag ye shes snang ba po/ /mnar med spang ba'i rgyu yi 19phyir/ / grub pas bla ma mngon phyag 'tshalas1/ /bslab dang dbang las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin ngo tsha'i 'bras bu nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyi/ /yo gis rnam dpyad snying rje 80—17

che1 / /sbyin sreg mchod rin sbyin dka' thub 'das/ /sngags dang bsam gtan rnam par spangs/ /dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas ( skuspyod pa byed/ /nges par sngon tsho ridu lha min gang / /brgya byin (5)lta bu yin na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis rnam par rgyu/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu snying rjes (6ribatung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor btung dga' rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan gyi 57)btung bas bzi ba med/ /spyod pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas :smra'i 8le'u bshad par bya'o/ /gang gis spun dang sring mor yang / /the tshom 9med par shes par bya/ /gang zhig sor mo gcig ston dang / /gnyis kyis legs par 'ongs pa yin/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bong 7bcangs pa las /bsnyun 11gyi phyag rgyar 12rnam par shes/ /gang zhig srin lag ston pa la12/ /de yi mthe'u 1 chung rnam par sbyin/ /gang zhig gung mo ston pa la/ /de yi mdzub 'amo rnam par sbyin/ /gang zhig srin lag ston pa la/ /de yi mgrin pa (7rab tu bstan / /gang zhig gos ni ston pa la/ /de yi 1 rtse gsum rab tu bstan/ /gang zhig nu ma ston pa la/ /de yi mtshams ni rab tu bstan/ /gang zhig so ni ston pa la/ / de yi 1 kha ni rab tu bstan/ /gang zhig khro gnyer ston pa la/ /gtsug phud 19dgrol bar brjod par bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa la/ /de yi rgyab ni rab tu bstan/ /gang zhig rkang mthil 1ston pa la/ /lto (22yis rnam par rtse dbar bya/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan gyis ni/ /dam tshig gis ni rnam par dbye / /de la rnal 'byor mas smras pa lha/ /e ma bu ni snying rje che/ /gal te 80—18

phreng ba (1)lag ston na/ /'du bar bya zhes smra ba yin/ /phreng ba mngon par gtad tsho byas na/ /dam tshig la mnos brtul (8༄zhugs bzang / /de la phyi rol zhes 'du ba/ /bzang po'i spyod yul la ri staganas par// /de la 'du bar rnal 'byor mas/ /gang smras de ltar thams cad bya/ /kye bcom ldan 'das 'du ba'i gnas su lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing nyid dang / /ts+tshan do nye ba'i ts+tshan do dang / /de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /sa bcu'i (6)dbang phyug mgon po nyid/ /'dis ni gzhan gyis brjod mi bya/ /kye bcom ldan 'das gnas la sogs pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas ni dzā lan dha tsho norar bshad/ /de bzhin du ni au rgyan 8nyid / /gnas ni kol la 9)gi ri 'o nyid/ /de bzhin du ni kām rū nyid/ /nye gnas mā 31la wa zhes brjod/ /sin dhu na 12ga ra nyid do/ /zhing ni māsgru nir bshad de/ /zhing ni byed pa'i brang nyid do/ /de wī 12ko ṭi 1 de bzhin zhing / /zhing ni lcags pa'i brang nyid do/ /nye zhing ku la 15ta zhes brjod/ /de bzhin arbu da 9nyid dang / /ba nyu yi mchog sbyin kha ba'i ri/ /nye ba'i zhing ni mdor bsdus pa'o/ /ts+tshan do ha ri ke la dang / /lan tshwa rgya mtsho'i nang skyes dang /lam ba kā dang kāñci 1 nyid/ /de bzhin saurāṣ+ṭa nyid donyu9/ /nye ba'i ts+tshan 2 do ka ling ka /gser dang ldan pa'i gling dang ni/ /kong ka ṇa 21yang nye ts+tshan dor na/ /mdor bsdus pas ni brjod par bya/ /'thung gcod grong khyer gyi dang yang / /'thung gcod grong gi mthar gnas pa/ /tsa 2 ri tra dang 2 ko sa la/ /ben dh+ya 580—19

gzhon nu'i grong khyer ro/ /rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod de nye ba'o/ /dur khrod rab son 41)dge 'dun dang / /dur khrod rgya mtsho'i 'gram nyid do/ /skyed 2tshal ra ba rdzing bu'i 'gram/ /nye ba'i dur khrod brjod par bya/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud kye'i (5)rdo rje/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 4legs 'du ba/ /nyin par nyid kyang rab bshad bya/ /kye bcom ldan 'das nyi ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / yi dgas 5zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun nyid/ /lan bdun pa yang (6bza' bar bya/ /'bad pas snying rje bskyed pa yis/ /gsad 7)par bya bar brjod pa nyid/ /snying rje med na mi 'grub pas/ /de phyir snying rje bskyed pa nyid/ /thams cad gdug pa gzhug napa ste/ /cho ga'i gtso bos dgag par bya/ /de la 'di ltar blta ba nyid / /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mtshan mo shes rab brtag par bya/ /mi bya cung 9zad yod ma yin/ /rtag tu mi bza' yod ma yin/ /'di la mi bsam yod ma yin/ /bzang ngan mi smra gang yang med/ /ji ltar bdag nyid de ltar gzhan/ /de bzhin bdag ni 1 stang mchog nyid/ /'di ltar sems pa'i (1rnal 'byor bdag /bza' dang btung ba la 12sogs spyad/ /yan lag ji snyed bsgyur ba dang / /tshig rnams rab tu rgyas pa nyid/ /he ru ka dpal gnas bzhugs pas/ /de snyed sngags dang phyag rgya yin/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te//he ni rgyu sogs stong 1 pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba nyid/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /skye bo gang dang gang rnams kyi/ /sha ni mkhas pas bza' bar bya/ /sems can de de'i sadabang du 80—20

'gyur / /brda 6)dang gnas gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i khams su bha ga bsam/ /dbus su rnam par bsgom pa ni/ /'khor lo sngon du ci rigs par / /lha rnams ji rinaltar 'byung ba nyid/ /'khor lo sa dang chu ni 5)sngo / /ji ltar (5rigs par byin za dang / /lha rnams kyis 56)ni rlung chen dang / /ji ltar sgom po 'byung ba yang med/ /chos 'byung las skyes 'khor lo nyid/ /'phar ma gnyis dag skyon med pa/ /ze'u 8)'bru las ni gcig 'gyur te/ /gru gsum gyis ni phyi mar brjod/ /de dbus shi ba bcwa ri9stelnga yi/ /gdan lagyi bdag nyid rnam par bsam/ /de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon nyid/ /phyi (stonas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyis 12gnas/ /kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma 'dus pa las/ /dkar mo 12la sogs rab tu grags/ /zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /bdun skogyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /so sor rtog dpar brjod par bya/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yis / /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lanyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūm̐ phaṭa rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnam par bsgom/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs gong ma bzhin/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /'di ltar 80—21

thams cad rdzogs pa nyid/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye bas/ /ā li shes rab kā li thabs/ /'di las dkar mo 1la sogs pa/ /kha dog dbye bas so so yin/ /re zhig 2nang gi 'phar ma la/ /rnal 'byor ma lnga nges gnas pa/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /dbang por rdo rje gshin rjer dkar/ /chu bdag chu yi ( rnal 'byor ma/ /lus ngan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbus su bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /phyi rol gyi ni 'phar ma la/ /dkar mo chom rkun ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī dang puk+ka sī/ /ri khrod ma dang gdol pa ma / /brgyad pa ḍom+bi nī 5ru brjod/ /'og ldan ma dang steng ldan nyid/ /mkha' sgyu spyod ma dang sa spyod brjod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /snying rje chen po 'di dag gnas/ /lha mo thams cad kha dog gnag sku /drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /zhal gcig spyan ni dmar ba rnams ri/ /lag par gri gug thod pas khyab/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang / /lag par lag gdub ska rags nyid9/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /'di lnga phyag rgya dag pa'o/ /ji ltar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /de ltar thams cad rnam par bshad/ /lag pa gcig ni thod pas brel/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pas nyu trekha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid do/ /stag gi pags 11pas rnam dkris shing / /ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar/ /phyag gnyis gyen du dbu skyes ser/ /nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /gcod phyir gri gug rnam par gnas/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi/ /mgo bo'i 1 pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /stong pa'i rnam pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thabs kyis ro ni rnam par brtag /'dis ni 1 'khor lo rnam bsgoms 1 na/ /863—22

dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /dang por nag po rab tu bsgom/ /gnyis par dmar po rnam par bsgom/ /gsum pa la ni ser po bsgom/ /bzhi par ljang gu 1de bzhin no/ /lnga par kha dog sngon po dang / /drug par dkar po'i lus can te/ /yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /dga' bral mthar yang de bzhin no/ /bskyed nanopa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /rdzogs pa'i yang ni 4rim pa nyid/ /rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do/ /bskyed pa yi ni cha bshad do/ /nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma la/ /bha ga zhes bya ye shes brjod/ /bsgom pa zhes bya snyoms 'jug nyid/ /de yi bde ba 5'khor lor brjod/ /sngon du byung ba zhu ba nyid/ rim 6)pa ji bzhin rang rig nyid / /lha zhes bya ba byang chub sems/ /ji ltar 'byung ba khu ba yin/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gnyis/ /re zhig 7ribatsun mo shes rab yin/ /skyes bu thabs su brjod pa nyid/ /kun rdzob don dam dbye ba las/ /phyi nas de yi 8rnam pa gnyis/ /re zhig 9)skyes bu rnam pa gnyis/ /de yi khu ba'ang bde ba nyid / /skyes bu ji bzhin shes rab la'ang / / de yi 1 khu ba'ang bde ba nyid/ /de nyid phyir na dga' ba nyid/ /bzhi yi rab tu dbye ba yis/ /skye 11med rim pa'i phyogs las ni/ /'di ltar lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi/ /dga' ba dang po dpa' bo nyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /shin tu bde dga' thams cad nges/ /de bde'i sna thabs las thams cad rig /dga' ba'i 1 bde ba cung zad de/ /mchog tu dga' ba de las lalhag /dga' bral dga' bas 15chags bral yin/ /lhag ma tshalhan cig skyes dga' nyid/ /dang po 41 reg par 'dod pa dang / /gnyis pa bde bar 'dod pa nyidatu / /gsum pa 'dod chags 80—23

'jig pa nyid/ /des na bzhi pa bsgom par bya/ /mchog tu dga' ba srid par brjod / /dga' bral las ni mya ngan 'das/ /dbu ma dga' ba tsam nyid de/ /'dis ni lhan cig skyes pa spangs/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di la 1thabs dang shes rab med/ /yang dag de nyid snang ba'o/ /gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed den/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa yis/ /bdag gis dkyibasod nams las shes bya/ /dman pa 'bring dang mchog rnams dang / /gzhan rnams rdzigang rnams de rnams kyang / /ro mnyam de nyid bsgoms pa yis/ /'di kun mnyam pa nyid du blta/ /dman pa'i gnas 5ni phra ba'i don/ /mchog ni dngos por brjod par bya/ /dbu ma gnyis kyis spangs pa nyid/ /gzhan rnams zhes bya dbang po drug /gang rnams de rnams brtan dang g.yo/ /'di kun zhes bya nga nyid de/ /mnyam nyid mtshungs par 'dod pa nyid/ /ro mnyam de nyid bsgoms pas tshoni/ /mnyam zhes bya ba mtshungs par brjod/ /de yi 'khor lo ro zhes brjod/ /bsgom 7pa ro gcig mnyam pa nyid/ /'dis ni don gyis brjod par bya/ /nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung 8/ /nga las gnas gsum po yang 'byung 9/ /nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong / /de ltar rnal 'byor pas shes na/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag gang goms pa / /bsod nams chung ba'i mi yis kyang / /de ni grub 1 par the tshom 37med/ /bza' dang btung dang 1 blugs pa dang / /nyal dang log dang sems pa na/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon 'dod pas/ /de nas sngon 1 du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgom 1 par/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya thams 8(1—24

cad chos ni yongs shes na/ /bsgom pa nyid ni bsgom pa min/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po gang / /rtswa lcug 'khri 1)shing la mon)sogs pa/ /bdag gi dngos po'i rang bzhin las/ /dam pa'i de nyid nges bsgom bya/ /de rnams dam pa gcig yod min/ /rang rig bde ba chen po nyid/ /rang rig nas ni byang chub 'gyur / /rang rig phyir na bsgom pa nyid/ /rang gis darig pa'i 'gyur ba las / /dman pa pa las ni las skyes te/ /rang gis 'phrog 5 cing rang gis byed//rang rig rgyal po rang gtso bo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang phrag dog dang / /de bzhin gti mug nga rgyal nyid/ /de kun de gnas 6nyams dga' bar/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /chos 'byung las skyes ye shes ni/ /mkha' mnyam lhan cig thabs dang bcas/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /'jig rten gsum po de las skyes/ /khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan nyid / /de yi bde ba 'dod mar brjod/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba ste/ /skad cig gcig las mchog dga' ba/ /rang gis 8rig pa'i ye shes 'di/ / ngag gi 9rilam 'das spyod yul te/ /'di ni byin rlabs 1 rim pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu / /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /me dang nam mkha' nyid dag ni/ /rang gzhan nyu1rig pa'i tshor ba yis/ /kun gyis skad cig mi gnod de12/ /mtho ris mi yul rkang 'og gi/ /skad cig las ni gzugs gcig 'gyur/ /rang gzhan 1 cha yi byungarnam rtog gis/ /gnod 7pa nyid ni 7nus pa min/ /thams cad rig byed grub mtha' dang / /de bzhin las rgyas la sogs pas/ /srid pa dag 'gyur 1 dngos grub min/ /yang ni srid mthar skye bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /de med pas kyang dngos grub med/ /gang gis mi shes 80—25

kye'i 1rdo rje/ /de yi nangal ba don med 'gyur(5)/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du rnam capar gzhag /rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'du ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re'i (5nidabye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyi ne ni brjod par bya/ /phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sbyang 7bya/ /rang rig bdag nyid (8)dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /yul gyi dngos po dag pa'i phyir/ /rang gis rig pa'i bde ba 9mchog /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pas mthong ba/ /dngos po de kun dag pa ste/ /'di ltar 'gro ba sangs rgyas bdag1 tsho /kye bcom ldan 'das rnam par ma dag pa gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs la sogs pa'o/ /de nyu17ci'i slad du zhe na/ gzung 12ba dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das gzung ba dang 'dzin pa yang nya gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mig gis gzugs ni gzung bar bya/ /sgra ni rna bas mnyan par bya/ dri ni sna yis tshor bar bya/ /lce yis ro ni myang 1 sgyubar bya/ /dngos po lus kyis reg par bya/ /yid kyis bde sogs thob pa ni/ /dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /bsten bya 'di dag bsten pa nyid/ /80—26

gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la yang dkar mor brjod/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /rtag tu 'di dag rnam dag pas / /de nyid rnal 'byor pas 'grub 'gyur/ /nang gi 'phar ma la'o1 de nas phyi yi (5)'phar ma bshad/ /dbang ldan du ni puk+ka sī/ /mer ni de bzhin ri khrod ma/ /bden bral gdol pa mo bzhag cing / /rlung du g.yung mo rnam par bzhag /phyi nas 57lha mo dkar mo sogs/ /dbang dkar gshin rjer chom rkun ma / /chu bdag phyogs su ro langs ma/ /lus ngan por ni ghasma rī/ /'og tu sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /steng du mkha' spyod ma zhes bshad/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid kyi phyogs/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /lha mo 'di gnyis rnam par gnasari ri/ /gzugs la dkar mo 55rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags / /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma rī rab grags/ /reg 6la sa spyod ma zhes bshad/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /rtag tu 'di dag rnam dag pas/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas 'grub 'gyur/ /phyag gi dag pa stong pa nyid/ /bdud dag pa las zhabs rnams nyid/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis zhal rnams nyid/ /rdo rje gsum gyis dag pa'i spyan/ /sa ni puk+ka sī 7zhes bshad/ /chu khams rngon pa mo ri zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid / /gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad/ /zhe sdang la sogs rnam sbyong ba/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs las 9ni/ /'dis ni phung po sbyang bar bya/ /gang 80—27

dang gang gis 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /de dang des ni 'ching ba las grol te / /de nyid mi shes 'jig rten mi grol zhing / /de nyid rnam 6)spangs dngos grub rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de phyir dri med sgra med gzugs nyid med/ /ro dang sems kyi rnam par dag pa med/ /reg med chos med thams cad rnam par dag /rang bzhin dag pa'i 'gro la 'gro bar shes/ /rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas ji ltar dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rim pa yang dag rab tu bshad/ /gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba'i/ /cho ga'ang (gerab tu bshad par bya/ /dang por ①lha yi bdag nyid kyi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni nor 'dzin sbyang / /'bad pas hūm̐ 9)las rdo rje can/ /byas te phyi nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang / /dkyil 'khor dam pa rab tu bzhengs/ /rdul tshon (5)dam pa'i tshon dang ni / /yang na 'bring po nyid kyis te/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pas so / /de nas dkyil 'khor khru gsum dang / /mthe 97)bong gsum ni lhag par bya/ /der ni rigs 98lnga las byung ba'i/ /rig 59)ma bzang mo rnam par gzhug /yang na ji ltar gang rnyed de/ /de ltar bcu drug lon pa nyid//ji srid khu ba ldan gyur pa/ /de srid phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /phyag rgya'i gdong ni 1 bcing ba dang / /thabs kyi gdong yang de bzhin no/ /bsten pa de las gang byung ba/ /slob ma'i khar ni btung bar bya/ /ro mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid / /de nyid la yang bya bar bya/ /rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /rang 80—28

gzhan 0)yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab shin tu 'dres/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par 'dres/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa nyid/ /de nyid 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ /de nyid thams cad khyab pa po/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /dngos dang dngos med de las byung / /gzhan rnams (gegang rnams de rnams dang / /rnam par shes pa kun gyi tshul/ /skyes bu sngon rabs dbang phyug dang / /bdag dang gso ba sems can dang / /dus dang gang zag nyid dang ni/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /dang po dga' ba tsam nyid de/ /gnyis pa'i grangs las mchog dga' nyid/ /gsum pa las ri ni dga' bral bshad/ /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang ni/ /rdo rje snying po la ris)sogs kun/ /mkhas pas de skad nges thos nas(5) / /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyur nas ni/ /brgyal (6)zhing sa la 'gyel bar 'gyur / /dang po dga' ba 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /de bzhin mchog dga' 'gro ba nyid / /dga' bral dga' ba'ang 'gro ba nyid/ /gsum pa lhan cig skyes pa med / /bcom ldan bka' stsal kye'i rdo rje/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pa/ /rdo rje snying pos rtogs bya'i phyir/ /the tshom (7)legs par sel ba ni/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum po spangs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod/ /yang na de nyid thams cad bdag /yang na kun gyis rnam par spangs/ /de yang dga' bral dang por mtshon/ /dga' ba gsum po rnam par spangs/ /dang rin po sprin 80—29

dang 'dra ba yin1/ /grub pa sgyu ma lta bur (55'gyur/ / gnyid log sad par mi byed par/ /8nyal dang log pa'i khyad par las/ /rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur / /dngos grub mtshan nyid mi phyed pa'i/ /phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub / /ston pas dkyil 'khor 'di skad gsungs/ /gru bzhi yang dag 'bar ba nyid/ /sgo bzhi gzi brjid chen po ste/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /phreng ba sna tshogs rnga yab ldan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan/ /rdo rje srad bu mnyam par ldan/ /me tog sna tshogs nye bar brgyan/ /bdug pa mar me de bzhin dri/ /bum pa brgyad la sogs pa 4)ldan/ /de yang yal ga la sogs brgyan / /mgrin (5pa gos kyis dgab pa dang / /rin chen lnga ni yongs su gzhug /rnam par rgyal ba shar du sbyin/ /rang 'dod lha yi gzugs kyis ni/ /sar 6pa legs par bkal ba dang / /shin tu tshad ma (7mdzes pa yi(she/ /srad bus shes rab can gyis gdab/ /'khor lo'i bdag po'i bzlas 99)pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi de bzhin khri/ /gong du gsungs pa'i sngags nyid kyis/ /mkhas pas nor 'dzin rnam par sbyang / /gong gi a 3 )sogs sngags kyis ni/ /de la gtor ma rnam par sbyin/ /ji ltar bsam gtan de bzhin 'dir/ / bsrung ba 11ji ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /gang zhig dbang ni rab phye ba/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin/ /mchod dang gsol ba gdab pa nyid/ /ji ltar bshad pa de bzhin 'dir/ /'phar ma gnyis bzang rnam bris nas/ /myur du dkar mo la sogs bri/ /shar du gri gug rnam par bri/ /lho dang nub tu'ang de bzhin no/ /byang dang me yi mtshams dang ni/ /bden bral rlung du'ang de bzhin no/ /dbang ldan du ni ci gsungs pa/ /de lta de ltar 'og dang steng / /80—30

rdo rje sems dpa'i snyems byas nas/ /rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang 17byas te/ /phyag gnyis kye rdo rje sbyor bas(ge/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'jug pa nyid/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra dri zhim lus/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ snyems pa byas nas ni/ / tī tī rnam pas 'jigs byed bdagatshon /phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang / /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ /mchog dgar 4bsgom pa med cing sgom pa po yang med/ /lus kyang med cing gzung ba med dang 'dzin pa'ang med/ /sha dang khrag kyang med cing bshang 55)dang gci ba'ang med/ /skyug bro rmongs med gtsang sbra mchod phyir thogs med dang / /chags med sdang ba med dang rmongs med phrag dog med/ /ser sna med dang nga rgyal med cing mthong bya med / /bsgom (5)dang sgom pa po med bshes dang dgra med cing / /rlom sems med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i 57)sna tshogs nyid/ /rdo rje snying pos 'di skad gsol/ /gzod nas rang bzhin med pa yi/ /lus kyi rang bzhin dag pa ni/ /ci slad 'byung ba'i bdag nyid lags/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mkha' 'gro bde ba sbyin pas gsungs/ /rlom sems med pa'i rang bzhin bdagaci ri /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /kye bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du 'byung ba chen po las gyur (9)pa'i phung po lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bo la gak+ko la sbyor bas/ /reg pa sra ba'i chos kyis ni/ /sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur / /byang sems khu ba'i rnam pa las/ /chu yi khams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskyod pa las ni drod skye ste/ /'gro bas rlung du rab tu grags/ /bde ba nam mkha' 4 nyid kyi khams/ /lnga po rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /gang phyir 'byung 80—31

ba che bde ba/ /de phyir bde ba de nyid min/ /lhan cig skyes pas gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /phyag rgya rgyu dang bral ba las/ /yo gi snying rje thabs su 'gyur/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod/ /sngags kyi bzlas med dka' thub med dang sbyin sreg 6)med/ /dkyil 'khor can yang med cing dkyil 'khor yang ni med/ /de ni sngags bzlas de dka' 2thub dang de sbyin sreg( no /de ni dkyil 'khor can dang de ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /mdor bsdus nas (47ni sems ni 'dus pa'i gzugs can no/ /dbang gi le'u zhes bya ba 45)ste bcu pa'o// //mnyam par ma rungs dpral ba can/ /rtag tu ltung bar byed par brjod/ /dbang gi lta stangs g.yon na gnas/ /g.yon pa nas ni gzugs brnyan gnyis/ /g.yas pa'i cha la dgug pa nyid/ /steng nas kyang ni gzugs brnyan gnyis/ /dbu ma rengs pa'i lta stangs nyid/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbus su gnyis/ /'byung 56)ba nyid kyis ltung bar byed/ /rngub pa yis ni dbang du byed/ /dgang ba yis ni dgug pa nyid/ /gzhil kyib yis ni rengs par byed/ /rlon na pa'i shing la ltung byed nyid/ /dbang ni me tog rab tu grags/ /rdo rje'i shing la dgug pa nyid/ /g.yo bcas rtsa 9la rengs byed nyid/ /zla drug goms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom ngamed/ /'di la 'khrul ba 61mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /lta stangs bzhi po bsgrubs nas ni/ /mkhas pas sems can gzhug par bya/ /gsad (1 par 'di la bya ma 1 yin/ /dam tshig nges par 80—32

nyams par 'gyur/ /sems can slu ba spangs nas ni/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad bya/ /sems can gnod pa tsam gyis ni/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub rnyed mi 'gyur / /de la dam tshig bza' bya ba/ /na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi shwa dang 6)dang po'i sha(mi/ / kye'i rdo rje yi 55)dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'/ /kye yi (4)rdo rjes gsungs (5rimatshan nyid/ /skye ba bdun pa'ang (6)de nas mtshon/ /dga' bral dga' ba la smod (7pa/ /lan bdun pas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /skad snyan mig dang ldan pa dang / /dri lus gzi 8brjid chen po dang (9ste/ /de yi grib ma bdun du 'gyur/ /mthong nas rnal 'byor pa yis mtshon/ /de ni zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig las 1 rini mkha' spyod 'gyur/ /ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par17/ /rgyas par gsungs pa mdo ru bsdu/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /kha dog dmar zhing phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' dang gzhu yi lag pa ma/ /ut+pa la dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'di ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed/ /'bum phrag gcig gis rgyal po rnams/ /khri yis 'jig rten phal pa nyid/ /bye bas phyugs dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'bum phrag bdun gyis lha ma yin/ /'bum phrag gnyis kyis lha rnams nyid/ /brgya phrag gcig gis sngags pa nyid/ /kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa las rdo rje snying po mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba brtag 12pa'i rgyal po rdzogs so1lha// //rdo rje nyu snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 7rdo rje snying po bdag /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /rab gnas mtshan nyid bzang po nyid/ /80—33

rim pa ji bzhin bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ci gsungs sbyin sreg 1byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs pa dang / /snga dbar sku gzugs sbyang ba dang / /sta gon la sogs byas nas ni/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /sku gzugs snying gar 55)rab tu gzhugal/rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rab mthong 5)sngags kyi pha rol son/ /oṃ badz+ra phusne āḥ6zhu swā hā/ o badz+ra dhū pe āḥ(7rgyu swā hā/ o badz+ra dī pe āḥ58)rgyu swā hā / oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ95rgyu swā hā1 tsho/ oṃ badz+ra nai we bye āḥrgyu swā hā/ sna tshogs hūṃ ni rdzogs pa dang / /me tog la sogs dbul ba nyid/ /song ma'i rgyud kyi chog rim pas/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil yo17gong ma bzhin/ /zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po nyid/ /rgyas pa nyid kyi gru bzhi pa/ /gsad / pa la ni gru gsum brjod/ /'di nyid la ni lhag ma bsgrub3ge/ /khru gang dang ni khru phyed nyid/ /zhi ba'i steng dang 'og tu yin/ /khru do skadang ni khru gang nyid/ /rgyas pa'i steng dang 'og tu brjod / /sor mo nyi shu'am de yi phyed/ /gsad nya5pa'i steng dang 'og tu yang / /zhi bar kha dog dkar por 7'gyur/ /rgyas par ser po sna de bzhin no/ /gsad zhi pa la ni kha dog gnag19 /dbang la dmar por rab tu grags/ /dbang la ji bzhin de ltar dgug /gsad 2 la ji ltar zhe sdang sogs/ /zhi la 31til dang rgyas la zho/ /gsad na la tsher ma de bzhin no/ /snang la sogs pa'ang tsher mar brjod / /dbang dang dgug la ut+pa la/ oṃ asne 22ma hā te dzā/ sarba kurma pra sā dha gaḥ kā ru ñcā kṛ ta satwa arba 2 a smin sarnyi hi to bha ba gi/ me dgug pa'o/ /ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ / kye yi na rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur / /che ge bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'dri snye/ /sarbartse zhu rib pa 80—34

rār+sha: 6)sā dhi tai gats+tsha ha bya bhu ka /ā ga mi ṣ+pe si ya thā kā le sarba nasasid+dhi dku ru ṣa came / me dga' ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ sa raṃ mchod yon gyi sngags so / /oṃ nī rī ti hūm̐ khoḥzhabs bsil (5)gyi sngags so/ /oṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ lha bshos kyi sngags so/ /kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa las brtag pa gnyis pa 6rab gnas kyi le'u ste dang po'o// //rdo rje snying pos gsol pa(7ri/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kun la/ /rgya mtshor ku (8)ba ji lta bar/ /rang 'dod lha yi gzugs las ni/ /sems can ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa 'am/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang / /dngos grub 'dod pas mi gnas so/ /dang po goms par byed dus kyi/ /gnas ni gang du bsngags 9)pa'i sems/ /gcig tu mnyam gzhag 1 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas ni bzang po 11 nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du mtshan dus su/ /bdag nyid 'grub 12pa'i sems kyis ni/ rnal 'byor ma bsgom shes rab can/ /yang na he ru ka dpal gzugs/ /rkang pa 'khrud 1 dang za ba dang / /'thor 'thung so rtsi za ba dang / tsan+dan gyis ni lag nyed 1 dang / /smad g.yogs kyis ni rked 'gebs dang / /'byung nyugedang smra dang 'gro ba dang / /'dug dang khro dang rgod pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das ma bsten sapa dang / /shes rab brtul zhugs can nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnam par bsgom / /gzhan gyi tshul gyis skad cig kyang / /gdug 1 pa'i sems ni mi rigs pas / /dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir/ /mkhas pas 'bad pas mi 80—35

gnas so/ /bsam 1tshogatan nyon mongs 'jig (gebyed pa/ /rdo rje snying po nga yis bshad / /brtse bas dngos grub don du yang / /zla ba phyed du yongs su rtogs(5)/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /lha yi gzugs su sems pa yis/ /nyi ma gcig tu ma chad par/ /bsgom (hopas yongs su brtag par gyis(5)/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub 56phyir/ /'khor bar thabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /rig ma lhan cig goms byas pas/ /'phral du mngon du byed pa nyid/ 'jigs smyo 7de bzhin sdug bsngal dang / /mya ngan gdung ba 'tshe (8)ba dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ches9)/ /sgrub nyu )pa po ni nyon mi mongs/ /phan dang gnod pa'i 'bras 'byung bar/ /de ltar nges par shes nas ni/ /ji ltar de ni skad cig kyang / /rnal 'byor ma 11rnams ngu 'bod gnas/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang / /gzhan yang skye ba dman gang dang / /rmongs dang ma rungs las byed dang / /gzugs ngan yan lag ma tshang ba'ang / /bsams 12pas de rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /dge ba bcu la goms pa dang / /bla ma la gus dbang po dul/ /nga rgyal khro las tsho rnam par grol / /des 1 ni re zhig minges 'grub 'gyur/ /rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis / /mnyam par bzhag sapas dngos grub 'thob3 tsho/ /zla ba gcig tu gsang la spyad/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma rnyed 18par/ /gnang ba rnyed gyur tsho)sngags pa la/ /rnal 'byor ma yis bstan par bya/ /phyag rgya che ge mo khyer la/ /sems can don gyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnyed pa de yang mig yangs ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan / /si h+la ga bur yang dag ldan/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam par sbyang / /dge ba bcu las 21brtsams nas ni/ /de la chos ni rab tu dbye/ /80—36

lha yi gzugs kyi sems dang ni/ /dam tshig sems dang gcig pa nyid/ /zla ba gcig gis skal ldan par/ /'gyur bar 0tsho'adi la the tshom (na)med/ /mchog thob pa yi ①bud med gang / /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /yang na bdag gi ④nus pa yis/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /gnod sbyin mi 'am ci las kyang / /phyag rgya bkug (3)la rab tu brtag /de (6)yang khyer la spyod pa spyad/ /bdag gi 577dal ba mngon du'i phyir/ /gang bshad 'jigs pa'i gzugs can gyi//spyod pa longs spyod phyir ma gsungs/ /yid ni brtan nam g.yo 'am ci/ /rang gi sems ni so sor brtag /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /phyag rgya (8)nyid ces ji ltar brjod/ /phyag rgya phyag rgya nyid 59dag gis/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub ji ltar 'gyuranyuge/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bud med gzugs ni spangs nas ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi /1gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa po lar / 'gyur/ /gak+ko la dbus yang dag gnas / /'gram gnyis dril bu nyid du 'gyur/ /ze'u nyu 'bru bo la can du 'gyur / /lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid/ /dpa' 7chen he ru ka yi skagazugs / /he ru ka sbyor skyes bu nyid/ /'bad pa tshumed par skyes bur 41 'gyur//gsal bar nus pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / de phyir tsho phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur/ / chags dang (rta'ajig pa dag gis kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gnod mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir thabs ni 'byung ba nyid / /'jig pa shes rab srid mthar byed/ /des na rab 'jig yod ma yin/ /de nyid la ni chags pa med/ /la la 'jig na ripas 'jig par 'gyur/ /'jig pa'i dngos med zad pa med/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom/ / spros pa 80—37

rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /1spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang / /ji ltar bar ma'i srid yin pa/ /rtag tu goms par (5)sbyor ba las/ /dkyil 'khor nyid ni de bzhin 'dod/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ri dbang bskur bzhi)/ /ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po/ /'di ni de yi byin brlabs (5)yin/ /gzhan las dkyil 'khor 'byung ba med/ /bde ba gnag (6 cing bde ba ser/ /bde ba dmar po bde ba dkar/ /bde ba ljang gu 7ribade ba sngo/ /bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun / /bde ba shes rab bde ba thabs/ /de bzhin kun tu ru skyes bde/ /bde ba dngos dang 8dngos med bde/ /rdo rje 9sems dpa' bde bar brjod/ /rdo rje snying ngo sa gsol pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /de yi bde ba bde chen brjod/ /rdzogs pa bsgom pa med pa ste/ /bskyed pa yis ni ci zhig 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /e ma'o byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med gang las bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ /khyab dang 1 khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med pas/ /bde ba nyid kyang dmigs 11med 'gyur/ / dngos nga dngos po med pa nga / /12dngos po rtogs phyir sangs rgyas nga / /gang zhig le los bsnun pa dang / /rmongs pa gang gis nga mi shes/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga ni/ /e yi rnam pa'i cha byad gzugs/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can du rtag tu bzhugs/ /'chad pa po nga 1 chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa 1 nga / /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga / /lhan cig skyes dga'i 8(1—38

de nas rab tu bzhad mdzad nas/ /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ / kye yi 1rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /gtso bo cho ga gang gis dang / /de bzhin bya ba gang gis ni/ / kye rdo rje yi bris sku ni na)/ /byed pa bde ba chen pos gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dir ni 'dri ri mkhan dam tshig can/ /sgrub po'ang dam tshig can gyis ni/ /bris 4sku 'jigs pa bri ba nyid/ /skyes pa'i thod gnas kha dog lnga/ /ro yi skra 5yi pir nyid kyis/ /bris ( sku bla ma bri ba nyid/ /gang gang skud pa 'khal 7ba dang / /gang gang ras yug 'thag 8)pa yang / /de yang dam tshig can nges pas/ /dam tshig byin rlabs 9rnal 'byor pas1 / /zla ba zla ba'i mar ngo yi/ /bcu bzhi pa la khyim dben par/ /phyed na ma rungs sems kyis ni / /chang gi btung ba cung zad las/ /lus la ni raṃ shu bsams 11nas/ /de bzhin gcer bur gyur pas kyang / /'bags 12pa dang ni ma dag pas/ /de nas dam tshig rab tu bza'/ /bzhin bzangs 1 snying rje ldan pa dang / /gzugs dang lang tsho skal bzang ma/ /me tog bcas shing sgrub por dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya g.yon du gzhag /kye'i rdo rje las bris sku'i 1 cho ga'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas de la lha mos zhus/ /bol+la 12kak+ko la sbyar nas/ /tshems kyis sa ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /glegs bam yang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pas lha yis rab phye ba/ /glegs bam nga yis bshad bya yis1 / /lha mo skal ba 18chen mo nyon/ /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ / mi yi 19rus pa'i smyu gus ni/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /gro gar 21dam 80—65

tshig nyu)can gyis bri/ /glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal med mthong na ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul med / /yang dag rab sbyin ldan pa la/ /res 'ga' tsam zhig bstan pa nyid/ /glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung nyid du sba/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag rinanas/ /yang dang yang du 'o mdzad nas/ /bde chen mnyam par myong dmadzad de/ /rdo rje can gyis (gi)bza' ba bstan(5)/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bza' ba ni sku/ /nyon cig lha mo mig yangs ma/ /gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/ /sgrub pa can gyi (pedangos grub 'gyur/ /dur khrod ri yi (8)bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang / /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar 9/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'7/ /de la gdan du brtag (skyepa ni/ /ro yi gzugs can dgu dang ni/ /yang na stag gi pags (nyapa dang / /dur khrod ras ni de bzhin no/ /dbus su kye rdo rje yi (stegazugs/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin gnas shes nas/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu yang / /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams dgod/ /bodam tshig mā la tiñca 8rna/ /stag gi pags ⑩pa'i steng du bza'/ /'bad pas rgyal po sā yo tsholu yi/ /bza' ba der ni bza' ba nyid / /der ni zos nas zos nas kyang (snye/ /der ni ma mo mchod par bya/ /sring mo bu mo sgyug 17mo dang / /gal te ma sring yin na yang / /de rnams rtag 6 )tu legs mchod na/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig 27par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la dbul 2skal chen ma/ /phyag 'tshal ( snyenas ni rang yang btung / /pad+ma'i lag pas blangs pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du rab 80—66

'dud pa/ /de ltar sgrub 0)pa po yis bya/ /kye'i rdo rje las bza' ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor mas zhus pa/ /phyag rgya chen po ji lta bu/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bde ba sbyin pas (7bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shin tu ring min thung ba min/ /gnag (5)pa ma yin dkar ba min/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ④ma'i rnam pa 'dra/ /de yi dbugs ni dri zhim ldan/ /rdul kyang dri zhim ldan 'gyur te/ /ri dgas (༄ste ba'i dri dang mtshungs / /pad+ma la yang dbang mchog (6)dri/ /skad cig pad+ma lta bu ( )'byung / / de yi (mig bur sih+la dag /mkhas pas dri bzang mtshon par bya/ /ut+pa (9kyel yi drir 'gyur zhing / /a ka yiru ni nag po mtshungs/ /dal zhing mi g.yo ba nyid dang / /snyan par smra zhing yid 'ong ma/ /skra bzang dbus su gnyer ma gsum/ /phal pas pad+ma can du brjod/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /de rnyed 17nas ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma nyugebadag med mas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das smon lam ji ltar gdab par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi tshonardo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam bzas yican/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /de nas lha mo de dgyes nas/ /tshig ni 'di nyid yang zhus pa/ /skal med sems can gdul 'daka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /80—67

dang por gso sbyong sbyin par 1bya/ /de rjes bslab dpa'i gnas bcu nyidari ni/ /de la bye brag smra ba 4bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes la 5nodabu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas / /de rjes kye yi dzirdo rje brtsam/ /slob mas gus par k+ṣ-i blangs nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom 8med/ /kye'i rdo rje las 'dul ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas kha sbyar 'byed pa yi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab tu bshad/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /bsgrub bya'i lte ba'i rtsa ba la/ /brtul zhugs can gyi 99lag pas gdon1 / /he ru ka mnyam rnal 'byor gyis/ /nang gi ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /'di ni bsgoms 11pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig12 /bstan la gnod pa byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa ni/ /bla ma thub pa la zhus nas/ /snying rjes gsad 15par bya ba nyid/ /ji ltar phyugs kyi gzugs mthong nas/ /khrag ni skyugs 1 pa nyid dang yang / /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba dang / kha ni 'og tu rnam par sgom15/ /de yi lam du khab ni me'i/ /gzugs can 'jug par bsam pa ste/ /snying gar sabyin za'i sa bon nyid/ /dmigs nas skad cig gsod par byed/ /rgyud 'di la ni sreg blugs 17med/ /phyag rgya bcing 18dang bya ba'ang med/ /rgyud chen bklags 19pas 'grub pa nyid/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtog med dngos grub sbyin pa po/ /srid pa sbyong ba nyams dga' bar/ /gsang ba mchog ni bshad bya yis 1/ /nyon cig lha mo 80—68

bzhin bzangs 1)ma/ /rin chen gzi brjid 'bar ba yi/ /phreng ba 'khrugs 2pa lha mo ltos/ /ma phug pas ni sbyor bral 'gyur/ /phug pas dga' ba sbyin pa'o(8 / /de ltar 'khor bar 94ri'adod pa yi/ /yon tan lnga ldan rin chen nyid/ /ma dag pas ni dug tu 'gro/ /dag pas 5bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rnam pa he ru ka /'gro ba sgrol ba'i gtso bo nyid/ /gang gi gzugs kyis ne'agyur ba nyid/ /de ni nga yis smra yis 7nyon/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la /byams pa'i thugs la 8yan lag gnag9ri /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed 1 rikyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug 1 ripa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /12sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma / /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags sna pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /bdag med mas gsol pa/ sngags btu ba ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /gang gi sngags kyis 1 skye bo yi/ /las kyi dngos grub 15'gyur ba nyid/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol / /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po/ rdo rje snying po gzi brjid chen pos bka' stsal pa/ sngags ni khyod la ngas bshad kyis17/ /lha mo shes rab chen mo 1 nyon/ /dang por 918rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /uṣ+ṭha 19rnams kyi 2 ribazhi pa la / /puk+ka sīs brgyan 21stong pas mnan/ /mdog dkar mthar 2 ni swā hā sbyar / /'dis ni bzlas pa 'bum gyis ni ri/ /'gro ba rtas tu rengs par byed//dang por yi ge'i bdag po bzhag na /de rjes mkha' spyod ma de 2 /nas/ /mthar ni swā hā sbyar byas nas / /sangs rgyas rnams kyang dbang du byed/ /rig byed 863—69

rnams kyi (1chodang po sbyin/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa la/ /stong bcas mtha' ⑧ni swā hā sbyar/ /sangs rgyas kyang skyod shes rab can/ /dang por ①rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /rwa 6)dang ldan zhing chu mas brgyan(zhe//stong bcas swā hā yang dag ldan/ /mi rnams thams cad sdang bar byed/ /dang po 65yi ge'i dbang phyug bzhag /lnga pa nyid kyi gsum pa la/ /stong pa mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /mthar ni swā hā mngon spyod che/ /yang ni yi ge'i thu bo sbyin/ /hūm̐ ni khrag dang 'dra ba yi57/ /mthar ni swā hā thig le mchog /dga' bzang (8)ma sogs rtag tu 'gugs/ /gti mug rigs ni dang por sbyin/ /ghu ni yang dag rab tu sbyar/ /mthar ni swā hā yang byas na/ /lha dang mi rnams gsod 5)par byed / /dang por rnam par snang mdzad bzhag /dang po nyid kyi dang po la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang sbyar/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /yang na zhi tshodang po'i rtse mo la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /yang ni de nyid yang dag ldan/ /steng du chom rkun ma yis 17brgyan/ /de rjes hrīḥyi yis rnam par sbyar/ /mthar yang swā hā spyod pa nyid/ /ku ru kul+le'i 12sngags so/ /oṃ ni dang po bzhi pa yi/ /gsum pa chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la/ /pi tsu badz+ra sbyar ba dang / /uṣ+ṭha sarnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /puk+ka sī yis rnam par brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /kye'i rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /snang mdzad dang por dz+wa la gnyis / /sbyar nas lnga pa'i bzhi pa la/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi dang po ldan/ /ghasma rīs 15ni rnam par brgyan/ /uṣ+ṭha 97rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 80—70

ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ phyag bzhi pa'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang dang po yi/ /dang po nang gi dkar mos brgyan/ /gsum pa 1)nyid kyi dang po la/ /nang gi dkar mos rnam par brgyan/ /nyis 'gyur lnga pa'i gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa'i gsum pa me yis brgyan/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa 9nagasum sbyar nas/ /lnga pa nyid kyi gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /phyag drug pa'i sngags so/ /dang po rnam snang bzhi pa yi/ /dang po byin ( za yang dag ldan/ /ro langs ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi (4)gsum pa la/ /ghasma rī (5)yis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po yi ni dang po la/ /mthar gnas pa yi dang po dang / /rdo rje ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /k+ṣa ni chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /lnga pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /uṣ+ṭha (6)rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur te/ /phaṭa dang mthar ni swā hā nyid/ /phyag gnyis pa'i sngags so/ /bdag med dang po'i dang po dang / /gnyis pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /gsum pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas rnams kyi dang po dang / /uṣ+ṭha (7rnams kyi dang po nyid/ /dang por rnam snang mthar swā hā/ /grong khyer dkrug (8)pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ni 'bum mo/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi gnyis pa dang / /k+ṣa yi rnam pa nyis (9)'gyur nyid/ /hūṃ gi rnam pa gsum dang ldan/ /dang por tsornam snang phaṭa (11)nyid kyi/ /rnam pa nang bcug mthar swā hā/ sa sbyangs pa'i tsho sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang de rjes su/ /rdo rje ma tu yi mthar ru hūm̐/ /bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlab khapa'o/ /80—71

dang por rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /de rjes a kā ro mu khaṃ/ /uṣ+ṭha tsho1rnams kyi gsum pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa ni/ /steng du me yis rnam par brgyan / / dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ 2de rjes rdo rje ma/ /byin la dra /nut+pan+da tāta no/ /oṃ āḥ5ni: phaṭa swā hā/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /kye'i rdo rje las sngags btu tshoba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas chos 7kun 8sdom gcig pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byas gsungs / /bdag med ma la 'o mdzad nas/ /bzlas pa'i yul ni rab tu dbye/ /shel gyis rengs pa'i bzlas pa nyid/ /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po nyid/ /lung tang 10gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ni raṃ shus ni sdang 11ba la/ /rta yi rus pas skyod pa nyid/ /bram ze'i rus pas 'gugs 12pa nyid/ /glang po'i rus pas char pa la/ /ma he yis kyang gsad 1 pa la/ /rengs pa 'o ma'i btung ba nyid/ /dbang la rang gi 1 'dun pas spyad/ /gsad 15pa la ni sih+la nyid/ /dgug 15pa la ni bzhi mnyam nyid/ /sdang la sā 1 lu skyes pa brjod/ /bskrad pa nyid la gla rtsir 1 brjod/ /yang na mtha'i shwa dang / dang po'i shwa dang / na dang po dang /ga dang po dang / ha dang po nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /kye'i rdo rje las bzlas pa'i le'u 19ste bcu pa'o// //kye'i rdo rje la dam 'khyud 2 cing / /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi rigs kyi gzugs/ /de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /bha gar ling ga gzhag 1nas ni/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pas 'di skad gsungs/ /863—72

lus can rang gi rigs bshad kyis(17/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma nyon/ /bud med dam ni skyes pa yi(2/ /gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur pa / /mi bskyod (8)pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi 'khor lor 'gyur / /dpag med mgon gyi 'dam skyes nyid/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i 4rin chen nyid/ /las kyi rigs kyi ral gri nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang nag po chen/ /de yi lha ni mi bskyod 6pa/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar po che/ /de yi lha ni rnam snang mdzad/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sngo bsangs che/ /de yi lha ni don yod nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ser po che/ /rin chen bdag po rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dmar nyid/ /'od dpag med pa rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dang ser/ /de ni sems dpa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /skye bo rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas/ /nga rgyal mi bcag tho mi btsam / /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /de rnams bde gshegs rigs su 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi mtshan nyid nin/ /ji ltar skyes pa de bzhin no/ /kun rdzob tha snyad tshul las ni / /de yi rigs su'ang de 'gyur ro/ /bha gar ling ga'i 'o mdzad nas/ /de la rdo rje che mnyes nas/ /bdag med ma yis go mdzad pa/ /lha mo rab tu mchod pa nyon/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /bdag gi khyim gyi nang du yang / /gcer bu 9phyag rgya cher 10byas nas/ /rnal 'byor rig 11pas rtag tu mchod / /'o dang 'khyud pa byas nas ni/ /de bzhin bha gar reg pa 1 nyid/ /skyes pa'i sna ni gzhib pa nyid/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung ba nyid/ /rtag tu myos pa'i mtshan ma las/ /bo la ldan pas lag pas bya/ /khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu bkal ba yi na/ /yang yang rdo rjes 1 'dod pa 80—73

bya / /steng dang 'og tu lta 1)ba nyid/ /dngos grub rgyas pa thob pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de la ga pur btung bar bya/ /de la ga pur rgyu yi (2phyir/ /sha ni bza' ba nyid du bya(kye/ /khyad par du ni chang nyid do / /kye'i rdo rje las lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba don gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas rdo rje can gyis (4༄dbang / /bzhi pa'i tshigs bcad (5)bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid/ /che dang dril bu chen po bzung (6)/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur(7)/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi (gyirgyun gyis dbang bskur ro1)/ /lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /ye shes 'di ni ches ⑩phya zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral thar sbyin (1zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang 12yang ni de yi pha/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab yo pa'i sngags ninyi tsho / o pad+ma su khā dhā skor ma hā rā ga 7su khaṃ da da tsa tu rā nan+da tu)rtswa ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kāḥ ku ru ṣ+ṭa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwo ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya maḥkha ga mu khe tunyeka ra so nā tha hūm̐ 19rtsu hūm̐ kāru ku ru ṣ+ṭa me tsho/ spyi bor ni oṃ gyi rnam pa/ snying gar ( 7ni 32rgyu gi rnam pa/ ze 'bru la ni āḥ'i ‘ sternam pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las phyung ba brtag pa gnyis kyi 2 /bdag nyid kye'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro 3nyam dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud ( nyakyi rgyal po 80—74
