rnal 'byor rab tu bsgrub1/ /rdo rje'i dbang po sngon po ste/ /zla ba chu shel nathub chen gyi/ /mkhar phyin skyes pa'i me tog dmar/ / nor bu dmar rgyal mkha' mdzod kyi/ /8pad+ma rā ga saspyan ras gzigs/ / rta yi'ang ma ra ka (5ta ste/ /rin chen lnga yi rdul mtshon nemachog /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur 'byung po 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /dam tshig yang dag rab phye ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i sa bon bdag /dbang po sngon po lta bu'i 'od/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs byed chen po ste/ /mdzes pa'i khro 7bo yi ni lus/ /dbang ldan 'byung po mnan pa ste/ /g.yas pas rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /lag pa g.yon pas mi /lpags nyid/ /gnyis po dag gis phyag rgyar sbyor/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang tho9 bas yang dag gnas/ /cung zad mche bas 'jigs par byed/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i rgyan mchog ste/ /mgo 'dzings phyed du bcings par ni/ /ri yi rtse mor bsgom par bya/ /'byung po 'dul bar 'grub par 'gyur/ rme/ /gnod sbyin du ma 'byung po dang / /gnod sbyin mo dang klu mo dang / /mi mo lha yi mdzes ma ni/ /sgrub pa po yis nges par 'grub / /sngags ni/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā 11ma ra bhū tā dhi 12pa ti ak+ko bh+ya ki rī 1 shi khan sarba bobyu lata pre ta pi shā ṭī na 17sā dha ya 1 rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur stobs po che'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /char chen rab tu dbab bya ste/ /pad+ma 'dab 16ma brgyad pa bsam/ /der ni klu brgyad dgod par bya/ /stobs po che ni rab sbyor bas/ /de rnams rnga ma yang dag mnan 1/ /char med stobs po che las ni/ /chu yi tshogs ni dbab par bya /kha dog nag 2 cing cher gsal ba/ /'jigs pa yang 2 ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /80wa 98

phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /skur nyi rdo rje gdan mdzad pa/ /phyag rnams kyis (1)ni klu bdag rnams(na/ /phuḥzhes bya ba'i sngags zlos zhing / /hūm̐ dag nang du chud byas te/ /phaṭa ni mtha' ru sbyar bar bya/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /gnyis pa zla 'od bzang po nyid/ /gsum pa ser po'i mdog lta bu/ /bzhi pa dmar po nyid du brjod/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis yan lag 4)brgyan/ /rdo rje sems dpas rnam par brgyan5)/ /klu rnams kyis 6)ni char dbab phyir/ /stobs po che ni rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'dzin pa rdo rje gur smra ba pos sangs rgyas kyi de kho na dbye bar bya'o//rdo rje pad+ma 'o byas dang / /ri dgas 7brgyan 8)pa zos pa dang / /rdo rje chu 'thung nor ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas de nyid 'di 59rig pa/ /dag pa'i gnas ni gnas chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab gang ba/ /rdo rje rin chen kun khyab pa/ /gang gyur nga yis bshad par bya/ /phan pa'i grong khyer yid 'ong bar/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje lu 1 7gu rgyud/ /zhen pa chen po sangs rgyas kun/ /lcags sgrog rdo rjes bcing bar 11bya/ /dga' ldan du ni ldeg par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams mi'adod pa thob/ /rgyal ba mgon po byams pa ni/ /ye shes spyan gyis rnam par gzigs / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bcings pas/ /rgyal po'i 12tshogs rnams bcing bar 1 bya/ /gang zhig dngos grub mi ster na/ /sgrog gis bcings nas dgug par bya/ /rdo rje kyo ba dkar mo che/ /rdo rje zhags pa 1 chom rkun ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ro langs ma15/ /rdo rje dril bu ghasma rīs/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dbang du byed/ /bzlas dang bsgom 1 pa mngon dga' ba'i/ /dngos grub gal te mi ster na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni drag shul 80—99

bsgrub1ri / /de nas rdo rje 'dzin gyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi nang du 'bum phrag lnga bris pa yang dag par bshad par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni dkyil 'khor 'bum/ /rdo rje can gyi de bzhin 'bum/ /'bum gyis rdo rje nyi ma yi / /'bum gyis rdo rje chos tshon kyi'o/ /'bum phrag phyed kyis rdo rje ste/ /'byung po 'dul ba stong phrag lngas/ /lnga yis las ni rab rgyas pa/ /lnga (da yis sangs rgyas gar mkhan nyid/ /stong phrag sum cu dag gis ni/ /ku ru kul+le brtag ri tsho pa'o / /lhag ma stong phrag lnga yis ni/ cho ga'i rim brgyud 5)kun gyi'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro kye rdo rje yitsi/ /'bum phrag lnga ni bris pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa blo dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur sangs rgyas kyi gar gyi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs 7so/ /gar dang glu la rab zhen pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir / /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rdo rje yis / /'dod chags can gyi 98byang chub sgrub99/ /de nas rdo rje can 'byung ste/ /me tog snyim 1 tshopas rab sbyor bas/ /sems can kun la phan ldan pa'i/ /dam tshig der ni bshad par bya/ /sems can ji snyed pa rnams sems can du (1bsdu bas bsdus pa sgo 12nga las skyes pa'am/ mngal las skyes pa'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa'am/ rdzus 1 te skyes pa'am/ gzugs can rnams sam/ gzugs med rnams sam/ 'du shes can rnams sam/4 ) 'du shes med pa can nyid rnams sam/ 'du shes med pa pa 35rnams sam/ sems can de rnams thams cad bdag gis kyang phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bya'o/ /dam tshig che bshad de nas ni/ /zur mig mi g.yo mngon 7byung ste/ /mi bskyod rngi ye shes brnyes 18ldan pa'i/ /ston pa la ni rnam par smod/ /ci khyod dam tshig hūm̐ zhes bya//80—100

thub pa chen po gzhu can yin/ /nga min 0)snying rje'i stobs dpal naldan/ /bdag stobs bcom pa min nam ci/ /ci khyod dam tshig oṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni tshangs pa thub pa rnams/ /nga min tshos)rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /khyod ni me bcom 'dod pa bral/ /ci khyod dam tshig āḥ(4)zhes bya/ /mnga' bdag mkha' lding mkhyen nam ci/ /nga min (gepad+ma gar dbang dpal/ /khyod ni gar mkhan nyer bzhad mkhan/ /ci khyod dam tshig ṭ+wāṃ 96zhes bya/ /khyod ni gdugs te tsha ba 'phrog /nga min 7)rdo rje nyi ma dpal/ /gdugs kyi rnam khyod ji ltar min/ /ci khyod dam tshig khaṃ zhes bya/ /khyod ni mkha' stong rang bzhin no/ /nga min 8rdo rje mgyogs 'gro yin/ /khyod ni rta ste pha rol 'gro/ /ci khyod dam tshig snying rje 'chang e ma chang 'tshong 9)mdzes ma'o/ /mi g.yo bdag ming 1 mā ma khri11/ /zhang po'i grong khyer 'dzin nam ci/ / ci khyod 1 dam tshig zhi ba nyid/ /bud med g.yo sgyu 'dzin nam ci/ /bdag ni ma yin lha mo spyan/ /spyan yin na ni g.yo dang bcas/ /ci khyod dam tshig 'dod chags che/ /smad 'tshong 12ma la smrar ci yod/ /bdag ming lha mo dkar mo'o1 ‘/ /ji ltar dri ma dkar ba yin/ /ci khyod dam tshig dbang byed tshes/ /btsun mo'i pho nya min nam ci/ /bdag ming chosazur mig sgrol ma'o/ /sgrol ma mig ni bcom pa yin/ /mig g.yon 1 bdag ni nor ldan dpal/ /de ltar ngo tsha med pas legs/ /ngo tsha med pas sangs rgyas min / /mthong dang mi mthun myur du smros/ /de nas rdo rje mig yon po/ /smod pa pos ni rab gsungs pa18/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang che/ /thub pa rnam par snang mdzad rmongs/ 'dod la sna zhen pa 'jig rten bdag /ser sna rdo rje snang byed de / /don yod skyon ni thams cad byed/ /'dren pa lnga ni skyon ldan 80wa 101

no / /sgong skyes mngal nas skyes pa 'am/ /drod gsher skyes dang mtha' 'khob bzhin / /gzugs can rnams sam gzugs med dam/ /rdzus 91)nas skyes pa nyid dang ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bya'o zhes/ /khyod kyis dang po (gegasungs pa la / /khyod nyid sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /de rnams ji ltar rgyal ma mdzad/ /de nyid phyir na brdzun gsungs pa / /mnga' bdag ji ltar 'di ma gsungs/ /sems can bslus na khyod kyi 5gang / /sangs rgyas nyid de ngo mtshar rmad/ /'chi bdud 6tshe 'am mu ge 'am/ /phas kyi 7'khor lo'i gnod pa dang / /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /char med pa dang zhi ba la98/ /sngags dang bsgom 9par ldan par ni/ /gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol pa/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste/ /der ni brdzun 1 du mi 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon lnga dang lha mo bzhi/ /mi g.yo bdag nyid smod pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i gnas nyid du/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa mdzad/ /khams gsum de bzhin rtsa ba 'am/ /ma dag pa'i yang rgyan rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gar mkhan gar/ /bde ba dga' bar byed dang bcas/ /chos 'byung grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje dam tshig glu 11yis dang / /rdo rje rkang pa'i gom 1 pas gar/ /mthar ni rdza rnga lā 1 su 1 sogs/ /phyag rgya chen po rab ster ba'i/ /'di 15nyid 'dir ni cher gsang ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' ji bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad pas 17bsrung bar bya/ /glu lha sna tshogs dang rol mo'i sgra dang gar dang 'dul bar 'jug pa dang char dbab pa dang mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //80—102

de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ 'byung po'i gtor ma gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ / pad+ma 'dab brgyad 1bsgom par bya/ /dbang po shar gyi 'dab namar bsam/ /mthar byed lhor ni dgod par bya/ / chu bdag nub kyi 'dab cam la/ /byang du nor sbyin dgod par bya/ /mer ni byin za chen po nyid/ /bden bral mtshams skyong de bzhin no/ /rlung du gnas med bsam par bya/ /dbang ldan du ni 'byung po'i gtso/ /zla nyi tshangs pa la 55sogs dang / /tshangs pa'i ris ni dam pa dang / /tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don mo nyid dang / /dga' ldan 'thab bral gnas pa dang / /rgyal po chen por gyur pa dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang sgyur 7nyid dang ni/ /gang zhig 'phrul dga'i gnas rnams dang / /gtsang ma'i gnas su gang gnas dang / /bde ba can du 'dug pa dang / /'og min du ni gnas pa dang / /'od zer can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa dang / /de kun steng du gnas par bya/ /chos 'byung nang du son pa ni/ /stobs kyis 8rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni rigs ldan nyid/ /pad chen pad+ma bzang po can/ /lha min dmyal ba sems can rnams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'og tu'o/ /oṃ las tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /hūṃ las ma chags pa la sogs/ /āḥ9las stobs kyis 1 rgyu la sogs/ /lag 11gnyis gdong gcig ldan pa ste/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po che/ /dbang po la sogs nag por mtshungs/ /stobs kyis 2rgyu sogs dmar po che/ /rang mtshungs rig 1rim/ lus sprad ldan/ /rdo rje dril bus lag pa brel / /g.yas brkyang 1 bas ni stan la gnas/ /tshangs sogs rtag pas phyag 863—10 3

rgyas gdab/ /mchod sbyin brgya sogs rdo rje yis/ /stobs kyis 1rgyu sogs gar dbang 2gis/ /thams cad rigs gsum las skyes pa'o/ /dkar mos dgug par byas nas ni/ /chom rkun mas ni zhags pas bcings(gu ro langs mas ni sgrog bcings la / /ghasma rīs ni dril bus dbabar/ /de nas mchod yon (ne zhabs bsil dbul/ /sngags ni 'di yis bsang 7)gtor bya/ /oṃ āḥrgyu/ phyi nas 'thor 'thung dbul bar bya/ /sngags ni 'di yis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa/twa twe nano pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ 9phyo me 1 bha wa / su po 116 me bha wa/ su to 12khyo me bha wa/ shā shwa to me bha wa/1 a nu rasto me bha wa/ hro da yasmo a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/nyu sarba 15 sirnyi m+me papra yats+tsha/ sarba kārle ṣā me cilta shri yaḥ1 ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ 12ha 19ta ha ha hoḥ bha ga wī sasba ta thā ga ta 2 badz+ra mā me muñca/ brdzu 21bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥmuḥ 2 de nas rdo rje 2 'dzin pa'i rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur 2 rdo rje ming gi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te rdo rje ming phye ba'o/ /ming gi dbang gi dus su ni/ /slob ma bdag nyid dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba/ / skyes pa mi'adir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / mdzes pa'i rdo rje dang / rol pa'i rdo rje dang / shin tu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / shin tu dga' ba'i myu gu'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma 27rdo rje dang / pad+ma myu gu rdo rje dang /a la la rdo rje dang / pad+ma lcags kyu rdo rje dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje dang / yan lag med pa'i rdo rje dang / shes rab myu gu'i rdo rje dang / snying rje myu gu'i rdo rje dang / dam par dga' ba'i rdo rje dang /shin tu bde bar dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo rje dang /8(1—104

'bebs pa'i rdo rje dang / nam mkha'i rdo rje dang / shes rab rdo rje dang / pha rol phyin pa'i rdo rje dang / 'dod chags rdo rje ni dag pa'i gnas su phyag rgya chen po grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams yin no/ /bud med rnams kyi 'byung ste / rdo rje snyems ma 1dang / rdo rje mtshon cha ma dang / rdo rje e ma'o bde ma dang / rdo rje bdag med ma dang / rdo rje spyan ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 5'gro ma dang / rdo rje dkar mo dang / rdo rje sgyu ma dang / rdo rje 'bar ma da dang / rdo rje 'khris 4)shing dang / rdo rje mgyogs ma dang / rdo rje ro langs ma dang / rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje bskor ma dang 5)/ rdo rje phreng 6ba ma dang / rdo rje lā su 7rim dang / rdo rje bzhad ma dang / rdo rje 'khyud nam dang / rdo rje phye ma dang / rdo rje pad+ma dang / rdo rje 'byung ma dang / rdo rje chen mo dang / rdo rje 'dod chags ma dang / rdo rje sgrol ma dang / rdo rje do shal ma dang / rdo rje sgeg 9mo dang / rdo rje kong 1 ka ṇa 11dang / rdo rje lā mā 1 dang / rdo rje dbugs dbyung ma dang / rdo rje rnam pa tsho1nam ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan du gyur pa/ kye yi 1 rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rnam snang chen po dang ni rang byung dang / /rdo rje arli skems 15pa'i khro bo dang / /de bzhin du yang rdo rje'i khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi bdud rtsi khothab 1 sbyor dang / /he ru ka dang snying rje'i stobs nyid do/ /rtag pa dang ni gti mug rdo rje dang / /rnam par snang mdzad dang ni thams cad skyob/ /sgyu 'phrul dang ni de nas oṃ mdzad dang / / sku yi rdo rje 1 rab tu grags pa dang / /sa snying dang ni gti mug chen po dang / /gshin rje'i 19gshed dang tho ba'i dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gshegs dang 2 shākya thub pa dang / /sangs rgyas 'es 863wa 105

byar rab tu grags pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma de nas rin chen bdag / de bzhin du yang rin chen rgyal po nyid51/ /rdo rje gzi brjid dang ni rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bdud zil gnon dang snang byed do/ /rta mgrin dang ni 'jig rten bdag po dang / /rdo rje chos dang spyan ras gzigs dang ni/ /pad+ma gar dbang dang ni 'dod chags dang / /'jig rten mgon por 9nanorab tu grags pa'o/ /dam pa'i rta dang rta yi 3rgyal po dang / / bdun gyi la rgyal po de nas lcags rgyal dang / /dam tshig rdo rje dang ni rta mchog dang / /de bzhin du yang las kyi rdo rje nyid/ /don yod dang ni don grub rgyal po 55dang / /rdo rje mgyogs 'gror rab tu grags pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de nas rdo rje can/ /rnam par rgyal ba phyag na rdo rje dang / /dpe 6med ro mnyam shin tu dga' ba dang / /dam pa dang po bde ba chen po'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /dam tshig sems dpa' nor bu ni/ /'di rnams rigs ni drug tu brjod/ /'dod pa'i thar pa rab sgrub 7pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni 8tshogasum pa'o/ /bzhi pa sna tshogs brtag pa ste/ /rdo rje brtag pa lnga pa'o/ /brtag 795pa drug pa stobs po che/ /brtag pa bdun 1 pa mi g.yo mgon/ /brgyad pa gzungs kyi brtag 1)pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu/ /bcu pa 'dul ba'i brtag pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcu gcig la12/ /dngos grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ /sgrol ma'i brtag 1 pa bcu 80wa 106

gsum pa/ /rdo rje phag mo bcu bzhi pa/ /bcwa 1lnga pa ni gzi brjid che/ /bdag med brtag pa bcu drug pa/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bcu bdun pa/ /hūm̐ mdzad kyi ni bcwa (5brgyad pa/ /dbyangs nocan gyi ri rini bcu dgu pa/ /sbyin sreg 5brtag pa nyi shu pa/ /rab gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i brtag pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa ni gnyis su ri sku'adod/ /gtor ma'i brtag 7 pa nyi shu gsum / /nyi shu bzhi pa sta 8gon gnas/ /mngon par rtogs 9pa nyi shu lnga/ /de bzhin phyag rgya 1 nyi shu drug /byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /glu 11ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cur 12gcig med sum cu pa / /brtag pa sum cu par ni bshad/ /stong phrag sum cu'i 1dgrangs kyis ni/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ / kye yi rdo rje 7'chang gi ni15/ /rgyud ni e 17ma rgyas bstan pa/ /'bum phrag lnga bdag kye rdo rje/ /dag pa'i snying po yongs su bzung 1 / /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa ste / /'di ni rgyud kyi 18des pa'o/ / kye yi 19rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang por rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med bzung 2 )phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na spros pa las bsdus pa lags/bskal pa bzang po la byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / so so'i skye bo rnams tshe thung bar 'gyur na/ ji ltar na de rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams thos par 'gyur/ ji ltar na de rnams 21sems par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa tshe thung bar 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig nagang dag slob dpon rnams su 'gyur ba de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / gang dag spyod pa po de rnams mi dge ba 8(1—107

bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag so so'i skye bo de rnams srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag bud med kyi tshogs rnams gcig 1tu 'dod pa la zhen par 'gyur ba ste/ de'i phyir rgyud rnams thams cad rgyas par bstan pa nasam yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rdo rje gsung 5thos nas mnyes par 'gyur zhing 4dgyes pa brnyes nas tshig 'di gsungs pa/ snying rje chen po kye'i rdo rje/ /da ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /bsnyen bkur 5can la dngos grub ster/ /mtsho skyes rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong / /sku gdung zab 6mo'i mchod rten dang / /rkang 'thung rlon pa'i 'og tu ni/ /nga ni sangs rgyas dngos grub ster/ /tshong dus tshong rdal nyid dang ni/ /tshong dus rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma bstan 7pa nga / /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster / /glu gar rab tu 'ching ba dang / /chang 'tshong nam yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad+ma gar mkhan nga / /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu 'gro mgyogs zhon 'gyur dang / /res 'ga' 59lam du 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod bstan 1 pa nga / /dngos grub rdo rje rnam tsho1ster 12ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur phyag rgya rnam par rgyal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 1 te/ phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan yang dag par bshad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi brtag pa las/ /phyag rgya rnam gsum shes par bya / /sku la lag pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /sngags bzlas pa las ngag phyag rgya/ /sems la mtshan ma'i phyag rgya yin1 / /de nyid bsam gtan 1snyedakyil 'khor la'o//lag pa'i g.yas na skam 7pa ste/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 1 de bzhin no/ /80—108

mkha' 'gro skam pa ma 37'jigs ma/ /gdug pa rnams kyi 'khor dab 'don/ /g.yas pa'i lag na zhags pa ste/ /gdug tshonasapa rnam bcings ri rnam par dgug5 /de 56)'di zhags pa ma zhes 7)bya/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /g.yas na nya rgya zlum po ste/ /gdug pa rnams ni dkri 8chibar 'dod/ /'di ni rtag tu dol zlum bshad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /lag pa g.yas par lcags kyu ste/ /gdug pa rnams ni dgug par 'dod/ /'di de rdo rje kyo mar bshad/ /g.yon pas bdud la /sdigs mdzub ma/ /lag pa g.yas pas nyu )nyi ma ste/ /gti mug mun pa rnam par dral/ /g.yon pas 11sdigs mdzub mar ni bshad/ /de ni rdo rje nyi mar brjod/ /lag g.yas mar me'i 12sdong snod de/ /de bzhin g.yon par sdigs mdzub bo/ /'di de rdo rje mar mer bshad/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'joms/ /lag pa g.yas na rin po che/ /sems can rnams la sbyin pa ster/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rin chen sgron 1rim 'di rab brjod/ /glog ni lag pa g.yas pa ste1 / /rnam par rtog pa'i chu 'dzin 'joms/ /de 'di glog lag mar shes bya/ /de bzhin g.yon pas sdigs mdzub ma/ /lag pa g.yas par pad+ma ste/ /pad+ma'i 'dod chags brjod par bya/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub ma nyid de/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro'i pad+mar skabarjod/ /g.yas par bha ga'i pad+ma ste/ /bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub mdzad 17ma ste/ /'di ni chos 'byung mar ni brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag na lcags sgrog ste/ /byang chub zhen pas kun 'ching sna snab/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin ma ste/ /'di ni rdo rje sgrog mar 1 brjod / /sanges rgyas rjes chags 'ching ba yis/ /bdag nyid 'khyud par 80—109

'dod pa ste/ /byang chub chags pas rab sgrub (1)ma/ /de 'di rdo rje 'khyud (na mar bshad/ /g.yas pa'i lag na sgo lcags te/ /ye shes kun gyi srung ri stab mo /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje sgo lcags brjod/ /g.yas pa'i calag tu lde kyog ste/ /ye shes blangs nas gcod 5)pa mo/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di de rdo rje lde kyog 56brjod/ /g.yas pa'i lag tu sgo mo ni / /ye shes skyes pa ma spangs pa/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /'di ni rdo rje sgo mar brjod/ /lag pa g.yas par yol ba ni/ /rang mtshungs btsun mo srung 7 ba nyid/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje yol ba mar ni brjod/ /de 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dam pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni rab bsgrub 3phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 9rgyud gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje'i gsung thos nas ngo mtshar skyes par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya 'phrog pa 'di ci nyi tshe ba'i dam tshig phyag rgya 'phrog 1 pa lags sam/ de nas bcom zhen 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na 11rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i lung bstan pa yod de 'di ni de'i yin te/ ḍi bai ha ya sa ga ma ne'i skad kyi dbyings 'dir rnam par brtags 12pa ste/ thams cad kun tu nam mkha' 1 spyod par grub pas 'di ni mkha' 'gro mar rab tu grags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams thams cad tshig 'di thos nas dga' ba dang mgu ba nye bar skyes par 'gyur ba 1 dang tshig 'di 15gsol pa/ e ma mkha' 'gro ma yi sargyud/ /rgyud kun las ni 863wa 110

phyi 6)ma dang / /rtogs sla rtogs par dka' ba dang / /rig dang mi rig pa nyid pa'o / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa (2)mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskul ba'i phyir 'di skad ces (snaragasungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di la rdo rje gur rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po nya4)'dir ji ltar rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis (5bsdu ba yin/ byams 6)pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol pa/ sgo nga las skyes pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa ngas srid pa las bsgral bar bya'o zhes smon lam sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub gang 7du rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs na/ ci'i phyir na srog 85chags rnams gsad (9pa dang / gcig tu 'dod pa'i btsun mo rnams nyu spangs lags/lta ba rnams las log 11rnams dang / /btsun mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 12rgyud bshad do/ /bde ba'i thabs ni mdor nyu bsdus pa/ /gzhung nyung don ni rgyas pa ste/ /blo dman rab tu sad byed pa/ /rgyud kun gyi ni snying por nges/ /sngags rnams kyi ni khyad par du'o/ /rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'di ni bshad pa tsam gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis/ /sngon du gar gyis mchod byas nasang/ /rang gi 'khor lo 'di gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /gal te rdo rje chos dang ni/ /rta mchog rdo rje nyi ma yang 15/ /bdag gis spangs na mi 'grub ste/ /nga 9nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /yum gyi gzugs kyis skyed 1 par byed/ /de rnams kyi ni mdzes ma nga / /de la nga ni dngos grub ster19/ /mig sman dang ni rkang byug dang / /ral gri sa 'og bsgrub 2 pa dang / / ril bu 1mkha' la 80—111

spyod pa dang / /mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ṣ+ṭanyid dang / /bu mo dam pa dgug pa ni/ /bdag mnyes (5)pas ni sgrub (5)pa pos/ /dngos grub rdo rje rnams 'thob 4bo/ /spros pa rnam pa mang por ni/ /smras pas (5ri'adir ni ci zhig bya/ /bdag spangs nges par mi 'grub cing / /byang chub med cing bsgom 6pa med/ /gang zhig rtag tu bdag dran zhing / /rtag tu klog ri ri cing sems pa nadang / /sngags kyi phreng ba bzlas pa dang / /nga yi sku ni sgom (9byed pa/ /gal te sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sam/ /gal te rmi lam 'dra bar blta/ rdzo/ /shin tu bsgom 11pa'i rim pa las/ /mngon sum du ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu sbyor ba las/ /de yi dngos grub sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab sbyor bas/ /shin tu bde chen sbyor ba las/ /gang zhig bdag la 'dod ster ba/ /lus can de la smos ci dgos12/ /gang zhig nyi ma gcig bsgom 1 pa/ /rdo rje'i 1 mchod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dngos grub / /ster de 'di la the tshom 5med/ /bdag nyid he ru kur byas shing / /rang gi btsun mo rang bsgoms nas/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor cher 'dod pa/ /de rnams la ni nga mnyes 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan zhing / /spro ba dga' bar ldan pa dang / /glu gar 15rol sgra'i rnam pa dang / /'dod kun bde ba spro ba dang / /sna tshogs sgeg par ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs ro yi btung ba dang / /sna tshogs gos ni ri mo can/ /sna tshogs dri 1 yi byug pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag dang rtag nyal ba/ /de yi dngos grub ster ba nga / /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas na 'dug1 /de yi 'dod pa ma 19gyur to/ /oṃ a ā i khri u u ṛ rī bla lī ri e e o au e 1swā hā/ gang zhig 'dis nga skul 2bar byed pa'i rgyal 863—112

ba'i sras (1de rnams kyi lag tu bud (2)med kyi sgyu ma'i bde ba yang dag par gnas kyis da)'dug go/ /rdo rje ma ni shar du sbyin par bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni cadakar mo'i gzugs can ma'o/ /nub phyogs su ni chu'i 55)mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /nga 56ridabus su bzhag ste (75snying po dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gang zhig bsam par byed pa (85de'i bdag mdzes ma ste/ phyag gnyis ma zhal gcig ma'o/ /gri gug dang skyes pa'i thod pas brel (9)ba/ stag gi pags 1 pa bgos pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra gyen du brdzes yi1pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan kyi pa/ shar gyi sgor ni dkar mo chen mo'o/ /lhor ni chom rkun ma'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor ni chu ma'o/ /de bzhin du tsho byang du ni ghasma rī'os/ /dbang ldan du ni puk+ka sī'o/ /'tshed pa'i 15mtshams su ni ri khrod ma'o/ /srin po'i gluphyogs su ni gdol 1 pa mo'o/ /rtag tu 'gro bar ni g.yung mo'o/ /'di rnams ni nyu8mtshams dang mtshams 19bral du sbyin no/ /gang zhig bdag rab tu sgom 2 par byed pa de'i lag mthil du phyin pa'i dpal sus kyang dbrog 21par mi nus so/ /thams cad kyang kha dog nag por mtshungs pa 2narab tu son pa'i steng du gar dang bcas pa khro mo chen mo dpa' mo/ g.yon rin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo rje gur mchog tu dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ rig ma'i dbang yang 2 nodag par bshad pa/ rang gi rig ma skyes 25bu'i chus/ /bum pa brgyad po thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje thugs ni rab bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje can bsam dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab bsgoms 7pa/ /der ni dbu rgyan 2 sbyin par bya/ /thams cad sngon sbyin des bsams rnams 8/ /rdo rje'i tshigs 9bcad sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje chen po rtse dgu 80wa 113

pa / /snying gar 1rang gi lag pas nasabya/ /slob ma 'jig rten dbang phyug byas//rdo rje sems dpas dbang 4bskur 5bya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis nigyes/ /de ring 7khyod ni dbang bskur 'gyur/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /bzang bsgrub naphyir ni rdo rje bzung 9/ /slob ma lcags mchog lha mo ni/ /sgrol mas 'khyud par bsam par bya/ /lag pas rdo rje dril 'khrol zhing / /rdo rje bdag pos dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badzā dhi nyu pa ti two a bhi k+ṣi: 17mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ slob ma rnam snang byas nas ni/ /ming gis kyang ni dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa tam a bhi ṣiñca 12mi badz+ra nā mā bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye 12che ge mo rdo rje/gang gang kun gyi 1 rang gtsor 15gyur/ /de de bdag nyid he ru ka /sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi rang bzhin dag pa'o/ /'di de tshasangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rdo rje snying po brtul zhugs brtan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung 1 / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi 1ldebadz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e kho haṃ twa dha ra yā mi tī 19gyi hi hi hi hi 2 7rtsu/ kun kyang cho ga 1gcig pa yis/ /rtag tu bla med mchod pas ni/ /slob ma na rdo rje brtul zhugs sbyin/ /phyis ni rdo rje lag nas lag /sems dpa' thog ma tha ma med / /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' chen po/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag / rdo rje snying po'i bdag po'i bdag lha /yang na de ring dril bu sbyin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje dril bu zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun 25gyi don gyi phyir/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /rgyal bas byang chub mchog brjod pa/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung tsi/ /dbugs 'byin thams cad byin nas ni/ /shākya thub par rang 80wa 114

gyur pas/ /slob ma chen po lung bstan te17/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom ldemed / /khyod ni 'chi 'jigs mya ngan med/ /de bzhin nad dang tsha ba med/ /bde chen theg pa chen po ni/ /'di las nga yis lung bstan bu/ /oṃ e kho haṃ byā ka ri ro mi kau 5badz+ra satwa ta thā ga tatshone/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bsgral te/ /shin tu srid pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /kye 'grub 'gyur de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /ming ni rdo rje zhes byar 'gyur/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis rig ma chen mo'i dbang gi dam tshig bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje ston pa pos/ dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba bton te / tshig 'di skad 8bka' stsal pa/ bla ma rdo rje rnams 9mchod cing / /bdun po 1 rnam par dag par bya/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas su/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgom11/ /de la sangs rgyas gnas bsams nas/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /dang po skyes bu bsam de nas/ /mkha' 12'gro ma yi 'khor lo spro/ /dri za 1 mnyam par zhugs pa ni/ /khu bar rjes su dran par bya/ /mtshams 1 kyi lha 15mos bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i 'dren 10pa bskul nas ni/ /mig la 1 sogs pa gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /phyi nas rjes chags rdo rje ste/ /ye shes rnam par gzhug pa dang / /dbang ni rig ma brgyad 18rnams kyi/ /yang ni bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /lha mo brgyad kyis 19mchod pa nyid/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa bstod pa'o/ /rang byin rlabs 2 pas byin brlabs 51te/ /de la yan lag drug bsgom bya/ /phyi nas yang ni dam tshig gi/ /cho ga'i go rims 22rim pa yis/ /mtshan ma yang dag mtshon par bya/ /dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba yin/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa 863—115

yin / /bzhi pa mar 1me nyer (2ri'abar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste( ra/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyung)/ /dngos grub nye 5bar 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi nas sgyu snyoma'i rnam pa ltar/ /rmi lam rnam par skad cig 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i ri/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub / /'jig rten khams 8ni thams cad du/ /ji srid rdo rje'i lus can rnams / /ye shes phung po'i blo ldan pa/ /de yi rjes su thams cad 'brang / /ji srid skye gnas las byung ba/ /khams gsum lam 9 ni nyams dga' bar/ /phyag rgya chen po rab sbyar bas/ /de rnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /tshig gi rdo rje rnam thos nas/ /dga' zhing rangs par gyur nas ni/ /smra ba'i rdo rje mdzad par 1 ldan/ /rig ma chen mo bdag med dang / /rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen dang / /rta mchog thub pa chen po dang / /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid che/ /rta mgrin 11mnga' bdag chen po ni/ /sku gsung nyi thugs ni nyid dang yang / /lus kyi gong bu 'gul bar 'gyur/ /lan cig 1 rgyal po ston pa yis/ /'phral du mngon sum byed pa po/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po sku gsum mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen 1 po mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te tshig 'di skad 15gsungs so/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs 17pa/ /zhal brgyad pa la stobs po che/ /phyag ni bcu drug rnams dang ldan/ /dbang po sngon po mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gzi brjid chen po zhabs bzhi pa17/ /sgeg cing khro ba'i nya gzugs can te/ / skyil krung phyed 19pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /rus pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni nag po ste/ /dkar po dmar pos 80wa 116

rnam par brgyan3)/ /lhag ma'i (nazhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa ste/ /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /der ni rdo rje mdog nag po / /'od zer chen po'ang bsgom par bya/ /dbang bskur ba yi tsho gnas nyid du / /sangs rgyas lngas ni rnam par brgyan ca/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sa 5skur bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad du ni/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /drod dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /skyes bu chen po bzhengs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gti mug rdo rje mig la dgod/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rna ba la/ /ser sna 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /reg dang bdag med bsgom par bya/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa yin/ /sna tshogs gzugs ma btsun mo nyid/ /lag pa ri nigri gug thod pas brel/ /srog song du ni 7)yang dag gnas/ /sa spyod mkha' spyod ma nyid dang / /de bzhin rkang 'og gnas pa mo/ /'di nyid kyi ni cho ga yis/ /gnas gsum du ni gnas par bsgomachin/ /oṃ mdzad rgyal po chen po ni/ /sku yi 9chirdo rje rnam par brgyan / /thugs kyi rdo rje rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /a ni mchog gi de nyid de/ /ngag gi lam ni gsal 11byed brjod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yin15/ /chos can las ni rigs gsum 'byung / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dkar mo gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu 1risdigs mdzub la'adzin pa mo15/ /kha dog dkar mo 'od chen mo/ /dkar mo rdo rje can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dmar po'i gludakyil 'khor dbus gnas par / /chom rkun 1 ma yi gzugs can bsgom1 / /btso 19ma gser gyi mdog 80—117

'dra ba/ /rdo rje zhags 1pa mtshon chen mo2/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par / /ro langs ma ni khrag dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog dang rgyal byed/ /byang chub 'ching bar mdzad pa mo/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /de nas ghasma rī cabasgom bya/ /rdo rje dril 5bus lag pa brel56/ /margad ri ut+pal 8'dra ba'o/ /rdo rje sgo skyong ma rdo rje brtson ma ri9zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mtshams su lha mo bzhi rnams ni/ /cho ga'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /byang sems bum pa ri rab dang / /me 1 yi thab khung rgyal mtshan che/ /phyi bcas gnyis med rnal 'byor pas/ /mgon po de ltar bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /dba' rlabs med pa'i bde ba 'thob11/ /'byung ba bzhi'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po theg pa gsum gyi dam pa ston pa po/ thams cad kyi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo ni/ /rtag tu zhe sdang ldan pa'o/ /nang du ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /na maḥs man+ta budhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra muṅga ra hastu ya tsaṇ+ḍa lha lā k+ṣe pa ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'dir khro bo chen po bshad pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jigs shing 'dar bar gyur nas mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa dran par byed do/ /skyes pa'i pad+ma gas chag 1dmed / /srubs 1 gcig pa dang srubs 15gnyis pa/ /rig ma bzhi yi rab sbyor bas / /sangs rgyas kun gyis lorab tu dgang / /rkang rjes rdul gyi 1 sbyor ba yis / /rkang pas mnan cing bsdigs 18par bya/ /sku gsum bskyed pa'i bsgom 19pa yis/ /bu mo chen mo dgug par bya/ /gshin rje gshed rdo rje zhes bya ba'i 863—118

ting nge 'dzin to/ /na maḥs man+ta 917budhe bh+yo/ ma hā daṇ+ḍa dha ra bi bi dha su rā su ra man+ta na bhū ta narjisgro tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i stobs po che bshad pa las tsho byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang 'dar bar gyur cing de dran par byed do/ /'byung po yi dgas sha za nyid/ /mkha' 'gro grul bum zin pa la/ /hūm̐ gis dregs ril byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje btsir bas bde ba nyid/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na maḥs man+ta 5budhe bh+yo/ 6tu lu hu lu/ ma hā pad+ma a mṛ tī ri ku ru ma hā bi ṣā na āḥn btsan 95dug chen po dgug par bya'o/ /brgyal ba bslang bra 1 de bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i dregs pa'i 11 rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na maḥ sa man+ta 1 budhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra gro dhā ya ma hā rda zloska ṭa hai ra wā 1 ya/ badz+ra sardo ha dpyo 1 ya/ oṃ 15a mṛ 7ta kuṇ+ḍa lī 1 rtsu phaṭa/ de nas khro bo chen po 18bgegs 'joms rdo rje bshad pas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid mi dga' bar gyur to/ /rlung gis bteg pa po dang / rkang rjes kyi rdul blangs nas bsgrub bya de'i ming byang bzung ste / tshogs kyi bdag po'i rkang pa'i 'og tu dgod cing hūm̐ phaṭa ces bya ste/ rtsu gi tsho nga rgyal byas nas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i na ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa/ khro bo'i 1sngags kyis rab tu sbyor bas sangs rgyas rnams kyang skrod par byed do/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /shin tu legs na par gsang dbar ni/ /bya ba 'di ni rab bskul bar/ /ye shes rdo rjes bya ba ste/ /nyi ma bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /na maḥs man+ta 2 burnye bh+yo/ oṃ ya ma daṇ+ḍa ya nī lā ya/ nī la daṇ+ḍa 5ya/ tu ru tu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba duṣ+ṭa 57na mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ 80wa 119

phaṭa / de nas khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po skyes bu chen po bshad pas sems can thams cad dang / sangs rgyas rnams srog la the tshom 1)du gyur to/ /brgya phrag brgyad bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang shin tu bsgom napar rin sbyor ba'i cho gas 4bskul ba las mugadug tshopa thams cad 'ching bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyig pas mnan 7pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /na maḥnas man+ta budhe bh+yo/ na mo ma hā ba lā 9ya/ u thob 1 gro dha rā dzā ya sar+pā nā gā ṭ+wāṃ hro da yaṃ tā 11ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas gtum po chen po bshad pas dug gis 12gdong 'jigs shing stobs dang yinabral ba dang / skrag cing 'dar bar gyur 1 te/ stobs po che dran par 'gyur ro15 / /rdo rje stobs kyi spyan ras gzigs zhes sabya ba'i ting nge 1 'dzin to/ /na maḥ sa man+ta 18burnye 19byo/ na mo a tsa la ka ṇa tses tses mos mos tus tus / gha gha ghā ta ya bhā ta ya 21rtsu phaṭa/ de nas khro bo chen po 22mi g.yo ba skyes bu chen po bshad pas lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin chen po brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /'dis t+t+waṃni khro bo'i 2 rgyal po yis/ /seng ge zhon pa'i cho ga yis/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor las/ /skyes pa dang ni lha rnams khug gi /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa 2 partsu/ groṇ+ḍa 2 pa ya griṇ+ḍa 8pa ya hūm̐/ ā na na ya ho bha ga wān bit+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa / rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa yis 1/ /khro bo chen po bshad pa yis/ /lha min bu mo klu mor bcas/ /nu ma 'dar zhing nar ba 'am/ /rdo rje zhags pas nges bcings te/ /lcags kyu yis ni dral rinas ni/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pa yis / /bu mo thams cad dgug par bya'o/ / 'jig rten gsum dgug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rdo rje chos ni char sprin che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' char mchog ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma dge 'dun che/ /rta mchog tshogs ni chen po dang / /8(1—12()

phan pa'i yang ni char sprin gyi/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i bsgom tsho1pa yis sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'gugs dzodabarjod na/ /so so skye bo smos ci dgos/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bsams / /sku gsum rdo rjes rnam par brgyan(4/ /lcags kyu la 5sogs sbyor ba yis/ /bu mo bkug 6kyil bza' bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje chen pos dgug pa'i dam tshig bka' stsal to/ /namaḥs man+ta 7budhe bh+yo/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ kyi/ kha ti 59dang ni btsag la yang / /rdo rje lcags kyu'i sbyor ba las/ /zla ba nye bar chags dus su/ /khar bcug nas ni bsgrub par bya/ /ming ni bris pa tsam gyis kyang / /brgya ni gsal bar bzlas pa yis1 //sgra ldan gnas med dbang po drag11 /chung mar bcas pa dgug par bya/ /dam tshig 12lcags kyu'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / /bsam gtan sngags dang ting 'dzin gnas/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bdag /dgug pa'i gnas su gzung khabar bya/ /thub pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nī'i/na maḥ/glu sa man+ta dharmā shā1 / na maḥs man+ta 18〈 ghā nī/ oṃ si tā ta pa 419/o bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ bra traṃ 2 gi (21ra/ oṃ badz+ra usnri 2ga tsakra warnyi sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra mū la nam brnya rna tā ḍa rna na khri la rna bā ma ma kṛ te 2 ye na ke na tsita kṛ tai ta ta ta sarban+tu sbyin sbyin bhin+da bhin+da 5/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri tsi/ ma ra ma ra / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ bdag nyid bsrung 2 ba'i sbyor ba la/ /sbyor ba rgyud sogs gzhig 8pa la/ / dpung par rig pa gdags byas na 9/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 'da' 0mi nus/ /khro bo chen po 'khor lo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dben pa'i nags tshal nyid du yang 1/ /yid gnyis thams cad rnam 2spangs la/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni 'di bsgrubs na//863wa 121

thub pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /khro bo chen po 'khor lo'i snying po'i 93)sngags la 'jug pa rdo rje 2 zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rin)le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las byung ba/ /yang dag nges par rab tu dbye/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgom bya/ /casangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms munas/ /rdo rje rnam snang dran par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab bsgoms te/ /rdo rje nyi ma rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rab 6bsgoms nas/ /'dod chags rdo rje rnam par bsgom / / sangs rgyas nagazugs brnyan rnam bsgoms te/ /rta yi don yod rab bsgom bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni rtag bsgom bya/ /thams cad rnams kyi sngags 'di yis/ /snying gar 9ye shes gnas su dgod/ /ye shes sems dpar rab sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rang sngags yi ge rdzogs pa dang / /phyag rgya tshi dang ni phyag mtshan brtag /spro dang bsdu ba byas pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 'byung gnas 11nyid/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po/ /gzugs la 1 rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la yang 1 dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rgyal po ni/ /rdo rje rnam snang mnga' bdag nyid/ /dri la rnam gsum rnam shes nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /rin chen phung po 1 rab tu grags/ /ro la rnam gsum rnam 80—122

shes nas/ /lha rnams la yang dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags nyid/ /rdo rje chos ni de bzhin gshegs/ /reg la rnam gsum rnam shes nas / /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /don yod 'bras bu ster ba po/ /bsrung 1ba'i dam tshig dbus gnas pa'i2/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ni bsgom cipar bya/ /lnga lnga'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam par bsgom ri/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan/ /'od zer sna tshogs kun tu khyab/ /sna tshogs las ni byed par brjod/ /thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /rdul tshon gyis kyang bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /phung po lngar ni rab tu grags / /sangs rgyas mgon po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /shar gyi char ni rab tu grags / /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma yi/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje yi/ /byang du rta yi rgyal po yi/ /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste / /lhor 55ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /dmar po nub kyi cha nyid du/ /btsod 6ni byang du yang dag ldan/ /mtshams 7kyi char ni thams cad dang / /sgo yi logs dang ya phubs su/ /rdo rje chen po 8rnams kyis brgyan9/ /sna tshogs snang ba rnams kyis mdzes/ /sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su 'gyur ba ni/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /snying po yongs bzung nyu dkyil 'khor te / /dkyil 'khor re re bsgom 12pa 'am yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro1 / /brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa 'am yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga ru/ /gang tshe dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yi/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog 1 de bzhin rdo rje nyid/ /'jug pa'i sgo srung 58(1—123

dgod par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdus pa chen po'i dam tshig 'di skad ces 1bka' stsal to/ /dom nyanadang bya rgod de bzhin bse/ / snyug glang ( skadang ni stag nyid dang / /spre'u dang sna 'thung cab glang 'tsher/ /rdo rje chos kyi g.yas na'o / /khwa 'ug chu skyar seng ge dang / /mtshor gnas de bzhin ra dang ni/ /ri dgas 'phag dang yang dag ldan/ /g.yas min par ni rtag tu gnas/ /rma bya ma he chu srin dang / / nya yi 7༄rgyal po rus ri sbal dang / /'og gi rlung dang ngang skya 9dang / /ri bong phan pa'i g.yas pa na'o/ / /sbal ba thu bo sprin shugs kyi/ /kha chu mig sman mtshungs byi la11/ /g.yag dang dri ldan de bzhin bzhad/mi/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ / kā raṇ+ḍa nyu dang 'khor lo dag /lug dang tsa ko ra dang ni/ /bye 1 khra hor mo 15'ol ba dang / /ku rar 4nyi ma'i g.yas na'o/ /stobs kyis 1 rgyu dang dung skyong dang / /rigs ldan pad+ma pad bzang dang / /'jog po nor rgyas mtha' yas ni/ /rin chen rgyal po'i g.yon na'o/ /gza' lag phur bu mjug rings 18dang / /sgra gcan mig 19demar pa ba sangs/ /spen pa khyab 'jug rta rgyal nyid/ /g.yas pa nyid du rab tu grags/ /dbang po tshangs pa de bzhin drag /'dod lha de bzhin thod pa can/ /gcer bu dang ni thags bzangs 2 ris/ /stobs ldan zhes bya g.yon na'o/ /glo 21dang dbugs dang de bzhin 'bog /khong skem na mdze dang rkang shu dang / /mchin pa mcher 2ripa'i rang bzhin yang / /glang po la 2 sogs rab tu grags/ /lcags stegs dang ni brjed 5byed dang / /khrag rdo gcong nad rgyal po dang / /gzhang 'brum skran dang bkres nad dang / /mig ser don la 5sogs pa'o/ /rdzi 2 ma byi dang so nad dang / /mkhris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung / /bad kun 'dzag dang lus 80wa 124

skam dang / /skya rbab 'bras ni rma bya sogs/ /rkang bam 1tshil nad rlig 2spangs dang / /rgyu ma 'phel dang gsud pa dang / /tshad pa rims dang rab cigs ni/kā 4noraṇ+ḍa sogs rab tu grags/ /rlung mkhris de bzhin ma zhu ba/ /sgrib g.yogs rab rib gcin 5sri 6ba/ /gzhogs 7)phyed na dang lkog /ri'abras dang / /rlung 9rgyas gza' lag la sogs pa'o/ /mi yi 'gro ba dam pa ni/ /rab mchog de lta bu 'gro ba/ /thams cad nad kyis khab tsholha mthong nas/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni cher grags pa/ /bdag gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /sems can rnams la gdungs ma gyur/ /nad rnams zhi phyir sangs rgyas ni/ /glang po la 11sogs nad 'dzin to / /de ltar bsgom 15par gyur pa la/ /nad med ru dza trang grum 1 med/ /'chi med nges par bya dhi 1 med/ /nga rgyal med cing gti mug med/ /bkres nga/ med cing skom 15pa med/ /sdug bsngal tshangan 'gro de bzhin med/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams sam/ /gang gis kyang ni nad byed min/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje 1 zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po lus thams cad 'dzin pa po mkha' 'gro ma'i yid 'phrog pas tshig 'di bka' stsal pa/ sems kyi rjes dran dmigs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom18/ /sems kyi rin chen bsams nas ni/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa bsgom19/ /las rjes dran pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'khor lo chen po rab bsgom bya/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni mchog rab ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dang 'a rnam 2 bsgoms nas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje 21rnam snang bsams nas ni/ /phyag rgya bsgoms pas 80—125

phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /rin chen phung po rab bsgom 41)bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rab sbyor bas/ /las kyi rdo rje phyag rgyas gdab/ /zhe sdang rgyal po rgyal po che/ /skyon rnams thams cad zad par mdzad/ /spro zhing bsdu tshonabar bsgom par bya/ /bsdu ba yang ni yang dag bshad/ /sangs rgyas mgon po rab bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgom (8)bya/ /sems ni 'byerin chen rin po ches/ /bdud kyi skyon rnams zad par mdzad/ /sems kyi char sprin sbyor ba yis/ /yang ni bsdu ba bstan par bya/ /chos kyi rgyal po gti mug che/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i gzugs can de/ /thun tshod bzhir ni byin brlabs 5pa/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems ni 'gro mgyogs ltar bsams nas/ /gzhal med 'bras bu 465 ba'o/ /rta mchog char sprin chen po yis/ /bsdu ba yang ni bsgom par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis (6)spro ba dang bsdu ba'i dam tshig chen po de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyis rnam par ( bsgom par bya/ /rnyog med dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sku yi yi ge rnam par bsgom(8/ /khrag gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyi rin chen yi ge dgod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dbus gnas par/ /gsung gi yi ge rnam par bsgom/ /las 99)kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /don yod yi ge'i nya )gzugs can te/ /sku gsum mi phyed bsgom 11pa yis/ /ye shes rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mi phyed pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam snang la/ /rin chen sems kyi rin po che/ /pad ma bzang po 'dab ma 12dmar/ /shes rab ral gri don yod kyi/ /80wa 126

shes rab rnon po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam rtog ri bo bcad nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po ldan par 'gyur/ /dpag tshad bye ba brgya 6)par ni/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /phan pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang yang / /rin chen phung po 'od chen dang / /chos kyi phung po mgon chen dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje las/ /sna tshogs 'od zer cher 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis rnam par brgyan gu/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis gang / /thams cad du ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /mtshams kyi lha mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab bsgrub bya/ /dam tshig 'khor lo bcug pa yi / /ye shes rdo rje chen po 'bar/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /skad cig la ni gnyis med 'gyur/ /ru drwa k+ka chadang dung bse ru/ /bu cirayi 'tsho ba pad 'bras dang / /mu tig la sogs byi ru sogs/ /bsam gtan ldan pas 55sngags bzlas bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes chen la la zhig /skad kyi (6nga ros bos pa na / /thos pa tsam gyis 'ongs gyur 57)pa/ /de ltar skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs / /'jig rten khams ni stong phrag dang / /nam mkha'i khams kyi mkha' grong du/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bde gnas kyi/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de rnams sngags rig drung na (8rigashegs/ /rdo rje spyan 59)gyis rnam par gzigs/ /gang gis sngags kyi rim thob pa/ /e ma de yis byang chub 'thob / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sngags kyi spyod pa dang 80—127

por 'dzin/ /rdo rje sngags ni rab sbyor bas/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i ye shes 'thob / /de ltar shes pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i rim gnas pa/ /'bras bu nyid la mi gzigs te/ /de ni sangs rgyas mnyam par tsho17brjod/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal dmigs nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba/ /gang zhig bsgom dpa de bas na/ /sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par gyur ri/ /'jig rten ji ltar sangs rgyas te/ /ji ltar chos ni rnyog med pa / /sems can khams ni de ltar bshad/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /ngan par brtags pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /rin chen sems ni dri can byas/ /sems dag pas ni dag par 'gyur/ /ji ltar nam mkha' mi 'jig pa/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin de bzhin sems/ /sems kyi rin chen bskul ba las/ /sems nyid bsgom 5pa sangs rgyas te/ /skye bar sangs rgyas dam pa nyid/ /rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don namane/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /yid kyis sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal po che/ /sems gcig gis ni thob par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya'i rang bzhin te/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mchog tu zhi//'di ni rin chen mchog tu 7brjod/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes nyid/ /'di dag thams cad sems las skyes / /thub pa 'di ni gzhan mi 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /'dod yon 9'bras bu rab ster ba/ /sems kyi de nyid rang bzhin dag /sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras bu 1 ster/ /de nyid phyir na sangs rgyas kyis11/ /sems kyi rdo rje 8(1—128

bskul ba yi1)/ /zab mo'i narnam pa nges ldan pa'i/ /phyed par dga' ba'i dngos grub ster ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 54snying po snang ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas rdo rje chen po rdo rje can mkha' 'gro ma'i gur bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs sku te/ bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor gsungs pa/sangs rgyas gnas ni rab rdzogs dang / /rnam pa lnga po bsgom 6pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgrub 7dang / /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dgod pa dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi la sogs pa/ /rim napas rjes su bsgom 9 par bya/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /oṃ sarba 1 ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta 11badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta12/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de 1 skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba 1 ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da 15badz+ra swa sabhā ba ād+ma ko3rta1 / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu 1 med pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba 19ta thā ga ta stu 2 ti badz+ra swa na bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sab na ta thā ga ta pū dzā badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3he ri/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rta mchog gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sarba tsita thā ga ta a 2 nu rā ga ṇa 28badz+ra swa 2 bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta / zobacom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' da de bzhin gshegs pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / spros pa dang ni bsdus pa'i sku//rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad che/ /chos dbyings yi ge las bskyed pa/ /de rinani sangs rgyas gnas dgod ri bya/ /oṃ sarba 5ta thā ga ta a ni ri la ya badz+ra swa bhā 80wa 129

wa 1ād+ma ko3lha (2)/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /de yi steng du sangs rgyas bsam/ /spros nas gzhal yas gnas dzo ridagod bya/ /rdo rje lta bu mi phyed phyir/ /des na mi bskyod bsgom par bya ma skyes rjes su dran pa las/ /rnam par snang mdzad phan pa nyid/ /rin chen rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /'di 47ni rin chen sems su bshad/ /rdo rje chos ni rgyal po che/ /'dod chags mtshan nyid 'dzin pa las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug pa'i/ /sems ni 'dod chags zhes byar bshad/ /gang phyir 'bras bral mi 'grub ste5/ /de phyir don yod rab tu grags/ /rig ma mdzes ma rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te(6)/ /ji ltar lus ni de 7bzhin gshegs/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bris nas ni/ /dam tshig khu ba'i cho ga yis/ /haṃ dang bsam gtan bskyed byas nas/ /de tshe dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /mkha' 'gro lnga dang ldan pa dang / /dam tshig lnga yis bkang ba dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi ri tshogs ldan pas/ //9)rdo rje sa bon rab sbyor bas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar byas nasa'i/ /slob ma rtag par nges bsams te / /rgyun gyi 11rigs kyi ming gis ni/ /slob ma rdo rje can dbang bskur/ /spyan 12dang bdag mo 12sgrol ma dang / /dkar mo la yisogs bdag gzugs kyige/ /rdo rje btsun mo rab sbyor tshabs/ /rdo rje bla med bshad par bya/ /bla na med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gnyis su med cing yi ge med/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal byed / /bde ba bzang po'i ro myang gis(1 / /sgrib pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i 80—130

ting nge 'dzin to/ /ga dang ha zhes bya ba dang / /dang po mthar yang shwa ldan pa'i / /rab tu gsal ba dam pa nyid/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ / cho gas (1rdo rje bdud rtsi myang / /'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab tu zhi/ /de ni gzi brjid lus chen po/ /'jig rten kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phas kyi rgol ba kun las rgyal/ /'jig rten kun gyi bdag pos brgyan na / /lha rnams kyis ( ni 'dren par brjod/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chos kyi zas ni za ba po/ /dam tshig chen po'i bsam gtan /4)zos pa'i 5nirdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mi bskyod brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /rtag pas mdangs ni ri chen por ldan/ /rdo rje nyi mas 7)rgas pa med/ / rdo rje chos ni bsten pa yis / /bud med kun la longs spyod do/ /rin don yod rgyal po chen po ni/ /rdo rje srog gi yan lag 'byung / /don kun sgrub cing dpal dang ldan/ /des ni rnal 'byor par ni brjod/ /mi bskyod btung ba'i sbyor ba las/ /stong phrag lngas (9 ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phan pa yis tsho )ni khri ru brjod/ /rdo rje nyi mas 17rdo rje'i 'bum/ /tshe dpag med kyis dpag med dang / /bdun gyis nam mkha' ji srid bshad/ /rdo rje nyi ma dpag med dag /'khor ba'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba nyid / /'di dag bsten 15pas rnal 'byor pa/ /kun tu bzang po 'dra bar 'gyur / /shes rab pha rol phyin ye shes/ /'di ni rdo rje nyi mar brjod/ /chos rnams thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can nyid do1ri/ /thabs dang shes rab 'phel mdzad pa ri/ /khams 80—131

gsum dag ni thams cad du/ /sa dang sa 'og bar snang la/ /khrag dang khu bas khyab pa'i lus/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug gis 'di gsungs/ /sen mo ba spu de bzhin gshegs / /khams dang khu ba snang mtha' yas0)/ /lpags (5)dang khrag la gzi brjid che/ /tshil dang rkang la rdo rje 'dzin/ /thams cad mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /rtsa dang sha la bdun rgyal po/ /'di rnams la ni sangs rgyas lngar//rdo rje mkha' 'gros rnam par bshad/ /sa yi (5)khams ni rnam dag pa/ /spyan (4)ni 'khor lo mdzes ma 5 nyid/ /rdo rje btsun mo dang ba ste/ /pad ma'i bu mo tsha ba nyid / /sgrol ma rlung ni rnam dag pa56/ /rdo rje btsun mo bzhi rnams ni(7ri/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya'o/ /gur gyis de rnams bka' stsal to/ /sngags thams cad rnam par dag pa 8bdud rtsi lnga mchog tu byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te le'u bdun pa'o// //khyod ni zhe 9snang rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /thugs dang chos ni shin tu rnam dag pas / /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan mdzad pa/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la myur du gzigs / /rnam 1 par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes 11par mdzod/ /khyod ni gti mug rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /sku yi bdag po chos kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan 12mdzad pa / /mgon po ri khrod ma 1 la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /khyod ni 'dod chags rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /gsung dag legs par so sor rtogs 77pa yis / /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan sgosamadzad pa/ /gtum par ldan pa bdag 80—132

la gzigs par mdzod6)/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad yongs skyong ba/ /gzugs kun nan tan thams cad mnyam nyid kyis/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag brgyan ( mdzad pa/ / ḍom bi (2)bdag la mgon pos 4༄myur du gzigs//rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spangs (5)skye ba bzhes (snyupar mdzod/ /thams cad bzhengs (7par mdzad pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /'khor lo can rnams thams cad kyi/ /'dis ni bskyed par 'gyur bar nin/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po 'di (9)skad gsungs / /oṃ sasba 1 ta thā ga ta khe 11tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa 1 ād+ma ko3lha lha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3rta57/ o sarba ta thā ga ta 'apā tā la wā si ⑨sri badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3rta1 / sku gsung thugs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /byin brlabs sna gnas su brtag 16par ni/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag rgya chen por rab sbyor bas rnyi/ /sku yi rin chen sbyang bar bya/ /bsam gtan rdo rje bsams nas ni/ /sems kyi rin chen rab sgrub byed/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /ngag gi rdo rje dri ma med / /gti mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyang / /zhe sdang rdo rje bsam lhapa yis/ /sgra yi sgo yi (22bsam (na pa'o/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje yis / /ro drug 'dod chags rdo rje yis/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje yis/ /yid ni kun du bzang po yis/ /de nyid mkha' 'gro bdag med ma/ /'di rnams kyis ni rnam par sbyang / /gal te 'gal ba yod pa ma yin yang / /de 2 tshe rgyal 80—133

ba'i dngos po sbyong ba yod(1)/ /kun rdzob bden par yang dag gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo gzugs kyi chos tsam rnam par bsgomatshu/ /chos kyi dngos po ma byung spyad pa las/ /gang zag thams cad rnam spangs 'jig rten pa/ /'jig rten 'gro bar bsam par mi nus te/ /chos kyi tshul gyis thams cad rnam par dag /tshig pa rnams kyi gdung dang dug khyab pa'i/ /lus kyi sman ni gzhan gyi dug nyid de / /ji ltar chu ni rna bar zhugs pa la/ /yang ni chu ni thabs su 'gyur ba nyid//ji ltar rlung gis dkrugs pa'i sems rnams kyi( ra/ /de bzhin mkhas pas mon sran gre'u bzhin/ /'dod chags kyis kyang rmongs pa yi/ /skye bo 'dod chags me yis gdung / /'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod chags med ④pas zad par 'gyur/ /'dod chags rdo rje yongs shes pas/ /yid ni rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhags pas 'ching ba yis/ /'jig rten chags pas khyab par brjod/ /'dod chags bral ba'i mngon byang chub/ /'dod chags mthar phyin rnams mi 'dod/ /de nas rdo rje sgrol ma yi(5)/ /sgrub thabs sbyin sreg (6)las kyi ni/ / cho gas 9)'dod don thams cad ni(8)/ /sgrub thabs yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la 'di rnams ni sngags kyi rkang pa yin te / rten mo rat+na 7dra yā ya/ oṃ na ma ār+sā (stob lo ki te 6)shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā 12ya/ ma hā satā beya/ ma hā kā aru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭan ma kṛ 7te dzi bha ya stam+bha ya/ mo ha yo ya/ brnya yinyeya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa19/ sarba du/ 8 )stam+bha ni tā re rdo ཿswā hā/ ma mo dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya/ /phyag brgyad zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gser gyi kha dog 'dra bar bsgom( snye/ /80wa 134

gzhon nu ma yi mtshan nyid 'bar/ /rdo rje nyi mas dbang bskur ma1)/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi dbu rgyan can/ /lang tsho la ni bab pa'i lus/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'od zer dmar pos rnam par brgyan②/ /rdo rje zhags pa de bzhin dung / /g.yas pas mda' ni 'gengs pa'ol/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ut+pa la/ /sdigs mdzub ①g.yon pas 'dzin pa mo/ /rdo rje skyil krung ④sbyor ba yisal/ /gnas gsum pa ni bsgrub par bya/ /shar du me tog sgrol ma ste/ /kha dog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge oṃ las skyes pa'o/ /me tog phreng bas lag pa khyab/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig ma nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas su bdug spos sgrol ma ste/ /mdog gnag stimadzes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /spos dang dung gis lag pa brel/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub tu mar me sgrol (pem ste/ / mar me (8risdong bus lag pa khyab/ /mdog ser rnam par rgyan ①chen moyi/ /g.yo ba gser 41gyi rna cha ma/ /byang du dri yi sgrol ma ste/ /dri yi dung 8gis lag khyab pa/ /khrag gi tsomadog ltar lha mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu la sogs rab dbye bas/ /der ni sgo yi dhisung yim bsam/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma/ /'og tu gnod mdzes ma rab bsgomayi/ /'khor lo klu zhags ( bsnams nas ni/ /spro zhing sngags ni bzla tunyebar bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā / yi ge bcu yis lha mo bcu/ /pha rol phyin bcu la gnas ma/ /'bras bu thams cad rab bsgrub //phyir/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgom ( )par bya/ /sngags ni mchog dang phul du phyin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad ma/ /bklags ( stopas 'gyur byed drag po ste/ /rdo rje gur gyis bshad pa'o/ /sngags 'dis gos 80—135

kyi thu bar bdun/ /mngon par bsngags pa 91)bya ba ste/ /mdud pas bcings te nags tshal du/ /'gro (5na'ang sus kyang mi 'khyer te/ /stag dang chom rkun dang chu srin sna 'thung dadang seng 4)ge dang sbrul dang mche ba can dang ma he dang /dom dang snyug 5glang la sogs 'dran pa tsam gyis nyams shing yib bo/ /sngags 'dis ut+pa la la sbyin sreg ji srid du/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad ji tsam gyis (7)bsku bar bya ste/ oṃ tā 8re tut+ta re tu re 59a mu kai 7me wa sha mā nā 17ya swā hā/ yang sngags de nyid kyis khu'i 12sgro la lan sum cu 1 rtsa gnyis yongs su bzlas te/dgra'i khyim du sbas na/ nyi ma bdun gyis skrod par byedami/ oṃ tā skore tut+ta re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shī r+ghaṃ gā mi ni de wa dalta utsā ṭa tshaya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba/ oṃ tā re tut+ta 1 re tu re a mu kā kyi bhi 1/dh+wa māṃ )ku ( 1)mā rī ma h+ya muṅgā hi 22na ta staḥ pi tā pra yats+tsha tu /me swā hā/ spra na )tshil dang gtum pa'i sa bon dang / myos byed dang a sho 25ka'i lo ma dang / me tog sreg zhuciblugs bya zhing / mar dang sbrang rtsi bu ram du bcas pa stong phrag lnga'i sbyin sreg ni bu mo'i dngos grub la rab tu bsngags te/ nyi ma bdun gyis de'i tshe rnal 'byor pas rang 'dod pa'i bu mo thob bo/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor bar 'gyur ba / oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu kā bhi dhā māṃ swas+thā nā ta ā kur ṣa ya marnyi ke dzaḥ sngags 'dis ba da ra'i tsher ma stong phrag lnga rang byung gi me tog dang sbrags te sreg blugs 29bya bar brjod pa 'di byas pas skyes bu skyong ba rnams kyi bu mo yang 'gugs par byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i ras la bcom ldan 'das ma phyag gnyis ma/ zhal gcig sa1lag pa lcags kyu dang / ut+pa la dang zhags par bcas pa rnam par bris te/80—136

de'i mdun du mchod pa byas te6)/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge nazhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas phyi nas bsgom (5)pa dang ldan par sngags bzlas so/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu tī ma me pa si tai swa sno ka tha sa)ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong phrag lngas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhags pas (5)mgrin par bcings te/ lcags kyus 96)drangs nas bsgrub bya rkang pa'i 'og tu bsams te/ khol mo'i tshul gyis spyad par (7)bya'o/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags 8par bya ste/ bdag gi mig gnyis mig sman gyis bsku bar bya zhing rgyal po'i rigs kyi drung du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po slob ma dang 'dra bar gus par byed cing 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / bka' drin stsol 9)zhing snyan par rjod dzo )par byed pa dang / bran du yang dag par 'gro zhing khros pa yang 11dbang du 'gyur ba ste42/ 'di ni mngon sum du mthong ba dang ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba sgrol ma'i gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ kha gnyis pa'i so dug thal bar byas la1ri/ba kha dog dmar mo'i mar dang / arka'i shing bal las sdong bu rab tu sbar la nyu mig sman bsdu bar bya'o/ /mig sman rdo rje nyi 15ma dang / rdo rje chos dag mnyes la rdo rje 7rta mchog gis bdug par bya'o/ /thal ba dang lhan cig mig la bsku bar bya ste/ rdo rje mig gis gang bltas pa de/ gal te pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug mi 'bab na de'i tshe bdag sgrol ma ma 1 lags te/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bkrongs 18pa lags so/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu 19sbyor bar 'gyur ba byis pa so med pa'i lce blangs la/ sgrol ma'i gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags 2 par 21byas nas bung ba'i rgyal po'i rtsa ba dang / ba lang 2580—137

gi gi wang lhan cig byas pas dpral bar thig le yongs su bzung ste/ gang bltas pa de dbang du byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba lto ba'i srin bu la gzungs bdun mngon par bsngags pa bya ste/ rdo rje dang lhan cig hunyeso rtsis byas la byin te/ sbyor ba mchog zos pa na (mimi spong ba dang / gzhan du ⑧mi dga' ba dang / gzhan du mi 'gro ba dang / rang gi bdag po yang spong ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba mar khu rtsichen pos nye bar byugs la/sgrol ma'i gzungs bzlas la de bsgom par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar sā ⑤phu btags pas 'dag 6)gu'i dri ma la khu ba byas te/ gang la byin pa de lnga por yang mi spong ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba zla ba la nye bar chags pa'i dus su sgrol ma'i gzungs zlos shing bsnyen ⑦pa byas la de las byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug blangs te/ dung gi thal ba dang mnye bar bya zhing rab tu dregs (snyem nyid la sbyin 9)te/ ji srid du lnga por ⑩yang rjes su 'brang ngo / /de nas gzhan yang sbyor bar 'gyur ba (1sgrol ma'i gzungs yonyekyis ma da na pha la la (nyalan brgya rtsa labargyad yongs su bzlas te/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu des rta mgrin dang lhan cig pas bskus skin dbang du 'gyur ro/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re a mu ka ⑩su ban+dha na musti ku ru muḥyo snaswā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di arka'i lo ma la bsgrub bya'i ming nang du bcug par bris la ne'u le'i khung bur sbas na bcings pa las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'byung gnas yang dag par rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /gang gis bsgoms 8pa tsam gyis phas kyi 47rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod par 'gyur ro/ /lha mo phyag gnyis ma/ zhal gcig ma/ sku mdog dkar ba yid 'phrog ma/ skra phyed du li ba/ chu skyes shin 80—138

tu dkar ba la 6)yang dag par gnas ma/ lag pa g.yas (kyepar pad ma mdog dkar ba yang dag par bsgoms shing / g.yon na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin darapa / rdo rje skyil krung du ④gnas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ las skyes ma/ mchog tu dga' bar byed ma/ dam tshig ①sems dpa' bskyed nas ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya zhing rnal 'byor zla ba drug tu goms pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo bdun yidu sbyor bas bstan bcos thams cad shes par byed do/ /'bum bzlas pa'i sbyor bas nyi ma re re la tshigs bcad rdzibargya brgya byed par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu 'bad pa med par gzhung brgya yang 'dzin par byed do/ /de la sngags kyi rkang par gyur pa/ o pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā bad+dha (8)ni6)/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā ban+dha tu )ni/ dhi ri dhi ri budhi ban+dha (7ni swā hā/ khwa mi zer ba na/sngags 'dis bdun du mngon par bsngags par yonyebyas te/ ma bslangs pa'i tu sings po skyur po la lan bdun du sngags kyis btab par bya zhing yi/ ji srid zla ba drug tu gang 'thung ba de 7shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de yis nye bar bsten pa'i sngags / /sgrub pa po yis nges par 'grub/ /dal zhing zab mo'i yichos dang ldan / / rig pa kun la (rtemakhas dang bcas/ /sbyin sreg nyusnyedakyil 'khor sngags shes shing (6/ /rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son/ /de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig /nyan thos spyod pa srung ( )ba po/ /sngags spyod rim pa gus pa dang / /gzugs ldan mthong na dga' ba dang / /dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing bzlas par ldan / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'joms pa po/ /sngags dang lus skyob sbyor ba yis/ /80—139

ba'i tshul gyis dang / /dri ni 'thor ba'i tshul las dang / /sdong pos (3)mar me'i mchod ripa dang / /byug ②pa'i lus kyis rjes su dris/ /lā su'i (kyilag pa lā su (geste / /4phreng bas phreng ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /glu yis hūṃ gi dam tshig glu/ /brla bskums pas ni gar nyid de/ /mchod pa 'di rnams bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mchod pas mchod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub byed par 'gyur/ /bzlas dang bsgom (5)pa mngon dga' zhing / /rtag tu 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skyobaka' ji bzhin / /'di rnams bla med mchod pa'o/ /me tog spos sogs mngon sum du/ /'jig rten spyod par gnas pa yis/ /sna tshogs mchod pa mchog nyid min/ /de nyid byang chub yan lag min/ /dkar po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /ser po rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs la/ /dbang dang dgug par dmar po ste/ /tha ma'i las la nag po'o/ /zhi ba la ni me tog dkar/ /ser po rgyas pa'i rdo rje la/ /me tog nag po tha ma la/ /dbang dang dgug la dmar po bzang / /rnal 'byor pa gang dbang bskur med/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / shegang zhig rab gnas ma mthong dang / /gang zhig sbyin sreg ma byas pa/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ / de yi 5chudangos grub mchog nyid med/ /gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab/ /'dir ni rigs su skye ba med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bya/ /gang gis byang chub ma thob na'ang (kyi/ /'khor los sgyur kyisaba'i gnas su de'i/ /skye zhing skye bar skye bar 'gyur4)/ /yang na sa yi bdag po nyid / /dag pa'i gnas su mngon par 'gro/ /bde ba can dang mkha' 'gro dang / /dga' ldan du ni blo ldan skye/ /'jig rten 'dir ni gang 67'grub pa/ /80—141

par gyur nas ni/ /rdo rje'i 0)dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rta mgrin gyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ②sa ma ya sa / hu lu hu lu/ oṃ ā ④ro lika phaṭa swā hāX5)/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam na/ /rdo rje chos ni (6)grags chen po/ /'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas ni/ /chos kyi dngos grub rab tu stsol—/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ phan pa'i sngags 'di gsungs pa/ o shā shwa tai pa ra ma shā shwa ta e gyi hi dzi na dzika (pephaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis / /sangs rgyas kun dang de bzhin gshegs/ /brgyal zhing 'jigs par gyur nas ni/ /de rnams phu)sangs rgyas dngos grub stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin chen nyi ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sngags 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya ta mo bi dha ma na sa ma yang sta ma haṃ rat+na jika po)phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'od po che/ /'jigs shing brgyal yibar gyur nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dngos grub rab tu stsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs (1te/ rta mchog rdo rje'i sngags 'di gsungs so/ /phuḥphuḥphuḥhi hi hi pradz+nyā sgrika dzi phaṭa yo swā hā/ de nas 'di ni bshad tsam gyis/ /rdo rje don yod rigs byung ba/ /'jigs shing brgyal tshabar gyur nas nim/ /de rnams don yod dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor zlum po ste / /rdo rje can gyi zla phyed mtshungs/ /rdo rje chos kyi pad+ma 'dra/ /nyi ma'i yid bzhin nor bu bzhin7 / /rta mchog ces tsho/shebya de yi ni/ /thams cad du ni gru gsum mo/ /rdo 80wa 149
