bdud rtsi lnga'i/ /bza' ba dang ni spyod pa'o/ /khyod dang bdag gi snying po ni/ /ji ltar de ni nges par yod/ /sems can rnams ni bsrung ①don du/ /'dus pa'i gnas kyi dbus su ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig lha mo spyan bzangs ②mo/ /'khor lo drug gi sa bon ni/ / k+ṣiṃ slo blo durlo rlo dzā ni ④/ /dbus su re re dgod par bya/ /khaṃ raṃ shaṃ baṃ saṃ mo paṃ ni/ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i ⑤sa bon drug / gli klo rmi me ⑥'khor lo/ /mkhas pas gru gsum dgod par bya/ /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye khog/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa(nye/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i 'dab 6)ma la/ /gnyis su byas pa'i sa bon gdabaski / / ṭ+wāṃ trī māṃ khaṃ dang / lī rmā r+pā rta(nya/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sa bon brgyad / /a ā/ i khri/ u u/ ṛ rī/ '-i lī/⑩ e matso/ o au/ i aḥ longs spyod 'khor lo brgyad gnyis 'di/ /g.yon skor 8du ni bri bar bya/ /de ni gnyis su byas pa ni/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i sa bon no/ /mnyam pa yi ni sa yi cha/ /chang la sogs pas byug pa 'bya/ /tsan+dan dang ni gur gum mchog /sna tshogs mchog gi me tog dang / /sna tshogs mchod pa la tsosogs kyis/ /mkhas pas sa la mchod par bya/ /bu mo yid 'phrog lha yi gzugs/ /nyi shu lon pa g.yo ba med/ /gnas ni gang du sngags rgyal ⑩btu/ /re zhig yidang po de ru gzhug /mchog gi dga' ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rtse gcig gis ni bsnyen par bya/ /bsnyen pa'i las ni rdzogs pa dang / /de nas sa la bsang 6)gtor bya/ /slob ma de yi ne )thig le bya/ /bu mo la yang de ltar ro/ /sha chen la (1sogs kyis gang ba'i / /gtor ma phyogs bzhir gtang 6)bar bya/ /tshogs la 'bad de mchod pa tso80—254

bya / /med na yang ni 'bad pas so/ /sngags btu ba yi dus su ni①/ /'bad de bla ma mchod par bya/ /bla ma dgyes na sngags rgyal ni/ /the tshom med par thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar min na skyon yod de/ /sngags kyang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje phreng ②bas bskor ba yis / /'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma bri/ /dbus su k+ṣa yi sa bon ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rtsirang bzhin can/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyar nas/ /thub pa bdun ni btu bar bya/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad bri/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /uṣ+ṭha (geyi ni bzhi pa dang / /bcu drug pa yi duganyis par ldan/ /dang po yi ni dang po dang / /me yis 'og tu brgyan ⑦pa'o / /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /gti mug thams cad mtshon cha'o / /bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan/ / surmi sha niyi dang po dang / /an+tas+tha 6)yi bzhi par ldan/ /de nas me yi sa bon dang glu/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /an+tas+tha yiyi dang po dang / /an+tas+tha 7yi bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig tsogasum pa dang ldan patso/ /thams cad kyi ni snying po bcom/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /de nas brgyad pa'i dang po dang —/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /yi ge mchog nyid gnas yin no//gsum pa yi ni dang po dang / /de nyid kyi ni 'og tu brgyan/ /yang na 8de nyid bri bar 8bya/ /uṣ+ṭha yiyi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can/ /uṣ+ṭha 4)yi ni gsum pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /uṣ+ṭha ()yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pas brgyan yipa'o/ /dang po yi ni dang po dang / /an+tas+tha ( )yi gsum pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /dbyangs ni (steganyis pas brgyan pa'o/ /dang po yi ni 80—255

gsum pa dang / /nyi shu pa yis brgyan pa'o/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa / /khro bo yi ni gzugs chen che/ /ud+ma 6)yi ni gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /de nyid 'og tu ldan par bya(snye/ /dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan pa ste / /lha rnams kun gyi byed pa'o/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pas brgyan pa'o/ /brgyad pa yi ni dang po dang / /thams cad kun gyi pha yin no/ /uṣ+ṭha (geyi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig drug pas brgyan pa ni/ /zla tshes thig le dang ldan pa/ /sems kyi dbang phyug yi ge (5)mchog /de nyid yang ni bri bar bya/ /de nas lnga pa'i gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po dang / /uṣ+ṭha 6)yi ni gsum pa dang / /an+tas+tha (7)yi bzhi par ldan / /dbyangs yig gnyis pas brgyan pa'o/ /ya yi sde tshan brgyad pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /thams cad don grub mchog yin te/ /bdag gi snying po'i sngags (0rgyal lo/ /dbang (9)po gzugs kyi bdag po dang / /an+tas+tha yiyi bzhi pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /me yis 47'og tu brgyan pa'o/ /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /dbyangs yig bcu gcig dang ldan pa / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pas brgyan pa//dang po yi ni gsum pa dang / /me yis (/nya'og tu brgyan ldan pa/ /urmi tsho)yi ni bzhi pa dang / /ri yiyig 'og tu brgyan pa ni/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ldan pa / /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ /yang na 'de nyid bri bar bya/ /de bzhin lnga pa'i gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po dang / /nye ba'i snying po mchog gi sngags/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad dang / /de nas urmi'i skigasum pa dang / /dbyangs yig lnga pa dang ldan pa/ /lha rnams kyi sems gti 80—256

mug byed/ /de nas me yi sa bon dang / /de nas bzhi pa'i dang po dang / /uṣ+ṭha 0)yi ni gsum pa dang / /de nas nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /de nas rlung gi sa bon bri / /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan/ /gzhan gyi phyag rgya rab tu 'joms / /uṣ+ṭha ②yi ni dang po dang / /an+tas+tha (miyi bzhi par ldan/ /de nas nyi ma'i sa bon dang / /dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan pa'o/ /urmi ④yi ni bzhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig drug pa dang ldan pa/ /zla tshes thig les brgyan pa'o / /yang na ⑤de nyid bris pa ni/ /gzhan gyi sngags ni 'joms pa'o/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /de nas gsum pa'i dang po dang / /urmi ⑥yi ni gsum pa dang / /an+tas+tha (7yi bzhi par ldan/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par ldan pa ni / /sdug bsngal thams cad med byed pa/ /ya yi sde tshan ⑧brgyad pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa'o6)/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa ste/ /khyod kyi snying po'i sngags rgyal lo/ /dang po lha yi 4 )bdag po dang / /de nas dang po'i dang po dang / /'og tu sa yig dang ldan pa/ /dbyangs yig gi ni bzhi pas brgyan/ /zla tshes thig le yis ni brgyan/ /thams cad kun gyi 4glebyed pa po/ /an+tas+tha 7yi bzhi pa dang / /sa yi (1 'og tu ldan pa dang / /dbyangs yig gi ni bzhi pa ldan/ /zla tshes thig le yis ni brgyan/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /sa yi yi ge 'og tu ldan/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ldan pa/ /zla tshes thig les brgyan pa'o/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po dang / /swā hā tha mar ldan pa ni/ /khyod kyi nye ba'i snying po'o/ /de ni 8sngags kyi gsang chen po/ /su la yang ni mi sbyin te/ /lha mo 'de bzhin man ngag 'di/ /su la yang ni mi sbyin no/ /bye ba 'bum gyi nang nas gcig /de ni man ngag gi ni 80—257

snod / /sngags sam yang na man ngag 'di/ /brtag ①par byas te de nas sbyin/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya ②yis kyang / /de ltar min na 'grub pa med/ /bla ma'i kha las man ngag 'di/ /legs dgyes dbang mo rnyed par 'gyur/ /bstan bcos lung las yang dag ni/ /nam yang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /man ngag don du bla ma mchog /yang dang yang du zhu mi bya/ /bla ma mnyes na yang dag nyid/ /man ngag de la sbyin par byed/ /ji ltar bu mo lang tsho bab/ /pha la zhu bar mi byed na / /pha rang nyid kyis shes nas ni/ /da ni bu mo sbyin dus snyam/ /ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥkho ③gi sngags rgyal gyis/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni spyad par bya/ /sa chu me rlung ④rnams kyi ni / /sa bon gyis ni bza' bar bya/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las 'khor lo drug gi sa bon dang / sngags btu ba dang / bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba dang —/ spyad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa phyigacig pa'o// //'byung po rnams ni bsrung ⑥rdon du/ /nyon cig gtor ma bdag gis bshad / /dur khrod yang na chu ngogs sam/ /yul gyi mtha' 'am yang na ni / /shing gcig dang ni khang stong du/ /gtor ma 'bad gde sbyin par bya/ /tshangs pa ma dang / drag mo dang / dbang phyug chen mo dang / khyab 'jug ma dang /phag mo dang / mi'i seng (mige mo dang / brgya byin mo dang / me mo dang / chu lha mo dang / rlung lha mo dang /(7) gzhon nu mo dang / gnod sbyin mo dang /mkha' lding mo dang / sprul mo dang / glang chen mo dang / gshin rje mo dang / nor sbyin mo dang /yi nyi ma mo dang / gtum myo dang / de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rnal 'byor pas 'dir phyag rgya 'dis yidagug 80—258

par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis byas te/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu bsnol bar bya/ /mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ /mdzub 6)mo drang por bsgreng ②byas te/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis ni/ /cung zad tsam ni dgug par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang / mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dang ⑧/ 'byung po dang /yi dgas byadang / sha za dang / drag po chen po dang / brjed byed rnams tshur shog tshur shog /nya dang / sha dang / khrag chen po dang / bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / chang dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la ⑤sogs pa dang /gdugs dang / rngul yab kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di snoms shig /dam tshig 'di srungs shig /bdag gi don thams cad kyi grogs gyis shig /rgyud 'di la gang zhig dad pa yod pa de rnams bsrung yiba'i don du gsol cig /'thung shig(pe /rol cig /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bha ga'i phyag rgya mgo steng bca'adu / /phyag rgya 'di yis gtor ma sbyin/ /rkang pa mnan cing steng yonyedu blta//ha ha'i ⑩sgra ni sgrogs (nyebyed cing / /rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa yi/ /he ru kur ni bdag nyid bsam/ /brgya byin 'dra ba'i lha ma yin/ /mdun du byung tsobar gyur na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /gzhan rnams smos kyang ci zhig dgos / /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las gtor ma'i las zhes tu)bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ni/ /nyon cig lha mo spyan bzangs moyi/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa yi/ /de ru 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /thams cad 80—259

dam tshig gcig pa dang / /thams cad rtog pa med pa dang / /ser sna nga rgyal spangs pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang bral ba dang / /bla ma la gus bsam gtan ldan/ /phrag 0)dog med cing rtse gcig pa/ /de ltar dgyes pa tshogs 'khor lo(mi/ /mkhas pas 'bad de gzhug ①par bya/ /de ltar min na skyon yod de/ /'khor lo yang ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /thabs dang mnyam pa'i gshes rab ma / /nyi shu rtsa lnga yan chad spangs6)/ /thabs re shes rab re rer ldan/ /kun la gcig ni mi mdzes (6)so/ /dang po yid 'phrog dgyes pa yis(7)/ /me tog dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de ru sna tshogs mchod pa ni(8ste/ /rtse gcig gis ni legs par bya/ /bla ma dngos po thams cad kyis/ /dad pa yis ni mchod par bya / /tshogs pa la yang 'bad de po)mchod/ /mnyam nyid blta ba sems kyis so/ /ji ltar bla mas phyag rgya 'dzin/ /tshogs kyis kyang ni de ltar ro/ /rtse gsum yang na ral gris bsadayo )/ /nam phyed na ni blang bar bya/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /mchod nas bla ma'i gdan bya'o/ /dbus su bdag nyid he ru kur/ /phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pa/ /de ni bla ma zhes su bstan/ /legs dgyes dbang mo bdag nyid do/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su huḥni/ /mchil ma la ()sogs dor mi bya/ /gtam kyang 9/nyesmra bar mi bya ste/ /rkang pa la 8sogs brkyang mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i brda 7dang gsang ba'i skad/ /de la 'bad pas ⑩bya ba'o / /bka' lung med na gar dang glu/ /nam yang tshogs kyis mi bya'o/ /dum bu gcig pa'i mtshan ldan snod/ /bla ma'i mdun du gzhag khyenapar bya/ /yang na dum bu gsum pa ni/ /lha yi chang gis bkang bar bya/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /snod de la ni mchod par bya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor snod 80wa 260

gzhan ni/ /me tog rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i/ /dang por ①gtor ma chen po ni / /ji ltar dga' ba med mi 'gyur/ /je mang je mang btung bar bya/ /yang dang yang du phyag bya zhing / /phyag rgya bcings la btung bar bya/ /de nas bza' ba thams cad kun/ /dag par byas nas bza' bar bya/ /lte ba'i ①ri bong 'dzin dkar dang / /rta mgrin mchog dang ldan pa dang / /rtsu gis rdo rje gi)dkar legs spyad(snye/ /āḥ(6)yis phyarab tu rtogs byas shing / /oṃ kyi (kyi'od kyis 6)'bar 'gyur bar/ /byin gyis brlabs nas mngon par bza'/ /rang rirtse pad 'dab dbus ma ru/ /hūm̐ byung rdo rje dkar po dgod / /phyi nang bdag nyid thams cad kun/ /'khor lo de yis rab tshim bya/ /'khor lo bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ /'khor lo ma lus kun sbyang 7bya/ /dpa' bo'i lce la dpa' bo ni/ /dpa' bo'i dpa' bo dbus su'o/ /dpa' bo'i kha la dpa' bo ni/ /mchod pa'i dus su mchod par (1bya/ /lte ba gnyis kyi tsodabus su ni/ /dpa' bo kun gyi yonamachog gi gnas/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi mchog gi don / /dpa' bo de kun mi shes na/ /de yis tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /nam yang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang ci de lta'i rim pa yis/ /phyi dang nang gi bya ba'o / /de ltar byas na dngos grub 'thob/ /mkha' 'gro ma yang lhan cig 'dus / /gal te gzhan ma'i rnal 'byor ma/ /brtag pa'i don du 'ong 'gyur na / /de la re zhig ⑩the tshom ni/ /mkhas pas nam yang mi bya'o/ /gtam ni smra bar mi bya ste/ /phyag rgyas bsnyun 7ni gsol bar bya/ /gang zhig de ru bla ma yis / /gsung ba dang ni mdzad pa'ang de/ /yang na las kyi rdo rje yini/ /thams cad don kun byed pa'ang rung / /ji ltar rdo rje sems dpas rol/ /80—261

las kyi rdo rjes de ltar ro/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis rnal 'byor ma/ /yang dang yang ni 'ong 'gyur na/ /de ru re zhig ①'jigs mi bya/ /dpa' bo yi ni gzugs su spyod/ /bsdams (7pa la lar byed pa nani/ /de la chad pa rab rtogs bya / /yang dag dga' ba byung gyur na/ /thar pa'i rgyu phyir gar bya'o/ /'on kyang rdo rje rkang pa'i gar/ /ji ltar rnal 'byor ma mnyes 'odago/ /ma 'am sring mo chung ma dang / /sgyug mo dang ni mna' ma la/ /shes rab thabs kyi ⑤cho ga yis / /'bad de de la mchod par bya/ /de rnams mchod pas dngos grub ni/ /gang zhig sems la bsams (6)pa yod/ /lhag ma'i chagator ma bzung ⑧nas ni/ /dgon pa chen por gtang (9)bar bya/ /gal te de ru rnal 'byor ma/ /blta ba de ni ston byed na/ /de rnams mtshan nyid 'di lta bu/ /mkhas pas 'bad pas shes par bya/ /gang zhig bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /kun du zlum por snang 'gyur zhing / /kha ni sma ra rtag 7par yod/ /spu dang smin ma ring ba dang / /gos bzang gtsang zhing zhi ba dang / /mi g.yo bden par smra ba dang / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos la dga'/ /dpa' bo'i sring mo de ni dran/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin rus /nyasbal phyag rgya'o/ /pags 8pa bum pa spyi blugs nyid/ /phyag rgya'i lan du shes par bya(snye/ /de ni tshes bcu'i res dag chal/ /khyim du pad+ma 'dri 'bar 'gyur/ /lā yim yi ni bud med kyi/ /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di nyid ni/ /ma mchu 'phyang zhing mig dkyus ring / /mig ni dmar zhing ser skya gnas / /phyug cing skal bzang yon tan can/ /ser zhing tsam pa lta bur snang //shin tu ring min 7thung ba'ang min/ /sna tshogs pa yi gos la dga'/ /dpral bar ri mo gsum yod cing / /mtshan ngan gyen du bltas pa las/ /rgod cing 80—262

dga' ba nyid dag dang / /lam ni rnam par mnan cing gnas/ /g.yul du shi ba rnams kyi ni/ /gtam dag la ni rtag tu dga'/ /de ltar rab dregs mthong na ni/ /rtse gsum phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /rkang pa g.yas ①pa bskum pa yis/ /gar nyid kyang ni bstan par bya/ /g.yon pa dag ni yongs bzlog pa/ /phyag rgya'i ②lan ni yin par bshad/ /tshes bcu dang ni bcwa dubargyad ni/ /de yi dus tshigs yin par bstan/ /khyim du mdung rtse gsum pa yang / /bris nas de ni rtag tu mchod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lā ma yi/ /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin/ /gang gi mkhur ④tshos dag tu ni/ /khung bur snang bar gnas gyur cing / /de bzhin dmar ser lag pa dmar/ /mig ni ljang ①ser dag tu snang //skra ni de bzhin 'khyil pa dang / /mgo la dar ni bcings ⑥pa dang / /dpral ba la ni gsal ⑦bar ni/ /gzhu yi dngos por rab tu gnas/ /de bzhin mgrin ring sna ⑧ming ba/ /rtag tu gos dmar la dga' zhing / /rgod yo)cing glu ni len pa dang / /lan 'ga' zhig ni 7khro ba dang / /sems ni rnam par g.yo ba dang //rtsod pa la ni dga' ba ste/ /'di 'dra'i rab dregs mthong nas ni/ /shag ti'i phyag rgya ⑩bstan par bya/ /gnyis pa nyid ni 'bad pa yis/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su ldog tu)pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yin par bstan / /thung zhing byin ⑩pa 6sbom pa dang / /rtag tu gos ser la dga' zhing //phrag pa dag nas gos kyang 'phyang / /de 'dra'i bud med mthong nas ni/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya bstan bya zhing / /'bad pa yis ni gnyis pa yang / /dung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon nas yongs su bzlog 8pa ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni yin par bshad/ /bcu bzhi de yi tsodus yin te/ /de yi khyim du rdo rje 80—263

'dri0) / /he ru ka dpal lā ma yi/ /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin/ /lus kun la ni ba spu yod/ /mig ni gnag (micing ser ba dang / /sbom zhing rnam 'gyur (8)mi bzad 5gepa/ /bzhin (5)'phel che zhing kha che la/ /mchu ni 'phyang zhing kha dog gnag(nyu /mig zlum sna ni nyams (7)pa dang / /rtag tu glu dang gar la mkhas / /sprin gyi gzugs can gsus pa che/ /'di 'dra'i rab dregs mthong nas ni/ /glu yi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /gnyis pa yang ni 'bad pa yis/ /mdung gi phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /g.yon nas yongs su bzlog na (kyini/ /phyag cirgya'i lan ni yin par bshad/ /tshes grangs bcu gcig de yi dus/ /khyim du mche ba 'dri 9)byed pa/ /rdo rje phag mo lā ma yi7/ /mtshan nyid gyur pa 'di dag yin / /mtshan mo'i dus su lam du ni/ /de ltar 'bad de shes par bya de kun 'jigs par yong 11)mi bya/ /phyag rgya rnams kyis mnyes par bya/ /ji ltar bsams 12pa bzhin du ni/ /mnyes nas dngos grub ster ba'o/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i yan lag gi mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u ste (stenyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// // de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /de ru las ni rab yin te/ /gang zhig bsten pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub la 'jug pa/ /yan lag dri zhim shin tu 'jam/ /rdul ni dri zhim gyur pa dang / /ngo tsha che zhing bden par smra/ /yun ring 1rimig ni mi 'dzums skipa/ /khro ba med cing snying rje che/ /skad cig 'jam par smra ba dang / /skye ba bdun nam yang yin gsum/ /'bad pa yis ni tu snabatsal bar bya/ /bsod nams dang ldan sems pa yi/ /des ni lag tu rnyed 80wa 264

par 'gyur/ /de yang zos par byas nas ni/ /de yi snying gar 1)ro tsa na/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis ni/ /he ru ka yi sngags lan bdun/ /bzlas nas 'bad pas thig le bya/ /'phral du steng du lding dun)'gyur zhing / /dpag tshad bye bar 'gro ba'o/ /de ni zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /khams gsum ye shes can du 'gyur / /dpag tshad bye ba lnga bcur ni/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'gro ba'o/ /lha yi 0lus kyang thob 'gyur te/ /bskal pa stong du gnas par 'gyur/ /brgya byin gyi ni stobs 'dra'o/ /bud med bltas pa tsam gyis ni/ /ji ltar me yis mar bzhu ltar/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las las kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u ste ④nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //bcom ldan ye (nyashes rgyal dbang po/ /bdag la the tshom skyes pa mchis/ /sngags pas 6)sngags rnams 'grub don du/ /bzlas brjod de ni ji 57)ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis bzlas dang bsgom(8) / /nyon cig lha mo 'gro ba ma/ /srog dang rtsol ba mnyam byas nas/ /srog dang rtsol ba bza' 59)bar bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba 'gog byas te/ /srog dang rtsol ba la blta'o/ /pad+ma'i kha sbyar sbyor ba las/ /shes rab thabs ni spyad par bya/ /lte ba gnyis kyi nam mkha' las/ /khab rtse dbye ba med pa yi/ /yi ge shel gyi 'od ldan pa/ /ā tsho )li'i phreng ba dran par bya/ /yi ge re re yid kyis ni / /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas/ /'khor lo rnams kyi lte ba'i nang / /bzlog pa byas nas drang bar 41)bya/ /ha ha'i sgra ni 'jam pa yis/ /mgrin pa ya rkan 'gul tu med pas/ /nang gi reg bya 'jam pa yi/ /snying ga 12kho na'i gnas 80wa 265

su bya/ /shes rab gtum mo'i gzugs su grags①/ /rnam pa dang bral bde sbyin ma / / reg bya med pa'i reg skyed ma/ /③de lta'i shes rab dang lhan cigani /rdo rje skyil krung ④sems kyis ni/ /sems ni g.yo ba med par bya/ /thig (getshul char yang dang bral ba/ /thig 6)tshul char yang dag ④nyid dang / /thig le tshul dang char yang nang / /rnal 'byor gyis ni der sems bya/ /char yang gi ni ⑧nang du sems/ /yang ni tshul gyi nang du sems/ /tshul ni thig ler 'gro bar bsgom6) / /thig le yang ni stong par 'gro/ /stong pa rang bzhin zhes su bstan/ /gsum dang bral ba ma skyes mchog / de lta bu yi cho ga yis/ /kyi'adi yi cho ga'i thabs kyis tu)ni/ /gang zhig rtse gcig gis ni bzlas/ /des ni dngos grub chen po 'thob/ /zla ba gcig gis gdon mi za/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //bcom ldan dpa' bo dpa' dbang phyug /sngar ni khyod kyis dus bka' stsal//thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dbang phyug /de yi don ni bshad du gsol/ /de yi dus kyi don 'di ni/ /spyan ring lha mo khyod nyon cig /dus ni char yang zhes su bshad/ /de rnams kyi ni sbyor ba'i don/ /sbyor ba bzhi yang bzhi bzhir gyis//yan lag gcig ni spangs pa'o/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis rnyed dka' ba/ /de yi skye ba bdag gis bshad/ /rten gyi srog gi dbyug ⑩pa la/ /de ru sbyor ba bstan pa'o / /srog gi dbyug yonyepa dbus na gnas/ /phra ba'i phra ba yang dag mchog /sum cu 8rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan/ /de ni phyi rol nang du min/ /mdud pa yi ni gnas su sbyor/ /de yini char yang rnams kyi don/ /char yang sbyor ba nang du 80—266

min / /nang du de ni rtog med ma/ /mdud pa'i nang du g.yas dang g.yon/ /ro ma dang ni brkyang stim laganas/ /mdud pa gnyis dbus gcig gcig ste/ /sum cu ①gnyis kyis bcu drug dran/ /bde chen 'khor lo mgrin pa gnas/ /lte ba'i steng ni yan chad do/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi skud pa ni/ /mdud pa med pa gcig pu'o/ /de 'og mdud pa dang ldan pa/ /rlung gi 'khor lo yan chad do/ /spyi bo nas ni mgrin yan chad/ /de tsam sbyor ba bzhi yin no/ /mgrin pa'i 'og nas snying ga'i ④gnas/ /de tsam gzhan ni bzhi (5)yin no/ /snying ga'i (nyaganas nas lte ba'i bar/ /de tsam gzhan yang bzhi yin no/ /lte ba nas ni nor bu'i mgrin / /de tsam gzhan ni bzhi yin no/ /de ni sbyor ba bzhi ru bshad/ /char yang dga' ba dang bral brdzi/ /'dod dang rdul dang 'dar dang stobs/ /'gro dang bdud rtsi yang yin te/ /dga' dang pad+ma (kyede bzhin te/ /de ni dang po'i sbyor ba bzhi/ /rgyas dang rdul dang mdud dang myos/ /'byung ba dang ni mtshan mo dang / /mchog gi dga' dang ro yin te/ /de ni gnyis pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /'bar dang zhi dang ⑨jig le gnas/ /myos dang 'og ma de bzhin no/ /dga' bral dga' ba 'gug ⑩pa ste/ /de ni gsum pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /u ta 'dab 4)ma tshul rlung ma/ /gnyid dang me ma de bzhin no/ /lhan cig skyes dga' ma skyes pa / /de ni sbyor ba bzhi pa'o/ /rin chen ske 4snyen phyin tugetsam na/ /de ni zla ba gang bar dran/ /dga' ba yod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /de ni shar bar yishes par bya//bcwa tsolnga pa ni 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /bcu drug pa la rtog mi byed/ /skye dang 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ /de la sbyor ba med pa'o/ /char yang rnam skyed sbyor ba ni/ /rtse gcig gis ni khyod nyon cig /bcu drug de bzhin nyi ma dang / /gang du gnyi ga 780—267

sbyor bar 'gyur/ /de la ma skyes cha zhes bya/ /de rang ngo bo rang bzhin no/ /bcu drug de bzhin nyi ma dang / /6)char yang 'byung ba'i ②rgyun ③yin no/ /de ni 'byung ba kun gyi pha/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par ldan/ /bcu drug pa ni shes rab yin/ /nyi ma thabs su bstan pa'o/ /bcu drug phan chad shes par bya / / nyi ma mchog tu dran pa'o/ /④de gnyis ⑤dbus bzhugs rang bzhin ni/ /ngag gi lam gyis rnyed par dka'ayi/ /de lta bu yi dus kyi don/ /yang dag par ni bdag gis bshad/ /'di las gzhan mchog gsang ba ni/ /zhal bzang yang dag med pa'o/ /'bad pa yis ni sba bar bya/ /su la yang ni mi sbyin no/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las dus kyi don gyi rang bzhin gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa 7)drug pa'o// //sngar sbas sngags kyis (8rigasal ba de(1)/ /nyon cig lha mo bdag gis bshad/ /dad ldan rnams kyis 7shes don du/ /dad pa med la nam yang min/ / hā swā tunyeṭapha hūm̐ hūm̐ ya bhā yoge rjis g+ni tu pā la kā hā ma sa ha ṭ+wā ṭ+wā ④ya dza bi ya dza ra snyishwa dhe kro hā ma oṃ/ gsang chen po yi sngags 'di ni/ /thams cad don kun grub byed pa//ṭapha dz+rī dz+rī 7bri dzo te dz+ra ba o/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags chen po/ /thams cad kun gyi (rtedabang du byed/ /hā swā ṭapha hūṃ hūm̐ ri shwa ye ma sa 8ta ra su oṃ/ khyod kyi snying po'i sngags dbang po/ /grangs med yon tan dang ldan no/ /sngags pa'i ye shes grub don du/ /gsang ba'i sngags ni gsal byas so/ /hā swā ṭapha rmi gli khri47o / khyod kyi nye ba'i snying po 'di/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rnyed dka' ba/ /bdag gis de yi sngags kyis ni/ /grangs med dbang du byas pa'o/ /dpal 80—268

phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las sbas pa'i sngags gsal ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa hu)bdun pa'o// //yang dam du 'khyud ②pa byas nas skad snyan pa yisagli/ bcom ldan 'das ma legs dgyes dbang phyug mas 'di skad ces zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das (gele shes mkha' 'gro nyi/ /mi shes mun pa 'jig (5)byed pa/ /gsang ba kun ni gsungs pa las/ /phyag rgya chen po de ma gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen po ji ltar lags / /rgyal ba'i dbang phyug yang dag gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rab tu bde ba'i rnam pa mchog /nyon cig lha mo phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya chen po gsang ba che/ /brjod med mi zad 6)ma skyes pa/ /thams cad gzugs can gzugs dang bral/ /gzugs med gzugs kyi bdag nyid mchog /sbom phra la sogs ⑦dang bral ba/ /gzhal du med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /yang dag dri med rnam pa'i 'od/ /gang du yang ni gnas med pa/ /shar ba ma yin nub pa min/ /rtag tu shar ba char yang mchog /dus dang gnas skabs grol ba ste/ /skye dang 'jig par byed pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rnyed mi dka'/ /rnal 'byor cung zad rnyed dka' ba/ /thabs mchog gis ni rnyed 'gyur te/ /thabs mchog med na nam yang min/ /dpa' bo chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /de la thabs ni bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rtsa yi kun spyod sbyor ba yis/ /slob dpon kha las rnyed par 'gyur/ /rlung 'khor char yang gnas na ni/ /rlung ma gnyid (khum yod pa'o/ /g.yas pa dang ni g.yon gyi cha/ /char yang la ni shin tu bskor/ /de gnyis khong du chud pa yis/ /80—269

de las mchog gi bde ba 'byung / /bde ba'i nang nas phyag rgya che/ /the tshom med par rnyed par 'gyur/ /char yang dbus na rtsa yi gnas/ /phra mo'i phra mo yang dag mchog /rtsa yi gnas na rtsa yi gnas/ /de tsam la ni nges khyab bo/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ /lha mo chen mo de ni khyod/ /nga yi 'od ni yang dag khyod/ /phyi dang nang ni 6)yod pa'o/ /gang zhig phyag rgya che mi shes②/ /sangs rgyas yin yang rnal 'byor min/ /phyag rgya chen po'i thig le 'di/ /gang zhig dri med shes pa min/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /'bum gcig rnal 'byor nges shes kyang / /de lta mod kyi 'bras rab nges/ /nam yang 'byung bar ②mi 'gyur ro/ /thams cad chos kun rab shes na/ /de ni nges par sangs rgyas yin/ /phyag rgya chen po rab shes na/ /de ni dpal rdor sems dpar 'gyur/ /de yi rang bzhin ye shes ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid do//de skad ces thos nas bcom ldan 'das ma bye ba 'bum phrag bdun cu khyim gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang (5)bcas pas bskor ba lan gsum byas nas phyag 'tshal te khrag dron mos mchod do/ /bcom ldan 'das la mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po 6)thig le'i rgyud thos nas dga' mgu yi ⑦rangs te cang mi smra bar zhugs (gyiso/ /yang lho)dam du 'khyud 7pa byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor ma yi bdag /cung zad bdag la the tshom skyes/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /rtsa ba yi ni rgyud du bshad/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi (nyaganas de ni/ /sngar ni bdag gis ma shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bdag gi tsoganas dang gzhan de bzhin/ /nyon cig yang dag bdag gis bshad/ /gzhan gyi gnas ni bha gar brjod/ /bdag gi tsoganas ni snying 80—270

po'ol/ /sgo yi phyi rol gzhan gyi gnas/ /bdag gi gnas ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /yang na gzhan gnas sbyor ba yin/ /nye ba'i sbyor ba bdag gnas so/ /sbyor ba 0)mtho ris zhes su bstan/ /de bzhin du yang mi yul sbyor/ /nye ba'i sbyor ba sa 'og ste/ /mtho ris chos kyi snying pad+ma/ /nye ba'i sbyor ba ri rab rtse/ /mi yul lte ba'i lte ba'o/ /sa 'og sprul pa'i snying po ste/ /ri rab rtse mo ②gsang sna'o/ /de ltar gzhan ni gsang chen po/ /yang dag gzhan du ngas ma bshad/ /'bad de de ni bsrung bya ste/ /su la yang ni mi sbyin no/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud dbang phyug rgyal/ /rnal 'byor ma la bshad par bya/ /yang na sems dpa' chen po 'di / /legs par brtags ①nas gsal bar bya/ /dpal he ru ka chen po'i ④ dang po'i ⑤dang po grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang yib las kyang ches gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le rnal 'byor ma chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i ⑦mnga' bdag /thams cad mkhyen pas kyang rnyed par dka' bdu/ rmad du byung ba'i rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i 6)rgyud kyi rgyal po'i mnga' bdag ces bya ba rdzogs soyi// //rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal sngar/ ka ma chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug mtshams tunyedagra bcom gyis dad cing gus pas zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'on 'on80—271

〈〈zhol 〉〉dza ya rā/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉spyo spyo/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〉 ṭ+wāṃ/ tu)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyis/8〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉shwa ya ma sa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sho ye ma/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dzi ki/269 ①〈〈snar 〉〉 rtsa/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉mkhyud/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉pas/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉—'das / 0〈〈snar 〉〉'jigs/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzad/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉las sogs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉la sog ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/27 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉na/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mi shes pa/ ⑧〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dad/ ⑥〈〈khu 〉〉po'i/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉yid/⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bzhugs/ 6)〈〈pe 〉〉yid/ 1 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkhyud/tunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ tunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gis/ yonye〈〈snar 〉〉gis/271 ①〈〈snar 〉〉 bdag gnas so/ /sbyor ba/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉mos/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉bdags/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉po yi/①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 dang po'i/ 6)〈〈li 〉〉sang ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉po/ (nye〈〈pe 〉〉dad pa'i/ po)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉po'i / ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'tshams/ yonye〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉pa'o/6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ye dharmā ho tu pra bha bā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e ba dri ma hā tha ma ṇaḥ/sablo bā bsgyu ka ra ṇi ku sha la phyo ba saspa rda swa tsi nyi gi ri ma nu me tad bud+ma nu shā sa rna/ 〈〈li 〉〉 bkra shes dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ ma phyi gnyis la btugs nas zhus/ 〈〈pe 〉〉 bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ /ma phyi gnyis la btugs nas zhus/ /ye dharma he tu pra bha bā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba tad/te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e bo dri ma hā shra ma ṇaḥsablo bā ba sā bar ṇi ku shal phyo ba saspa rda/ swa tsi nyi bar di ma nu me tad bus nu shā sa rna/ 〈〈co 〉〉 bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ ma phyi gnyis la btugs nas zhus/ dge'o//80wa 283

tshog /dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po/1)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī (nanodz+nyā na gar bha nā ma yo gi nī (5)ma hā tan tra rā dza ya ti rā ( )dza/ bod skad du/ dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 5)dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri rab kyi rtse mor bye ba phrag bdun cu 56)rtsa gnyis kyi grangs kyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas yongs su bskor nas bha gu la chen po'i skyed 7)mos tshal na bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo legs dgyes dbang mo dang lhan cig tu ri rol pa mdzad pa'i tshe rje btsun la ba spu langs so/ /de'i dus su bcom ldan 'das ma legs dgyes kyi sbyor ba las langs te lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas zhabs la mgo bos phyag btsal (9)te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma (/rtabacom ldan 'das ci'i phyir nyid kyi sku la ba spu langs lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 80—285

bka' stsal pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das ma de 6)dgos pa ci zhig yod/ gang gi don gyi phyir nga'i ②sku la ba spu langs pa de ni gsang ba chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ gsang ba chen po lags mod ①kyang mchog gi dbang phyug bka' 465 cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ④bka' stsal pa/ nga yis legs dgyes kyi bde ba nyams su myong zhing steng dang 'og na gnas pa'i dga' ba'i skyed (snyebyed ma rnams la 'dus pa las ba spu langs so/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa / steng dang 'og na (nyaganas pa'i dga' ba skyed byed ma rnams la 'dus pa ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ steng dang 'og na gnas pa'i dga' ba skyed (7)byed ma rnams la gang zhig 'dus pa de ci'i phyir mi shes(nya/bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de skad du de ltar ni lags mod kyiponye/ 'on kyang mi shes pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du bdag gis ni zhus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni so so rang gis ⑩nyams su myong ba yin mod kyang / 'on kyang khyod kyi ngor ngas bshad par bya ste/dga' bral gyi 317dga' ba 'byung ba'i stong phrag bdun cu 8rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid kyi rtsa'i (nyedra ba 'dar zhing g.yos pa tsam gyis tshul shar ro/ /tshul shar bas thig le'i rgyal po zhu'o/ /thig le'i rgyal po zhu ba las steng dang 'og na gnas pa'i dga' ba skyed 'byed ma rnams la 'dus pa'o/ /de skad ces thos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ dam du 'khyud pa byas nas ma mchu'i bdud rtsi'i bobatung bas dgyes par byas te phyi ⑩nas yang zhu ba mdzad do/ /kye tu snabacom ldan 'das dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i dus su 'dus pa lags na/ de la sbyor ba med pa gang gi dus lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/80—286

dris pa yang dag dgyes pa mchog /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rnyed dka' ba/ /dga' bral dus su sbyor ba med/ /de ni dga' bral dga' ba min/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ kyai ①bcom ldan 'das dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang dga' bral la khyad par ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dga' mo khyod ci'i phyir de skad ces smra/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang dga' bral gnyis la khyad par cher yod pa de brjod par bya'o/ /gang zhig dga' bral gyi dga' ba de zhu ba gnas pa ste 'pho ba la sogs pa dang bral ba'o/ /gang zhig dga' bral de ni dga' ba dang bral ba zhu ba ②'pho zhing 'jig pa'o/ /dga' bral gyi dga' ba ni zhu ba gnas pa ste/ 'pho ba la sogs pa dang bral ba'i phyir rang gis nyams su myong ba'i ngo bo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ rang gis ②nyams su myong ba'i mtshan nyid dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i khyad par ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni dngos po yang ma yin/ dngos po ma ④yin pa yang ma yin/ gsang ba yang ma yin/ ye shes kyang ma yin/ ye shes las byung ba yang ma yin/ srid pa yang ma yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang ma yin/char yang ma yin/ thig le yang ma yin/ tshul yang ma yin/ tshul tsam yang ma yin / mchog kyang ma yin/ gzhan mchog kyang ma yin/ shar ba yang ma yin/nub pa yang ma yin/ gzugs kyang ma yin/ sgra yang ma yin/ dri yang ma yin/ro yang ma yin/ reg bya yang ma yin/ yi ge yang ma yin/ rten yang ma yin/brten pa yang ma yin/ khams kyang ma yin/ shes rab kyang ma yin/ thabs kyang ma yin/ thim pa yang ma yin/ longs spyod kyang ma yin/ dbang yang ma 80—287

yin / sprul pa yang ma yin/ chos kyang ma yin/ longs spyod kyang ma yin/lus kyang ma yin/ ngag kyang ma yin/ yid kyang ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad dang rnam par bral ba/ mi zad 4)pa/ dri ma med pa/ skye ba med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ rtag tu shar ba'o(gu/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ de lta bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba gang las rnyed/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba nyams su myong ba las rnyed de/ de bzhin du bsam gtan la sogs pas ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i nyams su myong ba'i rgyu lags sam 'bras bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rgyu yin te 'bras bu ni 98)ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba 'byung ba la rgyu'i dngos pos dgos pa ci mchis/ rang bzhin med pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar bsreg 5pa la dud pa bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de skad du smra ba ni tshad ma ma yin te/ dang por bsreg (6)pa med par der (7)dud pa 'byung 8ba gang las 'ong / de lta bu'i rigs las lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ de ltar lags na lhan cig skyes pa las dga' bral gyi dga' ba ni rgyu yang yin la 'bras bu yang yin na/ 'on kyang 'dir rgyu ni gnyis su dbye ba dang / 'bras bu yang gnyis su dbye ste/ gsal ba'i rgyu dang /'byung ba'i rgyu'o/ /'bras bu yang de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa / kye 9bcom ldan 'das gsal ba'i rgyu ci 'dra ba dang / 'byung ba'i rgyu ci 'dra ba bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsal ba'i 80—288

rgyu ni dga' bral gyi dga' ba ste/ ji ltar mar me bzhin no/ /'byung ba'i rgyu ni dga' ba las mchog gi dga' ba ste/ ji ltar sa bon las myu 0)gu bzhin no/ /dga' bral gyi dga' ba ni gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir 'byung ba'i rgyu ma yin te/ dga' ba gzhan dang mi 'dra na ba las 'byung ba yin no/ /dpal ye shes snying po las lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ gang zhig dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las phyag rgya chen po'i don bstan pa de thob par bya ba'i don du de'i thabs bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis bdag la zhus pa gang / /nyon cig lha mo rab tu bshad/ /phyag rgya chen po ni 'dir bzhir dbye ba ste/ las kyi phyag rgya dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / chos kyi phyag rgya'o / /gang zhig las kyi phyag rgya ni snang ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba'i lo dang ldan pa'o / /gang zhig dam tshig gi phyag rgya de ni snang ba mched pa'i rang bzhin skye mched kyi lo dang ldan pa'o/ /gang zhig ye shes kyi phyag rgya de ni snang ba thob pa'i rang bzhin khams kyi lo dang ldan pa'o/ /gang zhig chos kyi phyag rgya de ni 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin no/ /phyag rgya chen po de yang 'od gsal ma yin pa gzhan las mi rnyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'od gsal zhes bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ gang du gnas pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od gsal ni nam mkha'i dbus su gnas pa'i thig le'i ngo 80—289

bo ste de 0)ni phyag rgya chen po rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa / re zhig (mi'od gsal ni ji ltar rnyed pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ las dang dam tshig dang ye shes dang chos kyi phyag rgyas so/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ phyag rgya rnams nyid ni gang las rnyed par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbang bskur ba'i ③phyi'i phyag rgya la brten nas nang gi phyag rgya rnams rnyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ phyi dang nang gi phyag rgya de gnas gang du gnas par 'gyur/mtshan ni ji lta bu/ rang gi ngo bo ni ji lta bu/ der dbang ni ji lta bu lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dir dbang ni bzhi ste/ slob dpon dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes dang / de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi dbang ni dga' ba'i lo dang ldan pa gzhon nu ma la rdo rje dang dril bu mnyam par ldan pa yis (9nu ma dang 'dza' ⑤ku ni reg par byas pas soyi/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni skye mched kyi lo dang ldan pa'i gzhon nu ma la nang gi rkan yongs su 'jibs pa las so/ /shes rab ye shes ni khams kyi lo dang ldan pa'i gzhon nu ma gal lhan cig srub (kyepa yonyedang bsrub ⑩pa'i thabs chen po las zhu ba 'pho ba'i dus su ye shes nyams su myong bas so/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa ni shes rab ye shes de nyid brtan par byed pa ste/ de'i phyir de ltar de bzhin zhes bstan pa yin no/ /brtan par byas pa tsam gyis drug cu yirtsa bzhi'i ti'adab ma'i nang du phyag rgya bzhi mnyam par sbyor bar 'gyur ba 4)yin no/ /de yang 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / 'gro ba dang / rten pa'i ngo bos so/ /'jug pa ni gtum mo'o/ /gnas pa ni 48rang bzhin gyis 8rtog pa med pa'o/ /'gro ba ni bya yi80—290

gdong ma'i rtsa'o/ /rten pa'i ngo bos sgrog ma'i rtsa'o/ /don dam par phyag rgya chen po gcig pu ste/ 'on kyang las kyi rang bzhin gyis bzhir dbye'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams la las kyi rang bzhin gyi bye brag ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhi ba dang /rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po ste/ las kyi bye brag gis phyag rgya chen pos hu)thob pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po rnams kyi ming dang spyod pa ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhi ba ni rgod ②pa'o/ /rgyas pa ni blta ①ba'o/ /dbang ni lag pas 'khyud ④ pas so(snye/ /drag po ni gnyis kyis yiganyis snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /de rnams (1)la spyod pa'i tshangs pa'i gnas pa'i spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs ( chen po'i spyod pa dang / gos bral gyi brtul shugs 6)kyi spyod pa dang / rang dbang gi spyod pas so/ /dpal ye shes snying po las phyag rgya chen po dang / dbang bskur ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su dkyil 'khor rnams ji lta bu/ slob dpon ni ji lta bus bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i dus su rdul tshon la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gsang ba'i dbang la bla ma la dbul ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rang byung gi me tog dang ldan pa'i me tog gis so/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi 7dus su byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i bzhi mnyam gyis so/ /bzhi pa'i dus su 80—291

gzhan ma yin pa byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig dkyil 'khor gyis so/ /de la slob dpon ni mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan 0)pa dang / rgyud thams cad mkhyen pa dang / dbang bskur ba la mkhas pa dang / thugs rje dang ldan pa dang /rgya che ba la mos pa dang / sngags la sogs pa dang / rab tu sbyor ba la mkhas pa dang / dngos grub thob pa'i slob dpon la sogs pas dbang bskur ba dang /dngos grub thob pa'i bla ma'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang / yang na rang nyid dngos grub thob pa des ni dkyil 'khor dang / dbang bskur ba'i rim pa dang /sgrub tsho thabs la sogs pa bya'o/ /de bzhin du rtog ge pa la ( )sogs pas ni ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ kye (4)bcom ldan 'das slob dpon gyi ni dbang bskur ba'i/ dkyil 'khor mtshan ma ji ltar lags/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni tshad ji tsamakha /gtso bo bdag po yang ni gang / /ngo bo gang gis slob ma gzung 5/ /las kyi slob dpon ji lta bu/ /mchod pa rnams ni ji ltar lags/ /bla ma'i yon ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / khyod kyis sgyu bdag la gang zhus pa/ /lha mo nyon cig bdag gis bshad / /mtshan ma'i slob ma'i mos pas so/ /yang na ji ltar dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyi yid dang 'thad pa'o/ /de bzhin mthe bo'i sor gsum lhag pa'i khru phyed dang do'i dkyil 'khor bya'o/ /de ni re zhig tsho7)mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de'ang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi go rims kyis (8)bya'o/ /de yang yan lag 9thams cad tshang ba'o/ /de'i yidabus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du hūm̐ gi rnam pa/phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma 11'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa/ rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam 80—292

par brgyan par bya'o/ /de'i shar gyi 'dab ma la 'khor lo mdog dkar po dang /lhor rin po che mdog ser po dang / nub tu pad+ma mdog dmar po dang / byang du ral gri mdog ljang gu 0)dang / me'i mtshams su rin po che'i shing dang /chu'i mtshams su se ②'bru dang / rlung gi mtshams su rgyal mtshan dang / dbang ldan gyi mtshams su ka pā la'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dang / lhor rdo rje zhingezhags pa dang / nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / byang du rdo rje dril bu'o/ /mtshams rnams su me tog gi chun 'phyang dang / bdug spos kyi reng bu dang /mar me dang / dri'i dung chos so/ /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje phreng ba'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang du hūm̐ gi rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ rgyal po'i bzhugs thabs kyis gnas pa/ rang 'od kyi (4)rig mas 'khyud pa/ nam mkha' sngon po'i mdog can / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis kyi lo dang ldan pa/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i dbu rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang /dril bu dang / rnge'u chung dang / ka pā (5la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ 6ga 'dzin pa'i bdag po'o/ /mtshan ma'i skabs su dbus su rdo rje dang / 7)dril bus bya'o/ /de nas slob ma sta gon byas la sman sna tshogs kyis khrus byas pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bos slob ma gzung bar bya'o/ /las kyi slob dpon ni bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas pa/ ser sna med pa/ mtshan ma cung zad thob pa'o/ /der mchod pa po rnams shin tu mkhas pa/ chags pa la sogs pa dang bral ba/mtshan ma rnyed pa/ dbang gsum thob pa'o/ /slob dpon la dbang bskur ba'i dus su'am/ rgyud thos pa'i dus su shin tu gces pa'i chung ma dang / bu mo 80—293

dang / gzhan yang gser dang / mu tig dang / nor bu dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / zhing dang / bran dang / bran mo dang / na bza' du ma la sogs pa ci tsam nus pa dbul bar bya'o/ /nor la sogs pa yod nas gang zhig mi 'bul ba 6)de ni bskal pa stong gi bar du dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod med par gyur pas kyang ②rang gi lus po dbul bar bya ste bran du bya'o//des ni tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid dam/ yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa la sogs pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas sam rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ram ci/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo sbyin pa la sogs pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas sam rdo rje 'dzin par mi 'gyur te/ 'on kyang bla ma la mchod pas bsod nams chen po'i tshogs skye'o/ /bsod nams chen po'i tshogs bsags pa las sdig pa'i phung po zad de/ bla ma'i mchog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin rang gi lha'i sku yang dag pa dang phrad pa thob bo/ /phrad pas yang dag pa'i man ngag gnang ①bar 'gyur ro/ /man ngag thob pa las brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa yin no(4) / /des tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas sam rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /dpal ye shes snying po las dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar lags/ /mnga' bdag chen po 5)bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bdag gi 96)dkyil 'khor dge ba ni/ /nyon cig lha mo rab tu bshad/ /gru bzhi 80—294

pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed chun 'phyang dang / /'dod yon rin chen la sogs brgyan/ / de yi nyadabus su gzhan min bdag /zhal bzangs 0khyod dang lhan cig go/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum ut+pal nisngon po'i mdog /phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa dang ske/ /sna tshogs rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhi ba chen po'i rang bzhin can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /'jigs 0byed dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan/ /rgyal po'i bzhugs stabs ⑤kyis ni bzhugs/ /rdo rje dril bu rnge'u yichung dang / /ka pā la dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnamasal/ /zhal gzhan ser dang dmar dang ljang / /lha mo khyod kyang bdag gi mdog /zhal gsum ma la spyan gsum pa/ /phyag gnyis gri gug pad snod 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rgyan (nyegyis brgyan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ 'di yi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la/ /'khor ni gang lags grangs du mchis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig khyod kyis bdag la zhus/ /nyon cig lha mo bdag gis bshad/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir dpa' chen po/ /shes rab yan lag mas 'khyud cing / /mtshams su rdo rje ma mo bzhi/ /sgor ni khros pa'i lha mo bzhi'o(9)/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ de rnams la bskyed yipa'i cho ga ni gang / mdog dang phyag rgya dang bzhugs thabs la sogs pa ⑩ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod dang bdag rol pa mdzad cing / srub phonyepa dang bsrub tu pa'i thabs chen po'i sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i rtags las dpa' bo chen po 'tshangs pa zhes bya ba phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/ gser gyi mdog nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyal po'i bzhugs thabs kyis gnas pa/ ral pa'i cod 80—295

pan gyis brgyan pa/ shes rab ma'i yan lag gis 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga 'dzin pa / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / rnge'u chung dang / ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ shar gyi 'dab mar ro yang srub 1)pa dang bsrub (5)pa'i thabs kyi 95rimachog gi dga' ba'i rtags las dpa' bo chen po khyab 'jug ces bya ba/ mar ka ta'i mdog lhag ma ni tshangs pa bzhin du byang du'o/ /yang srub 47pa dang bsrub (5)pa'i thabs kyi (6)dga' bral gyi 6)dga' ba'i rtags las dpa' bo chen po drag po zhes bya ba mdog nag po khyab 'jug bzhin nub tu'o/ /yang srub (8)pa dang bsrub (9)pa'i thabs kyi yo )lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rtags las dpa' bo chen po dbang phyug ces bya ba (nyamadog dkar po khyab 'jug 12bzhin lho phyogs su'o/ /pad+ma'i mtshams su dri zhim pa dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba'i ka pā la bzhi'o/ /yang srub 1 pa dang bsrub sapa'i thabs kyi laro brgyad las me'i mtshams su dpa' mo sachen mo mdog 1 dkar mo'o/ /chu'i mtshams su gzhan gyis mi thub ma bai ḍūr+ya'i 1gemadog go/ /rlung gi mtshams su dus mtshan ma nam mkha' sngon po'i mdog go/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su gi rī mdog ser po'o thams cad kyang shin tu lang tsho la bab pa zhal gcig yo pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyal po'i bzhugs stabs shu )kyis bzhugs pa/phyag rgya lnga 'dzin pa/ phyogs kyi 51gos can/ gri gug dang / ka pā la dang /kha ṭī ga dang / rnge'u chung bsnams pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje gtum mo ni nag mo chen mo'i mdog go/ /byang sgor rdo rje 'jigs zhugebyed ma ser mo'i mdog go / /nub sgor rdo rje sgra ma dmar mo chen mo'i mdog go/ /lho sgor rdo rje tsa rtsi kā 80—296

ljang gu'i 6)mdog go/ /phyag bzhi pa(2kyi/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/g.yon brkyang ba/ na bza' spangs pa rim pa bzhin du nam mkha' lding dang /seng ge dang / stag dang / ma he'i steng na gnas pa'o/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa / mgo chen po'i chun po 'phyang ba 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po mche ba gtsigs (5)pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skyes 'bar ba/ sgra chen po'i sgra sgrogs pa / ral gri dang / rtse gsum pa dang / ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/rang 'od kyi thabs dang 'khyud pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo chen po rnams la shes rab ma'i yan lag ma ji ltar lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpa' bo chen po rnams la shes rab ma'i yan lag rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang khyod bzhin du zhal gcig 9 pa'o/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du rnyed par (5)dka'/ /dgyes pa thams cad grub byed cing / /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan khyod dang bdag bskyed (6)pa'i/ /sa bon gang lags snying po ci / /nye ba'i snying po ji (85lta bu/ /'khor gyi 9)sngags ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyis 1 chibadag la gang zhig zhus/ /nyon cig lha mo bdag gis bshad/ /sa bon ya sde'i bdun pa ni/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa dang ldan pa/ /lha mo chen mo thig le ldan/ /khyod kyi sa bon rab mchog go11/ /ya sde'i sa bon brgyad pa ni/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dang ldan pa/ /dbu ni thig le yis ni brgyan / /bdag gi 1nas bon rab mchog go/ /de ni sa bon gnyis ka rab/ /thams cad dbang du byed pa ni/ /lus can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /skye ba 80—297

dang ni sdud byed do/ /drug pa brgyad pa bzhi pa dang / /bcu gnyis pa dang bcu dang nyi/ /dang por oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa mthar/ /bdag gi snying po rab tu mchog /nyi shu pa dang bcu gnyis mkha'/ /dang po dang ni bcu drug nyi/ /dbang 0)po tshangs pa ②rgyu phaṭa mthar/ /khyod kyi snying po dgyes pa mchog /dang por oṃ dang tsū phaṭa mthar/ /dbus su ming dang spel ba ni/ /tshogs kun gyi ni sngags yin te/ /mchod pa'i dus su mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ④mā ra bi ④marna ⑤na ma hā bī ⑥ra rā dza tsū r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ skal ldan mo de khyod kyi ni/ /nye ba'i snying po drag po che/ /oṃ haṃ haṃ ༷ho ho nirta/ ke le ke le sab po)rdosta pra bha 0dza ka hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ pad+ma'i zhal de bdag gi yini/ /'od chen nye ba'i snying po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ sngags 'di la nus pa'i mthu ci tsam zhig mchis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grub pa tsam gyis khams gsum thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor pa khro bo'i ⑫lta bas 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa byed 8na/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po lta bu la 'bum phrag gcig gis gsod par byed do/ /zhi ba'i tshul gyis bzlas pa byas na grangs med pa'i nad dang / nyon mongs pa dang / dbul po dang / mdze dang / phol mig 'jig par byed do/ /phra mo'i grub pa brgyad skad cig gis byed do/ /gzhan yang las du ma rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma legs dgyes dbang mo stan las langs nas mgo bos phyag 'tshal te④/ 'khor thams cad dang lhan cig tu lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas rang rang gi 7rdzu 'phrul gyis mchod pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dbang phyug legs so legs so 80—298

zhes brjod nas yang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su nam mkha' la me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i char dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi char chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi 6)drung du babs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog dang rin po che de dag gi thog tu chibs ( te/'khor dang bcas pa mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal ye shes snying po las gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po rdzogs sol// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba'o/ /dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i phyi ma'i phyi mtho// //80—299

sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyi0)/ /thugs kur (mirtag tu bzhugs pa'o/ /rnam par 'byed la sgom pa med/ /phung po khams la sogs dang bral/ /sgra la sogs pa'i chos kyis ③stong / /stong dang snying rje'i bdag nyid yin/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po dang / /dbang phyug rtag tu zhi ba dang / /de rnams kun gyi yab yin no/ /'byed pa dang ni mchog rmad 'byung / /de nyid ye shes thig le 'dir / /mchog rnams (4)grub pa'i mnga' bdag go/ /'byung ba kun gyi nang yod pa/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid phyirab mchog yin/ /mkha' 'gro dbang phyug lnga bdag po/ /nam mkha' bdag nyid skye ⑥med do/ /nam mkha' lnga yi zhi)nang du thim / /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /de lta'i gsang chen ye shes ni/ /ye shes dbang po rnyed dka' ba/ /ji ltar nor ni rkun mo yis/ /ma rnyed byed ltar 'bad pas sba(8di/ /dpal ye shes thig le las 'pho ba'i dus shar ba dang nub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //lha'i dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ kye ⑨bcom ldan 'das/ de nyid gsum ⑩bdag nga ro ci/ /de bzhin zla ba 47bde ba mchog /phyag rgya chen po'i rnam pa ci//de yi mtha' ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de nyid gsum ni sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje gsum 9)ni ye shes mchog /zla ba 8bde ba mchog ces pa/ /de yi phung po dbang po khams/ /phyag rgya chen po rdor snying po / /de yi mtha' ni bha gar dran/ /mtha' dang snang ba rnam par shes/ ri /chu yi 7zla ba bzhin du mthong / /chos kun rang bzhin dri ma med/ /snang ba las ni thams cad 'byung / /skye ba dang ni 'gag pa med/ /yang dag 'od las thams 80—310

cad 'byung / /de'i 6)phyi rol chos thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni bcom ldan 'das dpal ye shes thig le'o/ /de la dang po (mirnam pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bskyed pa bsgom (9pa dang / sngags dang bzlas pa dang /sbyin sreg dang mchod sbyin dang / gtor ma dang mchod pa dang / gnas kyi brjod pa dang / dbang bskur ④gyi rim pa de dag bshad do/ /dpal ye shes thig le las de kho na nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid dang zla ba mchog gi bde ba dang phyag rgya chen po'i mtha' la sogs pa'i phyogs tsam bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //lha'i dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ tshangs pa'i rus pa srog gi dbyug pa'i steng dang 'og gi 'pho ba cha gnyis su rtsa (snyesum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rang bzhin las le'u dang por gang gsungs pa ni de rnams kyi nang nas gcig tu rtog med bde legs yid ma gcig pu nges par bstan par mdzad kyi/ bcom ldan 'das rtsa gzhan rnams ci'i don gyi ④phyir 'dir ma gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcig pu rtog med bde legs yid 4)ma de ni bye ba phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsa (nyephra mo'i dra ba rnams rol mo'i don du byas nas(9na/ sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po'i sa stengs su tu )'byung zhing skye'i char 'bab pa'i don du bstan pa'o/ /lha'i dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ de ltar lags mod kyis tsho1kyang / rtsa sum cu rtsa gcig po rnams kyi nyi 2mtshan dang grangs 'dir mchog gi dbang phyug la bka' drin zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang phyug sum cu rtsa gcig gi ming rnams nyon 80—311

cig /gsang ba dang / zab pa dang / sred pa dang / phra mo dang / bdud rtsi ma dang / bdud rtsi khri ma dang / dag pa ma dang / bde ba ma dang /stobs ma dang / thabs ma dang / hrud hrud hu)ma dang / ser ma dang / 'o rgyun ma dang / dga' ma dang / snum ma dang / khro ma dang / mngar ma dang /skyur ma dang / khab ma dang / bska ②ma dang / tsha ①ma dang / lan tshwa ④ma dang / rtsub ma dang / dad ma dang / stobs ma dang / dga' byed ma dang /dga' sbyin ma dang / gnyid ma dang / bcad skyed ma dang / khong chud ma dang / tshe ma ste/ de dag ni rtsa sum cu rtsa ⑤gcig stezhin/ steng dang 'og tu 'pho ba gnyis kyi zla ba dang nyi ma (7)gzas nizin pa'i dus su tshigs rgyas pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi rim pa bshad de6)/ ji lta yi ni go rims suyo )/ /dbang bskur mchog ni rnyed pa gang / /thams cad du ni nus par 'gyur/ /yon tan tshul khrims ldan pa'i bu/ /bla mas dang por dbang bskur bya /tshome/ /khrus byas mig dag ras kyis dgabazhuge/ /snyim pa me tog gis bkang ldan/ /yon phul nas ni dga' dang bcas/ / lha yi (snyedabang phyug dbang bskur ⑩bya8/ /dbang bskur las 'di sangs rgyas sa/ /the tshom hu)med par rnyed par 'gyur/ /de bas kun tu rab 'bad de/ /dpal ldan dbang rgyal blang bar bya/ /dbang bskur (nyabazhi ru phye ba ni/ /slob dpon la sogs dbye ba yin/ /dang por slob dpon gyi ⑩ni dbang / /gnyis pa de ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang / /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa'o/ /bzhi gnyis rab du dbye ba ni/ /slob dpon dbang la sogs par bskur/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang gsum du/ /nam mkha' mnyam du bdag gis bshad/ /de gnyis la ni bcu gcig phye/ /rdo rje 80—312

slob dpon dbang rgyal lo/ /dbang bskur de ni rin po che/ /khams gsum gyis ①ni phyag byas pa/ /thar par 'gro ba 'grub don du/ /'di ru rim pas bdag gis bshad/ /chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang / /lung bstan pa dang skyabs sbyin dang / /phyag rgya sngags dang ye shes so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa la/ /dbang brgyad phye la sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma la mos la②/ /bcu gcig bdag nyid sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma la mos pa rnams/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni sbyin pa'o/ /gsang ba gnyis su dbye bar gsungasasri/ /de ni ④phyi dang nang gis so/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla ma'i phyir⑤/ /dbang bskur shes pas sbyin par bya/ /nang gi rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni rab tu sbyin/ /de ni gsang ba gsum du dbye/ /skye dang mdud dang de bzhin sad/ /shes rab rnam pa gnyis su dbye//bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bye brag go/ /shes rab brgyad gnyis lo dang ldan/ /spyan rings yicha la mkhas pa dang / /yan lag tsan+dan sar (7pa'i dri/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i khu bas tshim/ /gzugs bzang sngo la skal lngan ma/ /'o 'dzin mkhrang nizhing 'jam la mtho/ /bsam gtan sngags la dad cing zhi/ /dbang bskur dang ldan thugs rje grub/ /de lta'i rab grags 'bad de btsal/ /dbang gi don du bla ma 5)zhu/ /de kun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /chung ma yang na sring mo 'am/ /bu mo yang na mna' ma 'am/ /mkhas tsho )pas 'bad de blang bar bya /rang gi rigs ni ji bzhin rnyed/ /khu ba dang bcas gzhon nu ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs par brgyan/ /mkhas pas bla ma la ni 'bul(1nya/ /dbang gi man ngag gsum du bzhugs/ /nang gi yis tshogeni brda 512byed pa/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu'i 80—313

ngo bor grags/ /gsum dang bral ba'i gsum bdag nyid/ /dga' ba la sogs bye brag tu/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mas gsal dbye/ /dbang bskur gyis ni 'khor los sgyur①/ /the tshom med par yin par 'gyur/ /dbang gis dri ma med par byed / /chu la sogs pas ras bkrus bzhin/ /cho ga thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbang / /yan lag de nyid dang ni bcas/ /gcig nas gcig tu rim pas brgyud / /bla ma rab kyi zhal nas blang / /gzhan du rtog ge'i tshogs la mkhas/ /sgra yi bstan bcos rtag mos la/ /dbang gi mchog ni rnam pa gsum/ /blang bar mi bya sbyin mi bya/ /yang dag 'bras bu 'dod pa na( kyi/ /de ni ring du spang (7bar bya/ /de ltar yang bye ma du ma bsdus pa'i phung po la 'bad de rnam par btsir bas mar khu'i thigs ④pa phyed kyang mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du rtog ge mang po dang / ngag gi dra ba dang ldan pa (9bstan pa'am/ nyan pa las ni de la nyon mongs pa 'ba' zhig las gzhan 'bras bu ni rnyed pa med do/ /de bas na gcig nas gcig tu rim pas brgyud de rnyed pa'i dbang shes pa de ni rdo rje slob dpon bla ma chen po'o/ /mi gsal 6)mchog gi bkra shis can/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu sbyin pa'i sbyin/ /bla ma'i gzugs so gzhan ma yin/ /bsod nams thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug lha(7)/ /de kun gyis ni bdag mchod 'os/ /ma grags kyang ni grags gzugs yin/ /de ltar shes nas sgrub pa pos/ /'bad pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /bla ma'i zhal snga mchod byas na/ /ci 'dod pa yi 'bras bu rnyed / /rgyud kyi don nam shedabang gi don/ /shes nas bla ma mi mchod pa6)/ /sa stengs 7nyi zla yod bar du/ /de ni mnar med pa ru 'gro/ /de bas kun tu 80—314

'bad pa yis/ /gus pas bla ma mchod par bya/ /rin chen sna tshogs bzor byas legs/ /gser gyi pad+ma dri ma med/ /mu tig do shal rin thang med/ /sna tshogs du ma yi ni gos/ /gces pa'i btsun mo bu dang bcas/ /glang chen ①rta dang bran la sogs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ /dad gus brtan pas dbul bar bya/ /dpal ye shes thig le las yon dbul ba dang bcas pa'i dbang gi rim pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rab bshad nyon/ /gnas kyi rnyed pa ji bzhin don/ /ka ba gcig dang sgo dgur ldan/ /rdo rje rtsig (mipa'i rgyan 'a)dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i thig dang bla res ④ni/ /kun tu yongs su bskor ba yin/ /rlung la sogs pa'i rim ⑤pas dbye/ /'byung ba bzhi dang ldan pa yin/ /ji snyed nam mkha'i mtha' kun tu/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /rdo rje gur gyi dbus su ni//srung ⑥ba'i 'khor lo 'khor bzhin pa/ /rtsibs bcu pa la gser gyi mdog /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'o/ /khro bo thams cad zhal gsum pa/ /spyan gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ /g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa 7zhigasus pa rlo (sheb/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ljags 'dril 595ba/ mche ba 'jigs pa gtsigs tu )pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'greng ba/ ag tshom (/stedang smin ma che zhing ring ba ste/ shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gshin rje'i yigegashed sku mdog nag po g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal gnyis ni ser ba dang dmar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rtse gsum pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang dbyug pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi rtsibs la shes rab mthar byed dkar po g.yas kyi zhal dmar ba/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag 80—315

g.yas pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ /phyag g.yon pa gnyis na mtshon rtse gcig pa 0)dang mgo bo'o/ /nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po zhal g.yas dkar zhing g.yon sngon po/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag ②bzhi na ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / ri rab zur brgyad pa'o/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gnyis ni dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na rdo rje rgya gram dang / ral gri dang / mdung thung dang dung ngo rdo sku/ /me'i mtshams su 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gzugs can g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal gnyis ni dkar ba dang dmar ba/ g.yas kyi laphyag gnyis na ral gri dang rin po che/ phyag g.yon na sta re 95)dang mdung thung ngo / /srin po'i mtshams su dbyug pa sngon po chu srin 'dzin ser po'i gzugs/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ljang ba dang dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rgya gram rtse gsum dang ral gri/ phyag g.yon gnyis na sā ⑥la'i shing chen po dang / de bzhin du me'o / /rlung mtshams su stobs po che du ba'i mdog /g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa'i zhal gnyis ni ser ba dang dmar po/ phyag bzhi la ral gri dang dung dang dgra sta (7)dang rnga ma'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su mi g.yo mgon dkar nag zhal g.yon dmar po dang rin/ g.yas sngon po/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na ral gri dang lcags kyu dang pi wang dang rnge'u chung ngo / /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur lho)ba sku mdog ser po g.yas 1 1dang g.yon pa'i zhal gnyis ni sngo ba dang ⑪dkar ba/ phyag bzhi na 'khor lo dang / ral gri dang / ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'o/ /'og tu sum bha'i 12rgyal po sku mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo ba/ g.yas kyi zhal mthon mthing 1 chen po'i 'od can/ g.yon pa ni nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od 80—316

can / g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na ral gri dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa'o/ /thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang pad+ma bsnams pa / rang gi 'od kyi shes rab ma la /khyud pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa ni 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi steng du'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ①ba dang sum bha'i ②rgyal po ni zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i (gyi'akhor lo'i lte ba gru gsum gyi gzugs te ri bong can dkar po'i 'od chos kyi 'byung gnas so/ /de'i dbus su sngar bstan pa'i 'byung ba bzhi ji lta bu'i rim pas / rnam par snang mdzad yongs su gyur pa las dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs pa chen po'i 'phar ma gnyis nyi ma'i gdan du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab lim brgyad kyi lte bar 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi (5)bde byed ma'i steng du tshul dang thigs pa'i rang gi ngo bo ā li dang kā 6)li gnyis las byung ba/mi hūm̐ las dpal ye shes thig le phyag rgya chen pos 'khyud (7cing zhal brgyad pa/phyag brgyad g.yas brkyang ba/ zhal bzhi ni gnag pa (shedang ser badziste/ dmar ba dang ljang gu'ol/ /gzhan bzhi ni ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab (11rim lta bu'o/ /rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / rnge'u chung dang / ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang /ral gri dang / mda' gzhu'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba tshes pas ral pa'i dbu rgyan (snyedang dpral bar thod pa'i steng du mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can no/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku bcings pa/ rgyu mas brgyus pa'i mgo kyi bo chen po'i do shal gyis sku brgyan skipa/ tshangs pa'i pags pas rked (8pa'i sham thabs can gyi skur bzhengs shing ha ha'i gad rgyangs dang pho (7ka ra'i 1 chol ba'i sgra chen po'i nga ro bsgrags shing brjod pa tsam gyis tshangs pa'i yul :shes bye ba'i grangs kyi 19thod pa'i 80—317

lto 0)brlag par mdzad pa/ mi bzad pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / ce (mispyang gi tshogs 'jigs (kyesu rung ba dang / sha za'i tshogs ha har rgod ④pa dang / nag po'i me can gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad na 'jigs byed kyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i gar byed pa'o/ /dpal ye shes thig le las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //da (5)ni sngags mchog bshad bya ba/ /sgrub pa po ni 'grub 'gyur ba/ /sa yi cha ni mnyam pa'i mchog /sbrang rtsi ga bur gyis ni byug /dri zhim pa yi (7me tog bkram / /me tog gis ni chal par dgram(pe/ /chu ngogs yang na thang stong du/ /rdo rje skud pa yis ni bskor/ /mig mdzes rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ /zla ba nyi mas pad+ma khengs/ /lang tsho gsar la reg bya 'jam/ /dang po mkhas pas 'jug par bya/ /sngags kyi gnas su ①lugs ji bzhin/ /legs dgyes shin tu sbyor bar bya/ /de yi sbyor bas (9)gang zhig 'byung / /kha dang sa kyisogs mchod /ra bya / /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bya/ /rdo rje yi ni phur bu bcu/ /mkhas pas khro bo'i sngags kyis gdab/ /ā li kā nyu11li mnyam byas nas/ /'dab ma kun la rim pas dgong / /ā 15li ye shes 'dab mar tunyegacig /kā yili 'dab ma bdun mdu dran/ /'dab ma re re yi ge lnga/ /lnga pa lnga ni lnga la'o/ /'dab ma gnyis su bzhi gnyis te/ /k+ṣaḥyiyi yig 'bru lte nang ngo / /dbyangs yig gsal yig bye brag tu/ /ā li kā 1 tsholi 'du shes yin/ /gnyis kyi yi ge 'dab ma yis/ /sngags kyi rgyal po de nyid dran/ /dang po'i gzugs kyis rgyal po'i dbang / /de nas 'dab gnyis kyi dang /2por/ /bzhi pa'i dbyangs yig dang bcas pa/ /80—318

gsal byed pa ni bzhi (nyaganyis pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun pas ni ldan/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa yi gzhan/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bdun pas ldan/ /bzhi (kyepa las ni gsum pa'o/ /de dang nye bar rlung yin no/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan / /'bras bu thams cad don sbyin no/ /lnga pa yi zhu)ni lnga pa dang / /ha yi yig 'bru de dang gonye/ /lnga pa yi (snyeni gsum pa dang / /nyi shu rtsa brgyad de nas ⑥so / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /nyi shu rtsa bdun de nas so/ /dbyangs yig gi ni gnyis pas ldan/ /khams gsum dgug (7)par nus pa'o/ /gsal byed kyi ni dang po dang / /nyi shu rtsa bdun pa ni ldan/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dag dang / /dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pas ldan/ /nyi shu rtsa drug yi ge mchog /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gcig ldan/ /swā hā mtha' ru ldan pa ni/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis spel bar bya/ /de ni phyag rgya che snying po/ /yid bzhin rin chen mnyam pa'i 'od(she/ /dang po yi ni pra ṇa yi)pa/ /de nas 'dab gnyis pa yi gsum/ /ya yi sde tshan gnyis pa dang / /nyi shu rtsa dgu de nas so/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge gsum pa yis/ /snying la khong du chud par bya/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi phyed dag pa/ /ra yi yig 'bru de dang mnyam / /tha mar swā hā dang ldan pa/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ni spel ba yin/ /nye ba'i snying po sngags chen po/ /thams cad sngags kyi bdag po nyu 7mchog /oṃ shrī ma hā kā ru ṇa nyunyaku ta/ ma hā be be 12da/ sī ra ṇa ma hā ma'i yinyesasne/ sam pra bha yidza ya bi dza skeya/ astasta hā 7sa/ ma hā gho ra gho re shwa ra ma hā bī ra bī re shwa ra ma hā ru dhi rī tra mā la dha ra/ sau ma srur+ya yi asna lo tsa na/ ā kā tu sho da ra/ ma hā sā gar koḥ/ ha na ha na/ da ha da nyu7ta/ pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha ni bi dhī sa ya bi t+t+waṃ 21sa ya/ ā tar+ṣa ya ā /khyo ya/ bhāñja ya bhāñja ya/ tsuṇ+ḍi ya tsuṇ+ḍi ( snye80—320
