ni 6)khams gsum kun/ /mgo bo chad pa'i mi bzhin du/ /grangs ②med 'jig rten gyi ni khams/ /khyod ni ye shes 'od byed pa/ /khyod ni thams cad dngos kun gyi / /thams cad 5)bdag nyid 'byung ba kun/ /chos kun yongs su shes nas ni/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen par grags/ /de yang lha mo khyod kyi drin/ /brjod par mi nus yang dag don/ /khyod kyi drin gyis grangs med pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnyed 'gyur/ /mchog gi nam mkha'i gnas nas byon/ /mchog gi nam mkha'i gnas su gshegs/ / mchog gi nam mkha' rang ngo khyod/ /④mchog gi nam mkha'i ngal bso gnas(5)/ /mchog gi nam mkhar nyurtag tu bzhugs / /kun rdzob rnam pa'i mchog tu ni/ /pad+ma'i skud pa ji bzhin du/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse snying por gnas/ /langs nas bde ba'i pad+mar ni/ /thig le khong du chud pa'i phyir/ /gshegs nas brten (7)pa thams cad sreg(she /rgyas pas thig le khyer 9)nas su/ /yang 7ni khyod 'dir byon ༷/spepa'i don/ /lte ba sprul pa'i pad+ma yi/ /lha mo gang tshe khyod kyi gnas/ /de tshe khyod ni shes rab grags/ /legs dgyes rab mchog rmad 1 du byung / /bdag dang lhan cig gnyis med sbyor / /legs dgyes dbang mo khyod ni bzhugs/ /tshangs pa'i yul (snyes bye ba mthar / /legs dgyes khyod kyi rgya yis btab/ /grangs med pa la rgyas btab stesnyi / /de phyir phyag rgya che khyod grags/ /dpal ye shes thig le las/ dpal phyag rgya chen po bcom ldan 'das ma'i rang gi ngo bo bstan pa zhes bya riba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //gsang ba'i pad snying rgyas 'byed pa/ /rdo rje nyi ma gzhan yang zhu/ /re zhig 80—378

ci'i ①yang gsang ba gsungs/ /gnas ni gang na yod pa lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byang chub sems ni gsang ba yin/ /khu ba'i ngo bo chang dang bral/ /de yi gnas ni mngal yin te/ /phyag rgya dga' ba sbyin pa mo/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa(mi/ byang chub sems ni khu ba'i gzugs/ /de ni ji ltar gsang bar brjod/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni mngal yin te/ /gzhung de bdag la 'thad ma lags/ /de lta na ni gang zag kun/ /nges par gsang ba shes par 'gyur/ /de yang dbang bskur la sogs ni/ /su la yang ni mi dgos ②lags / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑤yum khyod de ni bden/ /gang zhig khyod kyis nges par bzung (5)ba'i don/ /'on kyang drang ba'i don gyi tshig gis ldan/ /rten gyi don phyir yang na nges pa'i don/ /rten med na ni 'bras bu rnyed mi 'gyur/ /lus kyi dngos med ji ltar 'di ru semasal/ /ji ltar don mthun yigasang tshig de ni gsang / /drang ba'i don min nges pa'i don yang min/ /dngos med yang min dngos po'i gzugs ma yin/ /bden rim 'byung ba thim rnams kyi ni gzhan/ /sku rtsigazugs gang du de ni yod ma yin/ /khrag kyang yin par ji ltar yang ni min/ /mchog dga' dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba min/ /gnas mngal de la nam yang yod ma yin/ /rdo rje rtsa ba bde chen la sogs min/ /drug phyed rtsa dang mtsho skyes snying po min/ /rig min yang min rig pa nam yang min/ /brjod med nam mkha'i rang gi ngo bo'o(she/ /'di lta bu ni don dam par/ /lha mo gsang bar rab tu gsal/ /yang ni 'bring gi don gyis su/ /bdag gis gsang bshad khyod nyon cig /'bring don de ni don gyi (9)mchog /mchog gi dga' ba sbyin pa'o/ /'bad pas dga' bral srung tso80—379

bar byed/ /dga' bral dga' bas lhan skyes 'gyur/ /nor mdud snying ga ①yi ni gsang / /byang chub kyi ni sems dang ldan/ /de ni thabs kyi gsang ba'i don / /shes rab ma yi de bzhin no/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang gnyis las/ /dga' mo gsang ba'i don shes so/ /dpal ye shes thig le las gsang ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das ma phyag rgya chen pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs la yang zhu ba zhus pa②/ mgon po thams cad gtan ((phab pa/ /rang bzhin ji ltar lags ④pa gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de lta bu'i tshig gsan pa dang cang mi gsung ba'i dngos pos skad cig tsam bzhugs te/ de nas mi snang ba'i rang gi ngo bor bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma phyag rgya chen pos bdag rang rten med par mthong nas zhus pas shin tu 'gyod nas cang mi smra bar bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su sna tshogs pad+ma la bzhugs pa'i ⑤'khor bye ba phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi grangs rnams kyis chos kyi 'byung gnas stong par mthong nas shin tu ya mtshan du gyur pas kun smre zhing brgyal (6)bar gyur to/ /kye phyibyang chub sem/sa dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gang na bzhugs/ gar gshegs/ kun du stong par bdag cag gis mthong lags so/ /lha'i dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ 'khor chen po rnams nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag rgya chen pos 'di ltar zhus te/ mgon po thams cad gtan la phab / /rang bzhin ji ltar lags pa gsungs/ /de lta bu'i tshig gsan pa dang 80—380

bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar mi snang bar gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rang bzhin de ni brjod du med pa dang / rtog ge med pa dang / btsal 6)du med pa dang / grangs med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / gzugs med pa dang ske/ rig ②pa med pa la ②dris pas/ de nyid smrar mi btub pa'i phyir/bcom ldan 'das snang ba med par gyur to/ /yang 'khor thams cad kyis gsol pa / kyai ①blo gros chen po chos kyi (5)mdzod/ snang ba med cing dngos po med pa 6)chad ⑦par mi 'gyur ram/ de'i don la shin tu 'jigs shing yang dag par yid zhum par gyur to/ /lha'i dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/ snang ba med par 'du shes gang / /de ni dngos med shes mi bya/ /nang gi rang ngor 'gro ba'i phyir / /snang ba med par 'di ru brjod/ /de bas 'khor chen ma 'jigs shig /yid skyo ba ni yongs su spongs/ /de la thabs ni gcig yod de(kye/ /gang gi po)rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /sngar ni khyod kyis mthong ba bzhin/ /pad+ma'i dbus bzhugs mthong bar 'gyur/ /de'i tshe 'khor thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i dbang phyug gi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das mthong bar bya ba'i phyir thabs zhus pa/ kyai yi tshoblo gros chen po dpa' bo chen po thabs ci yod pa bdag 47la bstan du gsol/ /dpa' bo chen pos bka' stsal pa/ dus gcig tu mgrin gcig gis snyan pa'i glus mchod pa gyis shig /de lta bu'i thabs kyi tshig thos nas thams cad dga' zhing mgu la yi tshogerangs pas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha'i dbang phyug gi tunyezhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ de nas drug ldan la sogs pa'i glu thams cad len no/ /kyai bsku rab mchog gi ngo bo'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang na bzhugs 80—381

pa mya ngan 'das mtshan nyid/ /de nyid dang bral chad pa'i stong de ni/ /gnyis med bde bas mkhyen par mi 'gyur ram/ /rdo rje mtsho skyes mchog sbyor yongs su gzigs / /gang zhig dngos med dngos de dpyad ①par mdzod/ /de nas ②rang bzhin las bcom ldan/ /chu las nya ni bzhin du bzhengs/ /mchog gi dga' ba'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /mchog gi dga' ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag /dngos dang dngos min gnyis kyi steng ( sta/ /gyen bltas pad+ma'i lte bar ni/ /zhal bzhi dang ni phyag bzhi pa(ge/ /shin tu ngo mtshar sku dang ldan/ /rgyal po yi ni bzhugs stabs (5)bzhugs/ /brgyad gnyis blo ldan byad gzugs can/ /spyan gsum mchog gi rnam pa can/ /zla ba nyi ma zhabs kyis mnan/ /rnge'u yichung thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje 'bar ba phyag na bsnams9)/ /de lta bu'i rmad du byung ba'i gzugs mthong nas 'khor thams cad dang (9lhan cig bcom ldan 'das ma phyag rgya chen mo langs nas lan gsum du bskor ba byas te/ dam por 'khyud yonyenas bstod pas bstod kyi 7pa/ mchog tu rmad byung chen po'i sku ni rgyal gyur cig /ye shes zab mo rgya mtsho'i snying po rgyal gyur cig /brjod bral bltar med dngos tunyamed sku mi mnga'12/ /gti mug chen po 'joms de rgyal gyur cig /mchog dang gzhan mchog de ni mchog gzhan mchog /mkha' mchog 'od mchog mchog gi ye shes snang / /mchog gi bdud rtsi'i snying po gang gā'i 1stergyun/ /mi 'chad rgyun rdzi'abab byed pa rgyal gyur cig /shin tu lkog gyur dbang pos bltar med pa/ /skye 'gag 'du byed mtshan med rgyal gyur cig /de lta bu'i bstod pa'i rgyal po byas nas yang phyag rgya chen po lha mo chen mos bcom ldan 'das la dad pas zhu ba zhus pa/ kye 15bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ci'i phyir ma gsungs 80—382

lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / srub dang bsrubs 0)pa'i sbyor ba las/ /lha rnams 'byung ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po rtsom pa shin tu 'dar//rnam par shes pas lha mo skye/ /de ni grong (nyalas kha dog dkar/ /'dod pa'i gti mug rnam par thos/ /grong khyer las ni longs spyod yin/ /spyod lam lha mo rgyal ba'i 'od/ /bskum pa las ni snang ba mched/ /snang ba mched las ye shes 'od / /bgrad pa las ni skye ba sbyor/ /sbyor las dga' ba'i skye ma (7ste/ /mnyam sbyor las ni ye shes skye/ /ye shes las ni dngos zad ma/ /khyod las 'di ru dngos po ste/ /dngos las 57longs spyod zla ba ma/ /dkar po las ni rten shes bya/ /rten las pad+ma'i lte ba masgi/ brang brdabs las ni rnam par 'byed/ /rnam par 'byed las pad mig ma/ /nag dang ljang (6)dang gur kum (7)mdog /dmar dang sngon po yi ni gzugs/ /zla ba dkar dang dmar gyi sngon/ /sgo la sogs dang mtshams na bzhugs/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan(she/ /snod dang gri gug gis phyag brel/ /na (9)bza' grol tsob phyag gnyis pa/ /de ni nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rus pa sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan/ /khyod kyi bzhugs stabs /lhaji lta bar/ /lha mo rnams kyang de bzhin no / /de rnams thabs ni bzhi gnyis kyi ni grangs/ /mnyam pa'i bzhugs stabs 4gephyag dang zhabs la sogs/ /rab tu dga' ba'i yid ldan zhi ba'i gzugs/ /rtag tu sems can don byed kho na brtson/ /lha mos gsol pa/ dpa' bo rnams kyi ming gi brda /ge/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rdo rjes gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyis nga la gang zhus pa/ /skal ldan lha mo de ni nyon/ / 'di yi dzargyud la bdag la gzhan/ /mtshan ni yod pa 8gang la 80—383

lar / /na ni lte ba gsang ba'i pad/ /dga' bral dga' ba sbyin pa'o/ /ma zhes nor bu bsrubs 6)pa ni/ /mchog gi dga' ba sbyin pa'o/ /gang zhig de yi ②dbus nas langs/ /de ni bdag gi rang bzhin mtshan/ /dpa' bo rnams ni bdag gis bshad/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma nyon/ /lha chen po dang khyab 'jug dang / /pad+ma'i lte ba shin tu blta/ /lha yi dbang dang 'dod pa'i lhag/ /pad+ma'i mig dang gzhon nu ma/ /re zhig 4)de ni dkyil 'khor pa/ /rang gi phyag rgya mtshon cha 'dzin/ /dpal ye shes thig le las bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das dbang bskur ba'i dus su dkyil 'khor rnams ji lta bu lags/ cho ga gang gis dbang bskur ba ⑤sbyin zhing blang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /chu la sogs pa'i dbang dus su/ /rdul tshon la sogs dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur dus su ni/ /me tog sna tshogs mchog gis so/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur dus/ /sna tshogs dri zhim po yis brgyan(6)/ /las dang po yi dang po la/ /nges pa'i don gyi (7chu la sogs/ /dbang bskur shes pas sbyin bya ste/ /de ltar min na skyon du 'gyur/ /shes rab can gyis 98)drang don der/ /sbyin no de nas dam tshig sbyin/ /nor bu mgrin par byang chub sems/ /bla ma nyi da kyis 6nyerang rig byed/ /shes rab lhan cig gnas las langs/ /slob ma'i kha yi pad+ma ru/ /nyid kyi rdo rje rab tu sbyin/ /de nas bde ba'i bdud rtsis dkrol/ /mgrin pa'i dbus su rtsa gnyis ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon na yod pa'o/ /sbom ma yangs mar 80—384

'di ru grags/ /srog dang nye ba'i rang ngo bo/ /g.yon ni srog tu shes par bya/ /nye ba'i srog ni g.yas na'o/ /de ru bde bar 'jug par bya/ /mthe bong srin lag gnyis kyis mnan/ /de nas ye shes 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bu mos rnyed pa'i bde ji bzhin/ /reg bya chen pos dga' ba che/ /dga' ba chen pos bde ba che/ /bde ba chen pos byang chub sems/ /shes rab bya gdong ma yi khar/ /nor bu'i kha las thigs 0)pa gcig /shes rab ye shes zhal bzang mo/ /shes rab bya gdong las bde ba/ /rdo rje rin chen kha ru 'gro/ /de ni dbang gi mchog rab yin/ /sangs rgyas grub pa'i 'bras sbyin bdag /shes rab gzugs bzang bha ga rab/ /shin tu lang tsho dbang bskur ldan/ /dga' sogs bye brag mgu bar byas/ /de nas slob ma la sbyin bya/ /sems dpa' chen po shes rab 'di / /yang dag ye shes rab tu ster/ /gang zhig bka' lung skyabs sbyin te/ /de ni bu khyod dad par bya/ /de yi mngal gyi g.yon logs na/ / i ḍā (gebya gdong ma ni bzhugs/ /de rnyed tsam gyis rang bzhin ni/ /shes rab bsnyen pas rnyed par 'gyur/ /de ni gzhan min yongs su shes/ /bzhi pa'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo yin/ /rang rig pa dang mchog ye shes/ /ngag ( cigi lam gyis rnyed dang bral/ /de (4)na lha mo skal ldan mo/ /gsang ba las ni shin tu gsang / /rgyud kun du ni bdag gis sbas/ /mtha' yi mtha' ru rab tu gsal/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ mtha' dang mtha' yi (5)don ni ci/ /mchog gi dbang phyug bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mtha' ni rnam par 'byed par shes/ /rnam par 'byed pa bcom pa'i phyir/ /rnam par 'byed pa bcom pa'i mthar56/ /rnam par 'byed pa mthar gsal 80—385

'gyur / /rnam par 'byed mthar ye shes che/ /de rang ngo bo'i rang bzhin no/ /lha mos gsol pa/ dgyes pa rdul tshon dkyil 'khor ni/ /mnga' bdag ji lta'i rnam pas bri/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig khyod kyis yongs su zhus/ /nyon cig lha mo bdag gis bshad/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /las la mkhas pas bri bar bya/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par bya/ /pad+ma'i nang du char yang bya/ /char yang dang ldan sna tshogs 'dabatu)/ /char yang gi nang thig le ste/ /de yi steng du rdo rje bri/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze 'bru ldan/ /rdo rje gri gug gis ni bskor/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyanan/ /sna tshogs bum pa dang ldan pa(mi/ /dkyil 'khor rab kyi mchog ni bya/ /shar gyi 'dab mar 'khor lo bri/ /byang du de bzhin pad+ma'o④ / /nub kyi 'dab mar rin po che/ /lho ru ral gri bsgreng (snyeba'o/ /pad+ma gzhan rnams thod pa ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis rab tu gang / /dung gzhu de bzhin ri rab dang / /rab tu 'bar ba yi ni me/ /me mtshams la sogs rim bzhin bya/ /'bad pa yis ni yongs su bskor/ /shar gyi sgor ni dpag bsam shing / /byang du 'bras bu sa bon dang 6/ /nub tu rin chen sdong bu dang / /lho ru sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /sgo yi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng / /'od dang ldan pas bskor (7bar bya/ /lha mo chen mo de lta bu'i/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes sbyin bdag po/ /dam tshig chen po dang ldan pas/ /rab tu 'bad pa yis ni bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bdag po'i phyir/ /des na bdag ni rab tshim (87bya/ /dpal ye shes thig le 6)las dbang bskur ba blang ba dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //80wa 386

bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ kye 51)bcom ldan 'das/ dga' ba bzhi yi ②ngo bo dang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dga' ba las ni mchog dga' ba/ /mchog dga' ba las dga' bral dga'/ /dga' bral las ni lhan cig skyes/ /dga' ba kun gyi de nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ de lta'i rig pa mgon chen po/ /rig pa sngar gyi gzhung ngam da ci/ /mngon sum dang ni ④rjes su dpag /sa bon dang 'dra 'bras bu yin/ / ko ṭa 5pa las sā 67lu ni/ /gang du yang ni mthong mi 'gyur/ /dga' bral las ni lhan cig skyes/ /bde min dga' bral sdug bsngal des/ /dga' ba kun ni 'joms par byed/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dga' bral 'di/ /dga' ba kun dang mi mthun no/ /dga' ba las ni mchog dga' ba/ /mchog dga' ba las shin tu dgyes / /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro de rigs lags/ /yang na mchog las lhan skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma de bden/ /dga' bral las ni lhan skyes min / /'on (8)kyang de bsrungs pa ri9rilas yod/ /de min lhan skyes gang du gnas / /dga' ba kun dang mi mnyam ste/ /dga' ba kun ni 'joms byed pa/ /'di skad smra ba shin tu mchog /don dam pa yi tshig yin no/ /dga' kun 'gro ba yang gcig pu/ /yid 'phrog lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /sprin med snying ga'i yinam mkha' ru/ /ye shes nyi ma rab mdzes shing / /dpal ldan ye shes thig le'i tunyergyud / /nam yang de ni thos ma yin/ / de bzhin 51gegashegs pa'i /sheganas ni mchog /lha mo de ni gang las rnyed/ /rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig tu/ /du 80—387

ma'i rgyud du bshad na yang / /de lta mod kyi rgyud 'di yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /de skad smra yi ①rgyud gzhan kun/ /dge ba'i yid dang ldan yang yin / /'di ru dad pa (mimed gyur na/ /dmyal ba la sogs 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mdo sde la sogs gsung rab kun/ /dad cing gus pas ③kho na yin/ /gang phyir rgyud kun gyi snying po/ /de phyir rgyud 'di rab kyi mchog /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ sbas pa'i yi ge drang ba gang / /snying po ye shes 'bras bu ster / /nye ba'i snying po de ni mgon/ /de ni de ring gsal bar mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sngags ni shin tu gsal ba mchog /de lta na yang gsal bar byas/ /sngags kyi bzlas las 'grub par 'gyur/ /grub pa (4)rnyed pas sangs rgyas sras/ /hā swā ṭapha (ge: hūm̐ ka la ti na dz+nyā dz+rab hā ma shrī oṃ/ hā swā ṭapha ṭapha haṃ haṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hri hri oṃ/(6) tā swā ṭapha hūm̐ hūm̐ yi mā k+ṣar dzi)la ba (guhā ma ye da ma zab oṃ/ hā swā ṭapha rtsu hūm̐ ras bi (9)ras oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa rnams kyis 7rdzu 'phrul gyis (7me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / sngon med pa'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyi chun po 'phyang ba dang / rol mo sna tshogs dang / gar dang / glu dang / mchod pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pas byas pa rmad du byung ba'i chos gos dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gser dang / nam mkha' las nor bu'i char bcom ldan 'das kyi 1 zhabs kyi rtsar babs par gyur to / /de nas nam mkha' las de bzhin gshegs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang 80—388

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bstod 6)pas bstod pa②/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pu/ /legs so legs so bcom ldan 'das/ /shin tu rmad byung ye shes che/ /mchog gi dbang phyug gtan la phab/ /'di yi ni'akhor ni dag byed dges④la/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par byed/ /yang dag mchog gi gsang ba 'di / /rnyed par dka' ba don dam pa/ /dpal ldan ye shes thig le'i rgyud/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gtan la phab/ /de lta 55bu'i tshogs kyi (6)mchod pa byas nas/nam mkha' la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa rnams de kho na nyid kyi bsam gtan la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das/ bde ba chen po gcig pu'i sku/ /tshig rgyas pa yi snying po'i don/ /mchog gi dbang phyug bdag la gsungs/ /mchog gi (7)dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/ nyon cig lha mo gsang ba'i mchog /rgyud kun du ni rnyed dka' ba/ /gsang sna pad+ma'i snying po ni/ /tshogs kyi gnas su 'di ru brjod/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo kha phye'i phyir/ /de ni rgyas par brjod pa'o/ /yang na thams cad kyi ni tshogs/ /snying po bya yi gdong mar dran/ /de la rdo rje rtse mo yis/ /phye ba de ni rgyas par brjod / / i ḍā (8)ping gal gnyis kyi dbus/ /rtog med ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / srub dang bsrubs porapa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdorje'i mthe chung rtse mo las reg byas gang gis bde bar 'dzag /zhal bzang de ni tshig rgyas pa'o⑩/ /lte ba'i gnas nas smin 'khor lo/ /de nas gnas pa'i rna ba'o/sto/ /spyi rtse tu tshangs pa'i bu ga ni/ /tshig rgyas pa ni gsum du dran/ /ma ni srub dang bsrubs tunyepa ste/ /ra ni dga' ba yin par brjod/ /mu ni lha mo sgrol ma yin/ /da yi yig 'bru zhu ba'i gzugs/ /gha yi yig 'bru sgra ru grags/ /ta yi yig 'bru gsal bar byed//80—389

na ni lte ba'i gsang ba'i mthar/ /de yi dbus su rtag tu shar/ /zla ba'i sku dang 'dra ba gsal/ /nyi ma bye ba yo)mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /byang chub kyi ni lam rab ster/ /de ni gsang ba ye shes che/ /rang bzhin tshig gis rab gsal byas/ /'bad pa yis ni sba bar bya/ /su la'ang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /dpal ye shes thig le las tshig rgyas par bstan pa zhes bya (snyeba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan nyon bdag gis bshad/ /ye shes rab mchog gang gis smras/ /de kho na ( nyid bdag don zab/ /nges bstan la sogs bye brag tu/ /srog gi dbyug pa bzhugs sa)thabs nas/ /rtsa dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba drug /thig le'i ⑤shar ba nub pa dang / /'pho ba sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang / /rtsa yi 'khor lo 'byung bar (rme dgyes/ /dbang gi rim pa de bzhin no/ /srung ( ba'i 'khor lo lha mo che/ /snying po sngags kyi rgyal po nyid/ /sku brgyad bdag nyid mchod sbyin dang / /thim dang longs spyod dang ni dbang / /rdo rje lha mo ye shes sku/ /gsang ba'i sgra yang de bzhin no/ /sung (8)ba'i dam tshig la sogs dang / /dpal ldan sbyin sreg 99)don dam par/ / srub dang bsrubs ⑩pa'i dgyes pa dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa mchod sbyin dang / /gnas brgyad sku yi ngo bo dang / /dga' ba la 3lhasogs pa yi mchog /dur khrod rnam rtog med par grags/ /chu ngogs rtog tsho pa med pa dang / /snang ba la sogs mchog ye shes/ /dngos po la sogs bde ba che/ /thog ma tha ma dur khrod brgyad/ /zhing la sogs pa bstan pa dang / /rlung gi de nyid snying po'i don/ /'jug pa gnas pa 'gro ba dang / /80—390

nyer 'gro sbyor ba rab mchog dang / /nyid ni ye shes thig le dang / /rang gi ngo bo rnam pa mchog /sa la sogs pa'i bdag po dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyabs dang / /rgyud kyi rim pa bstan pa dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin no/ /gsang ba yi 1)ni don dam par/ /de nyid mchod pas bskul ba dang —/ /shes rab ye shes ji bzhin no/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sogs / /zhal bzang tshig rgyas bstan pa'o/ /gtor ma 'byung la phan don du/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig lho par byed/ /de ni bde ba chen po'i mtha' de nyid bsdus pa'i snying po'i don/ /bzhi bcu'i bdag nyid de nyid don/ /gsang chen bdag gis rab tu bshad/ /de nyid sum cu drug bdag po/ /char yang ye shes tshor byed do/ /thig le ye shes bdag nyid tshor/ /de ni sum cu bdun dbang phyug /tshul gyis ye shes bdag nyid tshor/ /de ni sum cu brgyad dbang phyug /tshul tsam ye shes tshor byed pa/ /dgu lhag sum cu de nyid do/ /mchog shes pa yi rnal 'byor gang / /bzhi bcu'i mnga' bdag chen po'o/ /gzhan mchog gsung zhusalam brjod du med/ /rnam par dag pa de nyid mchog /thams cad de kho'i bdag nyid phyir/ /de bas bye brag mi bya'o/ /dpal ye shes thig le las de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus ri pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //lha mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni mchog dga' ba/ /kun dga' ba yi rnam pa sku/ /de kho na nyid zhal brgyad pa'i/ /rnam par dag pa ji ltar lags / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de nyid sgom (shepa rnam par 80—391

dag /skal ldan lha mo khyod nyon cig /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /nang gi stong pa de nyid do/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /sa dang stobs dang ye shes so/ /phyag rnams stong nyid rnam par dag /brgyad gnyis phyag ni stong pa nyid / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan sde dang ldan/ /thod pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas chos ni ma 'dres pa/ /'jigs byed ma ni brgyad gnyis dbye/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po ni/ /zhabs bzhi ru ni dran pa'o/ /chags sdang de bzhin gti mug ni/ /legs dgyes zla nyi 'jigs byed do/ /gang zhig srid pa'i gnas su bzhugs/ /zhal bzang de phyir g.yas brkyang ba/ /lha mo g.yon brkyang zhi)mya ngan 'das/ /ye shes sku nyid bzhugs pa'o/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das min phyir/ /lha mo de phyir bzhengs pa'o/ /gzugs brgyad rnam par dag pa yis/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /gzugs med gnyis kyi (mi'adu shes phyir / /shes rab thabs gnyis bdag nyid do/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'i phyir / /zhal bzang mo ni sna tshogs gzugs/ /lha mos gsol pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dbang phyug /bcom ldan bdag gis rnam dag shes/ /gsang ba'i don gyis 'di ltar mgon/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bka' drin gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i sgom pa rnam par dag /lha mo shes rab chen mo nyon/ /zhal dang lhan cig pa yi spyan/ /zhal bzang gnas la sogs pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs par yod pa'i rtsa/ /bcu drug phyag ni bcu drug pa'o/ /ā (8)li thig le rnam dag pa'i/ /thod pa yin par 'di ru bstan/ /'jigs byed rnam par 'jigs byed ma/ /legs dgyes dga' ba bcu drug go/ /skad cig bzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /zhabs ni bzhi ru dran pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba 80—392

ni mchog gi dga'/ /g.yon brkyang dga' ba dga' ba yin/ /bzhengs pa 6)lhan skyes dga' ba'o/ /phyag rgya pha rol phyin par dran/ /dbang gi rang gi ngo bo'o / /thim pa smad kyi tshangs pa'i ras/ /longs spyod zhi ba'i pags ②pa'i gosal/ /legs dgyes dbang phyug yang na gnas/ /bskyed pa ③tshangs pa'i pags ④par ⑤grags/ /bong bu'i zhal ni 'jigs pa'i sgra/ /phyag rgya shes rab thabs ni che/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med dran/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam dag pas/ /rus pa sna tshogs rgyan la sogs/ /nam mkha' ru ni 'gro ba'i phyir / /gyen du 'bar ba'i dbu skyes so/ /rang gi ngo bo bde chen phyir/ /sku mdog nag po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /dga' bral gyi ni bdud chen po/ /'jigs par 0byed phyir 'jigs pa che/ /dpal ye shes thig le las rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das mas ma mchu'i bdud rtsi'i ro phul te⑦/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i me tog gis mchod nas/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu tshim par mdzad nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kyai 5gebacom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i dus su yang dag par gsang ba'i rgyud 'di skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la sus 'chad par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje mgon pos bshad par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ ye shes bdud rtsi po)char pa che/ /mgon po khyod kyis rmad 'byung nyu )sbyin/ /phyag na rdo rje mgon po che/ /de yi bskyed pa ji ltar lags/ /rgyal ba'i kunamanga' bdag ye shes rgyal/ /de ni tshig gcig bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 80—393

stsal pa/ /gang zhig khyod kyis yongs zhus pa/ /bcom ldan ma de yang dag nyon//phyag na rdo rje mgon chen po/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag /mtha' yas pa yi 'jig rten khams/ /skye dang 'jig pa'i rgyu yin no/ /de las skye ba gang yang med / /rang byung mchog gi dbang phyug go/ /de yi phyag gi rdo rje ni/ /ye shes bcu gnyis skye ba med/ /thog ma yi hu)ni rwa ②lnga las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'byung ngo / /mtha' nas 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /dbus nas 'gro ba'i ①ris ④drug 'byung / /lta ba kun ni bsrung 951don phyir/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs su spyod / /la lar rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /la lar sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs/ /la lar he ru ka yi gzugs/ /la lar de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /la lar byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs/ /la lar nyan pa lta bur bzhugs/ /la lar 'chad do dgyes pad+ma 7/ /la lar klog pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /la lar rgyud dang bstan bcos ni/ /mdzad pa dang ni la lar 'dzin/ /mang du brjod lta ci zhig dgos//de ston phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ /lha mos gsol pa/ dkyil 'khor dang ni 'khor la sogs / /de la mdor bsdus ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa yis / /mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ma dgyes mdzod/ /gru bzhi la sogs dang ldan pa/ /dur khrod kyi (8)ni rgyan 5)gyis brgyan / /shing brgyad kyis nyu tshoni chal 17par bkram/ /rdzing brgyad kyis ni brgyan tu shepa'o / /de dbus sna tshogs chu skyes ni/ /'dab 1 ma dang ni ge sar bcas/ /de yi dbus su lha thod pa/ /dum bu gsum pa kun dang bzhi/ /rang gi ngo bo chos kyi dbyings/ /bdud rtsi lngas ni shin tu gang / /hūṃ gi yig 'bru de dbus gnas / /ye shes me yi 'od dang mnyam/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /80—394

sdig pa thams cad 'jig ①par byed/ /hūm̐ la sogs pa yongs gyur las/ /skad cig gcig gis rmad du byung ②/ /lha mo bcu gnyis dang ldan pa/ /phyag na rdo rje rgyal po bzhengs/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /char sprin gyi ni mdog dang mnyam/ /phyag bzhi pa ni rta la chibs / /nyi ma'i 'od dang mnyam pa'i spyan / /bskal pa chen po'i me dang 'dra/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /gdul dka' chen po 'dul bar mdzad/ /snying rje'i rlan ④gyis brlan (snyepar mdzad / /phyag rgya lnga 'dzin dpa' bo che/ /ral pa'i dbu rgyan gyis ni brgyan/ /ral pa sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla cod pan/ /phyag g.yas pas ①ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /sna tshogs kyi ni 'od zer 'phro/ /g.yon ni thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gzhan pas rdo rje'i mda' dang gzhu/ /rta ni 'di ru sngon po'i gzugs/ /spyan gsum pa la drag po'i 'od/ /zhi ba'i pags (7)pas sga cha byas/ /dgod (nyapa'i nga ro gshog 6)pa can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ma dang / rdo rje drag mo dang / rdo rje gtum mo ⑩dang / rdo rje nag mo ste/ gnag tunye)pa dang / dmar ba dang /ljang ba dang / dkar po ste ngang pa la chibs nyu pa'o/ /phyag dang 'osnyematshon cha la sogs pa ni gtso bo bzhin no/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsi sna tshogs pas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng na thod pa'o/ /mtshams su rdo rje 'dod ma dang /rdo rje rtsags ④bu ma dang / rdo rje phreng ba ma dang / rdo rje brtson ma rnams ni gzugs gnyis pa'i sku/ nam mkha' lding la chibs 12pa gtso bo lta bu'o/ /shar sgo la sogs par rdo rje sha ba 7ri dang / rdo rje ro langs ma dang / rdo rje rab tu gtum ma dang / rdo rje khom bi nī //ste/ nam mkha' sngon po dang / nyi ma'i 80wa 395

'od dang / me'i kha dog dang / du ba'i mdog bya rgod la chibs ①pa mtshams kyi bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i snam bu la tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / drag po dang / mi mchog la sogs pa 'dre'i rgyal po rang rang gi mtshon cha phyag na bsnams pa du ma bya'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ phyag na rdo rje gtso bo'i gsang sngags ni gang / sems can rnams kyis ②ji ltar bsgom ③par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo sngags ni yi ge drug /thams cad 'dod pa'i don grub byed/ /gdug pa thams cad 'jigs ①byed cing / /nad rnams kun ni zad par byed/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu sbyin/ /thams cad mkhyen pas mi thub bo/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ rnal 'byor khro bo'i ⑤lta bas bzlas(6)ske/ /skad cig gcig gis khams gsum gsodaphyi/ /yang na zhi ba'i lta bas bzlas8)/ /mtha' yas pa yi 6)nad zhi byed/ /mchod sbyin yang dag cher byas na⑩/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bye ba bya/ /zhi ba la sogs sbyin sreg ⑩bya/ /ji ltar sngar ni bdag gis smras/ /dur khrod yang na chu ngogs su/ /phyag na rdo rje bsgrub par bya/ /dung chen gyi ni phreng ba yis/ /'grub pa'i don phyir bye ba bzlas12 / /zhi ba zhi ba'i sems kyis ni/ /drag po drag po sgrub yi par dka'/ /dbang bskur med pa'i sems can la/ /sngags 'di sbyin par mi bya ste/ /mkhas pas bris sku glegs bam ni/ /nam yang de la 7bstan mi bya/ /de lta min na 'grub 8mi 'gyur/ /kun nas kun du rab tu blta/ /gsang ba yis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun nas kun du zhal bzang mo/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad gyes pa/ /'dab ma sna tshogs pa yis mdzes/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni / /mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ /rgyal po'i bzhugs stabs yikyis ni 80—396

bzhugs / /nam mkha'i mdog ltar sngo ba ste/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal gcig pa/ /spyan gsum pa la zhi ba'i gzugs/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis ni/ /rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /chos kyi don ni 'chad pa'i phyir/ /phyag gnyis chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dab ma bdun la sangs rgyas bdun/ /brgyad pa la ni byams pa'ol/ /pa ti la sogs shing la brten/ /thams cad zla ba'i gdan du dran/ /gshin rje'i stigashed la sogs pa bzhi/ /gzhan min sgo la sogs par dgod/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs bzhi/ /sgo yi mtshams su gnas pa'o/ /sgo yi phyi rol snam bu'i gnas/ /yang dag lha chen la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng bas kun du mchog /mkhas pas yongs su bskor bya'o/ /dpal ye shes thig le las dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ②bskyed pa'i sgom (0pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad ④pa'o// //de nas de'i dus su 'khor thams cad stan las langs te/ lan gsum du bskor 6)ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi (6)zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag brjod do/ /mgon khyod bka' drin gyis ni bdag cag dag /gzhan dang mi mnyam rgyal bas rnyed dka' ba/ /blta bar dka' ba shes dka' gzung (7skabar dka'/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba mchog gi mchog rab nyid / /dpa' bo dbang phyug chos dbyings phyag 'tshal bstod58)/ /log shes mun nag 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog char grags la 'dud / /yig bral thig le skye med la phyag 'tshal/ /nam mkha'i (9norang bzhin tshul grags la phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis su med pa'i tshul tsam la phyag 'tshal/ /80—397

mchog gi rang bzhin phyag 'tshal 6)phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gzhan min gzhan mchog rang bzhin phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ye shes thig le las bstod ②pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor thams cad dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma ②la bos te/ kye ④bcom ldan 'das ma ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sbyor drug gi (6༄grags pa bcu dang bral ba bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid/ dpal mchog gi bla ma'i zhal snga nas pad+ma btsal te/ bsam gtan la sogs pa yis ⑦yang dag par mthong ba zhes gtan ⑧la phab pa'o/ /dpal ye shes thig le las mchog tu gsang zhing shin tu gsang ba thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyis 0kyang rnyed par dka' ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rmad du byung ba/ mchog chen po ⑩nang gi rnam par shes pa drug gi bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u tunyeste sum cu (nyepa'o / / //dpal ye shes thig le 3 rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdzogs so / / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī pradz+nyā mgup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / / //slad kyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su zhu thig 8g.yar tsokhyal bgyis so / / //80—398

༄ga /dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/tu)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tatwa ( pra dī paṃ nā ma ma hā yo gi nī (5)tan+t+ra ④rā 595)/ bod skad du/ dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba (6)rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 77dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje dpa' bo chen po dang /dpa' mo'i dbang phyug mas yang dag par bskor nas/ shes rab kyi bha ga la bzhugs so/ /der bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas legs dgyes chen po'i rol pa 87sgog pas nye bar longs spyod pa dang / ri ma mchu'i bdud rtsi'i btung bas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byas te/ kha sbyor gyi thabs kyi sbyor ba las langs nas/ ri rab kyi nyi rdul gyi grangs kyi rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig pas lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 80wa 416

mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan ye shes zla bar grags/ /lte ba'i ku mud kha 'byed pa/ /gang zhig bdag gi zhu ba kun/ /mnga' bdag chen pos bdag la gsungs/ /dpal ldan bla na med pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor ma zhes rab grags pa/ /e baṃ ma yā (1)la sogs (bsgra'i/ /don ni ji lta bur ni brjod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig lha mo spyan bzang ring / /khyod kyis nga la gang zhus pa/ /e baṃ ma yā (bsogs sgra yis/ /khams gsum 'gro dang mi 'gro bcas/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /thams cad rgyas btab gzhan gyis min/ /de kho na nyid sgron mar grags/ /dri med rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu'i gzugs/ /e baṃ ma yā (༄de nyid gsum/ /thog mar bdag bcas pa dang ni/ /rang bzhin bzhi yi bye brag tu/ /don dam par ni shes par bya/ /thos pa'i don ni zla ba bde/ /de ni nam mkha' bzhin du mchog /gcig ces bya ba gzhan mchog rab/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa spangs / /dus ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ /bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs dang bral/ /bcom ldan 'das ni mtha' zhes bya/ /rang dga' nyams su myong ba'i dngos/ /thams cad ye shes gsum stong nyid/ /de nyid de nyid kyis ni spangs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam 'byed grags/ /dang po'i gnas ni rab grub (5)byed/ /sku ni dga' ba'i gzugs su grags/ /dbang po gnyis byung dang bral ba/ /gsung ni mngon par dga' zhes bya/ /dam tshig las byung gis ni spangs/ /thugs ni dga' bral dga' zhes bya/ /ye shes las byung bde dang bral/ /rdo rje lhan skyes zhes su bstan/ /rang bzhin gyis ni spangs pa'o/ /lha mo dpal chen nyi ma skyes/ /zhu ba dga' bral dang bral lo/ /dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma bde 80—417

rten / /dang po'i bdud rtsi las skyes so/ /yan lag kun gyis ①yang dag bskor / /khyab pa srog gi pad+ma bzhin/ /shes rab tshangs pa'i sgo lnga'i khyim/ /tshangs pa'i ye shes 'dzin phyir ro/ /bha ga dngos po 'jig pa yis/ /yang na longs spyod myong bas so/ /bzhugs pa rang gi ngo bo la/ /gnas pa yang na gshegs pa'o/ /de lta bu ni don dam par/ /'di skad bdag la sogs par bshadal/ /thams cad rnal 'byor rgyud du sbas/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bla mar yang —/ /nges dang drang don bye brag tu/ /e baṃ ma yā ②la sogs gnas/ /rgyud shes pa yi don phyir te/ /gnyis su dbye ba'i rgyud rab bstan/ /'bras bu ye shes chen po'i ④ro/ /rang gis ༷nyams myong ngo bo nyid/ /rang rig dag gis mi rnyed pas/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /lha mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan ye shes rgyal po nyid/ /log pa'i ye shes mun 'joms pa/ /de nyid nyi shu gnyis bdag nyid/ /gang zhig ye shes thig ler gsungs/ /de la yang ni nges pa'i don/ /mchog gi dbang phyug bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang zhig de nyid nges don du/ /zhal bzang de ni gsang ba'o//khyod kyi ngor byas bdag gis bshad/ / de lta min na sbas pa'o/ / e baṃ (5)rnam pa'i dbus su ni (nyagang zhig drug cu rtsa ⑦bzhi'i 'dab (nyama'i dbyibs kyi rtsa'i 'khor lo de ni rnam pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /de'i nang du gang du rtsa sum cu (9)rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid ut+pa la'i rnam pa'i 'khor lo de ni mtha' ste/ de la gang zhig zur brgyad pa'i rnam pa'i lte ba de ni snang ba'o/ /gang zhig lte ba'i dbus yangs pa de ni nam mkha'o/ /der ni lnga gnyis nas bzung ste/ bco 0lnga'i bar gyi sa'am/ dbang phyug gi mnga' bdag bzhugs 80—418

so / /der gang zhig de hu)kho na nyid gsum gyi (mibadag nyid de ni lan gsum 'bab pa'i phung po'i rnam par shes pa sems dang sems las byung ba dang ma rig pa'i gzugs kyis gsum du dbye ba zur dang po la thun tshod gcig gi bar du 'bar ba'o/ /gang zhig srog gi dbyig pa de ni lu gu rgyud kyi rnam pa'i mdud pa sum cu rtsa gnyis su sbom pa dang phra ba'i thig le ro gcig pa'i gzugs kyis dbyig pa'i bdud rtsi zur gnyis pa la thun tshod gnyis kyi bar du zhu ba'o/ /drug po de ni bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i grags pa dga' ba drug zur gsum pa la thun tshod gsum gyi bar du 'dzag pa'o/ /gang zhig thig le shar ba dang nub pa de ni thim pa dang longs spyod du grags pa'i srog de ni zur bzhi pa la thun tshod bzhi'i bar du 'bar ba'o/ /gang zhig 'pho ba'i sbyor ba de ni steng dang 'og gi 'dab ④ma yod par byang chub kyi sems 'dus pa'i dbang ni zur lnga pa la thun tshod lnga'i bar du zhu ba'o/ge/ /gang zhig rtsa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba de ni yan lag thams cad la bdud rtsi rgyas pa zur drug pa la thun tshod drug gi bar du 'dzag pa'o/ /gang zhig dbang gi rim pa de ni gcig nyid srog gi kha ru srog la 'bab pa dang /'phur ba dang khyab pa de yang zur bdun pa la thun tshod bdun pa'i (5)bar du 'bar ba'o/ /gang zhig srung (6)ba'i 'khor lo de ni mthe'u chung gi mdud pa'i nang du bdud rtsi la bskor ( )ba zur brgyad pa la thun tshod brgyad kyi bar du zhu ba'o / /de dag ni g.yon du bskor ba'i srog gi rlung la zhon pa nyi ma skye ba la mtshan mo dang nyin 2mo'i bar du sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tsha rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang na bcu drug bral ba'i mtshan nyid mi gsal ba dang /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid bcu drug gsal ba de'i don gyi phyir dga' bral gyi dga' 80wa 419

ba'i mtshan nyid ā hu)li'i rang gi ngo bo zla ba'o/ /phyi dang phyi'i don rnams kyis ni nang dang nang gi don gnas par gshes par bya'o/ /de yang phyi'i tshes kyi grangs kyis so/ /nang srog gi rlung gi grangs kyis so/ /lha mos gsol pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis ②kyi chu skyes kyi ut+pa la'i rnam pa la bde ba chen po'i kun du spyod pa nges pa'i don gyis gnas pa de mchog gi dbang phyug gi bka' ④grin bskyab tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig lha mo skal ldan mo/ /gsang ba chen po ye shes mchog /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /thams cad sa yi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /gang zhig snying po'i sngags ni nyid/ /de ni bdag nyid bcu drug bde/ /kun rdzob ri bong can gyi 'od/ /don dam par ni nam mkha' bzhin / /gang zhig sku brgyad mchog sbyin ni/ /de ni mtshan mo brgyad mchog go/ /lha mo yang na ye shes brgyad/ /mtshan mo nyin mo gnyis las 'byung / /gang zhig thim dang longs spyod dbang / /de ni nges par bskyed rim mo(ge/ /lha mo bskyed rim (6)gsal ba ste/ /rim las byung ba'i bde ba che/ /skal ldan myo gang ye shes sku / /de ni rim (7)sogs yan lag spangs/ /yan lag bzhir dbye drug dbye 'am / /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /lha mo gang zhig gsang ba'i sgra/ /de ni ye shes gsum dang bral/ /yang na gzhan min bdag nyid gsum/ /mtshams kyi ye shes yod pa'i phyir/ /lha mo gang zhig dam tshig ni/ /srung (nyab (9)la sogs kyinges par ro/ /de ni bde ba dbus gnas su/ /gzung bya yang na gang nang du/ /gang zhig sbyin sreg 11don dam par/ /de ni ha zhes glo bur te(ste/ /char yang dbus yod thig le ni/ /gang du skad cig gis thim mo(nye/ /gang zhig srub dang bsrubs lithabs ni/ /de ni thog ma'i dga' ba spangs/ /lha mo de 80—420

bzhin tha ma'ang min/ /thog ma tha ma gnyis dang bral/ /skal ldan mo gang sngags kyi bzlas/ /de ni srid pa 'das pa'i yid/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas kyang min/ /gnyis kyi ngo bo gnyis dang bral/ /gang zhig gnas ni brgyad du bstan / /de ni nyi skyes ma rgyas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang gis shar ba la/ /nye bas myur du rgyas pa'o/ /gang zhig dga' ba la sogs rim/ /de ni rim pa gnyis su dbye / /rnam bcas las ni dang po pa/ /rnam bral bcu yi dbang phyug go/ /gang zhig dur khrod rnam rtog bral/ /dbugs dbyung (1)la sogs rnam par spangs//byang chub kyi ni sems ro la/ /rnam par zhu ba dam tshig phyir/ /lha mo gang zhig chu yi (gyengogs/ /de ni rtog med ma yi mthar/ /yang na de ru bsrog nigi rtsa/ /bde ba'i chu bo 'bab pa'i phyir/ /gang zhig snang ba sogs ye shes/ /de ni dga' ba dang ldan yid/ /sa dang chu dang 'od kyi gzugs/ /de bzhin rlung gi ngo bo dang / /gang zhig dngos po rten la sogs/ /de ni bde ba'i dang por rig /rang gi rnam pa'i bye brag gam/ /rnam par dpyod pas nges par dpyodartsi//lha mo gang zhig dur khrod brgyad/ /de ni bde ba la thim zhes/ /rnam par rtog pa 'dzin pa'i sku/ /de la thim zhing thim (napa'o/ /gang zhig shing la sogs pa'i don / /de ni dang po'i bdud rtsi rgyu/ /rtsa de brten (6)pa'i gzugs su grags/ /thams cad rnam pa'i bde sbyin ma/ /gang rlung de nyid snying po'i don/ /de ni rin chen gdu bu'i bde/ /'dzum 57༄pa yis ni yang dag par/ /pad+ma'i zhal de myong ba'o/ /lha mo gang zhig mdzub (8)la sogs/ /de ni gyen du gzung ⑨ba'i rlung —/ /yang na rtsa yi kun spyod las/ /'gro ba'i bdud rtsi 'dzin pa'o/ /gang zhig nyer 7'gro'i bsam gtan sbyor/ /de ni zla ba gyen du byed/ /yang na 80wa 421

tshangs bzhi rnam dbye byas/ /rnam par shes pa las ①gshegs gsol/ /gang nyid ②ye shes thig le ni/ /de ni drug phyed gsum dang bral/ /bcu dang lnga yi sa rnams ni/ /dbang phyug 'pho med skye med do/ /gang zhig bdag gi phyirang ngo mchog /de ni nges par bzhi pa'i 'bras/ /yang na tor 0ya nyams su myong / /'bras bu'i sgras ni brjod pa'o/ /gang zhig sa yi dbang byed pa/ /de ni de nyid drug rang bzhin/ /de nyid drug las de nyid gsum/ /de nyid gsum las rang bzhin gcig /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /de ni mya ngan 'das mtshan nyid/ /yang na dga' ba dang ni bral/ /dga' bral dga' min rang ngo bo / /lha mo gang zhig rgyud bstan pa/ /de ni bde ba shin tu 'phel/ /bde dang bral ba'i bde ba ni/ /yang na de nyid rnyed pa'o/ /gang zhig phyag rgya che rang bzhinal/ /de ni thim sogs yid las 'das/ /rang gis nyams myong rang ngo bo/ /bsam gtan (5)'dzin pa spangs pa'o/ /gang zhig gsang ba don dam par/ /de ni dga' ba dga' dang bral/ /yang na nang gi reg bya ste/ /reg bya dang bral rtog pa med/ /gang zhig bskul ba'i mchod pa'i don/ /de ni dri med bde ba 'byung / /'das pa las ni yang skye ba/ /skye ba de la 'phel ba'o/ /lha mo shes rab ye shes gang (6)/ /de ni kha la snying gar (7bde/ /kha ni rtag tu shes rab yin / /snying ga (na/ye shes brjod pa'o/ /gang zhig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor / /de ni khu ba 'pho (97med dge/ /yang na bde chen rang ngo bo bde ba'i rnam par rtog dang bral/ /lha mo tshigs rgyas gang zhig ni/ /bya gdong ma de khong du chud/ /yang na tshigs ni zhu med khu/ /dga' mo rgyas pa mchog yin no / /'byung ba bsrung 7don gtor ma gang / /de ni srog chags bsad pa'o/ /80—422

bcad pa de ni mchog gi ①gnas/ /'gro ba 'gog par byed pa'o/ /de dag ni mchog gi gsang ba chen po'i gsang chen bcom ldan 'das ma bzhi bcu'i bdag nyid kyi de kho na nyid bde ba chen po'i rgyal po'i bdud rtsi'i gter la nges pa'i don to// //lha mos gsol pa/ bzhi bcu'i bdag nyid de nyid ni/ /shin tu reg med gzung ②bar dka'/ /sa yi dbang phyug du tsam zhig /mchog gi dbang phyug gis mkhyen lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis nibaka' stsal pa/ /sna tshogs rnyed pa sum cu drug /bcu gcig sa yi bdag po'o/ /dga' ba rnyed pa sum cu bdun / /bcu gnyis sa yi bdag por brjod/ /mchog dga' rnyed pa ④sum cu brgyad / /de ni bcu gsum pa yi sa/ /sum cu dgu lhag mthar thug pa/ /sa ni bcu bzhi rnyed pa'o/ /bzhi bcu de ni lhan skyes so/ /bcwa ⑤lnga rnyed pa'i mnga' bdag go/ /gang zhig bcu drug pa yi 6)sa/ /brjod du med pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /de la dbang phyug mchog gi mkha'/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rnyed dka' ba/ /zad ( )med 'pho med zhi ba ste/ /skye med rmad byung bas rmad byung / / lha mos gsol pa(kye/ kye 5ribacom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsi'i rgyal po'i 0bdud rtsi'i gter de kho na nyid de la kun du spyod pa'i dus ni gang lags/ 'dus pa ni ci zhig lags/ nyams su myong ba de ⑩ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid la sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi chu tshod kyi bar du srog dang rtsol ba'i rlung gnyis shar ba ni kun du spyod pa'o/ /rtsol ba'i rlung 'byung ba'i dus su gang zhig yan lag thams cad la yonakhyab pa'i srog de ni (nyagayon skor 8du 'byung ba 80—423

yis 6)ut+pa la'i rnam pa 'dzums shing chanang gi lte ba'i snying po rtsa ba'i sdong bus 'jug pa'o/ /'jug pa tsam gyis zur brgyad pa'i nang na yod pa'i bde ba chen po'i srog gi rgyal po la gang zhig ro gcig pa'i mtshan nyid de ni 'dus pa'o/ /de'i dus su gang zhig bdag dang gzhan gyis ②bye brag med pa gnyis su med pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes kyis thams cad gzigs pa de ni stinyams su myong ba'o / /lha mos gsol pa/ gang zhig nyams myong las rnyed de/ /mnga' bdag de ni ji ltar lags/ /nyams su myong bas gang rnyed pa/ /de nyid mdor bsdus bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dris pa de ni rmad byung mchog /nyon cig lha mo spyan bzang ring / /nyams su myong bas gang rnyed pa / /dga' ba'i dbang mo de brjod med/ /bla ma'i zhal nas nyams su myong / /dbang bskur las ni rnyed (2pa'o/ /lha mos gsol pa/ dbang bskur ba ni du ma zhig /rgyud rgyud nang du rab tu gsal/ /'di ru bye brag ci 'dra ba/ /su la sbyin par bgyi ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dga' ba'i 'bras bu bye brag tu/ /dbang ni re zhig 96)bzhi ru dbye/ /dang po dga' ba dang ldan pa/ /las dang po la sbyin par bya/ /gnyis pa mchog dga' dang ldan pa/ /snang ba gsum ni thob pa la/ /dga' ba gsum pa dang ldan pa/ /chos kyi sprin rnyed nges pas so/ /kun du 'od sa zhes bya ba/ /rnyed pa bzhi la sbyin par bya/ /lha mos gsol pa/ kye /77bcom ldan 'das snang ba la sogs pa dang chos kyi sprin dang kun du 'od rnyed pa la de lta bu'i dbang gi rim pa lags na/ sa la sogs pa ma 981rnyed pa la ji ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa la (9)sogs pa ma rnyed pa rnams la thog mar rang gi ngo bos so/ /sa la sogs pa rnyed 80—424

'dir sngon du bsnyen pa med(1)/ /de bzhin yul dang dus tshes (midang / /gza' dang rgyu skar nisbyor med pa/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu bstenago/ /dus dang bya ba'i nges mi bya/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje zhes su gsungs/ /thod pa gru gsum yang dag 'byung ske/ /sbyor ba gsang bar gnas pa'i rtsa/ /de yi sna tshogs ngo mtshar ⑤byed/ /sde ni bde chen ye shes so/ /'di nyid theg pa chen po ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi (7rtsa las byung / /de ni rmad stibyung che mchog ste/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba nyid / /de nyid he ru ka dpa' bo9)/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs las sgrol byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba 'bab/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 6)sna tshogs bde/ /dpa' dbang 7bdag mo dbang phyug ma/ /de yi thod pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sngags dang rgyud ni rnam par gnas/ /de yi ye shes bzang po ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa dag las 'byung / /de ni rig (nyapa'i dbang lnga dang / /sangs rgyas bdun gyi mtshan can te/ /sna tshogs sbyor dang tshe 'phel dang / /dngos grub thams cad sgrub 8pa ni/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'grub par 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /man ngag lam las gang shes pa//bla ma'i drin las shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud chen po rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las dngos grub 'thams cad dang ye shes gtan la dbab pa dang / thod pa kha phye ba las glegs bam byung ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /sngags le'u ji bzhin gsungs pa ste/ /80—441

mkha' 'gro ma mo 'byung po rnams/ /sngags gang gis ni 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de ni bdag gis rab bshad kyis6)/ /khyod kyis dad pa brtan ②pas nyon/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni ta ṭa ②sto ṭa ya sab ④shu bha pra dā yi ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ spos dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ⑤ni ma ṭa ma ṭa a swā hā/ me tog dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka stimā la badz+re ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ⑦ta ṭa sta ṭa ya sta ṭa ya ma ṭa ⑧ma ṭa hūm̐ he hrīḥ(9)swā hā/ dri 'bul ⑩ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni griṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa gro: pa ya gro: (1pa ya ba ra ba ra ta ṭa ta ṭa8/ sta ṭa ya 8sta ṭa ya ma ṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ yiswā hā/ mar me dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka apā li ni/ grohā groṇ+ḍi gro: pa ya griṇ+ḍa pa ya kha kha 84/ lha bshos dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka pā li ni badz+ra dharma dhasme me ghi ⑩ba re pra ba re ba ra ba ra ka ra ka ra ta ṭa ta ṭa ha he swā hā/ gos dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hṝ (3ho ā+oṃ ho 8ho haṃ hā/( )la/ go cha'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka sh+yapā li ni a khaṃ kro r+ghaṃ shrī ⑦aḥ ā rtsu rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ spyan drang ba'i ( stesngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka pā la badzi ṇi (stegats+tsha gats+tsha uta tiṣ+ṭha uta tiṣ+ṭha ( nyedza dza dza 30ha rdza rdza rdza/ tre+e ni 7lo rkya ( shebi ṭa pā 0ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka pā ri )la badz+re 5)tsi tre su tsi tre+e ()a māṃ 6rteb ne phrin pu )ā/ sarba da bhū zhigata na mā ra ṇa tī la ya sasba duṣ+ṭan utsā ṭa ya sab birgyu bi tā sa)ba ya bha ga ba ti yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa pi shā tsā zhushen sho ṣa ya ta ṭa ya sap+ta pā tā ()la ga tā 6 na/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /'bras sā lu blangs (nyete 'o mas bkrus la bu mo gzhon nu mas de shin tu nyazhib par btags la/ de yang (2shes rab can gyis (rigazugs brnyan byas te/ zhal gcig 6 phyag bzhi (3gzhung 6 80—442

bzhin cang te'u dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / ral gri dang / thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas ro bsregs pa'i sol ba 6)phye mar byas la rdo rje gtsug gis mnye bar ②bya'o//de nas des gzugs brnyan la byug par bya'o/ /me tog dkar pos mchod pa ①byas te/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas he ru ma'i rnam pa'i sbyor bas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra he ru ke ④badz+re/ dha ra dha ra/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ma hā dz+nyā na sbo ṭa ṇi/ shī s+t+waṃ sā da ya ⑤sto bha ya tī la ya ⑥hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'di rtsichu la lan bdun du mngon par bzlas te/ gzugs brnyan nide bkru bar bya'o/ /chu des rang gi gdong bkrus na mi snang bar byed de/lha rnams kyis kyang rnyed par dka'o/ /nags kyi nang du stag gis kyang mi mthong ngo ske/ /gzhan dag gis kyang de mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /srog chags 'bum gyi nang du song na ngo mtshar sna tshogs byed do/ /gang gis kyang mi mthong ngo / /lha'i bu mo 'phrog cing lha rnams kyis kyang mi mthong ngo / /'o mas gdong bkrus pa tsam gyis ni mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs brnyan de'i snying gar shing 6)'ba' bo las phug stetshu/ dur khrod kyi me la 'ba' bo la (stodang tshangs pa rdo rjes rab tu sbar la/ de'i thal ba yang dag par blangs te/ kham phor du gzhag tu par bya'o//yang na pad+ma'i snod du'o/ /sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par bzlas par bya'o / /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li 6 rini ṭ+wāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi li tsorisi nī hrīḥ8rgyu/ oṃ kā 'ami nī khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ pā tā la 7ba sī māṃ tsho āḥrgyu/ tsho i tsi tra ཿse nā sa ma yā dhiṣ+ṭha ya hrīḥkhri )hūṃ / sngags 'di dag ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /thal ba de dang rdo rje gtsug gis lus ri 1byug par byas na ri sheji srid du lus la mtshon chas phog pa de srid du mi tshugs so/ /slar zhing dgra thams cad kyi mgo bo 80wa 443

'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gang sdang ba la bltas na de long bar 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig sdang ba'i sems 'dzin pa na de smyo 6)bar 'gyur ro/ /thal ba de nyid dang mar khu bzang pos mig byugs na dpag tshad stong mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang ci yang (2)rung ba'i 6)sa'i 'og na gnas pa'i gter dpag tshad stong gi 'og tu son pa'i dngul dang gser dang / rin po che gang na yod pa de thams cad la srin lag gis sdigs gi)mdzub (5)byas pa tsam gyis thams cad mdun du lhags te gsol ba 'debs so/ /kye 96)sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pa gter (7)long la sems can gyi don gyis shig /des (8)gter blangs na gang 'dod pa de byed de6)/ thal ba des byed do'i/ /thal ba de nya7dang go ro tsa na lhan cig bsnos te/mdzub 1)mos mnyes pas dpung gi tshogs langs pa mdzub mo bskor ()ba tsam gyis 'bum phrag stong gi dpung rnams kha sbub chatu lhung 8bar 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dod pa de byed do/ /bkrus 7pa tsam gyis langs par yo 'di the tshom ()med do/ /thal ba de dang zha nye'i phye ma dang bsnos te gcig tu byas la/ /rdo rje'i gtsug rjes su byin te khab len gyi lcags kyi phye ma bsre 67zhing gser gyi phye ma yang cung zad bsre bar bya'o/ /rdo rje'i chu'i khu ba dang lhan cig tu bsnos te zangs ma'i snod du nyi ma bdun gyi bar du gzhag go/ /de nas mkhris (2 pa chen po mnyes te rta'i khrag dang lhan cig tu bsnos 31la yang snod de nyid du nyi ma gsum gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas bton na te lcags gsum gyi rnyisnod du gzhag par bya'o/ /zangs ma'i snod du bzhag pa de me'i nang du bcug na gser dang dngul du 'gyur bar som nyi (stemed do/ /srang gcig shākyang srang stong gi rin thang du 'gyur te rin po che dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /gser de ma sha gcig dang dngul srang gcig bsres te me 80wa 444

la bzhu na srang sum brgya'i rin 0)thang gi tshad du 'gyur bar cha'adi la the tshom med do/ /'di lta bu'i sbyor ba ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rnyed par dka'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' grags pa chen po snying rje dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid chen po stobs che ba de rnams ①kyang sbyin par mi nus so/ /'di yi sbyor ba rnyed dka' ba/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud du gsungs④ / /rgyud gzhan rnams su sbas pa yin/ /'dus sogs ⑤rnal 'byor rgyud du ni/ /sbyor ba rnam pa ma gsungs pa/ /gang tshe sngon du bsnyen de'i tshe/ / de yi 0sbyor bas ci zhig bya/ /bsod nams dman ④pa'i sems can gang / /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa yang / /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yisal 'di lta'i sbyor ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /dngos po de yis blo chen rnams/ /sems can don la gcig tu brtson/ /srang gcig gis bsres bye ba'i ⑨rin/ /sbyor ba kun tu rnyed par dka'o⑩/ /sbyor ba glegs bam la ma bris7/ /bla ma'i drin las shes par bya/ /bla mas dngos grub bla mas thar/ /bla ma ston pa rnam 8kun pa / /des na slob ma blo chen 'gyis/ /'bad pas bla ma mnyes par bya /thal ba de nyid kyis ⑫ lus blta yigeba'i don du bu mo'i mgo la blugs te rdo rje gtsug gis bu mo bkru'o/ /yang thal bas yithig le byas la/ tshangs pas 4)rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byas te/ de'i dbus su bu mo gzhag par bya'o/ /bdug spos lngas bdugs shing sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs na bu mo la 'bab par 'gyur te/ 'das pa dang / ma'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba ston to / /bu don gyis zhu 'bras bu /tsal sngags 'di lan bdun du mngon par bsngags so )so / /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni de hi de tī da dā pa ya da dā ri 1pa ya he he bha ga ba ti shī 80wa 445

r+ghaṃ khasgo da ri ①nyi bud+dha ka pā la badz+ra su ya dzha ②ma lo gha ya hūm̐ sti hrī ②phaṭa a phaṭa/yungs kur dubasnun pa tsam gyis ni/ /bu mo grags chen ma ni rgodadu/ / de yi dukha nas ral gri bdun/ /'byung ba la ni the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas ⑦skad cig ma de nyid la 'grub par 'dir ⑧som nyi ⑨med do/ /de ltar ral gri tsogacig grub pas bye ba brgya stong gi rig 'dzin grub pas yibaskor bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta (2bu'i sbyor ba ni 'jig rten gsum na yang 0rnyed par dka'o / /bu mo bkrus pa tsam gyis rnal tsomar 'gyur ro/ /de'i thal ba lcags gsum gyis dkris te ril bu tsobyas nas khar bcug pa tsam gyis ni mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab can gyis sum cu pa yang ⑩bskor ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ / ril bu ⑩lag par blangs pas dngos po gang dang gang la reg pa tsam gyis de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /thal ba'i sbyor ba 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā la dzaḥtsos khaṃ raṃ a(7/ 'jig rten gsum bsgrub ( )pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni hrīḥ 0rtsu/dgra brlag 6)pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā ka pā snyenal badzi kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba duṣ+ṭan (stegha gha bhā ta ya ghā ta ya sasba ( gesha hūm̐ oṃ hi ṭ+wāṃ ( )rtsu phaṭa/ bskrad pa'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud chen po/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las thal ba'i sbyor ba dang las sna tshogs gtan la dbab pa dang / sngags kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ru //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes sna tshogs sde ma la btud de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can don la gcig brtson pa//80—446

legs so ①bcom ldan 'das lha mo/ /'di lta'i rab tu sbyor zhes pa/ /rgyud gzhan dag tu ma gsungs shing / /sangs rgyas kun gyis ②rab sbas pa/ /de ni 'bad de gsal bar mdzod/ /lha mo chen mo khyod kyis gsungs/ / lha yi ②le'u ni ji lta bu/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i ④rnal 'byor ma'i/ /rgyud du lha rnams du zhig gsungs/ /de ru gzugs ni ji lta bu/ /gus pa yis ni nyan par 'tshal/ /gsungs pa/ ro las nyi ma bsam par bya/ /nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ byung ba'i/ /rdo rje nag po sreg ①pa'i bdag /rdo rje de nyid 'od zer gyis/ /ra ba dra bas ⑥mtshams bcing ngo / /de bzhin rdo rje nag gyur pa'iX/ /rdo rje'i dus gzhi bsam par bya/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i 5)dbus chud par/ /e yi rnam pa bdag nyid che/ /gru gsum khams gsum bdag nyid can/ /yi ge lo gyur sa yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi rab ser po'o/ / de yi yidabus nas sa bon ni(nya/ /yi ge oṃ 7ste chos bdag nyid/ /oṃ tunyelas byung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsa rnams kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnam par bzhugs/ /rtsa ni drug cu chal rgyan dang ske/ /sprul pa drug cu rtsa bzhi 'dab7/ /des na rtsa brgya yinyi shu'o/ /rdo rje spre zhesku yi tsobadag nyid che/ /shes rab can gyis de ltar bsam/ /de yi dbus gnas sa bon ni/ /bam̐ (tshedakar yi ge las byung ba/ / chu yi 6 )dkyil 'khor zlum po'o / /rtsa rnams thams cad chu yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni thim par 'gyur/ /slar yang bsam par bya ba ni/ /raṃ ( stodamar las byung me so dkyil 'khor/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i bdag nyid can/ /rab tu 'bar bzhin pa yi ni/ /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo yang dag blta/ /de nas bsam par bya ba ni/ /yaṃ gyur rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla ba phyed pa'i rnam 'dra sngo/ /rtsarnams rab tu g.yo ba'i gzugs//80—447

thim gyur 'khor lo'i rig par gsungs/ /de dag thams cad thim 'gyur btu)/ / de yi dbus gnas (0rnal 'byor pa/ /de ltar shes par byed gang zhig /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de nas zla ba bsam par bya/ /zla ba'i steng du nyi ma'o/ /de yi dbus chud sa bon ni/ /hūm̐ dang a yi rang bzhin no/ /yi ge ka yis ha brgyan te①/ /ka ni ha la thim ④par 'gyur/ /mi phyed pa yi ha dang hūm̐/ /gnyi ga'i bdag nyid can blta'o/ /ha ni mi shigs shes rab kyi/ /bdag nyid u dang 5) thig le 4)dag /gnyi ga gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi mchog blta'o(pe/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'od zer rnams/ /de yis bde ba che bskul te/ /ba mo lta bu'i ri bong can/ /nyi mar lhan cig zhu gyur cing / /dkyil 'khor gnyi ga gcig gyur pa/ /nyi ma'i mchog tu blta bar bya/ /yang ni hūm̐ byung 'od zer des58)/ /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo thams cad la/ /reg ma thag pa'i mod la ni/ /rtsa ba'i 6)'khor lo las 'bab 'gyur/ /zhu ba ⑩de yis sa bon bkrub/ /hūm̐ gyur pa las rdo rje ste/ /dbus su de nyid kyis byin brlabasayi/ /sa bon rdo rje las byung ba/ /dpa' bo khrag 'thung (gemadog sngon po/ /zhal gcig (1pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /gtso bo hūm̐ zhes 'don pa ste/ / skyil krung 'phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /gnyi ga'ang khro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /stag gi pags 8pa'i na bza' tshamanabs1 tsho/ /mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng tu ba 'chang / /bsregs (7su mchod phyir thogs pa yi/ /shin tu bzhad 2 )pas 'jigs che ba'i/ /gtso bro snying rje'i bdag nyid blta/ /dpung rgyan mgul do 'khor gdub dang / /gcer bu rus pa'i ska rags ( rto'achang na / /g.yer kur 2nabacas pa'i rkang gdub can/ /ma lus bdud rnams 'joms par byed/ /ral pa'i cod 7pan yang dag ldan/ /80—448

sangs rgyas rnam pa lnga yis brgyan0)/ /zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa'i lha/ /dbu la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan②/ /'khor lo rna cha gdu bu dang / /phyag rgya rnam pa lnga yis mtshan / /thal ba'i rdul can 'jigs par byed/ /thod pa gti mug gis brgyan pa'i / /dpa' bo 'khor ba sgrol byed pa/ /byang chub sa bon rang bzhin no/ /gtso chen de yi gshes rab ma/ /sna tshogs sde ma rnal 'byor ma/ /gcer bu mgo bo'i phreng ba spangs / /rgyan med mchod phyir thogs med ma/ /bde ba kun gyi gzugs can ma/ /phyag gnyis skra (55ni grol ba mo(6)/ /he ru ka la (7da'akhyud gnas ma / /de ltar pha rol phyin lha mo/ /kha dog dmar po 58rnam cadagasal ma/ /zhal ni shin tu rnam 'gyur ba/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs 'jigs ma/ /g.yas na cang te'u gri gug ste/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa'o/ /rang gi lus skyes 'od zer gyis / /rtsa yi 'khor lo bskul bar bya/ /de yis bskul ba tsam gyis ni/ /rtsa yi tshi'akhor lo'i 7rang bzhin las/ /'dzag 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 12med/ /'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma/ /brgyad po bu mo rnams kyi mchog /mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa yis/ /mgon po he ru ka mchod do/ /rdo rje mgon po'i shar gnas pa/ /rdo rje mche ba 4rim yis ni/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang bzung ste/ /gzi brjid chen po gsol bar mdzad/ /rdo rje pho nya bdag nyid che/ /dbang ldan du ni cang te'u brdung (6/ /rdo rje gdong ma dri snod dang / / me yi 7phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /rdo rje can ma grags chen mo/ /mchod yon snod bcas skibaden bral na/ /rdo rje gtsigs ma lho yi ni/ /phyogs nyu na rnga bo che 'dzin gsungs / /rlung du rdo rje lte ba ma/ /ri (2bong can gyi snod 'dzin no/ /nub tu rdo rje 'jigs ma ni/ /ce 19sbyang phyag na 'dzin par gsungs/ /byang du 'dod 80wa 449

chags rdo rje ma/ /lha mo'i chags pas gtso bo mchod/ /de ltar he ru ka bsams ①nas / /rnal 'byor ma ni brgyad kyis mchod/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom / /sna tshogs rol mo mchog gsungs dang / /dri zhim lnga dang me tog spos/ /'di dag gis ②ni gtso bo mchod/ /mchod yon zhal bsil de bzhin khrus/ /glu ①yi mchog ni rnam mang pos/ /mgon po khrag 'thung bdag nyid che/ /'di dag gis ni mchod par bya/ /dpa' bo rdzogs par mthong nas ni/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo las ni 'dzag /'dzag pa de las rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam mang ④brtse ba cher ldan pa / /bder (shegashegs kun gyis byin brlabs (nyam/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs(na/ /sna tshogs pa yi na bza' mnabs(snye/ /gzugs ni lang tsho gzhon pas brgyan/ /lo ni bcu dang gnyis lon pa⑨/ /phyag g.yas byang chub sems bkang ba'i/ /bum pa a mra'i lcug bcas bsnams/ /zhal ni rab bzhad dang ba yis/ /he ru ka ni 7rgyal gyur cig /rgyal gyur cig ces 'di ltar smra/ /mgon pos mdun du bltas nas ni/ /dbang bskur mchog ste yigasol ba gdab//brtse 8dang ldan pa'i 9/nyagrags chen mo/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /dbang bskur ba yis bdag bsgral 8phyir/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mas khrus shigatso /dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ba tsam gyis stong pa nyid/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyis stong ⑩pa nyid/ /dper na pi bang 4)sbyor kun tshogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung 4)mi rung / /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /de ltar shes bya rnal 'byor 80wa 450

mas① / /slar yang bdag la dbang bskur cig /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal phyite / /thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba gdab/ /gal te dbang bskur med na ni/ /he ru ka yi ①bdag gyur cing ④/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de rnams/ /rgyal gyur rgyal gyur zhes smra zhing / /bcom ldan dbang bskur khrus gsol lo/ /phyi nang gsang bar bcas pa yi/ /dbang bskur tsam gyis (zhenam mkha' yi/ /khams ⑥nas rnga yi sgra grag (7cing / /me tog tsan+dan char 'bab 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de rnams/ /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo la ni thim/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las lha bskyed ⑧pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // de nas nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu rnams kyis (9) phyag na rdo rje kyil phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ci yi phyir na bdag cag rnams/ /'od zer gyis ni 'tshal te mchis/ /bcom ldan bdag la bshad du gsol/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen 47pos rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs sde ma la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nor rgyas la sogs bdag nyid che/ /klu rnams ci (rtephyir dgug 4)pa lags/ /rnal 'byor chen po bdag la gsungs/ /de nas sna tshogs sde ma'i snying gi 'od zer gyis klu thams cad kyi snying ga (stedang spyi bo'i (nyemathar thug par zhugs te/ tshim par byas nas slar log go/ /de nas klu de ⑩rnams thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal the te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha mo bka' ni ci zhig gsol/ /kyitsho lags ji lta bu zhig tu)bgyi/ /gsungs pa/ mu stegs la sogs mkha' lding sngags/ /ye shes las byung ji lta bu/ /dus su zin 80wa 451

pa ji ltar yin/ /ji ltar dug ni skye bar 'gyur/ /sbrul gyis zin pa tsam gyis ni / /slar yang sems can 'chi 'gyur zhing / /zhus pa/ khyab 'jug dbang phyug sogs lha dang / /tshangs pa tshangs pa mdun lan 'don/ /de rnams la ni 'chi 'pho mchis/ /dug gi (gyinyes pas gnod par 'gyur/ /de ltar dus su zin ces smra / /0sbrul gyi dug ni sel ba med/ /de bzhin sbrul la dug ni yod/ /sbrul zin 'tsho 'am mi 'tsho ba/ /bde byed la sogs rdzu 'phrul che'i/ /lha de rnams ni de ltar smra/ /ston dzo pa stong nyid nges gsung ba⑥/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang bas gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la/ /sbrul gyi dug ni ji ltar yod ri/ /gang gis 'dzin cing gang zhig 'dzin/ /dus dang dus min ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar spyod cing ji ltar 6)bsdu/ /gang phyir 'dzin cing gang du 'dzin / /sems can dug 9nozin mi 'chi ba/ /stong nyid smra ba'i nges pa yin/ /'dod chags gti mug stong pa nyid/ /grags chen yul ni stong pa nyid/ /yul gyi rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dri ma dang bral ji ltar dug /sbrul gyis kyang ni ci zhig byed/ /tha mal pa yi yul ni sbrul/ /yul gyi yinyes pa dug nyid do/ /lha rnams yul rnams kyis ni bsgribs/ /thams cad dus su zin pa yin/ /yul gyi nyes pa sbyangs pa nyid/ /ston pa longs spyod gos mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'dod kun nye bar longs spyod bya/ /ri skegs sbyor ba rnyed dka' dang / /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ldan pas/ /'dir ni klu rnams thams cad lhags11/ /de phyir rab nges lha mo kye(snye/ /dus zin the tshom med pa ru/ /blo med mu stegs can de smra/ /'di ltar smras te klu rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs sde la phyag 'tshal 12te/ /rang rang gi ni gnas su dong / /de nas 80—452

bcom ldan 'das mas yul gyi nyes pa spong ba'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rta6)/ stong dang stong min mtha' dag bcas/ /sgyu ma ②mi lam lta bur gcigal /'jig rten mtha' dag brdzun gyis bcings④ / / kye lags bshas ⑤mo 'di ltar ltos/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen pos bcom 4)ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ri skegs sbyor ba rnyed dka' ba/ /lha mo yis (7ni bshad du gsol / /sems can don la gcig tu 'bad/ /de ru bdag la ltad mo mchis /gsungs pa/ dkyil 'khor med par sbyin mi bya/ /slob ma bsdu bar mi bya'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar gsungs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor las ni smra bar bya/ /mtho (8)lnga pa yi sa bzung ste/ /khor (9yug tu ni gru bzhi'o/ /de yi phyed kyi zlum po la/ /brgyad kyilas 'dam skyes 'dab ma brgyad/ /oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ11rtsu khaṃ hūm̐ a hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭha nyugeyod/ sa sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /badz+ra he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hri sasba hunyeduṣ+ṭa sa (lam ya mu dā pra r+bha 12dza ha hūm̐ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa sbyang ba'i dus su gtor ma gtang tshaba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sasba khye 9ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na (nyeyi dam sru tra tiṣ+ṭha mā tu tsa la he he bud+dha ka pā la badz+ra he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭha ṭha( — bye/sngags 'dis lan bdun du srad 21dbu la mngon par bsngags sa par bya'o/ /thig skud kyi sngags so/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldanam/ /kha khyer snam bu spangs pa la(snye/ /ba dan rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdulatshon gzhan dang 'dres med pa'i/ /rdul tshon ( stedamar por rdzogs par bya/ /de ru bum pa bzhi po rnams/ /grwa dang grwa ru rnam par bzhag /bum par mtshan ma bri bya ba/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /80wa 453

gri gug dang ni cang te'u dang / /cang te'u gnas su rdo rje bri/ /rdo rje'i steng du 'dam skyes te/ /de ltar bum par bri ①byas nas/ /chu yis yongs su dgang ⑧bar bya/ /bum pa la ni ras kyis brgyan/ /rin chen rnam pa lnga gzhug cing / /bum par kun nas 'bru lnga dang / /a mra'i lcug mas dgab par bya/ /de nas 'o ma'i snod bzhag ste(mi/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo chen gyis/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma ste/ /nyi ma'i steng du rtsu yig bsam/ /hūṃ gyur pa las rdo rje ni/ /sngon po tsū gi bdag nyid skyes/ /hūm̐ dang rdo rje byung dpa' bo/ /he ru ka ni bdag nyid che/ /sku mdog sngon po phyag bzhi pa/ /gtso bo chen po zhal gcig pa/ /g.yas na gri gug thod pa ste/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje'o / /sku la mi yi (༄rus pas brgyan/ /klu rnams skrag par byed pa po/ / skyil krung ⑤byed pa'i gar gyis 6)bzhugs/ /gcer bu 'jigs byed rang bzhin te / /zhal gyi mche ba cung (7zad gtsigs/ /dbu skra ser zhing gyen du 'bar/ /thod pas spyi bo brgyan byas pa(8)/ /sa 'og bdun ni 'khrug par byed/ /dpa' bo de ltar bsam par bya/ /phyis ni phyogs kyi 'dab po)ma la/ /oṃ dang rtsu dang khaṃ dang swa/ /yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnam pa bzhi/ /sna tshogs sde ma 'dod can ma/ /sa 'og gnas ma rab bzang ma/ /lha mo de dag mdog sngon mo/ /grags chen zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bzhugs/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zha )zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /g.yas na gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u/ /rus rgyan yonyalha mo kun 'jigs ma/ /zhal gyi yo mche ba cung zad gtsigs/ /stag gi pags (nyapa'i na bza' mnabasang)/ /skra ni ser po gyen du 'bar/ /thod pa'i phreng bas spyi bor ski80wa 454

brgyan / /de rnams mgo rgyus phreng ba can/ /lha mo'i 'od zer spros gyur pas①/ /klu rnams skrag ②par mdzad pa ②mo/ /phyogs kyi 'dab stibazhugs cher bzhad ma'o / /blo ldan mtshams kyi 'dab (snyebazang la/ /nyi ma bzhi la hūm̐ yig bzhi/ /hūm̐ yig so sor gyur pa las/ /chang 'tshong ma dang 'byung po ma/ /bzhin bzang ⑥nam mkhar 'gro ma ste/ /mtshams kyi 'dab (7)mar gnas lha mo/ /kha dog ser mo grags chen mo/ /thams cad na bza' ser po mnabs5kyi/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis 6)gnas/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /klu brgyad rgyan 0byas lha mo ni/ /g.yas na gri gug cang te'u 'dzin/ /g.yon na kha ṭī thod pa'o/ /sku las 'od zer ser po 'phro/ /shin tu sgeg /nyepa'i nyams dang ldan/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs tu pa'i zhal/ /thams cad gar byed skra ser ma/ /klu rnams skrag par ⑩skyed byed ma/ /mtshams kyi cha ru rnam par gnas/ /de nas bsam par bya ba ni/ /slob dpon he ru gas rang gi lus las skyes pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang dag par reg par byas nas slar log ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang dag par reg pa'i 'od zer las lha mo'i tshogs yang dag par spros pas he ru ka dang rnal 'byor brgyad lhan cig tu bkrus so/ /bkrus pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams cod pan du gyur to/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par mthong nas ni/ /slob dpon bdag nyid chen po yis/ /phyis ni gtor ma gtang skobar bya/ /khyad par du ni 'o ma'o//sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ldan pa'i/ /shes rab can gyis chang btung zhing / /mar me bzhi yini dbul bar bya/ /'bras bu bzhi yang dbul bya zhing / /de nas slob ma blo chen gyis/ /rasazung yigasum ni dbul bar bya/ /der ni gdan 80wa 455

yang bstabs 0)par bya/ /slob dpon bdag nyid chen po yis/ /de ru rnal 'byor ma mchod do/ /blo gros chen po thugs dgyes pas/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs skom/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshim bya/ /mgu bar sems pa'i yid kyis ni/ /'khor lo khyad ②par che bya ste/ /phyis ni slob dpon brtse chen bdag /phyi rol sa ru byung nas ni/ /bde ba yi ni gdan bzhugs te/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal gsum byas la/ / bla ma me tog sna tshogs mchod/ /①zhabs la spyis ligatugs 'di skad gsol/ /ston pa bcom ldan bla ma kye(nya/ /sems can don la gcig brtson pa/ /nam mkha' lding bzang sbyor ba dang / sha ri ka yi sbyor ba 'tshal/ /dus su zin pa bzlog pa yin(6)/ /sems can don ni bzang po 'tshal sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas(7)/ /ston pa chen pos de dag gsungs/ /bdag gi the tshom 58)bzlog pa dang / /sems can don ni mthar thug bgyi/ /brtan pa dang ni rgyu ba dang / /yan lag skyes dang bcos ma yi/ /dug rnams dug med par bgyi zhing / /sems can thams cad 'tsho bgyi ba/ /bla ma chen po de dag gsungs / /de nas slob dpon brtse ba yis/ /byin gyis brlab kyi)pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /khrag 'thung 7go 'phang gnas pa yi/ /slob ma la ni so shing sbyin/ /so shing sngags ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ hūm̐ he bha ga ba ti mu khaṃ pa ri shurje ku ru swā hā/lan bdun mngon par bsngags (11)byas la/ /so brud nas ni kha bshal te/ /slob ma lhag par gnas par bya/ /rang gi lag pa byug bya zhing / /me tog gis kyang dkri /shebar bya/ /mgrin pa lag par zla ba bsam/ /zla ba'i zer gyis dzi phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas spyan drangs gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kun zla bar blta'/ /grags chen thams cad rab zhugs shing / /zla ba zhu bar gdon mi 80—456

za / /slob dpon bsgoms hu)pa'i nus pa yis/ /slob ma'i mgo ru lag bzhag ste / /lhag par gnas pa'i gsang sngags bzlas/ /oṃ sarba (kyebud+dha a tra a mu ka su kā ⑧ya ma dhiṣ+ṭha na④/ yan+tu ma tsa la ma tsa la (getiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ha ra ha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ dha ra yidha ra/ tra ba tra ba bho bha ga lān+ta sab (7)budha ka pā li badz+ra su (nyaka tai ma la ya shī s+t+waṃ khyaku ru ku ru rtsu rtsu ha ha/ sngags 'dis lan bdun du bzlas pas lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyis de'i lus la yang dag par byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /lhag par gnas pa tsam gyis rdzu 'phrul chen po'i klu rnams skrag cing dug gi bum pa yang ⑩'dor ro/ /nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu stobs po che rnams dpyod par 'gyur ro/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ /lhag ⑩par gnas pa tsam gyis ni/ /'di lta'i sdug bsngal thob 'gyur na/ /mkha' lding rtogs 8pa'i sems can gyis/ /bdag ni ji ltar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ma thag tu slob dpon gyis/ /dkyil 'khor nang du me tog ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dbul bar bya/ /sna tshogs spos dang lha bshos dbul / /dung chos zangs chos snod dag ni/ /mañji'i 8steng du gzhag par bya8/ /mchod yon gyi 8ni don ched du/ /bum pa rnams la lhag gnas bya/ /khrag 'thung go 'phang leganas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad bskor ba yi(me/ /khrag 'thung yinyernam par lho)spyan drangs te/ /dkyil 'khor ji bzhin yang dag ldan/ /mdog dang mtshan mar ldan pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams sa bon gyi/ /'od zer gyis zhu )ni rnam par bsam/ /bdag nyid chen po grags chen po/ /bum pa ru ni zhugs tsam gyis/ /dmatshig dkyil 'khor zhu bar 'gyur( lha/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i sems dang ni/ /slob dpon gyis ni 'di ltar blta/ /de nas 80—457

zangs ma'i snod du chu blugs shing dung phor chus bkang ste/ mkhyi'i ①steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /yang phyir byung nas slob ma'i don du bdag nyid kyis ras kyis ⑧mig dgab par bya'o/ /ras gsum gon par gyur pa'i slob ma phyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgor bzhag la chus gtor te sngags bzla'o/ /a bhi ṣiñcan+tu nirmā sarba yo gi ni ma ku to a tra a tiṣ+ṭha yan+tu/ a tsan+tu dus swā hā/ cod 0pan byin gyis brlab (7pa'i sngags so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis kye 7khyod su zhes smra'o/ /slob mas bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras zhes 2smra'o/ /de'i rjes su skyudakyil 'khor gyi dbus su me tog lan gsum du gtor la/ mig ras bsal te/ dkyil 'khor mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ he ru ka badz+ra put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha 0rtsu/ dbus su'o⑩/ /oṃ tsi tra se nā put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha 'artsu/ shar du'o/ /oṃ kā mi tso'i put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha 8rgyu/lho'i'o⑩la/ /oṃ pā tā ⑩la bā si ni put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha 0rtsu/ nub tu'otunye/ /oṃ su bha dre put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hu)rtsu/ byang du'o/ /oṃ shoṇ+ḍi du ni put+pa yaṃ pra tīts+tsha 0rgyu/ mer ro / /oṃ burnyi ni sa)put+pa (1pra tīts+tsha zho ste// bden bral du'o/ /oṃ tsa tu ra bha dra tsoput+pa zhugapra tīts+tsha ( 7rgyu/ rlung ngo 8rte/ /oṃ ā kā sha bā 66si ni put+pa ru pra tīts+tsha (1rgyu/dbang ldan du'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sku mdog ji lta ba (snyedang /mtshan ma la sogs pa de bzhin du slob ma la bstan par bya'o/ /yang dung phor blangs te chu btung bar bya'o/ /de 'thungs 6)pa tsam gyis klu thams cad skrag cing skyo bas dug skyugs 8 7par 'gyur ro/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i (nyedug gang yin pa dang / gzhan yang sbyar ba dang / nye bar sbyar ba'i dug gang yin pa dang / mda' dug dang / byug pa'i dug dang / dgra rnams kyis gang sbyar (nyab dang / bud med rnams kyis gang sbyar ba'i dug de rnams nye bar 'pho bar 80wa 458

'gyur ro/ /gal te klu yis zin pa yang / /de ru de ni nges par 'gro/ /gzhan yang sbrul gyi dug kyang rung / /chu ni 'thungs ①pa tsam gyis kyang / /de dag thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ / de yi ②phyir na dug ①gi chu/ /'di ru btung bar the tshom med/ /de nas slob ma dri ④bar bya/ /'dir ni sha li kur byed cing / /mkha' lding shes pa'i slob dpon 'gyur/ /bsam pa rnam par dag shes nas/ /phyis ni bkas (5)gnang sbyin par bya/ /stong ngam brgya ru gsol ba gdab/ /de nas sngags kyi man ngag sbyin/ /ji srid sbrul gyis zin dus dang ne/ /ji srid mkha' lding rigs yod par/ /de srid de dang de las kyang / /ji srid dus su zin med par/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de srid 'bad rtsol bya ba min/ /dus zin 'chi ba'ang shes bya ste/ /nam mkha' lding gi bya ba bya/ /dus su zin no zhes smra ba(ye/ /de srid rnal 'byor che 'di yisargyal/ /de ru las ni brtsam par bya/ /bdag nyid he ru kur gyur cing / /rnal 'byor ma brgyad yang dag ldan/ /blo ldan sngon gsungs (shegasang sngags kyis//phyis ni gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /der (9)rjes dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gnas dgu ru ni mchod par bya/ /mkhas pa yis ni mchod byas rjes/ /mnyam par bzhag pas tu )las rnams brtsam4nya/ /gang du rdzu 'phral che klu yod(ge/ /de ru sems bzang 'od zer spro/ /klu tu rnams kyi ni snying ma~Xs pasali/ /ci zhig bgyi'o zhes ni smra/ /gsungs pa/ lha mo sna tshogs sde ma yis/ /sangs rgyas thod par sngon du sasungs/ /kye kye grags pa che ba'i klu/ /song ste 'dir 7dus zin gyur pa'i/ /dus zin 'dzin pa bzung ba med / /dug med sbrul yang med pa'o/ /gang phyir dogs pas rmongs gyur pa/ /80wa 459

de phyir skye bo rnams 'chir 'gyur/ /de nas 'od zer slar log ste/ /snying ga 6)ru ni thim par 'gyur/ /yang ni (misems ni mnyam gzhag pa'i/ /slob dpon gyis ②ni ngo mtshar bstan/ /de nas sa la ma lhung ba'irtsi/ /lci ba blangs te 'dab (9chags ri skegs gnyis bya zhing snod dkar po byas te/ ro bsregs pa'i sol ba la yigazhag par bya'o/ /ro bsregs pa'i sol ba las ⑦snag tsha byas te/sems can gyi don rig (8dpas dben par sngags bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ budha ka pā li ni hri taṣ+ṭha yonyeb ya bho sha li ka na a na ya nā bud+dha ka pā la badz+ra 7su ā dz+nyā ma lo gha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ran+tu sarba (med ḍi ka (1pha ti ka tse te/ man+dha (nyesnyi di sasba 'dzi i na su narnyi ba 62ya ga re re kur ko ṭa ka pra dhī (nyata ya nā tu)ga rā dza tson spu tarnyi murda na re re sa spya4) / a ba sa spya ( )ma tsa la ha ma bu la ha dza i tsa la ha bu la ha re 0re bha ru kri pra snri rten ya nā ༷ srig rā dza na u ha pu ṭa phyoṭa mu dhi pra na dza i zhes pa ni sha li ku'i snying po'i sngags so/ /de nas blo chen rnal 'byor pas/ /sems ni shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /yongs rdzogs sha li ka byas tsol/ /pho dang mo ru brtag par bya/ /snag tsha yis ni bri bar bya/ /mig gi sngon du mi gzhag cing / /sha li ka bzang pos 29phyogs blta/ /de nas lcug ma sngags kyis bsngags te/ /oṃ haṃ ha la khyab 'jug gi sa bon no/ /oṃ baṃ zhi tshangs pa'i sa bon no/ /oṃ saṃ zhes pa ()ni zhi byed kyi sa bon no/ /oṃ ha ha ha ha ha ha haṃ swā hāzhi )/ mngag 6nyapa'i sngags so/ /'di lta bu yi sngags kyi mchog /stong gsum na yang rnyed par dka'/ /lan bdun bsngags gepa tsam gyis ni/ /'gro bar 'dir sa ni the tshom med/ /klu rnams skrag par byed pa yi/ /mkha' lding nyams dga' song nas ni/ /klu yi gnas su zhugs de'i tshe/ /mkha' lding bye ba'i stobs dang ldan/ /rings nas 80wa 460
