kyang ni gshog 6)rlung gis/ /stobs po che yi klu rnams skrag /mtho ris mi yul sa 'og dang / /gang yang gzhan na gnas pa dang / /gzhan yang rung ste (kyede thams cad/ /skrag nas ci bgyi zhes ni smra/ /klu gang gis zin pa de gal te yang shi na/ bdag nyid chen po sha li ka mthong ma thag long bar 'gyur ro/ /klu dang sbrul de dag gis sha li (mika la 'di skad rgyagasol to/ /kyai (5)sha li ka gzhan du gsung bar ma mdzad cig /de ltar thos nas sha li ka mgu ba'i sems kyis dug gis zin pa'i mdun du sbrul long ba khyer te 'jog go/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bltas ༅te/ sa'i (7)gong bu blangs la sha li ka mngag (8)pa'i sngags kyis sbrul long ba la bsnun na6)/ /skad cig de nyid la de'i mig 'bye 1 ribar 'dir som nyi 11med do / / dus su zin pa 'byel tu te shi ba sbrul gyis mthong nas de'i lus la 'gro ba dang 'ong tibar byed pas dus su zin pa dug med par 'gyur zhing / dga' ba'i sems kyis ldang ngo / /zin pa langs pa tsam nyid na sha li kus sprul bzung skiste mi snang bar 'gyur 8ro/ /skad 9cig ma de nyid la slob dpon gyis stong pa nyid kyi ye shes bsgom tunyepar bya'o/ /stong pa dri med kun rang bzhin/ /chos rnams stong pa'i rang bzhin kyeyin/ /gang gis 'dzin cing gang zhig 'dzin/ /mtha' dag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin kye(/dze+e/ /dngos po ma lus pa ri tsamatha' dag dang dug kyang stong pa nyid du sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las gsungs te/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthar thug par ji srid du lus ma zhig pa de srid du slob dpon gyis yang dag par brtsam par bya'o(ge/ /de ltar slob ma la rjes su gnang ba na byin nas phyis lung bstan par bya'o/ /des lan brgya'am stong du gsol ba btab nas/dug 'joms pa'i sngags bstan par bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni a 2ju/ dug 80wa 461

bza' ba'i sngags so/ /de nas gzhan yang don du gnyer ba'i sems can de ①rnams thams cad la dkyil 'khor bstan te/ dung phor gyi chu 'thungs pa des na ②dug med par 'gyur te/ sbrul gyis mi 'dzin no/ /gal te 'dzin na de'i tshe klu 'chi bar 'dir the tshom med do①/ /de ltar slob ma sha li ma'i sbyor ba la mngon par brtson pa la bkas ④gnang ba byin te/ grong gang du gnas pa ⑤der dug gis 6)'dzin pa med do/ /gal te yod na de'i tshe ⑨klu 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar thos nas slob ma rdo rje'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gang ci yang ⑧rung ba'i yon der dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi sar byung ste gtor ma gtang ponyebar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyis gshegs su gsol tekyi/ oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni hrīḥ.u tiṣ+ṭha yigats+tsha hūm̐ gats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya / /chu yi yogesbyor ba bla med pa/ /gang gis byin 8pa tsam gyis ni/ /dug gis zin pa 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma bdun na ⑩'chi ba dang / /gzhan yang dug gis nyams pa rnams/ /chu ni byin pa tsam gyis ni/ /'di ru 'byu bar the tshom med / /sngags 'dis dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /gnas dgu rnams su mchod par bya/ /dung phor chu yis bkang byas pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gzhag par bya/ /de nas brtse ba chen po yi/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /rang gi lag pa g.yon pa la/ /zla ba yi ni khyad par bsam/ /bcu drug cha las yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /dri med dge ba'i lus can te/ /de'i dbus sa bon mi shigs dge /kha dog dkar po'i lus can no/ /lag des snod kyi kha bcad de/ /de nas gsang sngags bzla bar bya/ /oṃ sab 'bi ṣa ⑩ha ra ha ra rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa 80—462

swā hā/ sngags 'dis lan bdun gyi bar du 0)mngon par bsngags ②te/ mi shigs pa dang lhan cig zla ba zhu bar gyur nas chu'i nang du thim ste/ chu dang zla ba gcig tu 'dres pas shin tu dkar por 'gyur ro/ /gal te dug gis zin pa ma shi na de'i tshe chu blud do/ /yang na shi ba yin na mgo nas rkang pa'i mthar thug par lan gsum nigasum du chu rgyun mi 'chad ④par blugs na langs par 'dir the tshom med do/ /de nas chu blud na rnal mar ⑤'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las sha li ku'i sbyor ba dang / chu'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i 6)bcud len le'u/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mchog /rnal 'byor ma yi gong na med/ /gzhon nu ma dang sha ri ka /grub ma byis ⑦pa can ma dang / /de bzhin thod bzangs (kyecan ma'o/ /'di dag sman ni chen po lnga/ /sangs rgyas lngas 6)kyang rnyed par dka' / /'di dag zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /bskal pa bye bar de 'tsho'o⑩/ /gzhon nu ma ni zla drug tu/ /de bzhin sha ri ka zla gsum/ /grub ma zla ba gcig tu'o / /byis can ma ni zla phyed gnyis/ /thod pa can yang zla bar te/ /tshe 'phel ba yi mchog yin no/ /bya rog ma ni bya rog gzugs/ /glang po ma ni ngang pa'i gzugs/ /drod ma drod kyi gzugs can te/ /sngo bsangs dkar mo sngon mo'i mig /kha sbyar sbyor ba'i dus su ni/ /mig las byung ba'i rdzas gang yin / /sman de'i ming ni gzhon nu ma/ /'di ru bstan par som nyi med/ /de yi pad+ma las byung rdzas/ /rtsayinang na rnam par gnas/ /ge sar sbas pa'i spyod 80—463

yul te/ /sman ni 0)sha ri ka ru gsungs/ /me tog ldan pa'i bu mo ②gang / /kha dog nag mos rab mdzes ma/ /gang du thabs shes gnyis 'dus pa/ /de yi kha sbyar ⑧sbyor las byung / /sman de'i ming ni grub mar bshad/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bud med stirab mdzes ma nyams dang / /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mi phyed nye bar spyad pa yi/ /de las (snyedang por byung ba'i rdzas / /sman de byis pa can no zhes/ /bdag nyid chen po'i lha mos gsungs/ /lhan cig skyes dag byung ba'i rdzas/ /(nyamachog chen mar khu ⑦dag dang ni/ /bsre 'gyur 'dir 58)ni the tshom med/ /sman de'i ming ni thod can mo'oponye/ /zla ba nyi ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /bya bar 'dir ni the tshom med/ /zla bas zla bar nyi mas nyir / /de lus skra dkar gnyer ma zhi/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /de yi tshe ni rgyas par kyi 'gyur/ /sman 'di grub pa tsam gyis ni/ /dag pa'i lus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dngos po gang dang gang yang rung / /lcags dang zangs ma'i snod dag la/ /dngul ni byugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngul dang gser du 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dgongs bshad shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /rgyud gzhan du ni rab sbas pa/ /'bad pas de 'dir rab gsal bya/ /dri chu ye shes rdo rje ste/ /dri chen rdo rje bzang po nyid/ /khrag ni mar me rdo rje yin/ /khu ba rdo rje'i thabs byung nyid/ /sha ni chos kyi rdo rje yin / /de lnga rnal 'byor ma yi mchog /gang gi dam tshig rnyed dka' ba'i/ /thabs 'dir bdag gis bshad par bya/ /ba lang sha ni 'bar ba ste/ /khyi yi sha la spro bar gsungs/ /rta yi sha la bza' bar bshad/ /glang po'i sha la zhu bar gsungs / /sha chen la ni bzang por bshad/ /de lnga 31rnal 'byor mchog tu 80wa 464

gsungs / / rnal 'byor 1)rnal 'byor ma (mildan par/ /gal te gcig tu byed nus pa/ /de tshe rnam rtog de thams cad/ /'jig 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med//zan la bsod nams zhes bya ste/ /tshod ma la ni sdig pa nyid/ / ro la ②shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs/ /byis pa la ni 'gal ba nyid/ /g.yung gi)mo la ni bzang mor gsungs/ /rus pa'i phreng la rdzas zhes bya/ /skyes bu la ni rdo rjer gsungs//bud med la ni snod bzang nyid/ /dbang po gnyis kyi rab sbyor la/ /gzi brjid phreng chen de bshad do/ /rab chags shin tu mthong ba nyid/ /'khyud pa la ni chos zhes brjod/ /'dri ba la ni mar me'o/ /shin tu 'dri 95)la me zhes bya/ /'gro ba la ni phreng can ma/ /'ong la 6)shin tu phreng can ma/ /myur ba la 7)ni byug ces bya/ /dpa' ba la ni bzang de brjod/ /pad+ma rtse 'jo phreng can ma/ /sngags kyis mtshan ma 98)rab nges zhe'o/ /ljags 9dīl lce nya tsho'og ces bya ste/ /so la bza' ba sna la bde/ /mig la rol rtsed mu tig rna11/ /gsang ba'i yul la rnyed dka' zhe'o/ /'di dag bshad do lag chen po/ /'jig rten gsum na rab rnyed dka'/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /med par phan tshun smra mi bya / /'on kyang bshad chen de nyid 'di/ /gcig la gcig gis 12smra bar bya/ /rgyud rnams thams cad du sbas pa/ /rgyud 'di ru ni gsal bar byasatsho / /nye 'dun grong mtha' lhan cig zhe'o/ /'dus pa phyi rol zhes su gsungs/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa nang de bzhin/ /gnas la 'bras bu zhes su gsungs/ /nye ba'i gnas la shing nyid do/ /grong mtha' la ni sa bon gsungs/ /nye ba'i grong mtha' myu gu'o/ /tshogs pa la ni sdong bur gsungs/ /gcig pu la ni 'dab k+ṣam ste/ /stong pa la ni rtsa bzhi'om/ /de ltar dgongs pas bshad pa ni/ /bde tso80wa 465

gshegs rnams kyis mi mkhyen no/ /spyan ma la sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /rnams kyis ②khong du mi ()chud cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i ②yul min zhing / /bla ma gus pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /spros pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rdzas la chags par ④mi bya'o/ /shin tu stong sgom rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang phrag dog med/ /gti mug dang ni nga rgyal spangs/ /nyon mongs thams cad rnam par spangs/ /za 6)'thung de bzhin glu len na/ /shin tu spros pa spang ⑥bar bya / /bde bas dga' ba nyid dang ni/ /shes rab thabs ⑦kyis bdag nyid gsungs / /bla med de nyid zla phyed kyis/ /'grub par the tshom med pa'o/ /kye ⑧lags grogs mo 'gro kun gang / /mtha' dag dri ma med pa yi/ /blta dang bral la skye bo ltos/ /gsog gsob rang bzhin brdzun bslu ⑨ba/ /pad rtsa'i 0grib ma lta bur ltos/ /dbang po lnga ni sgyu 'dra zhing / /lnga phung dag pa'i rang bzhin gyis(te / /rnal 'byor 'di ni bsgoms pas 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud ⑫rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba zhes bya ba las sman bzang po dang / dgongs pa tibashad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa mchog gsang bar / /thabs dang shes rab sgrub pa yis8/ /gang 8gis slob ma dbang bskur ⑩ba / /shes rab pad+ma'i nang dbus su/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ / sum brtsegs yi tshodag pa'i bdag nyid lus/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa / /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus gnas par/ /mkhas pas slob ma bzang dbang tsobaskur(1 / /gal te byang chub bla med 'dod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bya ba min/ /80—466

lha rnams bshig ①pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa chen po skye bar 'gyur/ /des (min rdul tshon tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin lha rnams dag mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /de bzhin pad+ma ral gri nyid/ /byas nas slar yang 'jig byed pa / /skyes bu tha shal dmyal bar 'gro/ /gang gis sangs rgyas spyan drangs shing //gang gis gshegs su gsol ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' byon pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa rnams/ /gang na'ang byon pa ma yin no/ /dri ma med cing dag pa'i lus/ /gang gis spyan drangs gshegs su gsol/ /de nyid kyis na brtag ①med par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phyag bya/ /lo bcu gnyis pa'i bu mo ni/ /tshul khrims ma nyams chags chung ba'i/ /thos dang ldan zhing grags chen mo/ /nad med snying rje dang ldan ma/ /sems can don la gcig nan tan/ /dgod ④cing pad+ma'i spyan dang ldan/ /zla ba'i cha 'dra gdong mdzes ma / /mu cor mi smra brtan zhing dul/ /des na slob ma blo chen po/ /shin tu dad pa'i sems dang ldan/ /'dod med dbang po dul ba dang / /chags dang chags bral rnam par spangs/ /sems can don la shin tu sbyor/ /gti mug zhe sdang phrag dog spangs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /de rnams la ni de nyid bshad/ /gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni/ /bdun dang bcu bzhir bshad pa dang / / gnyi ga (5)gcig tu 'dus pa'o6)/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bshad par bya / /slob ma legs dang ldan pa dang / /brtse ldan sems gzhan med ⑦pa yis/ /gser ni 'bum phrag bcu drug dang / /sa gzhi (8)yul 'khor ldan pa dang / /glang po bud med dam pa dang / /ral gri 'khor lo rta dang ni/ /yongs 'dren skyes bu rin chen rnams/ /sbyoradang ldan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /der ni bla ma 80wa 467

dbul bar bya/ /shin tu dri med sems kyis ni/ /de nas 'dir ni gsol ba gdabasti / /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba ②bdag /dpung gnyen khyod kyis bsgral du gsol/ /bdag ni rtsol chung skal dman zhing / /sangs rgyas chos ni rnam par spangs/ /kye kye ston pa bla ma che/ /mgon po khyod ②kyis brtse bar mdzed / /de ltar gsol 'debs tshig gsan nas/ /de ru bla ma mi gsungs rjobazhugs / /man ngag 'di yi cha dag ni/ /glegs bam rnams las spyod yul minazhi) / / bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /(nyadakyil 'khor gang la gang gis brgyan / /mtshan ma'i don gzhan gar bkod kye/ /su yis sangs rgyas spyan drangs kye/ /'gro ba brdzun (7)'dra'i som nyir lhung (kye/ /mtha' dag stong pa gos med kye/ /chu nang zla ba ci 6)'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor pad dbus gnas / /kye lags khornal 'byor ma tshogs ltos/ /der ni he ru ka gcig dang / /thams cad skyed ((1par byed pa 7yin/ /'gro kun rmi lam bslu lho bas na/ /gti mug las ni bskyed pa ltosayi/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri ba dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /ri dang phug dang tshang tshing ngam yang na dur khrod dag na 7ni/ /gdod nas grub ⑩pa'i gnas su 'am/ /'on te rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag tu/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bla med bri/ /rdul tshon ()sngon po ni ro bsregs nyi pa'i sol ba las bya'o/ /rdul tshon (17dmar po ni dur khrod kyi so phag las bya'o/ /rdul tshon ( 7ljang khu ( nyani nim pa'i 'dab ma las bya'o/ /rdul 80—468

tshon ①dkar po ni mi'i rus pa'i phye ma las bya'o/ /rdul tshon (snyeser po ni yung ba'i phye ma las bya'o/ /de ltar rdul tshon 95)lnga rnams kyis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /pho brang rigs gsum zlum po la/ /rdo rje gsum gyis yongs su bskor/ /phyi rol gru bzhi lham pa yi/ /sgo bzhir rta babs rnams (9kyis brgyanadu / /ba dan rnam pa bzhi yis brgyan/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /phyi rol kha khyer dag pa dang / /rin chen pha gur yang dag ldan/ /pad+ma nyi ma 6)nyi shu lnga'i/ /gdan rnams kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ / de yi (7skudabus chud sa bon ni / /yi ①ge hūm̐ gi rang bzhin sngo/ /skad cig (9)tsam gyis he ru ka /sku mdog sngon po grags chen po/ /g.yas na cang te'u gri gug ste/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa'ol/ / skyil krung yiphyed pas 'jigs chen po/ /zhal gyi zhunyamache ba cung zad gtsigs / /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan cing / /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can / /dbu la sna tshogs rdo rje mnan/ /zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa'i lha/ /sku la thal ba'i rdul gyis byugs/ / dpa' bo /gephyag bzhi phyag mtshan 'chang / /shin tu hūm̐ sgrogs 8'jigs byed pa/ /gar gyi stabs kyis rnam par bzhugs/ /mgo bo rlon pa'i 7phreng ba can/ /mchod phyir thod mapa 'chang ba po/ /thod pa gti mug rnam dag pa/ /phreng ba brgyud 4pas brgyan pa'i lha/ / mgul do tu 1dang ni 'khor lo dang / /rkang gdub yishedang ni dpung rgyan /gedang / /gdu ( )bu rked ( nyapa'i ska rags dang / /dpa' bo rna cha mchog gis brgyan/ /'di 'dra'i gzugs can gtso bo ni/ /hūm̐ zhes zlos par byed pa'o/ /de las 8shebyung ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid rnams/ /sku mdog sngon mo grags chen mo/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma/ /zhal gcig du nyephyag gnyis 80wa 469

thod pa 'chang / /so so yi ni ming ji bzhin/ /de rnams ming ni rab tu bshad/phreng bzang 6)ma/ 'dod can ma/ 'jigs ma/ thub dka' ma/ dge ba'i ska rags can ma/ gzugs can ma/ rnam rgyal ma/ 'byung gnas ma/ thod can ma/ mtsho ②chen ma/ byed ma/ gsod ma/ sgrol ma/ 'jigs ma/mthong ma/ mi pham ①ma/ dge ma/ 'dzur dubyed ma/ dus mtshan phyim/grags chen ma/ mdzes sdug ma/ nor 'dzin ma/ skal bzang ma/ grags mthong ma'o/ /'di lta bu yi 6)dkyil 'khor mchog /kha dog rnam pa lnga yis brgyan / / de yi (7dbus gnas ⑧lha mo ni/ /he ru ka la bde ster ma/ / skyil krung (9)phyed pa'i gar byed ma / /mi yi rus pa'i phreng bas 0brgyan/ /lha mo 'od zer dpag dka' zhing / /skra ser gyen du 'bar ba ste/ /hūm̐ gi bdag nyid las skyes 'jigs/ /zhal nas khrag ni 'thor 8byed ma/ /dkar mo nag mo ljang khu ⑫ma / /thams cad khu ba ldan gyur ma/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid gsungs/ /bdag nyid he ru ka gzugs la/ ri /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lha mos mchod/ /thod pa bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba/ /he ru ka yis btung bar bya/ /de yis 'thungs pa tsam gyis ni/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bdag nyid che/ /gtso bo las gzhan tha dad gzugs/ /rnal 'byor ma kun de dang 'dra/ /de ltar he ru ka mgon pos/ /rnal 'byor ma kun spyad par bya/ /thams cad spyad pas zhu gyur te/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gnas/ /de ni zhu bar mthong nas ni/ /shin tu srid pa bsgrub 7pa'i phyir/ /sgo yi rnal 'byor ma yis bskul/ /ci ste 'jig rten snyan mnan na/ /ci phyir khyod ni mi dgyes gyur/ /gal te khyod bdag tshig gsan na/ /mi dgyes gyur pa mtha' dag thong ⑫/ /srid 'jigs skye 80—470

bo kun lhung bas/ /stong pa'i thugs ni ma mdzad par/ /nyid kyi 0)dgongs pa kun bsgrubs kyel/ /rnal 'byor ma yi grogs po bzhengs/ /gal te sngon gtso skyitshig gsan na/ /'bras bu yal bar ma dor cig /khyod mi snang na ④'gro ba yi/ /skye bo mtha' dag gdung bas non/ /log pa'i nga rgyal ma mdzad par/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin spangs nas ni/ /khyod kyis dngos med kun thong phyil/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ⑥tshogs la spyod/ /rnal 'byor ma ni bzhi po yis7/ /'di lta bu yi glu yis bskul/ /sngon bzhin mdog dang mtshan sogs ldan/ /kun nas rnal 'byor ma rnams bskor/ /'jigs pa 'khor ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /dpa' bo chen po 'di bzhengs so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las/ dkyil 'khor dang he ru ka bskyed pa dang sgom (nyapa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sbyin sreg 6)dkyil 'khor mchog bzang po / /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod de/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /shing gi sbyin sreg mi bya zhing / /'bras dang 'bru rnams kyis kyang min/ /blo ldan gal te zhi 'dod na/ /me tog gis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /me tog lnga po mchog chen dang / /'o mar yang dag ldan pas bya/ /gal te zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'dod/ /zhi ba'i gzugs sogs ldan pa yis/ /zhi ba'i thab khung gru bzhi pa/ /zabs 4 )dang rgyar ni mtho gang ba/ /kha la rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /dkar po rtse mo 'dus pa bri/ /rdorje rtse gsum sngon po ni/ /zhi ba hūm̐ bdag 'khor bar ni/ / deyi yi/dbus su 'khor lo la/ /gru gsum pa yi yi 80—471

shes brgyan/ /e baṃ ma yā 0)mchog chen gyi②/ /lte ba ru ni bskyed ②par gsungs / /rtse gsum 'jigs pa'i rdo rjes bskor/ /rdo rje'i nang du pad+ma ste/ /pad+ma'i dbus su nyi ma bsam/ /nyi ma'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ/ /kha dog dmar po'i 'od chen po/ /mtshams dang mtshams su rdo rje ni/ /rtse dgu ser po bri ④bar bya//bdag nyid he ru kur blta ste/ /phyis ni sbyin sreg yang dag brtsam/ /shes rab can gyis me yi lha/ /sngags 'di yis ni spyan drang ngo / /oṃ sasba de bā hu ta (5)pra dhe ni i bi kulbe (67su da ha da ha (7ne da ha da ha dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ ya tri kun+de a dhiṣ+ṭha ⑧ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭha (9)ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha7/ ki li ki li(lha/ ha he ho haṃ hraḥhriḥ/ rtsu swā hā/ me lha spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /shes rab can sngags lan bdun bzlas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 3 byin brlabs yishing / /mdog dkar du ba dang bral ba'i//me lha rgyal dbang byon nas kyang / /thab khung gi ni dbus su bzhugs/ /de nas blo ldan sbyin sreg bya/ /de ru sol ba gzhug 7bya ba/ /a shwat+tha yidang n+ya gro dang / /u dum bā 1 ra ra ka ti/ pa la sha ste shing lnga las/ sol byas du med 'bar ba'i me/ blo ldan thab khung dbus su gzhugayoste /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /pad+ma brgya ni rtsa brgyad dang / /de bzhin ut+pa la nyid dang / /ku mu da 17dmar dri zhim 'dra/ /ka ra bī khri )ra gzhan nyis 'gyur/ /byas te bsregs pas zhi bar gsungs/ /sbyin bdag mdun na 'dug pa la6ste/ /de tshe du ba dbab par bya/ /mkhas pas gsang sngags 'di bton ( stezhing / /pad+ma mar sbags da bsreg par bya/ /oṃ pad+ma rā tshodze asdi pra ṇi ( miya a mu ka su shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ mkhas pa yis ni sngags bzlas te/ /ut+pal 'o mas sbyin sreg bya/ /oṃ 80—472

gha gha bhā ②ta ya ghā ②ta ya te dzo rā (0dza bi nā ④ya shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ mkhas pa bde gshegs kun bdag gis/ /gur gum ku mu da (gesngags bsreg /oṃ su puthe su ka ra tsa le dz+wa la nī (6)ye shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /dri zhim tsan+dan sbyin sreg bya/ /oṃ dha me ma (7tā me rā dze da ha da ha sarba bisdi shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ ka ra bī 58)ra dri zhim mar/ /mkhas pas 6)sngags rgyal bzlas te bsreg /oṃ kā ⑩li su kā (stoli ka rā la rā tri sar+bha (nyehā paṃ da ha da ha shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ me tog re re re re la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po (nyelan re bzla / /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bla med cipa/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed par dka'/ /me ni 'o mas zhi bar bya8/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyas pa yi/ /sbyin sreg khyad par bshad par bya/ /rgyas la thab khung zlum po ste/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor ltar snang ba / /zabs dang rgyar ni mtho gsum ste/ /kha dog ser por rnam par bsam/ /de dbus rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /sngo bri de steng pad 'dab 0brgyad/ /bdag nyid he ru ka rnam pa/ /khro ba'i sems kyi the rdzobadag nyid kyis/ /shing bsreg pa yi sbyin sreg bya/ /gal te rgyas pa mchog 'dod na/ /a mra (3kar+sha pa la dang / /arga bil ba du du ra/ /shin /tshetu rnyed dka'i shing lnga las/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam du/ /slob dpon gyis ni gzung nalhabar bya/ /ma gas ma skams 2nam bcad cing / /bu ga can gyi ri steshing spang ngo / /de yi dbus su sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsam/ /re re la 9 )ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bgrangs te de nas sbyin sreg bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka yi tshul/ /sku mdog nag po 'od chen pos/ /mar dang yam shing thams cad ni/ /sngags bsregs 'dir ni the tshom med/ oṃ ga ga ni ga ga na bi lo ka ne 2nartsu phaṭa/ te dzo rā dzā genya80—473

puṣ+ṭa ku ru swā hā/ shing rnams kun gyi ①sngags 'di yis/ /re re bzhin du sbyin sreg bya/ /phyis ni ser po'i chus zhi bya/ /'di lta'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni②ske/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed par dka'/ /rgyud gzhan rnams su sbas pa ni / /rgyud 'di ru ni gsal bar byas/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg mchog /thab khung gru gsum dmar po la/ /zabs dang rgyar ni sor mo brgyad/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab nibargyad dmar/ /zla ba dmar la sogs pas brgyan/ /grwa grwa ru ni rdo rje dmar/ /bdag nyid he ru kur bsam pa/ /dmar po ltar snang chags pa'i bdag /rdo rje dmar po thod pa bsnams / /yongs su gang ba'i khrag nyid kyis/ /khams gsum pa la rjes su chags / /a sho ka yi yam shing dang / /go ro tsa ④nar ldan pa ni/ /blo ldan brgya rtsa brgyad bsregs te/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sngags ni gdon⑤/ /oṃ a sho ka ⑥ni su ra ke a nu rā ga ya tre+e lokya ⑦ba sho ka ⑧dri tre+e lo kyi bā shā mā na yā 6)hrī ⑩ga hā / nyin bdun sbyin sreg byas tsam gyis/ /khams gsum dbang du 'gyur ba yin / /chu ni dmar por 3)me zhi bya/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /mngon spyod dang ni gsad 62pa mchog /zla ba phyed pa'i cha 'dra'i thab/ /zabs dang rgyar ni khru gang tshad/ /'jigs chen mdog ni ljang khu'o(nye/ /grwa grwa ru ni rdo rje bri/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi 8stong pa ru/ /blo ldan sha lngas sbyin sreg bya/ /gsod pa yi ni sbyin sreg mchog /mngon spyod gsod pa ru ni gsungs/ /dgra kun bsnun 7cing zlog yipar byed/ /dgra bo thur 37du kha bltas shing / /kha nas khrag ni skyug pa nyid/ /sha yi dbus su bsam par bya/ /seng ldeng sol bas me bya ste/ /med na 'ba' 'bo la nyid kyi/ /'ba' 'bo tsher yi mas sha phug ste/ /80—474

brgya rtsa brgyad du sngags kyis bsreg /oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya tī la 6)ya tī la ②ya sab ①sha hūṃ nā dusha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag nyid he ru kur gyur cing / /sku mdog sngon po thugs 'khrugs pas/ /dgra rnams thams cad brlag ⑤par ni/ /skad cig de la the tshom med/ /phed mdzad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed/ /ha ha zhes mdzad 'jigs par mdzad/ /gdug pa thams cad gsod ⑥par ni/ /sbyin sreg tsam gyis the tshom med/ / 'di lta'i bsad ⑦pa'i sbyin sreg dang ske/ /mngon spyod kyang ni rnyed dka' ba/ /rnal 'byor lha mos rtogs min na//sngags skyes phal lta smos ci dgos/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thod pa yi/ /rnal 'byor nga rgyal dang bral bas/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems lha rnams kyis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /ljang khu'i duchu yis me zhi bya/ /gang gis bsregs shing gang zhig bsregs/ /gang gi zhi ba gang zhi ba/ /gang gis rnam rtog kun bcom pa/ /de yis sems ni mgu bar byed/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa 6)gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las sbyin sreg 0gi cho ga'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /spyod pa'i (1)le'u shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /bud med shin tu mchog gyur dang / /rnal 'byor gang gis spyod 8kun byed/ /dngos grub brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /denas spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ /sems can dngos grub gang gang 'dod/ /de de'i dngos grub rtag tu ster/ /lag pas thod pa gzung byas tenyusnye/ /gcer bu skra grol gyur pa yi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis yispyod pas 'khyam/ /gangadang lkugang tshe de tshe der/ /rtag tu 80wa 475

spyod pa thams cad bya/ /rgyan rnams kun las 6)rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang mtshungs gyur pa yi/ /shes rab can gyis khyim khyim du/ /slong ②mo bya bar the tshom med/ /yid dang mthun (mipa kun blangs na④/ /bsam gtan gnas su the tshom med/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bsams nas ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi slong mo blang (she/ /chos la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thod pa'i steng du gzhag pa yi/ /rdzas ni de nas bza' bar bya/ /rdzas ni zos ma thag tu yang / /khyim khyim thal phung shing drung dang / /gang du gang tshe der de'i tshe(nya/ /gang gis dga' ba'i sems de yis/ /blo gros chen po gnyid log phreng ⑦/ /'di lta'i spyod pa'i sbyor ba yis58)/ /phyag rgya chen po nges par thobapo)/ /de ltar yang kyirgyud las gsungs pa(lha/ /gang du ji ltar der de ltar/ /gang gis de yis sangs rgyas te/ /rang gi rnam rtog dag gis nyams/ /mtha' dag rang bzhin rnam par dag /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las spyod pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /gcig tu sems can don rab nges/ /gser du nges par byed pa'i le'u/ /slob dpon la ni rab dang bas/ /mu tig dang ni nya phyis dang / /dngul chu dang ni byi (1 ru yis/ /gang gis sems can nor ldan 'gyur/ /'di ni phyi yi yo sman min te/ /shun lpagasu lo ma ma yin zhing / /dngul chu bcud len ma yin te/ /mu zi lhang tsher ma yin zhing / /lcags dang zha nye 1 )zangs ma minas/ /lcags gzhan dag ni ma yin te/ /grub pa'i sman gyi mchog yin no/ /'di lta bu yi litshig thos nas/ /phyag na rdo rje 80—476

stobs po ches/ /zhabs kyi rdul gyi cha btud nas/ /sems dpa' gcig tu dad brtan pas6)/ /lha mo legs so zhes ni smra(mi/ /sman gyi mchog ni gang yin zhing ne/ /dngos grub kyang ni ji lta bu/ /gus pa yis ni nyan par 'tshal lha mo chen mo khyod kyis gsungs/ /grub pa'i sman gyi mchog gang lags/ /gang gis sems can nor ldan 'gyur/ /tshe 'phel ba la brtson pa gang / /sngon bsnyen ltos pa med pa yis/ /sman chen grags pas 'grub pa gang / /gang gis rdzas rnams mang por 'gyur/ /mo sham (5)bu dang ldan 'gyur (cigang / /yang dang yang du mi 'chi zhing / /shi nas yang dag 'tshor 'gyur ba/ /lha mo chen mo khyod kyis gsungs/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyim 'di nyid du gnas pa yi/ /sman chen po yis 'grub pa ste/ /de yang snod bzang mchog la 'grub/ /byis pa rmongs pas mi shes so/ /bdag don gcig pu la 'bab cing / /kye ma gcig tu dka' 'bad pas/ /ji ltar sems can don 'grub 'gyur/ /snod bzang la ni gnas pa'i bcud/ /ze'u (5)'bru gsang ba'i spyod yul te/ /ro bcud rtsa yi nang gnas pa'i / /sman chen ro bcud ma ru brjod/ /gang gis lcags ni gser 'gyur ba/ /gcig gis kyang ni grangs 67med 'gyur/ /'dilta bu yi sman chen mchog /ro bcud ma ni de bzhin gnas/ /raba'abyor cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /sman gyi mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /derani yang dag sbyor ba bshad/ /dad pa brtan pa yis ni nyon/ /metog ldan pa'i bud med gang / /gzhon nu kha dog nag po ④ste/ /rgyud 'di thos pa dang ldan zhing / /ngo tsha med cing ltos med ma/ /'dod pa chung zhing sems can brtse/ /debazhin gshegs pa rnams bsten nasacing / /rtag tu rab sbas btsog tsamed ma/ /'dilta'i bud med rab blangs te/ /80—477

sman chen mchog ni yang dag brtsam/ /skyes bu shin tu chags che zhing / /myur du byang chub sems 'bab pa/ /gang yin de la dngos grub med/ /'di lta bu yi sman chen po/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rab rnyed dka'/ /shin tu brtan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /blo ldan bud med de rnams bsten①/ /de ltar yang zhes gsungs pa(gyi/ rab tu brtan ①pa gtso bo'i gnas/ /zhes ni sgrub pa po rnams smra / /de phyir brtan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /snod bzang 'bras bu bskul bar bya /der ni me tog ldan bud med/ /gser gyi sbyor ba rnyed dka' brtsam④/ /grub pa'i bcud kyis byugs pa yi/ /zla ba rang gi snying khar ⑤bsam/ /sngon du ri yi rgyal pos brgyan/ /der ni yi ge hrīḥyis bon/ /sems can don la gcig tu 'badal/ /blo ldan dgos pa yang dag brtsam/ /zangs ma'i dngos po srang gcig bcas / /zlum po snod bzang la bcug ste/ /g.yon pa bskum pa'i g.yas zur gzhag /med na lcags kyang bya ba yin/ /brtan pa'i sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /de nas blo ldan las rnams brtsam/ /ri rab zla ba sa bon rgyal/ /zhu 'gyur tshuthe tshom med pa yin/ /snod bzang der ni ngal bsos ⑧pas/ /'bo khyaba'i sbyor bas 'dzag pa nyid/ /bzang pos 7myur du rab blangs te/ /mkhas pa yis ni byug par bya/ /rdog po byugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /me yi nang du gzhug bya zhing / /de nas shes rab can bltas 1lhan/ /gser du 'gyur ba athe tshom med/ /de ni tu ma sha gcig gis ni/ /srang brgya ru ni 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar gser gyi sbyor ba mchog /'jig rten gsum na'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gal te sman chen tshad min na/ /de tshe sangs rgyas tshad ma yin / /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 'dir/ /dngos po gang dang gang gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba yis de 80—478

dag thams cad bden par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di tshad min smra ba'i/ /blo gros chen po thos ldan pa/ /ji srid sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /de dag thams cad dmyal bar 'gro/ /sman 'di tsam gyis ma grub na/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / /bla med rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /de dag thams cad brdzun ①par 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /sems can sangs rgyas chos la 'tshe/ /sman gyis (nyamachog ni 'grub 'gyur ba/ /skad cig de la the tshom med/ /sems can don la gcig smyo tu 'bad/ /sgom ldan 'grub pa lta ci smos/ /sman gomachog gser dang dngul du 'gyur/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ye shes yod/ /mi ni bskal pa bye bar 'tsho/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /mo sham 0rnams kyi bu med pa/ /yang dag sbyor bas bkrus tsam gyis/ /skad cig de la bu ldan 'gyur/ /sngon gyi gtso bos ji skad gsungs/ /khrus kyi cho ga rab tu bshad/ /kha dog lnga yi rdul tshon nam/ /yang na rdul tshon dkar po yis / /dpag dka' skrag par byed pa yi༅/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar byam/ /der ni bum pa lto che ba/ /zlum po bzhi ni gzhag par bya/ /shes rab can gyis (7chu yis dgang / /ras kyis kyang ni dkri bar bya/ /rang gi khrag gis mtshan ma bri/ /bud med mo sham (8)de yi ni/ /khams kyi gtso bo blangs nas ni/ /mkhas pas bum pa'i kha la byug /de nas khrag 'thung go 'phang la/ /gnas pa bsgom kyi)pa'i mchog ldan pas/ /nag po dmar mo 7'jigs chen po/ /rdo rje rtsu las yang dag byung / /'jigs pa'i me ltar 'jigs byed pa/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /bla ma 'jigs pa'i gar byed cing / /mkhas pas hūm̐ ni sgrogs bzhin pa/ /blo ldan bum pa'i nang du bsam/ /de nas ral gri 'dzin pa yi/ /80—479

skyes pa bzhi po grags chen po/ /khro bo gzhan gyi sems dang ldan/ /'jigs chen skyes bu de rnams kyis/ /ral gris nam mkhar 6)bsnun cing ②gsod / /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor ba dang / /'di lta bu yi sbyor ldan pas/ /de bzhin du ni bud med bkru/ /skad cig de la bkrus tsam gyis/ /bud med bu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba ༅rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las sman chen po khyad par can dang / mo sham (snyegyi khrus kyi cho ga'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /mkha' lding sbyor las byung ba'i le'u/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /blo ldan he ru ka dang ni/ /kun nas rnal 'byor ma brgyad bskyed/ /mtshan ma ⑥phyag sogs sngon gsungs 471bzhin/ /kha dog dkar po 'ba' zhig ⑧nyid/ /phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma dkar zhing / /mtshams kyi dmar po nyid yin noponye/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab( )/ /bum pa rnam pa bzhi po la/ /sngon gsungs phyag mtshan bri bar bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyis ni slob ma rjes su gzung yonya/ /sngon gyi cho gas gsol btab ste(1rta/ /sbyin dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /de nas dkyil 'khor mchod par bya/ /slar yang gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /slob ma rjes su gzung yistebar bya/ /sa stengs san ni dus zin la/ /cung zad gso bar mi nus te/ /nam mkha' lding can gyis btang zhing / /dus su zin ces smra ba ni/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /blo ldan de nas las brtsam tsomo/ /bdag nyid 80—480

he ru kur gyur cing / /kun nas rnal 'byor ma brgyad 1)de/ /de kun sku ni dkar po ru/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ /'bras btags (mirang bzhin blangs nas ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gnyis bya'o/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa yis / /de yi lag par ral gri sbyin/ /de yi snying gar (55sngags bzhugs pa/ /'dab ④ma gang dang gang de la/ /mar khu che byas snag tsha dang / /mkhas pas sngags ni bri bar bya/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā le ni hrīḥ55)tsha ka pā la chi6)ni badz+re ṇi aḥ(7)be t+t+waṃ sa ya sasba (nyanā ga na phyi)u da pa ya r+ya dha ra nizhu 7/ bi bha ba 47ya ka la da sha na/ bho bho bha ga ba ti/ bud+dha ka pā la / nī/ sa: 1 na ṇa k+ṣa yaṃ ka rī r+sha)ha ha ha swā hā/rig pa 'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs nas ni/ /'dab skam snying khar yigazhug par bya/ /gsang sngags 'di dang lcug ma yis/ /lan bdun bar du spyan drang ngo / /oṃ bud+dha nyu ka pā li ni gha ṭa gha ṭa/ gha ḍa gha ḍa hri hri (nye haḥhaḥ he hoḥrtakyi// lan bdun bsngags pa tsam gyis ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnam pa gnyis/ /bar snang du ni lding 'gyur te/ /gcig ni dum bu dum bu ru/ /sa la ltung ba ru ni 'gyur/ /dus zin 'dir langs the tshom med/ /gzhan yang sbyor ba rnyed dka' gang / /pad stegs la sogs bcwa 27lnga po/ /glegs bam la ni bri ma byas/ /bla ma'i drin las shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i so rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud 2 bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las rig pa 'dzin pa'i rku )sbyor ba'i man ngag nges pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas phyag na rdo rjes rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs sde ma la yang dang yang du phyag 80—481

'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gtsor gyur pa/ /shes rab chen po'i 6)lha mo legs/ /khyod kyis gsungs pa'i sbyor ba gang / /'jig rten na yang larnyed par dka'/ /bdag gis rgyud kun mthong mod kyi/ /sbyor ba 'di dag rnyed par dka'/ /rgyud 'dir khyod kyis gang gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ma bshad do/ /e ma'o sems can don la brtson/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kun skyed (0ma/ /e ma'o phyag rgya che la brtson/ /sngags rnams kun gyi rab sbyor mdzu )/ /shin tu rnyed dka' gang yin des/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ngo mtshar ba/ /sna tshogs byed 'gyur lha mo gsungs/ /dang po'i le'u ⑤gang gang gsungs / /sbyor de (6)lha mos (7bdag la shod/ /'di lta bu yi tshig gsan nas/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sna tshogs sde/ /bzhad cing shin tu bzhad pa yis/ /lha rnams thams cad skrag pa dang / /bdud sde thams cad 'bros pa dang / /bgegs rnams thams cad 'jig 8par 'gyur/ /e ma'o bzhad 5)pa'i nges pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i mchog kun ngo mtshar ro/ /gsungs pa/ rgyal mtshan 'phyang ba blangs (7byas la/ /de yi sha yang blang bya zhing / /de yi rked ()cha'i zes pa ni/ /blangs nas thab khung du ni bya/ /de yi thod pa'i rjes bzung ste/ /rgyus pa sdong bur byas te gzhag /de yi mar khus dgang bya zhing / /thab khung gru gsum steng du gzhag /gzhan yang dud pa 'bebs pa dang / /ji srid dud pa chags kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gsang sngags 'udi ni bzlas tsopar bya/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nya ni bha ra bha ra/ dha dha ra/ dha dha ra/ dha rā rdzipa ya dha rā tshapa ya/ sho ṣa 7ya/ sho ṣa nyi ya/ ta pa ya ta pa ya/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ yi ma (7mi saṃ ra ṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru bho bha ga ba te snabud+dha ka pā la su dz+nyā ma lo gha ya shī (214 6)ka dza la 80—482

pa te①/ pa ta ya pa ta ya/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ②a hūm̐ stam bha ya bho bha ga ba ②ti hūm̐ oṃ ④phaṭa / 'di ltar sngags kyi rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten gsum yang skems ⑤par byed / /'byung po ro langs mkha' 'gro ma/ /srin po sha za la sogs dang / /gzhan yang rung ste 6)bgegs de rnams/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'bros par 'gyur/ /ji srid dud pa ma babs pa/ /de srid sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /dud pa babs ma thag tu ni/ /lag pa gnyi gas (7)gzung (8)bar bya/ /de nas blo chen 6)rnal 'byor pas/ /rol rtsed phreng ba btung bar bya/ /bu mo lo ni bcu drug ma/ /lang tsho'i gzugs la brtse ba can/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa yis spyad/ /gcig tu sems can don 'bad pa/ /gcer bu skra grol gyur pa yi/ /mkhas pas hi hi'i ⑩sngags bton te/ /rol rtsed phreng ma /lhabatung bar bya/ /de yi rjes la rtse nyuge'ajo brtsam/ /shin tu bzhad gyur phed /nyamadzad pa'i/ /brtse ba chen po'i lag g.yon du/ /dud chen mchog ni gzhag par bya/ /sbyor ba la ni mkhas pa yis/ /phyis ni bags ⑩kyis bya ba bya/ /pad+ma las byung rdzas gang zhig /de nyid kyis ni dud pa mnye/ /ming med mthe bos me tog sbyin/ /ril bu brgya dang rtsa brgyad bya / /ril bu re re re re la/ /gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzla/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li ni ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥtsos phaṭa/ 'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' zhing / /rgyud rnams kun tu rnyed dka' ba/ /rnal 'byor mas yikyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sngags 'di yis ni dud pa bsgrub/ / /srin lag gi ni sor mo yis/ /mig la dud pa byugs tsam gyis/ /stong gsum rdul phran lta bu yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad cu yi/snye/ /steng dang 'og ni mthong bar 'gyuratshon/ /lag pa g.yon pas mnyes tsam gyis/ /skad cig 80—483

de la rnal mar 'gyur/ /mdzub 6)mos byugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mthong 'gyur te/ /'byung po yi dgas ②sha za dang / /gzhan yang grub pa rnams dang ni/ /dpag tshad bye ba stong phrag gi/ /steng dang 'og ni mthong bar 'gyur / /lag pa g.yon pas mnyes tsam gyis/ /rnal mar 'gyur bar ②the tshom med / /gung mos byugs (4)pa tsam gyis ni/ /shin tu ngo mtshar byed 'gyur te/ /pheg brdabs bdun gyi sgra tshad du/ /nag po 'bar byed rtse mo yis/ /sprin rnams thams cad 'thor (5ribar 'gyur/ /'di lta'i dud pa rnyed par dka'/ /lag pa g.yon pas mnyes tsam gyis/ /skad cig de la mi ru 'gyur/ /mthe bong gis ni dud pa yi/ /bdag nyid chen po (7byugs tsam gyis/ /gzugs brnyan mtshan ma ri dang shing / /gzhan dag gang yang rung ba rnams/ /khro bo'i lta bas sgibaltas tsam gyis/ /dum bu stong du 'gyur ba yin/ /g.yon pas mnyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /rnal mar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /mthe'u chung gis ni 6)mig 6)byugs na/ /skad cig de la mi snang 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs mi 'gyur / /skad cig sum cu gsum du 7'khor/ /mdzod dang 6nyebud med rdzas nyid dang / /dngos po gang dang gang 'dod pa/ /dud pa'i bdag nyid chen po yis / /skad cig de la 'phrog par 'gyur/ /'di lta bu yi dud mchog gi/ /sbyor ba sna tshogs legs par bshad/ /de 7ni mig la byugs tsam gyis/ /rang gi gzugs ni bsgyur yo bar byed/ /dud pa 'di yini byugs tsam gyis/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /bya rog 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /sbrul dang khyi dang ce 7spyang dang / /stag dang gung dang byi la dang / /sbrang bu glang po bong bu ru/ /de ltar dud pa chen po yis/ /sna tshogs pa yi 7las byed pa'o/ /kun la las 80—484

kun yod mod kyi/ /sbyor ba 'ba' zhig 6)rnyed par dka'/ /sbyor ba glegs bam la ma bris/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad de/ /sbyor ba shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /sngags dang rus pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rtag tu sna tshogs las byed do/ /glang po'i rus pas bsad (0pa'i sbyor ba bya'o/ /oṃ budha ka pā li nī hrīḥlas/ rta yi rus pas bskrad pa rnyed par dka' ba bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī khaṃ hrīḥgi)rtsu phaṭa/ ba lang gi (5)rus pas dgra'i snying gar (7phur bu gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥ /khyi'i (7)rus pas rengs pa chen po bya bar gsungs so/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī na.āḥrgyu phaṭa/ rus pa chen pos ni dgug 6)par bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī hrīḥbo ṣaṭahu )/ bong bu'i rus pas rmongs (nyepar bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā yosheli nī r+bha hūm̐/ 'ug pa'i rus pas dbang du bya'o / /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī ṭ+wāṃ trī /steḥs/ bya rgod kyi rus pas dbye bar bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī hāḥphaṭa hūm̐/ bong bu'i rus pas rengs par bya'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī badz+re ṇi traṃ/ ce 8spyang gi rus pas g.yul las rgyal bar byed do/ /oṃ budha ka pā li tsanī bha ga ba ti dha ra dha ra ha he ho ha ha/ ma he'i rus pas dga' zhing rtse bas lo bcu gnyis su nyin dang mtshan du de'i byang chub sems mi ltung 7ngo / /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī ra ma ra ma kri ṭa kri ṭa ha ha/ sbrul gyi rus pas shing rtsad nas 'don no/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī yi mota ṭa ta ṭa/ tra ta ya tra ta ya/ma ta sbo ṭa ya sbo (sheṭa ya/ ut+pa ṭa ya 4)rtsu phaṭa/ stag gi rus (2 )pas ri 'degs par byed do/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī/ gha ra gha ra/ ma ṭa ma ṭa nu/tra ṭa ya tra ṭa ya/gha ṭā so pa ya gha ṭā sa pa ya/ sbo ṭa sbo zhugeṭa mo ṭa mo ṭa ya geso kra ma zhugaya hrīḥsi snas tram̐ phaṭa / lcags kyus ni nags stug po stong par byed do/ /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī badz+re 80wa 485

nā sha ya mā ra ya ①lhu ṭa ghu ṭi ni sabra ②tha lan ya ti na hri ye yaṃ ta ḍa ༷ya bhi tā rjopa ya tsa rma tsa rma/ bhā ⑥ma ya bh+ra ⑦ma ya/ bho dubha ga ba ti i i taṭa hūṃ phaṭa/sems gcig dri med me long bzhin/ /gang bsams de yang gzugs brnyan dang ske/ /rmi lam lta bur 6)shes mod kyi/ /'on kyang rnam par rtog pas bzung ⑩/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa'i gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las sngags sna tshogs kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /rnam (skyedag le'u rab rnyed dka'/ /ne ne mo dang tsha mo dang / /ma dang bu mo chung ma nyid/ /gal te phyag rgya che 'dod na / /shes rab can gyis 'di dag spyad/ /g.yung mo dang ni gar mkhan ma/ /khrus mkhan ma dang gtum mo yi/ /bu mo ko ba byed par gsungs/ /blo dang ldan pas 'di dag spyad/ /de lnga rnal 'byor ma yi mchog /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /ma yi dag pa yi sems sbyang phyir/ /mig ni sring mor gyur pa ste/ /rna ba tsha mo nyid yin no/ /sna ni ma ru 'gyur ba ste/ /lce ni bu mo nyid yin no/ /yid ni chung mar 'gyur ba ste/ /lnga po de rnams mchog lha mo/ /phyag rgya chen po ⑫rab ster ma'o/ /gti mug gar mkhan ma ru 'gyur/ /zhe sdang g.yung mo nyid yin no/ /'dod chags khrus mkhan ma yin te/ /nga rgyal gtum mo nyid yin no//phrag 7dog ko ba byed ma'o/ /lnga po de rnams bud med mchog /gzugs las gti mug skye ba ste/ /sgra las zhe sdang skye ba yin/ /dri la longs spyad 7pas 'dod chags / /ro las 7nga rgyal nyid yin te/ /reg bya las ni phrag dog skyeyon/ /80—486

sems kyi dag pa nyid yin no/ /de phyir rnal 'byor blo chen gyis/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skyes 6)'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang / /skye gzhan srid par dngos grub 'thob(mi/ /ji ltar dngos po med par bsgomadu/ /ji ltar dngos po bsgom par bya/ /dngos po bsgom (gebya ji ltar 'gyur/ /sring mo'i gzugs ni ji ltar yin/ /dkar mo ljang khu ( sngon mo'i mdog /'di lta'i gzugs dang ldan par ni/ /dag pa'i sems kyis blta mi bya/ /tsha mos ji ltar sgra thos pa'i/ /sgra grag rdzu ripa ni rnam gsum nyid/ /'di lta'i sbyor dang ldan par ni / /dag pa'i sems kyis mnyan mi bya/ /rab sbas skyed ma gang yin des/ /dri ni rnam pa gsum bltas 575pa/ /lta min yid dang ldan pa la/ /ji ltar 'dod chags skye bar 'gyur/ /lce dang lhan cig longs spyod rdzas/ /ro drug myangs pa ci 'dra ba/ /myangs pas longs spyod ldan pa yi/ /myangs pa'i gzugs ni ji lta bu / /yid kyis (shelongs spyod dga' ba 9)de nyid/ /yid kyis gnyi ga tu )spyad pas bde / /der ni rtag pa yod ma yin/ /dngos po las ni dngos med yod/ /dngos med la yang dngos po nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyi ga stong / /'di dag sems kyi dag pa nyid/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /phyi yi hunyalus ni sbyang phyir ro/ /lta dang ldan pa snying rje ste/ /'khyud pa byams par 'gyur ba'o / /drud pa'i sbyor ba'i bdag nyid ni/ /dga' ba yan lag ma yi yonyemachog / gnyi ga yo 'dus las gang 'jog skipa/ /de ni bdag gis btang snyoms gsungs / /de ltar dngos po'i sbyor ldan pa/ /ji ltar 'dod chags kyis 'ching 'gyur / /mthong ba las ni 'dod chags skye/ /'khyud las 'bras bu cung zad tsam / /drud pa las ni dga' ba skyesnyi/ /kun gyi mtha' mar dga' bral lo/ /80—487

de ltar dga' dang dga' bral 'bras/ /khams gsum pa las skye bar 'gyur/ /rab dga' sems kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po gsum gyis 'ching mi 'gyur/ /bza' dang btung ba 6)gang ci'ang rung / /bde ba 'bab pa'i kha zas rnams/ /de kun bshang dang gci sogs su/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu brtag /gang ci rung ba'i dga' rtse 'jo/ /'khyud pa dang ni 'o byed dang / /nyed dang 'tshir ba nyid kyis ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'ang mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di lta'i bsgom ② dang ldan pas ni/ /'di ru 'grub par the tshom med/ /rnal 'byor ma lngas sangs rgyas kyi/ /dpal dang phyag rgya cher ( raster byed/ /rnal 'byor pa yis (3)de mchod na/ /'dod pa rnams kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /phrag dog la sogs kyis sbags kyang / /de la nyes pas gnod pa med/ /rnal 'byor pa yi ⑤mchog de nyid / /srid pa'i nyes pas gos mi 6)'gyur/ /ji srid khams ni phyi mi gsoratshu/ /sangs rgyas sku srid sdig dang bral/ /byang chub sems ni 'dzag ⑧med pa/ /gang tshe phun sum tshogs pa'i shing / /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las sems rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /sna tshogs sde mas bsngags pa'i le'u/ /de ltar phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / ri rab kyi rdul phra rab snyed dang mtshungs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs shing mgu ba'i sems kyis sna tshogs sde ma la btud de 991bstod pa/ /e ma'o bcom ldan 'das lha mo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed 7)byed ma/ /dpal dang grags pa che 80—488

zhing 'jigs/ /sems can kun la phan mdzad ma/ /lha mo snying rje che ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen po blo chen ma/ /don chen 'bras bu ston mdzad ma/ /sangs rgyas thod pa yi ni rgyud/ /rdo rje 'chang gis sbas pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gsungs shing / /byang chub sems dpa'i yul min pa/ / gsung gcig ①gis ni gsal mdzad de/ /de ni lha mo khyod kyis gsungs/ /e ma'o snod ②chen lha mo khyod/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bsdus byas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs kun yul min pa/ /rnyed dka'i sridangos grub gang yin pa/ /de ni lha mos gsal bar mdzod / /gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad nyon/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /'dod chags bral dang bdag chen nyon/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa nyon/ /klu dang lhar bcas mi rnams nyon/ /rgyud rgyal 'di ni bklags zhonatsam gyis/ /bsod nams gang yin de kun gyi/ /bsod nams rjes rang yongs su bsngo(3)/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don du ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnam pa dbul/ /sngags don zab mo rnams dang ni/ /sbyor ba shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /gang zhig gsal byas bdag bzod mdzod/ /shin tu sbas pa'i yul de yang / /sems can don du gsal byas pas/ /rgyal ba'i mchog rnams bdag bzod mdzod/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa stobs po che/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas thod sbyor bzang po bzla/ /oṃ hrīḥ56)bud+dha hūm̐ ka pā li nī āḥ 'jug pa la oṃ/ 'byung ba la hrīḥ(7ciganas pa la bud+dha/ bde ba la hūm̐/ nub pa la ka pā li nī/ ldang ba la āḥ'o / /de ltar bzlas pa rab rnyed dka'/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i sbyor chud bzla(8) / /de ltar yid kyi bzlas ldan pas/ /dngos grub 'thob 5)par the tshom 80—489

med / /oṃ bud+dha ka pā li nī āḥtrīḥheḥ0)rtsu phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ②ka pā li nī badz+re ṇi ②sto hūm̐/ a dur la k+ṣe ④rgyu phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags sol/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /dbang dus cho ga ji bzhin du/ /slob ma dad brtan gang zhig gis/ /shes rab ma la gsol ba gdab/ /dri zhim pa yi (snyedangos po yis/ /maṇ+ḍal rnam pa lnga byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑥brgyan byas pa / /lha mo che la gsol ba gdab/ /zhal du bza' ba'i rdzas mchog bstab⑦/ /rdzas de rnams ni gsol ba dang / /yid ni tshim zhing thugs dgyes so/ /lha mo dgyes par mthong nas ni/ /tshig 'di dag gis smra bar byed/ /rnam par rtog pa mang po yis/ /g.yogs pa'i bag chags rab ldan pa/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba bdag /mdzes ma khyod kyis skyob par mdzod/ /grags chen snying rje ldan pa yi/ /lha mo de ni zhi bar mdzod/ /der ni rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /lhab lhub rgyan rnams dbul bar bya/ /dad pa brtan ⑧pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de nas bdag nyid dbul bar bya/ /sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs btung / / de yi ⑨mdun du dbul bar bya/ /gang gis shes rab ma mnyes 7pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ni mchod/ /'di nyid la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan yang dngos grub gtso bo dang / /snying rje ldan pa gzhan gang zhig /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di la bzhugs/ /gang du dbang po 'gags gyur pa/ /bdag rtog nyunyerang bzhin nyams pa ste/ /kye de lhan cig skyes dgar 'gyur1nya/ /bla ma'i zhal sngar yi gsal bar zhus/ /gang zhig 'char dus tshe na dbang zhipo dang / /yul mnyam nub gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa skarnams kyi snying sbas su sad pa/ /phyis ni mngon dga' rgyal ba'i mdzes sku gcig /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i 80wa 490

rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud bla na med pa gsang ba'i yang shin tu gsang ba las sngags kyi bzlas pa ①dang / shes rab ma la gsol ba gdab pa dang / rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi'i ②le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //'di gsungs nas sna tshogs sde ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang —/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams rang rang gi gnas na 'dug ste/ ci'ang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud rnal 'byor ma chen mos gsungs pa mchog tu gsang ba rdzogs soni// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ga ya dha dur dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa ༷80—491

khug /rdo rje ā ra li zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/①༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ā ra li (nyam hā tan+t+ra rā dza ⑤nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje ā ④ra li zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gsol ba btab par rig cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yang mkhyen nas bde ba'i ting nge (ge'adzin las bzhengs 96)te/ phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chu yis gdong ni bkrus nas ni/ /sman ni bza' (7ribar byas nas su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /he ru ka ni rab bsgrub bya/ /rang gi snying gar (3nyere pha 6)ni/ /bsreg 7pa'i bskal pa ltar 'bar bsgom(11/ /de byung rdo rje nyi ma ni/ /'bar 80wa 518

ba'i phreng bas yang dag khyab/ / de yi 6)steng du hūm̐ nyid de/ /bskal pa'i me ni lta bu nyid/ /de ni rdo rjer yang bsams nas/ /rdo rje las byung he ru ka /bgegs ni chen po mnan nas ni/ /sku la thal bas byugs pa dang / /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ / 'jigs pa yang ②ni 'jigs par ①mdzad/ /in+d+ra nī la'i ④'od lta bu/ /dbu skra ser po stobs po che/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan par (snyeni/ /rol pa'i gar gyis 6)gar mdzad cing / /ri rab ri rgyal mthon po yang / / sa yi sti'og tu yang dag mnan(kye/ /phyag tu rdo rje ⑨rnam yibasgoms nas / /g.yon pas skyes pa'i thod pa ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /sha lnga yang dag ldan par bsgom47/ /kun+da yo)dang ni zla ba dang / /chu skyes do shal lta bur ni/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis phrag pa brgyan8/ /rdo rje ā ra li las lha'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa rdo rje btsun mo thams cad dang / dzam bha la la sogs pa'i rdo rje gnod sbyin thams cad dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'byung po thams cad dang /rdzi dbang po la sogs pa rdo rje nam mkha' la gnas pa thams cad dang / glang po che'i rna ba la sogs pa zhing skyong ba thams cad dang /kun dar la sogs pa'i yi dgas thams cad dang / de dag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi chos nyan pa'i sbyor ba des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje ā ra li chen po la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das gtor ma'i 80—519

sngags ji ltar 6)lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyi ston pa yis/ /gtor ma'i ②las ni rab tu phye/ /phyag rgya yang ni khyad par du/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa'o/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen phye nas/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di nyid sngags ni chen po nyid/ /de bzhin du ni nigator ma'i sngags/ /las ni thams cad pa yi sngags/ /yin pa nyid du the tshom ④med / /rdo rje ā ra li las gtor ma'i bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ming yang dag par rab tu phye ba/ gdong ring na rdo5)ni mtho ba dang / /de bzhin dpag bsam (7shing nyid dang / /tshangs par spyod pa mang ba nyid/ /dam tshig 'dir ni dngos grub byin⑦/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /khyi las byung ba'i mar me dang / /mar me chen po bsregs nas ni/ /tshangs spyod 'dzin pa mchod par bya/ /de nas sdom pa bka' stsal pa//khyod kyis srog chags gsad 8)par bya/ /brdzun 7gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /khyod kyis tshim byin par yang long (lha/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo ni/ /thabs dang shes rab cho ga yis / /rnal 'byor rig 12pas rtag tu mchod/ /de nas dbang bskur 6)bka' stsal pa/ phyag rgya ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /de la dbang bskur sbyin ④par bya / /dbang bskur de yi 7phyi nas ni/ /de 7nyid 'di ni rab tu dbye/ /de (rtenyid bde ba chen po ste/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /'di nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /de nas sbyin sreg (shebaka' stsal pa/ /khru gang tsam pa'i tshad dang ni/ /khru phyed sa la brko yogebar bya/ /80—520

rdul tshon yo)dkar po ldan par ni/ /rnam par mkhas pas thab khung bya/ /gsungs pa'i sngags kyis nges par ni/ /der ②ni sha sogs sbyin sreg ③bya/ /me stini lha yi spyan nyid de/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan(nya / /ka ba brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar byam/ /dur khrod sol ba so phag dang / /ldong ros phye ma nyid dang yang / /ljang khu ⑥yi yang phye ma nyid/ /dkyil 'khor la ni mkhas pas bsngags/ /dbus su gsum la rdo rje bri/ /shar gyi sgo ru mgo chen po/ /lho ru rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /de bzhin nub ⑦tu dgra sta ste/ /byang du gri gug dge ba ⑧nyid/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor du ni bri/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa la/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni rab tu dbye/ /dkyil 'khor bzhengs par byas nas ni/ /der ni slob ma gzhug par bya/ /ras kyis gdong ni bcings nas ni/ /bkrol nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /rdo rje ā ra li las las thams cad pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o / / //mngon par shes pa bka' stsal pa/ /lha yi mig dang rna ba dang / /de bzhin gzhan ⑨sems yishes pa nyid/ /sngon gyi gnas rjes dran pa dang / /de bzhin rdzu 'phrul mngon shes nyid/ /he ru ka yi dbyibs bsgoms na⑩/ /yo gi mngon shes lnga ru 'gyur/ /shin tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /he ru kur ni ngang gis 'gyur/ /bsam gtan las ni nus skyes nas/ / phyis ni spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ //sheyid ni brtan 12nam g.yo 'am 7ci/ /rang gi sems ni bskul 80—521

ba'i phyir/ /glu ni sna tshogs len pa dang / /de bzhin gar ni sna tshogs nyid/ /sna tshogs rim gro byed pa dang / /lus la rgyan ni sna tshogs dang 6)/ /de bzhin sna tshogs dga' ba yi/ /gzugs sgra ⑧de bzhin dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya yang dag brtsam/ /de nas las rgyas nu)bka' stsal pa/ /re'u mig brgyad ni dubris nas ni/ /rgyud kyi sngags ni rgyas par bya/ /las kyi dbye ba'i rab dbye bsal/ /de bzhin zhi rgyas la sogs kyis/ /oṃ ni dbang ldan la ni mer/ /de bzhin bden bral nyid du la/ /rlung gi mtshams su hūm̐ nyid de/ /shar du dz+wa ⑤ni rnam par gnas/ /lho ru dz+wa (nerayi rnam pa nyid/ /nub tu bh+yo yi rnam pa ste/ /byang du phaṭa kyi rnam pa yis(7)/ /dbus su swā hā rnam par gnas/ /ngos gsum du ni bsgrub bya'i ming / /rdo rje ā ra li las spyod pa'i nile'u ste 6)bzhi pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo bri ba bka' stsal pa/ che ge mo 'di sod cig /che ge mo 'di dbang du mdzod cig /che ge mo rengs par mdzod cig /che ge mo rmongs par mdzod cig /che ge mo ma lus par gyis shig /che ge mo lkugs par mdzod cig /che ge mo khug cig1 rme /che ge mo skrod cig /che ge mo la sdang skyobar mdzod cig /che ge mo chings shig /che ge mo ma ning du mdzod cig /che ge mo sgur ⑫por mdzod cig /ces sngags kyi rkang pa 'di rnams kyi ngos gnyis su bris te/gro ga'i 'dab ṇa/nyamar gur gum gyis 'dri ñca bar bya zhing / 'di dpung pa'i rtsa bar gdags par bya'o/ /dgug pa la ni zla mtshan zags pa'i ras la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas 'dri skyobar bya'o/ /bsad 7pa la sogs pa'i las la dur khrod kyi sol ba dang / tsi tra ku'i 0khu ba dang / yungs mar dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang /80—522

lan tshwa dang / tsha ba gsum dang / ka na ku'i nyukhu ba dang / rus pa'i smyu ②gus so/ /dgug pa la ni skyu ru ra'i tsher mas so/ /rmongs pa la ni dha ①ru ku'i shing gis so/ /rengs pa la ni pa ṭa'i smyu dugus so/ /ma lus pa la ni bo de tse'i shing gi smyu 0gus 'dri dubar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i mchod pa bka' stsal pa/bas mtha' dang ni dben pa dang / /bdag gi khyim gyi nang du yang / /lo ni bcu gsum de bzhin du/ /lo ni bcu drug bu mo dang / /nyi shu rtsa lnga ma mchod bya0la/ / ba dang ⑧de bzhin ma he dang / /spre'u mo dang khyi mo dang / /bong mo de bzhin rnga mo dang / /sha ba dang ni ra ma nyid/ /phag dang ba man ⑨las byung ba/ /gzhan yang he ru ka mchod na⑩/ /'grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /nya dang zla ba 'pho ba yi/ /tshes ni mu stegs yican gyis brtags8/ /dri ma gzhig ⑩par bya ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pas ni myang bar tsobya/ /srog chags rnams ni gsad ⑫mi bya/ /brdzun 8gyi tshig ni smra mi bya/ /ma byin par ni blang mi bya/ /pha rol bud med bsten mi bya/ /nyin par nyal zhing mtshan mo langs0/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag 8pas 'dug /sha chen dang ni rus pa dang / /khrag ni chen po btung ba dang / /khu chen yang dag bza' ba dang / /de bzhin rnam snang chen po nyid/ /bram ze mo dang g.yung mo nyid⑩/ /gar ma de bzhin btso blag ma/ /thod can ma dang ko lpags mkhan/ /gdol pa de bzhin phyag dar ma/ /rtswa 'tshong ma dang shan dum nyid/ /de bzhin kla klo la sogs dang / /smig sumakhan dang ni chang 'tshong ma/ /gzhan yang zla mtshan 'dzag pa nyid/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /sring mo las byung bu mo nyid/ /gzhan gyi bu mo spang mi bya/ /rje'u rigs mngon dga' mi bya ste/ /bgrod bya'i bu mo rtag spangs nas/ /bgrod 80—523

min mkhas pas bsten par bya/ /rdo rje ā ra li las 'khrul 'khor dang / las kyi phyag rgya bstan pa'i 0)le'u ste (0lnga pa'o// //de nas dam tshig gi bag dbab pa bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos skal ba ngan pa la / /bag ni dbab par mi bya zhing / /de bzhin gcer bu thod dum dang / /ral pa can ni thams cad la/ /dam tshig bag ni dbab mi bya/ /snying rje yis ⑧ni bdag nyid can/ /gal te yin na bza' bar bya/ /grub kyang lta ba dman pa ni / /sems can don byed skyes pa nyid/ /skal ba ngan pa zhes byar brjod/ /bram ze dam tshig rnam par sdang tsho ni/ /de nas slob ma'i dam tshig bka' stsal pa/dul byed blo dang ldan pa dang / /bzod ldan dal ba mi bslu (snyeb/ /bla mar gus shing snying rje ldan/ /rgyud 96༄ni 'dir ni rab tu bsngagasasti/ /de nas slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid bka' stsal pa/ sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de nas thun tshod bzhi byin gyis brlab (9pa bka' stsal pa/ji ltar bsgom 59)pa'i sbyor ba des/ /dang po thun tshod byin gyis brlab/ /des ni ci srid nyi phyed na/ /nyi ma phyed na thun gsum pa/ /dus dang bral nas nam phyed na/ /thun tshod byin brlabs tu cirab tu grags/ /thun tshod byin brlabs ⑩rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi nyurtarnal 'byor ldan pas 'grub/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /phrag yi dog dang ni ser sna nyid/ /bcom ldan he ru ka la med/ /yod na rnam par dag pa nyid/ /de nas dam tshig bsgrub sa pa bka' stsal pa/ bgegs dang 80—524

btsugs 6)pa'i shing la'am/ /ljon shing btags shing 'phyang ②ba dang / /g.yul du mtshon gyis bsnun pa nyid/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor ldan pas bsgrub / /de nas nang du mdzad pa bka' stsal pa/ btung ba rin po che yi chu/ /gang zhig bza' de rjodon yod nyid/ /khrus ni dpag med rdo rje yis/ /dril sogs rim pa rnam snang mdzad/ /dam tshig chos kyi de bzhin spyad/ /btso ⑤ni gang zag mnyam pas ni/ /dam tshig ro ni 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig glu yi rang bzhin nyid / /mkha' 'gro thams cad btsun mo ste/ /bu ni 'jam dpal la sogs pa/ /khro bo yi ni bsnyen bkur ba/ /bdag nyid he ru ka ru 'gyur/ /brjod pa bzlas pa yang dag bshad/ /yan lag nyed 6)sogs phyag rgya ste/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dmigs nas ni/ /gang zhig thams cad du ni gnas/ /mang du brjod pa (7)ci zhig bya/ /gang zhig 'jig rten bya gnas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i niganas thob phyir / /rnam par bzlog pas bya ba nyid/ /ri dgas 6)shor sogs bya ba ni/ /'jig rten du ni mi shes pas/ /mchog tu rab tu bsngags ⑩'gyur ba/ /rnam dag dag pa dam pa ni/ /de nyid thob pas rab tu spyod/ /de nas sdom pa bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje dril bu gzung nyunyebya zhing / /bdud rtsi mkhas pas bza' bar bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya rtag bsten cing / /spyod pa 'da' ba tu nyid mi bya/ /de nas lha'i mchod pa bka' stsal pa/ chu klung tshal gyi gnas su ni/ /bdag nyid lha ni mchod par bya/ /bdag gi sngags ni brjod par bya/ /me tog la sogs byin gyis brlab/ /rdo rje ā ra li las lasatshoge sna tshogs bstan pa'i skole'u ste 7drug pa'o// //80—525

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 6)bsod snyoms kyi lhung bzed bka' stsal pa/mkhas pas phru ba chag par ni/ /rigs ②bzhi ru ni slong (7mos rgyu/ /chu bo'i 'gram du bza' bya zhing / / gtsang (4)sbra nyid ni rab tu dbye/ /byi la'i rkang pa tsam gyi ni/ /kham (5)ni blo dang ldan pas blang / /phye 6)btab bza' bar mi bya zhing / /mi ster ba la rtag tu blangs9)/ /g.yas su rab mos (nyaskye bo ni/ /g.yon nas bskor ba ru ni bya/ /nges pa med par khyim du gnas/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom kyi)med/ /rdo rje shing gi stongs byas dang / /de bzhin dril bu shing gi bdag /he ru ka ni rab grub phyir/ /bzung nas rtag tu rgyu bar bya/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin mo'i bsgrub (7pa bka' stsal pa/ ser skya'i phru ⑩ma blangs nas ni/ /sngags ni 'di 12ni bzla bar bya/ /bsrung 5stebar byas shing bskams byas nas/ /de la gu gul bsre 1 bar bya/ /mkhas pas gnod sbyin mo sngon du/ /des ni bdug 7pa sbyin par bya/ /shin tu mdzes shing gos mdzes pa/ /bris skur gnas pa legs grub phyir/ /'di nyid kyi ni cho ga yis/ /gnod sbyin mo ni dgug par bya/ /bris sku nyid ni gnod sbyin mo/ /snga bar byin yinas 'gro bar 'gyur / /de yi rgyan rnams 1 thams cad ni/ /gang zhig cung zad rgyan rnams kun / /snga ba ru ni blang bar bya/ /gal te 'dod na mtshan mo la/ /me tog gis ni mchod par bya/ /de nas rdo rje ro langs kyi bsgrub yoshepa bka' stsal pa/ma chad rma med gang ba ni/ /legs par brtul zhugs can gyis bkru/ /mar khu chen pos byug pa dang / /bdug pa chen pos bdug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar phyogs su/ /mar khu chen po'i mar me dbul/ /nga yis //khyod la ci gsungs pa'i/ /de la dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /yungs kur 6 noro la 80wa 526

brdeg bya zhing / /sgra ni ri bor yang dag brjod/ /de la mkhas pas 'jigs mi bya / /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo rdzu brjod par bya'o/ /des ni ci zhig sbyin zhes smral/ /sgrub pos de la blang bar bya/ /rkang byug dang ni mig sman nyid/ /ral gri dang ni sa 'og dang / / ril bu mkha' tshul spyod pa nyid/ /thams cad sbyin par the tshom med/ /de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ gong gi bsam gtan byas nas ni/ /de la sngags ni bzla bar bya/ /rang gis ③te ru ka yi ni/ /rnal 'byor gyis ④ni bdag nyid du/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur//gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs dang / /zhi zhing dge ba'i gnas su ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bza' bar bya/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi ni/ /ā ra li zhes bya ba'i mtshan/ /za ba na ni gtam smra bya/ / ri yi ( rgyal po'i mgor gnas pa(5)/ /tshogs kyis dag pa'i sems kyis (pebaskor//de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'grub 'gyur gang phyir 'di nyid du/ /mchod pas grub par shes mi 'gyur/ /de yi btsun mo bsrung (kyeb ni/ /gshin rje mthar byed du ni 'gyur/ /shes rab mthar byed dpung gi mgon/ /pad+ma mthar byed sku bsrung (spyorabadag /de yi bgegs kyi mthar byed ni/ /dmag dpon du ni brjod pa yin/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /de yi gshed ma'i bdag po nyid/ /dpal ldan dbyig pa sngon po ni/ /sgo srung ba yi bdag po nyid / /thams cad la ni dbang byed pa/ /zhar tsho )ba mi g.yo mgon po nyid/ /yi ge pa yi bdag po ni/ /de bzhin du ni stobs po che/ /rdo rje ā ra li las dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tsho)le'u ste nyugebadun pa'o// //80—527

de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa thams cad gtam 'di thos nas srid pa'i sbyor ba kun tu bcad cing rnam par dag par gyur pa dang / /sdig pa zad cing nyon mongs pa bsregs par gyur 0)to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis tshig 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rdo rje ā ra li brtson che/ /sna tshogs e ma rmad byung ba/ /gang zhig bdag cag nyon mongs khebs / /gang zhig bdag cag grub 'gyur ba/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams rkang gnyis kyi mchog dam pa thob nas sangs rgyas kyi rol pa ston par byed do/ /la lar rdzogs pa'i byang chub mdzad/ /kha cig tu ni dka' thub spyod//lha las babs pa'i sprul pa dang / /de bzhin khab nas 'byung ba dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor na)ba dang / /kha cig tu ni rab byung byed/ /'dul bar (5)ston par byed pa dang / /mngon pa'i sems ni lhag pa'i sems la lar sngags kyi bdag nyid 'chang / /kha cig pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /kha cig bye brag smra ba'i lam/ /kha cig tu ni mdo sde pa/ /kha cig tu ni rnam shes nyid/ /kha cig tu ni dbu ma nyid/ /la lar dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /la lar sems can rjes su skyong / /sems can 'dul ba la bltas nas/ /snying rje'i bsam pas rol par bya/ /rdo rje ā ra li las phan yon gyi 94)le'u ste (5brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gang yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis las rnam par 'byed pa bstan par bya'o/ /gang zhig rgyud gang du dam tshig byed pa des ni 'jig rten gsum po kun gyis bstod par 'gyur 8(1—528

ro / /gang zhig rgyud de yis gang gi lho)tshe byed pa de ni srid par mdzes par 'gyur ro / /gang zhig glu yis mchod byed na/ /des ni rtag tu sgra snyan 'gyur/ /gang phyir gang zhig mar me 'bul/ /de ni mig dang ldan par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gar gyis risnyemachod byed pa/ /de ni rig 'dzin chen por 'gyur/ /gang zhig phyag 'tshal byed pa ni/ /de la skye bo phyag 'tshal 'gyur/ /gang zhig dri zhim 'bul ba ni / /lus ni dri zhim ldan par 'gyur/ /gang zhig phreng ba bzang 'bul bachi ni/ /de ni gser gyi phreng ldan 'gyur/ /gang zhig gos ni 'bul ba niri / /des ni lha yi 45rigos rnyed 'gyur/ /gang zhig mtshan tsam 'don pa dang ne/ /dad pa tsam yang rab byed pa/ /lhag par mos pa rab tu byed/ /gang zhig skye bo mchod byed pa / /de rnams thams cad rnam dag pa'i/ /srid pa'i longs spyod rab tu bzang / /rdo rje ā ra li las yon tan rjes su bsngags pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas yang gang zhig de ltar rnam par dag pa'i sbyin pa byin pas de rkang gnyis kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dga' bas the tshom skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te nye bar 'dug ste 7zhus pa/ ji lta bu yi rnal 'byor bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sbyin pa mtha' gsum yongs dag pa/ /he ru ka ni bsgom par bya / /sbyin pa yang ni he ru ka /gang la 8risbyin pa'ang de lta bu/ /sbyin pa 'di ni rab tu bsngags/ /sbyin pa 'di ni dpe tsam ste/ /tshul khrims la sogs 'di ltar spyad/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje ā ra li las de skad ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje ā ra li las rnal 'byor ma'i gong na med pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu pa 80—529

lnga(ba/bsu theb①// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā yasba pa ga ya dha phyira'i zhal snga nas dang ②/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab padu //bsdur
