dang / /'ug pa'i sgro ①ma'i smyu gu yis/ /ro dkris dmar po'i gos la ni/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni rang gis bri/ /de la rnal 'byor ma 'dug nas/ /ā ra li ni khri ru bzlas/ /oṃ ā ra li ri gi pho/ a mu kai ke/ ma me rda swasdi ②dar+sha ya bh+yo / swā hā/ khrag 5gyidagug pa bshad par bya ste/ rna tshol ④brtag par byas nas ni/ /gong bu mdun du dgod par bya/ /ri gi ā ra (gyeli'i sbyor bas/ /dbugs kyi gong bu dgug par bya/ /khab kyi phyag rgya mchu byas nas/ /dang po lce yi (7byed pa pos/ /ji ltar tsha (7)ba'i gong bu bzhin/ /shes rab can gyis sbrang chen dgug /khab kyi phyag rgya gnyis pa ni/ /mgrin spas dal gyis yongs su gzir / /'jug pa'i las yang dag par rab tu bshad (8)par bya ste/ ji ltar sbyor ba'i 99)gzugs bltas nas/ /bdag nyid ri gi yi gzugs su/ /ri gi ā ra li'i sbyor bas/ / mgo ni 1 sna'og tu rnam par bsgomatsho1/ /oṃ badz+ra ā ra li phaṭa ya to ta ya dze pho swā hā/ rengs par byed pa bshad par bya ste/ dgra bo nyid kyi lce la ni/ /bu ram 12gong bu bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ri gi lhusta ghuṣ+ṭa sha tunyertsu phaṭa / 'khru ba rab tu bshad par bya ste/3 dgra bo'i dri mas gzugs warnyan bya / /de yi skra yis dkri bar bya/ /tsha skab gsum gyis kha bkang nas/ /gzugs brnyan kha ru gzhag sapar bya/ /oṃ ā ra li yinam me a mu kai kai kai sa (ster ya 17phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa 3 snaswā hā/ dbang du bya ba la/ bdag gi g.yon pa'i mig tu ni / /e baṃ rnam par bsgom par bya/ / de yi nyagayas pa'i mig tu ni/ /cardo rje 'phro ri ba'i rnam pa 2)bsgom/ /de dag 'dus pa'i sbyor ri ba ni/ /ri gi ā ra lis sbyor bas/ /mdzes ma na dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid bsrung bar bya ba dang / /gnas ni sbyang ba nyid dang yang / /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug ri rinya80—536

pa dang / /thugs sogs byin gyis brlab pa dang / /yan lag dgod par bya ba dang ske/ /de bzhin lha yi dbang bskur dang / /lha mo rnams kyi sngags 'byung ba/ /ā ra lis ni rtag tu bya/ /oṃ dang āḥrgyu byin gyis brlab/ /de nyid gsum ni rigs gsum 'byung / /byin brlabs 0)las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /las rnams thams cad rab sbyin dge/ /snying dbus rang gi sa bon gyi/ /lcags kyus ā ra li phyung (minas/ /ye shes 'khor lo dgug par bya/ /bkug nas dam por ③bcing bar bya/ / dṛ ḍho (geme bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo ⑤me bha ba/ a nu rasto 6)me bha ba/ sarba (pesin+tismyu (shepra yats+tsha 6)e h+ye hi bha ga ban yi ti ri swā hā/ spyi bo snying ⑨dang de bzhin mgrin/ /lte ba gsang ba'i gnas su ni/ /zhags pa'i phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /dam po la sogs bcing bar bya/ /ha ha hi hi de bzhin du/ /hu hu ho ho de bzhin te/ /lus kyi gnas ni brgyad rnams su/ /yan lag dgod par bya ba nyid/ /spyi bo mchan khung lte ba dang / /kha dang de bzhin mig gnyis dang / /rkang mthil tsogasang ba nyid du ni/ /yan lag dgod par rab tu grags / /sngags ni rim pa yis ni mtshon/ /lag pa ba spu'i khung kun (snyenas/ /ri gi'i spu'od zer spro bar bya/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya rab sbyor ba'i/ /yang ni phyis ni bsdu bar bya/ /ri gi hūm̐ saṃ kai mo si nyid/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor rab tu grags / /r+ghaṃ skorwa:mo yī zhes bya brtse/ /gsung gi 'khor lor grags pa'o/ /rdza mi ‘/ hṝ kai i nyid ni/ / sku yi 51she'akhor lor rab tu grags/ /ri gi sngags kyi gdon pa ni/ /rim pa yis ni mtshon par bya/ /rang gi snying las 'od zer byung / /lcags kyu'i phyag rgyar rab sbyor bas/ /phyogs bcur rnam par bzhugs pa yi517/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des bkug nas/ /cho gas 'dod pas zhu no80—537

mchod nas ni/ /dbang ni blo dang ldan pas blang / /oṃ sarba nyuta thā ga ta ②nge ki r+sā nu ga ta ma hā a bhi ṣe chakā nu dha ri )nu zhes/ bdud rtsi lngas gang bum pa ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi phyirang bzhin gyi/ /des ni lha rnams dbang bskur bya/ / lha yi ⑥dbang las bde ba nyid/ /oṃ sarba (7)ta thā ga ta ḍā kyir+sā bhi ṣi ka nibadz+ra swa bhā bād+ma ko3nya6) / gru gsum me yi yis bon gyis/ /snang byed rnam par bsgom par bya(nya/ /snying gar 3)rgyu las rigs bdag nyid/ /de nyid kyi ni de ru 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje las byung kun/ /rdo rje gur dang ra ba nyid/ /ri gi ā ra li gnas su/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /dmyal ba brgyad ni thod pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'phar tunyem gsum gnas pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdomatshu/ /'khor lo g.yas su bskor ba yin/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i ā ra li/ /sems kyis 'jigs byed mnan nas ni/ /ri gi shing la mngon zhon pa/ /zhabs la zhabs kyis bskor ba 7bya/ /rnal 'byor ma kun thod par gnas/ /gar gyi rkang pas phyogs su gnas/ /tsha dang grang ba'i rab yidabye bas/ /mtshams su thod pa brgyad po 1 yin/ /las thams cad rab tu bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //ri gi ā 1nyar lis zhus pa/ /brda yi rnam pa du zhig lags/ /de la lha mo ri gi 16chos tsho/ /brda ni yang dag rab tu phye/ /brda ni chen po ts+tsha ma bcu/ /bdag nyid sngon du byed pa nyid/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub po dngos grub thob 'dod na/ /gnas ni dpral ba'i rgyab tu 'dod/ /ngos ni nye ba'i gnas nyid do lha/ /pus mo tsurdor 2'gro bar 'gyur/ /dpral gebar nye 80—538

ba'i tsusdo ①nyid/ /lag pa g.yas pa 'du ba nyid/ /g.yon pa nye ba'i 'du ba nyid / /rna ba g.yas pa dur khrod gnas/ /g.yon pa nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /snying ni zhing du yang dag 'gyur/ /lhag ma nye ba'i zhing nyid dang / /tshong rdal nyams dga' tshong 'dus ②dang / /ma mo'i khyim du rtag tu blta / /brda yi rnam par shes par bya/ /rang gi mtshan ma rang gis ston/ / ril bu ④mig sman la sogs pa/ /mchog ni rab tu smin par 'gyur/ /ā ra li yis lha mor ⑧zhus/ /ye shes dam pa ji ltar lags/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub po dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /'bras phyir byang chub thob 'gyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin lha mo ri gi ste/ /mchog tu bde ba chen po nyid/ /srub yidang srub 4)byed las byung ba/ /kun mkhyen ye shes yang dag 'byung / /sems pa thams cad yongs su spangs/ /dbang po thams cad bzlog par bya/ /dgon pa dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /gnyis gnyis thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mig dag steng du bzlog nas ni/ /smin ma'i dbus su sems byas nag/ /mi zad po)mun pa'i gzugs su ni/ /sgrub pos yidang po mthong bar 'gyur/ /phyis ni rna ba g.yon par bcug/nya /dal gyis dal gyis 'gul bar 'gyur/ /yan lag can gyi bde ba gang / /de bzhin phyag rgya chen po bde/ /phyi yi phyag rgya ngang gis 'jigatso /de yis ye shes kyang ni 'jig /bde ba chen po tsho rtogs pa'i phyir/ /de yi ye shes phyag rgya pa/ /'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid/ /rang gis rig pa'i rang bzhin can/ /gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji lta bar/ /gzhan du brjod par mi nus so / /lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /sems can gsol 'debs sems kyis ni/ /sems can kun la snying rje yis/ 'di ni rnal 'byor gtso bo r+shanyidam//80—539

'di la goms tsho17pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /snying rje mthu chen rnal 'byor pas/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dang por mun pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa dkar dang du ba 'thul/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ltar/ /bzhi pa ya ba'i me tog bzhin/ /lnga pa sprin med ye shes ni/ /rang gzhan (5yang dag rig pa spangs/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu ni / /de yod thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtse gcig sems kyis ri gir 'gyur/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rtag 'thungs pas/ /bkres pas zil gyis mi non cing / /skom pa yis kyang zil mi non/ /rga dang na bas gzir mi 'gyur/ /'di yi rithabs kyi (4)rnal 'byor gyis/ /ri gi thams cad rig par 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa chen po/ /ā ra li ni nyid kyis nim/ dam du 'khyud par 'o mdzad pas/ /ri gi la ni gus pas 6)zhus/ /e 6)baṃ ma yā ci zhig bshad/ /e yi rnam pas sa ru bshad/ /baṃ gi rnam pa de bzhin chu / /ma ni me zhes bya bar brjod/ /yā (7)yi rnam pa rlung du gsungs/ /ri gi sdom pa ci zhig bshad/ /ri gis bka' stsal pa/ ri gi mkha' 'gro mar ni gsung 8/ /sdom pa dam par gyur pa 'di/ /ri gi e baṃ sdom pa ni/ /e baṃ rnam pa rna bar gnas/ /ri gi sna yi 96 mor ni/ /rtag tu ri gi bzhugs pa yi//ye shes dam pa 'di nyid ni/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de yi bdag /'byung ba chen po bzhi gtan la dbab pa dang brda'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //1 de nas rnal 'byor chen po yis/ /ā 1nyar li ni nyid kyis ni/ /rang bzhin mdzes pa nyid la zhus/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa'i/ /khrag ni ji 80wa 540

ltar dgug par bgyi/ / ri gis bka' stsal pa/6) nus la sogs pas mdun du ni/ /ya ba'i me tog bzhag ⑧nas ni/ /rang gi khrag ni dgug par bya/ /ri gi nyon cig goms pa yi/ /nas ni nyi shu kha smad 'byung ni/ /phyi nas khrag ni 'gugs ④par byed/ /lha ni dral ba bshad par bya/ /spyi bor 'bar ba bsam par bya/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab nas ni/ /der ni sngags ni bzlas par ⑤bya / /oṃ he ru ka pa rta phi pa tā 6)ya/ /ri gi ā ra li'i sbyor bas/ /lha la phyag byas 'gag ⑦par 'gyur/ /ā li kā 6)li yan lag mnyam/ /'di dag gnyis dbus rang sa bon/ /rang gi sa bon nyid kyis ni/ /rang gi phyag rgya rnams yin te / /phyag rgya las ni lha rnams 'byung ⑨/ /o shu n+ya tā bidz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 lhayi/ lcags kyu phyag rgya lag gnyis kyis/ /mthe chung phan tshun lcags kyu'i tshul / /dbu ma yi ni sor mo gnyis/ /mthe lhonyebong rgan pos gzir bar bya/ / sdigs mdzub (steganyis kyi zhags pa nyidayi/ /rdo rje ral gri zhags chen po/ /chos kyi ye shes gang zhig gzhan8/ /ri gi nyid du rab tu grags/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yis ni/ /si si la sogs rab tu grags/ /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi yin te/ /mi bzar tsol sogs rab tu grags/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /wa la sogs pa rab tu grags/ /phyag drug 'gro ba drug tu gsungs/ /spyan gsum srid pa gsum du brjod/ /'jigs byed bdag gi sems nyid de4 / /zhabs kyi rtsa bar bskyel ba nyid/ /dga' ba la sogs sa bcu ni/ /gnas sogs yang dag rab tu grags/ /pha rol phyin drug phyag rgya drug /thod pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /e baṃ ma yā'i nyunyedabus gnas pa'o/ /bdag nyid kyis ni de ltar bsam/ /'chol ba kun gyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /thams cad rgyud 80—541

rdu yang dag gnas/ /gri gug ma rig gcod pa nyid/ /thod pa nyid 6)ni snying rje che / /ri gi ā ra li yi sgra/ /cang te'u (mirtsu he'i ③sngags bzlas pas/ /dgra sta ④chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod/ /rdo rje rdo rjer (5)rab tu grags/ /mgo bor 0nyon mongs pa yi bdud/ /thod pa nam mkha' dag pa nyidaspyi/ /lcags kyu ri gi ze 'bru ste/ /de bzhin zhags pa dag pa nyid/ / ngang gi dudag pa bsdus nas ni/ /lus ni mchod rten dag pa ste/ / skyil krung 5)gdan du shes par bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi snying por gsungs/ /gnyer ma gsum brtag ⑩ste ba nyid/ /lto ba yang ni gzugs su 'gyur/ /mgrin pa yang ni mgrin par brjod/ /kha khyer mgo bor shes par bya/ /spyi bo nyunyagadugs kyi phreng bar brjod/ /mig gnyis zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /'phan ni mgo las skyes pa yin/ /rus pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung / /de phyir rang byin rlob par 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lus/ /rnal 'byor pa yo yis rtag tu mchod/ /rang gi ngo bo sangs rgyas su bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // rgyal po chen po zas gtsang 'di/ /ā ra lis ni yang dag phye/ /de la ri gi sgyu ma che/ /'gro ba thams cad shes rab dag /don grub rdo rje sems dpa' ste / /lha mo sa 'tsho (nyephyag rgya'o/ /sgra gcan bzang po'i tsobade ba che/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs kyi spros pa las/ /sgyu ma chen po sa 'tsho 7nyid/ /rdo rje sgyu yima'i rnam ⑩'phrul bas/ /don grub lhan cig skyes dga' nyid/ /sras ni bcom ldan rdo rje can / /yab ni rdo rje 'chang bar grags/ /yum ni sgyu ma chen mo yin/ /de nyid phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /mthe bong rgan po rdo rje yin/ /lte ba chos kyi 'byung 80—542

gnas gsungs/ /sgyu ma chen po'i rnam 'phrul bas/ /don grub nyid ni gzi brjid can/ /ngo bos 'gro ba sangs rgyas nyid/ /lha mo ri gi nga tshig nyon/ /las la spyod pa rab brtags pas/ /lus can rnams ni rtag tu gdungs6)/ /dga' ba yang ni shi shir gsungs/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'dod pa ma/ /dga' bral dga' ba bde chen ma/ /lhan cig skyes dga' sdom pa ma/ /mi bzang (kyem ni (mi'o liru gsungs/ /rnon mo yang ni 'khyud mo nyid/ /sgyu ma skyed la sgyu ma che/ /mthe bo ⑤mchu ni 'jib 6)pa nyid/ /dga' ba'i rtsod (7)pa wa nyid de/ /sbrang rtsi btung bas ma he nyid/ /rtog (8)pa yis ni rta mgrin te/ /'o byed glang po'i rgyal mtshan no/ /rdo rje ra li 'dod chen can/ /'dod pa ma kyi)ni ri gir brjod/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba thams cad rnam par khyab/ /si si rnam pas dmyal ba bzhi/ /de bzhin ha yi rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor bar ji ltar spyad pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi 'gal lo/ /rdo rje ā ra li nyid ni/ /khu bar yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /ri gi bde ba chen por gsungs/ /ri gi ā ra li sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sgyu ma zhes byar brjod/ /bud med sgyu ma'i spros pa yis/ /'gro ba thams cad rnam par rmongs/ /bud med sgyu ma sangs rgyas nyid/ /sgyu ma thams cad spel bar byed/ /snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ ā ra lī 7byo bh+yo ha ha ha ha / si si si si mi gsal bar bzlas so/ /gnyis kyi nye ba'i snying po ni/ /ha ha ha/ las rgyas pa la sngags gang ni/ /de yi sngags su rab tu bsngags/sto/ /snying po yi ni sngags yin no/ /nye ba'i sngags kyis bskul ba yin/ /bsgom yinapa bde chen myang ba ste/ /de bzhin dam tshig mchod pa nyid/ /thams cad kyi ni dam tshig la/ /mi las skyes pa rab tu bsngags/ /klu gzir gnyis 'thung /gyedam 80—543

tshig ste/ /rmi lam rta ni rab tu bsngags6)/ /bsad (snyel ma he dam tshig go/ /dbang la khyi ni rab tu bsngags / /khrag dgug pa la dam tshig ste/ /'jug pa de bzhin rnga mo nyid/ / rengs pa ④la ni ne'u'i sha /kha na ma tho med rnyed pa/ /gal te bsad (9par byas na ni/ /de tshe rnal 'byor pas mi ⑥'grub/ /sems can bskyab sems rnal 'byor pa/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom ④med/ /dkyil 'khor khru ni bzhi pa nya8)bya/ / sgo la sor ni bzhi pa steponye/ /sgo khyud sor ni gnyis su gsungs/ /lo gsal yang ni sor gnyis yang / /sgo khyud kyi ni kha khyer la / /sor ni bcu gnyis dag tu gsungs/ /lha yi snam bu sor gnyis te/ /rta babs sor ni bcu drug nyid/ /sgo las sor mo gnyis kyis ni/ /rdo rje phreng ba de bzhin bya/ /dkyil 'khor snying po zlum po ste/ /phyogs bzhi kha dog bzhi dang ldan / /kha dog lnga yi rdul tshon nyid/ /srad bu lnga zhes bya bar brjod/ /gser dang yang na dngul nyid dang / /mu tig dang ni byi 0ru dang / /mu men (nyayang dag bsres nas ni/ /rin chen lnga ni shin tu gzhug /lha yi grangs kyi bum pa nyid / /rnam rgyal bum pa ches che ba/ /bum pa dkri 7ba nyid du ni/ /sgrub pa po ni dam pas bya/ /dang por sa ni yongs dag bya/ /gnyis par thig sogs gdab pa dang / /lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / /de bzhin lnga (/gyepar sbyin sreg nyid/ /'jig rten skyong ba dbang po dang / /lha mo khyod ni dbang du 'gyurami / /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bzhengs par bgyi/ /'od srung 7ma yis bgegs med mdzod/ /ji ltar bdag nyid nags de bzhin/ /rtag 7pa nyid du gtor ma sbyin/ /mtshan mo thun gcig 1meganas pa ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mnyes par bya/ /gtor ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ sharga ti ka sa ne nā kā 6)ro mu 80—544

khaṃ sar+pā dharmā tsā ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta0)/ sa ni yongs su gzung ②dus su/ /bgegs ni skyod par byed pa'i sngags/ /oṃ a na sa ta na na ṭa stiṣ+ṭha ①ya ma bā ru na ⑤ku be ra ka swā tsā s+tha ṇi ṣā skal can 'gyur/ / skyes pa ①bud med dag gi ②ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas ni thob par 'gyur/ / e yi (gumatshan ma la lhung na/ /dgra dang rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / /lus can rkun pos gzir 'gyur zhing / /nad dang rims kyis thebs (gepar 'gyur/ / o yi (snyematshan ma la bab na/ /gnas kyi dbang po ⑥'gyur ba dang / /nor dang 'bru ni rnyed 'gyur zhing / /yid 'ong rig pa de bzhin no/ / au yi (7)mtshan ma la bab na/ /'thab mo dang ni dgras 'tshe zhing / /gnas las nyams dang brdeg 'tshog dang / /byas pa chud ni zos par 'gyur/ /yi ge i la bab gyur na/ /bran bzang (7dag ni rnyed 'gyur zhing / /bu dang rig pa rnyed 'gyur te/ /de bzhin grogs po rnyed par 'gyur/ /ji ltar sngon gyi a zhes pa/ /de bzhin tha ma'ang gzung bar bya/ /drug 'gyur du ni bzhag 6)nas su / /lnga pa de ni sum 'gyur bya/ /sum brgya drug cu bsres nas ni/ /sa bzhin du ni bcad nas su/ /yi ge lhag ma bzung byas te/ / dge dang mi dge mtshan par bya/ /7yang na ri mo kyag kyog (1byi/ /dbyangs 7kyi dang po la sogs bgrang / /yang na me tog gtor nas ni/ /de bzhin sa ni mtshon par bya/ /snga dro ro hi ta dus su/ /bden pa thams cad blta bar bya/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos rab tu bsngags/ /bdag gi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba ste dang po'o// // ye shes de ni bye brag dag /bcom ldan 'das la nyan par 'tshal/ byu/lus kyi mtshan ma ji lta bu/ /de nyid gang la brten par bgyi/ /lus kyi mtshan ma ston pa rnams/ /nyon cig rdo rje rgyal po che/ /lus kyi mtshan ma mngon bstan 80—558

gyis / /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab par gnas/ /dbugs ni rnam par rgod tsam gyis/ /lus can zla ba drug gis 'chi/ /'jigs pa cung zad mthong min par/ /'gram pa'i mtshams 6)ni bye ②'gyur ①na / /de tshe dus la bab par 'gyur/ /dbugs ni chad cing chad gyur pal/ /snga dro ⑧ro hi ta dus su/ /mtshan ma dag ni brtag ⑥par bya/ /sna yi bar ni chad gyur na/ /nyi ma bdun na gdon mi za/ /mig gi chu ni chad gyur (7)na/ /de bzhin nyi ma lnga yis 'chi/ /'gram pa'i logs kyi mtshan ma (7yis/ /zhag gcig las ni 6)mi 'tsho'o⑩/ /rna ba'i chol zangs 6)ltebs pa yis/ /chu tshod lnga na gdon mi za/ /'dir ni lce yi thig nag gisakyi/ /lus can zhag gnyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /steng 'og so ni 'thams pa na/ /zhag gsum 'chi bdag phrad par 'gyur/ /mgrin pa'i logs kyi phyi rol mas/ /zla ba phyed na gdon mi za/ /brang gi dra ba zhom gyur na/ /zla phyed sman pas gsor mi rung / /sen mo khrag ni med pa yis/ /lus can nyi ma brgyad na 'chi/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma brgyad bcas pa/ /'chi ba'i dus bab mtshon par bya/ /sna yi bar sha chad pa la/ /ye shes sa bon gyis gzir bya/ /mig gi chu ni chad pa la4ste/ /rdo rje ma yi sa bon gzung / / mkhur tshos yilogs kyi mtshan ma la/ /drag mo'i sa bon gzir bar bya/ /rna ba'i chol zangs 8zhum pa la/ /ro langs ma yi sa bon dgod/ /lce yi thig nag 'di la ni/ /gtum mo'i sa bon bsam par bya/ /so dang so ni 'thams pa la/ /seng ge ma yi sa bon brdeg /mgrin pa'i logs kyi phyi rol rtsa//stag mo'i sa bon brdeg par bya/ /brang gi dra ba zhom pa la/ /ce 7spyang sa bon gzung bar bya/ /lag pa'i sen khrag med pa la/ /'ug pa ma yi sa bon 80—559

gzung / /'chi hu)ltas (kyeyan lag mtshan ma ni/ /sa bon de dag dgod pas bsrung ③/ /phyi nas ④ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /bri ba'i cho gas rnam shes bsrung ⑤/ /ma bsregs 6)kham phor gnyis bzung la/ /gur gum ro tsa na yis ni/ /'og gi cha ⑦ni re mig dgu/ /de bzhin steng la bcu gnyis bya/ /dbus su ming ni bris nas su/ /sa bon gyis ni mngon par bskor/ /phyag 'tshal dbyangs (9kyi dang po ste / /bsrung ba'i tshig ni 5)sngon du bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga sogs ldan pa yi/ /sa bon mtha' ru gnas pa ste/ /sreg 7byed yi ge de yi (nyamatha'/ /steng sogs myu tsokhyud dbyangs yig dgod/ /kha ba gnyis 'gyur sa bon dang / /lha mo rdo rje ma zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yin kyisnyes bon ldan/ /thams cad phyag 'tshal sreg byed mtha' / /dbyug pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon/ /gya gyu phyag na rdo rje yin/ /de bzhin lus ni 'jam pa'i mchog /mgo dang yidapung pa byams pa ste/ /steng du 'bar ba ma yig 97ste/ /'khor ba thams cad sgrol byed pa'o/ /de la shar gyi phyogs gnas pa/ /lha mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du drag mo zhes bya ba'i / /sa bon nyid ni sbyar bar bya/ /nub kyi phyogs su gnas pa ni/ /ro langs ma yi sa bon sbyar/ /lho yi phyogs su gang gnas pa/ /gtum mo'i sa bon rdzogs par bstan / /sa bon mngon du bstan pa bzhin/ /dbang ldan du ni seng ge ma/ /me mtshams stag mo dgod bya ste/ /bden bral du ni ce 7spyang ma/ /rlung du hūṃ byed 'ug pa mo/ /mtshams na gnas pa'i sa bon ni/ /bzhi po'i drug hunyepo'i dngos su ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ji bzhin du/ /de bzhin sa bon dgod par bya/ /steng gi gnas ni khrinabacu gnyis la/ /dbyangs kyi sa bon gzhag par bya/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg pa mtha' dang bcas/ /phyogs su ma ning gzhag 80—560

par bya/ /'bar ma 'jib ma zhes bya dang / /de bzhin 'phrog byed mkha' 'gro ma / /phyag 'tshal sreg pa 5)mthar gnas pa/ /ji lta'i gnas bzhin gzhag par bya / /shar phyogs mkha' 'gro ma yi gnas/ /byang du gnas pa 'bar ma ste/ /nub tu 'jib mar yang dag gsungs/ /lho ru 'phrog byed dgod par bya/ /dbus su ming ni bri bya ste/ /'og tu ji bzhin steng de bzhin/ /gnyi ga kha ni sbyar nas su/ /skud pa dmar pos (5)dkri bar bya/ /kun nas mnyam pa'i gnas su ni/ /tsan+dan dmar pos byugs nas ((su/ /sna tshogs me tog bdug pa dang //drir bcas nyer spyod gtor ma byinago/ /dbus su 'khrul 'khor bzhag nas ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor bar bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje can sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag ⑤ces brjod/ /rdo rje lag ni lag rtse ru(6)/ /rdo rje bsams nas reg byas ⑦la/ /dbus su bstan pa'i sa bon ni/ /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas par bya/ /tshe rabs snga ma'i sdig la sogs/ /lha la sogs la bsgo bar (shebya / /yan lag thams cad gzir ba dang / /'chi ba'i dus bab 'byung mi 'gyur / /'tshe (9)med nad ni thams cad dang / /nad pa glor gzhag sbyar na ni/ /dus rnams kun tu nad mi 'byung / /lus can tshe ni zad pa yang / /zla ba drug tu gnas par 'gyur/ /gnas gzhan du ni bzhag nas su/ /rtag tu mchod la brtson par bya/ /rdo rje'i yirgya 41)ldan sbyor ba yis/ /rnam shes gang du'ang 'gro mi 'gyur / /gzhan yang bdag gi dbugs dag ni/ /der ni rab tu brtag par bya / /dbugs kyi gnas ni mtshungs spyi pa na/ /thams cad grub par gsungs pa yin / /g.yas la tu g.yas su gnas pa dang / /blo ldan g.yon la g.yon du gnas / /der gnas na ni smra byed pa/ /thams cad 'grub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /80—561

dbugs dang 'dri ba mi mthun 6)pa/ /dngos grub ring ba mtshon par bya/ /skad cig srog gi ②rab sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba gnyis ni shes bya ste/ /skad cig la ni bya ba kun/ /rgyas par 'gyur bar rab tu grags/ /srog la bya ba gang byas pa/ /grub pa ring bar the tshom ①med/ /mche ba la sogs bsams nas dug /der ni gso ④ba dag tu bya/ /sbyor sogs sngar gyi mtshan nyid can/ /thams cad rig pas klu la bsgo/ /sbyor ba bzhi la sos (snyebatab pa/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba the tshom med / /dug bsdu ba yi (7sbyor ba yis/ /gzhan ma thams cad gso bar bya/ /sos btab lus la kun rig pas/ /sa bon gyis ni dgod par dgod/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sngags dag ni/ /yan lag brgyad po ⑦rnams su dgod/ /kha dog dkar po bsams pa yi(kyi/ /sa bon rnams kyis yid dug dbrog /dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pa yis6)/ /ye shes kyis ni rnam shes bcing ⑩ yan lag bsgyur ba'i sbyor byas nas/ /de 'og phyi rol brtsam par bya/ /chu dang 'o ma bsres (1pa yis/ /sa snod yongs su dgang bar yonyebya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan tunyepa'i/ /dbus su pad+ma bsam par bya/ /gdugs dkar po yis brgyan pa yi / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma de bsgomatso/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung 7bcas/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' 6)bklubs/ /klu brgyad kyi ni mgo bo bsnams(she / /pad+ma yi ni gdan la mnan/ /shar du nor rgyas bu bsam bya de bzhin byang du 'jog po'o/ /nub tu stobs kyis rgyu ba ste/ /lho ru pad+ma blta bar bya / /dbang ldan du ni pad+ma che/ /me mtshams su ni dung skyong ()ngo / /bden bral rigs 3 )ldan zhes bya ba/ /rlung mtshams 'khyil pa ltung ba'o/ /klu brgyad po 80—562

ni bsams nas su/ /mgo bo rnams ni mnan par bsgom/ /rdzas rnams kun gyis mchod nas su/ /me tog spos sogs gtor ma 6)sbyin/ /bdag nyid lha yi ②rnal 'byor ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ru bsam/ /rma bya sgro yi chun po yis/ /chu yi sbyor bas drang bar bya / /kun nas rkang ④par drangs nas su/ /rkang pa nas ni chur thim bya/ /o hrī ṭas (snyer hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpar mngon sbyor bas/ /'bum phrag la sogs bsnyen pa bya/ /o bā su ki ri trī ṭas ra 6)rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐ tshuphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa ka trī ṭas phyir swā hā/ oṃ /rko ṭa ka trī ṭas ⑨ra swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma trī ṭas yir swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma trī ṭa:: 4nyar swā hā / oṃ shaṃ kha pā la hrī ṭas tusher swā hā/ oṃ bh+yo tunyeku li kā ya lo trī ṭas rdzir swā hā / o hu lun+da ke trī ṭas tsor swā hā/ o trī ṭas yir hūm̐ hūm̐ tsū phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa a mu ka chasu nir bi shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / 'o ma'i dbus su drangs pa yis/ /'phral du 'o ma nag hunyepor 'gyur/ / yungs mar (peme tog dkar po dang / /tsan+dan dag gis bsres pa yis/ /'chi bas zin pa'i snying ga ( )ru/ /gsang sngags zlos shing brdeg par bya/ /snying ni 'phar ma thag tu yang / /ye shes bsdams te bsrung ( nyabar bya/ /rnam shes bsdams pa tsam gyis kyang / /de bzhin dbugs ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /dbugs ni rnam par g.yos pa yis/ /bdag gi ( nadabugs kyis gzir bar bya/ /dbugs kyis gzir ma thag tu yang / /rkang lag la sogs 'dar bar 'gyur/ /yan lag thams cad 'dar ba na/ /bdag nyid dbyangs ni blang bar bya/ /hūm̐ gi glu ( nani blangs nas su/ /se gol gsum gyis bslang bar bya/ /'chi bas zin pa bslang nas ni/ / de yi ( steyan lag bsrung bar bya/ /bsdus nas klu yi nisnyeganas su ni/ /80—563

'o ma de ni dbo bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpar mngon sprul hu)la/ /'bum phrag gsum ni bzlas pa yis(mi/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /de nas sgrub (mipos dug bsdus na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /kha dang thig le gnyis dag dang / /steng ④dang mgrin pa sna rtse dang / /snying ga (5)lte ba gsang ba dang / /rkang pa'i mthe (6)bo dag tu ni/ /zin pa gso bar mi bya ste/ /'chi ba nyid kyi rgyu ru gsungs/ /nyon cig rgyal po rdo rje che/ /char pa dbab pa'i cho ga mchog /chu 'gram dang ⑦ni nye ba yig/ /sa phyogs nyams ni dga' ba ru/ /bla re dag ni bres nas su/ /dar dpyangs yo)sna tshogs dpyangs yipa ru/ /kha dog sna lngar ⑩btsos pa yi/ /tshon gyi las ni brtsam par 7bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /klu brgyad kyis ni rnam par bklubs(/ste / /mgo bo gnyis ni sgor yibacas te/ /mjug tsom gnyis kyis grwa ru ⑩mdud / /shar du rgyal ba bzang po ste/ dpal dang dga' bo byang du'o/ /nub tu char 'bebs sdug pa ste/ /brtan dang drag po lho ru'o/ /klu brgyad kyi ni ra ba ste/ /phyogs la sogs par rigs brgyad dgod/ /nor rgyas bu ni shar du ste//'jog po byang du dgod par bya/ /nub kyi phyogs su stobs kyis 6)rgyu/ / lho yi (nyephyogs su pad+ma ste/ /dbang ldan du ni pad+ma che/ /me mtshams dung skyong dgod par bya/ /bden bral du ni rigs ldan te/ /rlung mtshams 'khyil ba ltung ba'o/ /sprin gyi dbang phyug rgyal po brgyad/ /phyogs brgyad nas ni dgug par bya/ /sgra sgrogs rmugs pa de bzhin du/ /drag po 'khyil pa stug 6)po dang / /gtum po char 'bebs rab gang ba/ /brgyad po rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dgod pa/ /ji bzhin phyogs kyi mdog tu bsam/ /dbus su rdo rje 80—564

mkha' 6)'gro ma/ /pad+ma'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs/ /sku mdog dkar po shin tu 'bar/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' bsnams/ /pad+ma sprul gyis bskor ②nas su/ /sbrul ni gdan du sbyar bar bya/ /mchod pa rgya chen bshams nas ni/ /'o ma la sogs snod brgyad bzhag /me tog bdug ①sogs 4)dri dang ni/ /mar me sna tshogs rig pas (snyemachod/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag bsgom ⑥pa'i/ /ye shes can gyi rnal 'byor pa'i/ /oṃ byurgyu ba swā hā/ nye bar ④spyod pa'i sngags so / /oṃ bā su ki hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ta k+ṣa ka hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ /rko ṭa (8)rtsu swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma rtsu swā hā/ o shaṃ kha pā 5)la ju swā hā/ oṃ ku li sha pā tshul hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ hu lun+ta tunyertsu swā hā/ klu'i yonyergyal po brgyad kyi sngags kyiso/ /oṃ ghi li ghi li/ bar+sha bar+ṣa pa 8ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ ṭha ṭha ṭha swā hā/sprin gyi rgyal po brgyad kyi sngags so/ /lag pa kun tu bskor nas su/ /phyogs brgyad du ni bstan par bya/ /sprin gyi rgyal po brgyad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs tsonas su/ /mthe'u chung dang mthe bong brgyadabya/ /g.yas pa sbrul mgo gdengs nas su/ /mthe bong steng du gung mor 7sbyar/ /klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ bsgo bar+sā 9/༄pa ya hūm̐ phu swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag ni/ /gsum du byas nas bzlas pa bya/ /rnal 'byor can gyi las 'di rnams/ /char 'bebs pa yi cho ga mchog /gzhan yang dge dang sdig pa yi/ /pho nya'i mtshan ma bshad par bya/ /mig yon hu)mgo dkar skur po dang / /'jigs pa'i gos dang dbyug pa thogs/ /bud med rnams sum̐ )dang 'grogs te sage'ong / /ngu zhing skra ( rteni lhug ( )pa sogs/ /80—565

gcer bu ngan gyis 0)smra ba dang / /sbyor bzhis 'chi ba ston pa yin/ /pho nya ji bzhin bdag nyid la/ /brtags (snyenas rnam pa gnyis su bya/ /de tshe sngags pa 'grogs 'dod na/ /grub pa nyams par the tshom med/ /bdag gi gdan gyi nirab tu byed pa zhes bya ba las rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// //rnal 'byor brtson pa'i khyad par dag /bcom ldan 'das la nyan par 'tshal / /gang gis sngags rnams 'tshal bar bgyibu/ /ye shes gzung ba ji ltar lags/ /nyon cig rdo rje de kho na/ /de bzhin lha yi (gyebadag nyid do/ /dang por stong nyid bsgoms pa yis/ /lus can dri ma bkru bar bya/ /dang po ⑥gzugs ni stong sogs bya/ /ji srid bcwa 9)brgyad nyid yin te/ /gzugs khams zhes bya stong pa ste/ /de nyid du ni sgra yang bya/ /dri khams zhes bya nistong pa ste/ /de nyid du ni ro /yang bya/ /reg bya'i khams ni stong pa ste/ /de nyid du ni gzugs kyang bya/ /mig gi bdag nyid stong pa la/ /dbus na rnam shes ji ltar yod/ /nyan pa'i bdag nyid stong pa la/ /dbus na rnam shes ji ltar yod//mnam tshipa'i bdag nyid stong pa la/ /dbus na rnam shes ji ltar yod/ /lce yi bdag nyid stong pa la/ /dbus na rnam shes ji ltar yod/ /lus kyi bdag nyid stong pa la/ /dbus na rnam shes ji ltar yod/ /yid kyi rang bzhin stong pa la/ /dbus na ji ltar brtag par bya/ /yid ni nam mkha' 9/nyethim nas su/ /thams cad stong par bsam 1 par bya/ /gling dang ri rab la sogs pa/ /steng dang 'og dang bar gyi ni/ /khams gsum stong par bsgoms pa yis thams cad zad pa 12nyid du bya/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /gzugs la 80—566

sogs pa zad par bsgom/ /bdag gi dngos po zad bya ste/ /dngos po 'dres ①par dmigs par bya/ /sbyor ba mnyam par kun bsams te/ /rnal 'byor pa ni mkhas pa yis/ /mnyam nyid stong par bsams nas su/ /de yi dbus su bltas nas kyang / /de la mtshan ma brtag par bya/ /mar me'i 'od kyis zhi ba stel/ /ser po dngul gyis rgyas par 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba ni/ /chags pa la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /mthar ni du ba gnag mthong na/ /mngon spyod du ni rab tu grags/ /rlung gi mdog ltar 'khrugs pa yis/ /de yi mod la bskrad par 'gyur/ /zla ba dkar po'i ②'od zer ltar/ /thams cad du ni dkar mthong nas/ /rnal 'byor grub par shes par bya/ /blo ldan 'gro ba'i yang dag gnas/ /de 'og rnal 'byor las byung ba'i/ /myu gu la sogs mngon par bsam/ /gang zhig stong shes bsgom pa yig/ /myur du sems dpa' grol bar 'gyur/ /ye shes kyis ni shes bya blta/ /shes byas 'gro ba brtag par bya/ /pha dang ma ni bsad ④bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang ⑤ma gnyis bzung nas/ /rgyal po yul 'khor bcas bcom na(6)/ /mi de dag par 'gyur zhes bya/ /bdag gi gdan gyi rab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba gsum pa'o// //nyon cig rdo rje ji bzhin lam/ /gnyis spangs gnyis su med pa ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor rab 'jigs pas/ /chu yi dgra ni dam pas gang / /dbus su bying ba'i lus can rnams/ /sgrol ba'i mtshan nyid ces ④byar brjod/ /mtshon byas mtshan nyid mtshon pa po(kye/ /rnam shes kyis 6)ni ye shes te/ /ye shes kyis ni shes bya blta/ /shes byas 'gro ba brtag par bya/ /'gro ba brtags 80—567

pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin mngon par 'gro/ /zhags pas glang chen myos bcings ltar/ /'khor ba'i zhags pas ①gnod rmongs pas/ /rnal 'byor pa ni stong phrag gcigayonas /tshe rabs snga ma'i 'gro bar 'gro/ /sngon du mtshan nyid bstan pa bzhin/ /mnyam nyid stong par bsams nas su/ /stong pa'i zhing la sogs lus la/ /blo dang ldan pas sa bon gdab/ /dper na gdol pa'i khang pa mer bsregs (gupa/ / lha yi ④byin gyis brlabs par rab tu brjod / /rigs can dge dang mkhas pa kun du gnas/ /de bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis kun bshig 95nyenas/ /sa bon dgod pas rab tu dgod par bya/ /steng du me yi (6kyis bon brtag / sa yi nya7)sa bon rnam pa gnyis/ /mig gnyis su ni sbyar bar bya/ /stong sogs rlung gi sa bon ni/ /sna dang rna ba dag la bsam/ /bdud rtsi'i 98)chu yi sa bon ni/ /lce yi dbang po dbang phyug gtso/ /gang gis brtsegs pa rim bzhin gzung (9)/ /gnas bzhi ru ni sbyar bar bya/ /mgrin par gti mug sa bon te/ /de bzhin dpung par nyon mongs so/ /snying ga'i ( )phyogs su g.yo ba ste/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar phyug 67yin no/ /yan lag brgyad du sa bon ni/ /brgyad po bkod pas bsrung bar bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gror bdag byas te/ /lus ni sa bon ldan par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa/ /pad+ma yi ni stan 12la bzhugs/ /gdugs ni dkar pos steng du g.yogs/ /btso ma'i gser ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung 1miyang dag bzhugs/ /steng du rdo rje dbu rgyan can/ /dar gyi thod ni mdzes par bcings/ /spyan gsum khro zhing bzhad pa ste/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /ral gri dgra sta rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa'i sdigs 'a)mdzub 80—568

nyid dang ni/ /shasti kha ṭ+wāṃ bsgreng 6)ba ni/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya mngon par bsnams / /sangs rgyas sprin ni 'phros pa yis/ /sems can rnams kyi don mdzad brtson(mi/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba ru/ /dbugs mi g.yo bar bsgom par bya/ /yid kyi ye shes rnam shes dag /shel dang 'dra bar bsam par bya/ /ā li kā (geli rab sbyor bas/ / de yi (4)sa bon bzung byas te/ /smin par thigs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /ye shes can gyi sa bon bsgom(5)/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis brgyan pa yi4)/ /yi ge'i sa bon bzlas par bya/ /rlung dang me yi mdun 9)don la/ /rdo rje me yi sa bon bskul(3)/ /sgra dang thig les yang dag mnan / /char pa'i rgyun zhes bya ba (9)brjod/ /thog mar bla ma'i yi ge gzhag /sreg byed yi ge mthar bzlas bya/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa yi/ /blo gros can gyis sum kyi'abum bzla/ /bzlas dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yis bsam (1tshopa thams cad 'grub/ /las brgyad la sogs dngos grub rnams/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /de 'og las rnams brtsam nyurtabyas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir tunyeni the tshom med/ /rmongs par bya ba'i bye brag ni/ /nyon cig rdo rje de kho na/ / bcings pa yinams kyi bye brag dag /sngon du rdo rje'i tshig brjod la / /sde tshan dang po'i dang po bzung / /de bzhin sde tshan bzhi pa yi/ /yi 'ige dang po bzung nas ni/ /nyis 'gyur re pha steng du gzhag /de bzhin i dang re phar sbyar/ /gang zhig sde tshan gnyis pa yi/ /yi ge gnyis pa thig le can/ /lcags kyu yis ni gzir bar bya/ /bzhi pa yi ni gsum par bcas/ /lan gnyis su ni bzlas par bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis brgyan pa dang / /sngon du phyag 'tshal yi ge ste/ /yi ge drug po mtha' ru sbyar/ /sa bon 'di bzlas rnal 'byor 80—569

pas / /dngos po thams cad bcing bar 'gyur/ /lag gnyis sor mo bsnol nas ni/ /de nyid bza' ba lta bur sbyar/ /khro bo 6)dang ni dbu ma brkyang ②/ /gnyis ka phan tshun drud par bya/ /'di ni chen po'i phyag rgya ste/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ②ba 'khrug dgra yi mgrin pa la sogs pa/ /dngos po thams cad yid kyis rol/ /de nas chu la sogs pa kun/ /rab tu bcing ba bshad ④par bya/ /gang yang sde tshan tha ma ni/ /yi ge gsum pa gzung bar bya de bzhin sde tshan gsum pa yi/ /yi ge gsum pa nyid dang ni/ / de yi ⑤sa bon gsum pa la/ /steng du e zhes bya bar sbyar/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i dang po la/ /lcags kyu yis ni gzir bar bya/ /gsum pa chu yi sa bon dang / /tsheg drag yi ge dbus byas te(ye/ /mtha' ma rdo rje can dang sbyar/ /re pha glo na lcags kyu can / /mtha' ni drag po'i (7)yi ge dang / /dang por phyag 'tshal gzhag par bya/ /bcing ba yi ni sngags su grags/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas su/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya/ /mthe ⑧bo gnyis ni dbus su sbyar/ /de nyid du ni mthe chung sbyar/ /rgod khyim kha yi phyarge rgya 'di / /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ /phyogs bcu'i gnas su 'bar ba yis / /sprin gyi lha tshogs sreg par byed/ /char pa bcing la sogs dus su/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sbyar bar bya/ /sgrub pos 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /bdag gi gdan zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa thab:ni tshogartse(// // —lha yi gzugs ni ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das las nyan par 'tshal zhi 80—570

ba'i sbyin sreg la sogs dang / /gtor ma ldan pa ji ltar lags/ /gzugs sogs bsam pa rtse gcig pa/ /nyon cig rdo rje de kho na/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sbyin sreg gi6)/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan bsgom pa rnams/ /sngon du me yi las (misogs la/ /blo ldan bzlas pa shes par bya/ /sa ni sbyangs ma thag tu yang / /stegs bu'i mtshan nyid 'bad de bya/ /sor brgyad lhag ni yan chad dug / /khru gang tsam nas brtsams nas su/ /ji snyed khru stong bar du gzung 4)/ /brgyad pa dgra ni 'joms pa ste/ /de bzhin bcu pas rgyas par 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis pas ni dbang du sdud/ /bcu bzhis de bzhin zhi ba nyid/ /mtheb (9sor bcu drug tshad kyis ni/ /rigs rnams mngon par 'phel bar byed/ / mtheb sor bcwa 6)brgyad gnas kyis ni/ /ba lang rigs sogs mngon par 'phel/ /thab khung sor ni nyi shu pas/ /grong khyer dang ni yul 'khor zhi/ /rgyar ni cha gsum bgos pa las/ /cha gnyis su ni brko bar bya/ /brkos pa yi ni brgyad cha yis / /khung bu yi ni kha khyer bya/ /kha khyer gyi ni phyed pa yis/ /phyi rol gyi ni mu khyud bya/ /mu khyud cha brgyad ldan pa la/ /pad+ma'i 'dab (7)de cha brgyad bya/ /pad+ma yi ni phyi rol du/ /sor gcig pa yi (gyer ba bya/ /thab khung nang du rdo rje rnams / /pad+ma'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /mngon spyod la ni gru gsum ste/ /zhi ba la ni gru bzhi'o/ /kun nas zlum po dbang du sdud(ltar/ /rgyas pa la yang de bzhin no/ /bskrad 7la zla ba phyed pa ste/ /dgug dang bcing la zur brgyad pa'o / / rim gyis rim gyis tu sbyar bar bya/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang sogs rnams / /sangs rgyas lnga yi mtshan ma nyugernams/ /ji bzhin phyogs su dgod par bya / /kha khyer gyi 5)ni gnas bzhi ru/ /sangs rgyas mtshan mas brgyan par bya/ /80—571

zla phyed rdo rjes shin tu mdzes/ /grwa dang grwa ru rnam par gzhag /ji bzhin stan gyi gnas su yang / /mtheb 6)sor bcu gnyis dag dang ni/ /dpangs su khru phyed ldan pa yi/ /ti se'i gangs ni mdzes par gzhag /'dab ②ma brgyad kyi gnas rnams su/ /lha mo rnams ni rim bzhin dgod/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de yi tshad/ /khyad par du ni sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ hi li hi li ki ③li be tā ④yi hūm̐ phaṭa/nye bar spyod pa'i sngags so/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ⑤bsgom pa yis/ /rang gi lus ni bsrung yibar bya/ /bdag gi yan lag brgyad po ru/ /thams cad bkod pas bsrung bya ste/ /lce la chu ni 9)nyid dang ni/ /nam mkha' rna ba sna dag la/ /sa ni (nyamig tu sbyar bar bya/ /de bzhin me ni tshangs pa la/ /mgrin par 6)rmongs pa'i ded dpon te/ /g.yo ba snying la gnas pa'o/ /nyon mongs thong ka kun tu'o/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar phyugs yin no/ /yan lag brgyad kyis bsrung ⑩ba 'di / /lha rnams su ni shes byas la/ /ba dan gsum gyi phyag rgya yis/ /yan lag brgyad du gtugs te bsrung snyoste/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bdag nyid du/ /bdag nyid lus ni sprul byas te/ /kun+da 6)zla ba ltar dkar zhing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs1snye/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dhiphyag gnyis pa/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' mnabasasnyi/ /phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje ste/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba kun tu gsal/ /rang gi lus ni mnyam bzhag pas/ /dbugs mi g.yo bar bsgom par bya/ /de nas sa ni sbyang bya ste/ /oṃ ha na ha na kro dha ⑩rlu phaṭa/lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ( 〉byas te/ /rdo rjer 6nyebasgoms nas sa la bsnun/ /sa sbyangs pa'i (7sngags dang phyag rgya'o )/ /lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbyar te/ /gung mo gnyis brkyang kun tu bstan( nya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni dag byed pa'o( gye/ /oṃ shrī rngo sheg hā/80—572

mar sbyang ①ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a ②swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzi (9swā hā/ 'bru sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zas mchog la sogs pa'i rdzas sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a swā hā/ yam shing sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /me dbus pad+ma bsams nas su/ /me yi lha ni dgug par ④bya/ /g.yon pa khu tshur bcings nas su/ /khro bo dang ni dbu ma brkyang ⑤/ /dbu ma'i tshigs ni gsum pa la/ /khro bo bsams te btsugs pas dgug /oṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha (6)asne dzaḥswā hā/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ru/ /thab khung dbus su bsgom par bya/ /bgrang phreng spyi blugs bu ram mdogatso) /ral pa'i thor tshugs ser skyar ldan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' bklubs/ /'od zer me ltar kun tu 'bar / /me yi dbus su bsgom par bya/ /der ni ji ltar 'byor pa dang / /dngos po lnga yis mchod nas su/ /me dbus me lha'i lce la ni/ /kun nas sreg blugs gsum gsum bya/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas su/ /pad+ma'i tshul du cung zad dbye/ /dbu ma kun tu brkyang bar bya/ /oṃ dzu hu (7dzu hu asne swā hā/me'i snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'bad pas se gol gsum/ /gtogs nyapas 'bar bar thim par bsgom/ / me yi yiganas su kun rig pas/ /de nas sbyang ba brtsam par bya/ /oṃ hūm̐ ṭa ṭi 4)rtsu phaṭa/ rdo rjer tsobacas pa'i lag pa yis/ /me tog yungs kur chu yis ni/ /phyogs kun tu ni gtor tunyenas su / / me yi nang 'du blugs 8par bya/ /sbyang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mā kā yir r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lag g.yon thal mo phar bstan te/ /g.yas pa tshur bstan rgyab sbyar nas/ /dbang ldan phyogs sogs bskor bar bya/ /ra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas su/ /phan tshun rtse mo reg 80—573

par bya/ /oṃ rdzu 6)swā hā/ rdo rje ②dra ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'og/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs ④nas su/ /mthe bong 'og tu brkyang bar bya/ /oṃ rbu swā hā/phur bu'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa'i/ /me dbus pad+ma bsams nas su/ /gdugs dkar po yis ⑤g.yogs pa yi/ /rdo rje dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa ste/ /kha dog dmar sogs bsam par bya/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba las/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni / /rdo rje'i gzugs su bskyed nas su/ /rang gi dbugs yilas byung ba yiX/ /sbyor ba'i gdan la byung ba yis(she/ /las kyi mdog tu bsgom par bya/ /phyag gnyis kha ṭī rdo rje bsnams/ /thams cad rgyan 0gyis rnam par bklubs/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni bskyed nas su/ /rang gi dbugs las byung ba yi/ /bdag gi ⑩lus ni gang yin la/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bstim par bya/ /me yi dbus su kun rig pas/ /sna tshogs dngos po mchod par bya/ /oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ dgang blugs kyi sngags so/ /g.yas su dbyug pa bsam par bya/ /de bzhin g.yon du snod ni sbyang (1/ /oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ba dang / /oṃ pra tīts+tsha su garnya tshis swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni dri'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /brkyang ba de nyid kyi mthe bong dang khro bo sbyar ba dang / /oṃ put+pa yo)mā le rtsu yiswā hā/ zhes bya ba ni me tog gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur de nyid las mthe 7bong brkyang ba dang / oṃ tīk+ṣa dī 7pe hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni mar me'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /me tog gi phyag rgya de nyid las dbu ma bsgreng yinyab dang / oṃ dhū lha be shwa ri hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni 9/)bdug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis ka brkyang ste mthe bong dang / gung mo bskyod pa 80—574

dang ske/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ba li 0)rgyu swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni gtor ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /me yi kha yi nang du ni/ /lan re bzlas shing lan re bzhin/ /dbus su gong bu bsreg par bya/ /bdun las lhag ma kun bzung nas/ /dbus su gong bu ran par ni/ /gong ②ma'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni/ /'bad de rdzogs pa'i mtha' ru ni/ /lhag ma dag ni bsreg par bya/ /bsreg pa zin nas lha rnams ni/ /bdag gi lus la thim par bsgom/ /dgang blugs nikun la rdzogs pa ru/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rdzogs par bya/ /snod ni mar gyis bkang nas su/ /me yi dbus su blugs nas kyang / /drangs stinas dbugs ni stongs 'gyur te/ /rang gi lus la thim par bya/ /de nas rang gi lus nyid du/ /mkhas pa yis duni bsgom par bya/ /dbus su me yi lha nyid ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsams nas kyang / /lhag ma lan gsum bsregs nas su/ /mchod de ⑥gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /bkra shis dbyangs ni blangs nas su/ /der ni phyag rgya sbyar bar bya/ /sbyin sreg las kyis 4)phye ba gzhan/ /mdor bsdus rgyas pa min par bshad/ /sā zhi)lu 'bras dang so ba dang / /til dkar po dang yungs mar ⑨dang / /nas dang drur yiba'i sa bon bcas/ /mar dang 'o mar bsres nas su/ /sbrang rtsi bsres pa'i 'o thug ni/ /khyad par du ni bsreg par bya/ /'o ma can gyi shing lnga las/ /sor mo bcu bzhir ldan pa'i tshad/ /zhi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ /bsreg pa'i cho ga'i ⑩mchog yin no/ /til nag po dang ma sha (snyedang / /sā rtso)lu dmar po'i zan dang ni/ /dri dang gur gum 'o ma ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir bsres 8pa dang / /mar dang ldan pa'i 'o thug dag /khyad par du ni bsreg par bya/ /'o ma can gyi shing lnga las/ /yam lishing sor bcu'i tshad dang bcas/ /80—575

gal te rgyas pa'i las 'dod na/ /sgrub pos khyad par bsreg par bya/ /til ni dmar dang gnag pa dang / /nā hu)ga ge sar pri yang kul/ /de bzhin ske ①tshe 'u su dang / /sbrang stirtsi dang ni mar (snyesar sbyar/ /thang shing dang ni n+ya gro dang / /klu shing dang ni ba sha ka /yam shing sor mo bcu gnyis pa/ /chags pa'i las la mchog yin no/ /til nag (6)po dang ma sha dang / /ba tshul ta ka nag chen 'bras//tsha ba'i mar nag khrag dang ni/ /bsres pa yis ni byugs pa dang / /lung tang shing dang sgur po'i shing / / ba lo (7ta ka ku li'i 6)shing / /yam shing sor brgyad pa yi tshad/ /mngon spyod las la rab tu grags/ / yungs kur mon ⑩sran gre'u dang se'u(ste/ /lam gyi rdul dang bsres pa dag /khrag dang kha ()ba'i mar nag gis/ /de 9/sheni bsgo bar rab tu gragasakyi/ /gser ⑩shing dang ni ba sha ma'i / /yam shing der ni bzung nas ni/ /de nyid las la bsreg bya ba/ /bskrad ⑩pa dag la rab tu grags/ /nya dang sha la sogs pa'i rdzas/ /bag phye 'bru rnams thams cad dag /khrag dang sbrang rtsis bsgos pa dang / /bya rog gi ni sgro dag dang / /bya rog tshang gi shing pu dang / /so shing 'chos nas bor ba ste / /'di dag bcing yo 7ba'i las rnams la/ /brtson dang ldan pas sbyor ba (nyebya//de nas gzhan yang khyad par du/ /sbyin sreg mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi yis/ /bsgos pa yi shri ba la ni/ /byang chub shing gi yam shing la/ /lnga brgya 46ru ni bsreg par bya/ /de yi dbus su mnyam bzhag 6 )nas / /smon lam btab ste rdo 7khrus byas na rta/ /rgyal srid nyams pa'ang myur du ni//sa gsum rgyal po dbang du 'gyur/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas/ /lo ta'i 69yam shing me la ni/ /brgya phrag brgya ru mngon bsregs na/ /shin tu myur bar 80—576

dpal ldan 'gyur/ /bya ba gang dang gang bsams pa/ /de 0)de thams cad 'dir 'grub 'gyur/ /de nas yongs gzung slob ma yiphyi/ /mtshan nyid dag ni bshad par bya/ /yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /dul zhing spyod pa zhi ba dang / /chos gsum la ni mngon par dad/ /theg pa che la rtag tu dga'/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi ⑧sbyor ba shes/ /bzo dang sgyu lirtsal thams cad mkhas/ /bsam gtan sbyor ba mngon par dga'/ /thos dang klog sogs gus dang bcas//dus rnams kun tu bla mar gus/ /sbyin sogs dge ba'i las la brtson/ /'dod la dga' ba ma yin zhing / /longs spyod la ni brten (5)pa min/ /khro dang nga rgyal med pa dang / /ngang tshul ngan min tshig rtsub ⑥min/ /sems can kun la smod ⑦pa dang / /lha dang bla ma de bzhin te/ /gdug sems can dang ngang tshul can/ /rtag tu sdig pa'i blo dang ldan/ /'khyal pa dang ni tshig rtsub smra/ /'di lta bu dag spang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi gdan gyi (sherab tu byed pa las rim par phye po)ba dang po'o// //chu yi sbyin sreg ji lta bu/ /lha las gzigs mo nyan par 'tshal/ /chu yi sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i/ /mtshan nyid dag ni ji ltar lags/ /chu sogs yang dag mtshan nyid rnams/ /nyon cig rdo rje de kho na/ /bla re dag ni bres tu )nas su / /sna tshogs gos rnams yonyerab tu dpyangs(mi/ /shin tu yangs shing gru bzhi par / /kun tu 6)dri yis yibyug par bya/ /dbus su chu yi snod sogs la/ /dri ni dkar pos byugs nas su/ /chu dang 'o mar bsres pa yis/ /snod ni mdzes par dag par bya/ /bum pa dag ni brgyad po yang / /phyogs brgyad dag tu 80—577

gzhag par bya/ /dri yi chu yis rab tu dgang / /kha ni shing lo sar pas brgyan/ /bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ru/ /skad cig gis ni bskyed nas su/ /me tog bdug spos dri sogs pa'i/ /dngos pos bdag nyid mchod byas pa'i/ /de 'og phyi rol gzhag pa yis0)/ /chu yi las rnams sbyar bar bya/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas su/ /pad+ma'i tshul du cung zad dbye/ /o ka ma le ste swā hā/ pad+ma'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa'i/ /pad+ma chu yi nang bkod la/ /gdugs dkar po yis g.yogs pa yi/ /sa bon dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rang gi dbugs las byung ba yi/ /sa bon las ni gzugs su bskyed / /sems dpa'i skyil krung ②phyag gnyis ldan/ /rgyan ①rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dbyug pa bsnams(ge/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /bzhad cing khro la sgeg dang bcas/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ / dam tshig phyag rgya sogs bstan zhing / /dam tshig sngags dang sbyar bar bya/ /lag gnyis phan tshun khu tshur bcings/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni brkyang nas su/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyis mdud par bya(snye/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha (6)rtsu phaṭa/ dam tshig gi sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /shar gyi bum pa rdo rje ma/ /byang du drag mo zhes bya ba/ /nub tu ro langs ma yin te / /lho phyogs su ni gtum mo gnas/ /seng ge zhes bya dbang ldan du/ /de bzhin me mtshams stag mo 'o/ /bden bral na ni ce (7)spyang mo/ /tsū byed 'ug pa rlung gi phyogs/ /so so so sor mtshan ma dang (gu/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar bstan par bya/ /rang gi gzugs kyi sku mdog ldan/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pa'o/ /me tog bdug spos dri la sogs/ /mkhas pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /rdo rje khu 80—578

tshur gnyis bcings la/ /g.yon pa snying gar hu)bzhag (snyenas su/ /g.yas pas steng nas dbub par bya/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /oṃ rdzu ①rgyu swā hā/rtsa ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /kun+da la sogs me tog dkar/ /rtse mor drur ba btsugs ④nas su/ /lha mo'i dbu steng (9rdo rje yi/ /cod pan la ni gtor bar bya/ /gsang sngags lan re bzlas nas su/ /lan re'i sbyor bas dbul bar bya/ /lan grangs khri yi las kyis ni/ /thams cad rig cing tshe 'phel 'gyur / /ka gyur bī tsora'i me tog dmar/ /drur (kyeb dang ni ldan pa yi9)/ /las ni khri phrag byas pa yis/ /khyim rnams zhi bar rab tu grags/ / nā ga put+pa'i ⑩yam shing gi/ /'o mar spags te dbul bar bya/ /las 'di khri phrag byas pa yis/ /grong ni zhi bar byed par 'gyur/ /pad+ma yi (1ni yam shing rnams/ /khri phrag du ni bzlas nas su/ /las rnams kun la sbyar byas na/ /yul phyogs zhi bar byed par 'gyur/ /pri yaṅku dang bil ba dang / /de bzhin ut+pal ku mu tatso//rgyal po'i las la sogs sbyar nas/ /pha rol yul 'khor 'joms par 'gyur/ /sngags pas rtag tu skyor chu gtor/ /bye brag tu ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi gdan gyi tunyerab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// //'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol mtshan nyid/ /nyon cig rdo rje rgyal chen po/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /dag dang ma dag rab tu spangs/ /dngos po gnyis ni rab spangs pas/ /gnyis med chos zhes 8bya ba ste/ /gzugs stong thog mar mthar thug dang / /dbu ma mnyam par gnas pa'o/ /dag dang ma dag dbu ma ni/ /'ba' zhig gis ni mnyam par blta/ /bsten 80—579

dang bsten med dbu ma yi/ /mnyam nyid ye shes las byung ba/ /lus ni mnyam par gnas pa ste/ /ngag kyang (1)mnyam par gnas nas su/ /mnyam nyid ye shes las byung bas/ /mnyam pa'i lta bas blta (gebar bya/ /mnyam pa'i lta ba ji lta bu / /bcom ldan 'das la nyan par 'tshal/ /gnyis med chos zhes ①bgyi ba yi / /bdag nyid ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /gnyis med ye shes mtshan nyid ni/ /ji bzhin de nyid rdo rjes ④nyon/ /dngos po gnyis ni rab spangs la/ /ye shes can gyis gnyis med chos/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi thog ma ru/ /dag pa rnam gsum brjod par bya/ /o swa 95ḍiṅgā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā 6rwasu bhā ba shurnyo3rta/ oṃ ⑦badz+ra shud+dhaḥsasba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3rta(8)/ oṃ 6)yo ga shud+dhaḥsasba dharmā ⑩yo ga shurnyo3heyi/bla med nyid du bya ba'i phyir/ /thal mo sbyar nas de dag brjod/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs kyi/ /gnas dag tu ni brten nas su/ /bla re dag ni bre (gebar bya / /sna tshogs gos ni dbyangs 32nas su/ /ba dan rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar bya / g.yer ka yidra bas mdzes byas la/ /gnas bcu dag ni kun tu yang / /de bzhin dri yi dkyil 'khor bya/ /skad cig rnal 'byor tshul gyis ni/ /rang gi lus ni bsam par bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bzung nas ni/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par lobya/ /lag pa gan rkyal bzhag nas su/ /der ni rdo rje brtag par bya/ /gnas lnga dag tu bstim par bya/ /sa 'og tu ni sbyang bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal 'joms pa'i mtha' ldan pa'i/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba sbyar bar bya/ /lhun po'i steng du bsam bya ba/ /kha dog bzhi sogs ldan pa yiyi/ /gser las byung ba'i grong khyer ni/ /rin chen bdun la sogs pas spras/ /g.yer ku'i yonyedra ba'i phreng ba can/ /mnyam zhing ji ltar 'dod pas dbyangs(she/ /phyag rgya kun gyi thog 80—580

mar ni/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcing ①la /g.yon pa snying gar ②bzhag nas su/ /g.yas pa mchan khung gzhug par bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya shes par bya/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg pa'i mtha' ldan pa'i/ /ji ltar rdo rje chadangos sa bon/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /de bzhin dam tshig bstan par bya/ /seng ge'i gdan ni rnam pa lnga/ /gnas ldan byadag tu sbyar bar bya/ /nyi ma'i gdan ni bsams nas su/ /gdugs dkar po yis brgyan par bya/ /rang gi dbugs las byung ba yi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbus su bsam/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung (snyecan / /skra grol bas ni g.yogs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis mdzes par byartsi/ /kha dog sngon mo drag chen mo/ /sbrul gyi rgyan ⑦gyis rnam par bklubs⑤/ /bzhad dang khro dang sgeg pa yi/ /zhal gsum po ni spyan gsum po/ /ha har bzhad cing gtsigs pa ste/ /na bza' dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ gyen du bsgreng 6)ba dang / /gnyis pa na ni dgra sta nyid/ /gsum pa na ⑩ni rdo rje thogs / /g.yon pas dril bu sgra sgrogs shing / /gnyis pa na ni snod nyid de/ /gsum pas de bzhin ral gri 'phyar/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba ru/ /dbus su mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /ye shes kyi ni shar phyogs su/ /bdag gi chu las byung ba ste/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /skra grol ba (steni rnam par bklubs/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung (1bcas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ rnal 'byor snod/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bzas (gebaklubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ /ye shes kyi ni byang gi char/ /bdag gi me las byung ba yi/ /kha 80—581

dog ser po shin tu mdzes/ /sems dpa' yi ni skyil krung hu)can/ /skra grol bas ni shin tu brgyan/ /sprul gyi rgyan (bgyis rnam par bklubs/ /sku la na bza' mdzes pa mnabasal/ /phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ rnal 'byor snod/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo zhes bya bsgom/ /ye shes kyi ni nub phyogs char/ /bdag gi rlung las byung ba yi4)/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung (zhesacan/ /kha dog dmar po kun tu 'ong / /kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod (6)bsnams shing / /skra grol bas ni mdzes pa ste/ /lus kun sbrul gyi 7rgyan gyis brgyan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol / /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro ro langs ma bsgom bya/ /ye shes kyi ni lho yi char/ /sa yi ye shes las byung ba/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung (7can/ /kha dog sngon po shin tu mdzes/ /kha ṭī rnal 'byor snod bsnams (9)shing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs pa ste/ /skra ⑩grol bas ni shin tu mdzes/ /ha har rgod 11pas 'jigs par mdzad/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro gtum mo zhes byar bsgom/ /bdag dngos lnga las 3 byung ba yi(rte/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni lnga zhes bya/ /lnga po lnga ru bsgom par bya/ /gzugs sogs shin tu mdzes pa yin/ /dbang ldan gyi ni phyogs kyi char/ /seng ge'i gdong ni bsam par bya/ /kha dog dkar zhing ser ba ste/ /glang po yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje lcags kyu sdigs mdzub 'tshocan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yisami/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /me mtshams stag mo zhes bya ba/ /rin chen bdun gyi stan la bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis kha dog dkar zhing sngo/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /lag na lcags kyus khobargyan pa ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub (me80—582

zhags pa can/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /bden bral ⑦lha mo ce ②spyang mo/ /ha ha bzhad ②pas 'jigs par mdzad/ /ma he yi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /mdog ni dmar zhing sngo ba ste/ /sku la na bza' mdzes pa ④gsol/ /phyag gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa dang / / sdigs mdzub 6)kyis ni shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ⑥ba yi/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /rlung mtshams lha mo lug pa mo/ /kha dog ser zhing dmar ba ste/ /klu yi stan la yang dag bzhugs/ /rgyan du'ang de nyid sbyar bar bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung ④can/ /sdigs (nyamadzub 6)lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /'bar ba'i lus can bsgom par bya/ /dbus kyi ⑩mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyiyi/ /phyi rol dag ni rnam bzhi la/ /shar du mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang mo/ /phyag gnyis kha dog dkar po ste/ /yi dgas ⑩kyi ni stan la bzhugs / /sbrul gyi kyirgyan gyis bklubs pa ste/ /shin tu drag 8cing skra grol bas / /'od zer sna tshogs yang dag 'bar/ /lag gnyis kha ru bcug nas ni/ /ha har tsobazhad pas shin tu 'bar/ /byang na 'bar ma rgyal dbang mo/ /kha dog ser mo shin tu 'bar/ /spyi bo'i steng du lag pa gnyis/ /thal sbyar mar me lta bu ⑩'bar/ /drag mo'i gzugs can tshig pa ste/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bzas ⑩brgyan/ /yi dgas kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /'od zer me 8ltar 'bar ba bsgom/ /nub kyi lha mo 'jib byed ma/ /kha dog dmar mo 'jigs byed can(7 / /yi dgas kyi ni stan la bzhugs/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i go bgos ( spre )shing / /yi dgas stan la kun tu gnonari gle/ /lag tu skud pa dmar khyer zhing / /80—583

thal mo sbyar te khrag 'thung ma/ /drag mo me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /lha mo 'jib 0)byed rab tu grags/ /ngag 'phrog ma (geni lho phyogs su/ /kha dog nag mo mnyam pa'i 'od/ /yi dgas stan la gnas pa yi/ /skra ni gyen du 'bar brgyan pa'i/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i dmar po'i gos/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ / sdigs mdzub (cigatun shing lag na thogs4)/ /rnam par rmongs pa'i sems can sgrol/ /drag mo me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /thams cad kun nas mkhas pas bsgom/ /de dag gi ni gzugs mdun du/ /dam tshig dag ni bstan par bya/ /rlung dang me yi bdun don la/ /rdo rje ma yi sa bon dbye/ /sgra dang thig le yang dag mnan / /char pa'i rgyun zhes bya bar brjod/ /phyag 'tshal dang po sreg byed mtha' / /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sa bon yin/ /dbyangs thog dang po'i sa bon ni / /phyag 'tshal dang po sreg byed mtha'/ /shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i / /sa bon du ni rab tu grags/ /dbyangs yig yi ge gnyis pa ni/ /phyag 'tshal sreg byed sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni byang gi phyogs gnas pa/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo'i sa bon yin/ /sa bon dag ni 'di nyid la/ /dbyug pa glo ru gzhag par bya/ /phyag 'tshal dang po sreg byed mtha'/ /nub phyogs ro langs ma yi yin / /sa bon dag ni 'di nyid la/ /steng du thig le sbyin par bya/ /phyag 'tshal sreg pa mthar 5sbyar ba/ /lho phyogs gtum pa mo yi yin/ /ma ning sa bon dang po ni/ /phyag 'tshal sreg byed mtha' dang sbyar/ /dbang ldan lha mo seng ge ma'i/ /sa bon du ni rab tu grags/ /ma ning sa bon gnyis pa ni/ /phyag 'tshal sreg byed mtha' dang sbyar/ /me mtshams (6lha mo stag mo yi/ /de (7)kho na nyid natshos bon bshad/ /de bzhin ma ning sa bon gsum/ /phyag 'tshal 80—584

sreg byed mtha' dang spel/ /bden bral lha mo ce yo)spyang ma/ /khyad par gyi ni sa bon yin/ /ma ning yi ge bzhi pa la/ /phyag 'tshal sreg byed mtha' dang sbyar / /rlung mtshams hūm̐ byed 'ug pa mo'i/ /sa bon du ni rab tu sbyar/ /sde ②tshan dag ni lnga pa yi/ /yi ge dag ni gnyis pa bzung ①/ /sa bon rtsa bar sgra ④dang sbyar/ /phyag 'tshal thog (5)mar sreg byed mtha'/ /shar gyi mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang mo'i/ /sa bon du ni shes par bya/ /sde tshan dag ni lnga pa yiyi/ /de bzhin yi ge gnyis pa gzung (7)/ /e dang thig ler sbyar bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal thog ma sreg byed mtha'/ /byang phyogs lha mo 'bar byed ma'i/ /sa bon yi ge sbyar bar bya/ /sde tshan dag ni lnga pa yi/ /yi ge gnyis pa bzung (0bar bya/ /o dang re pha thig ler bya5)/ /phyag 'tshal thog mar sreg byed mthar/ /nub phyogs lha mo 'jib 7byed ma'i/ /khyad par gyi ni sa bon yin/ /sde tshan dag ni lnga pa yi/ /yi ge gnyis pa bzung 41)nas su/ /re pha'i tu yi ge lcags kyu sbyar/ /phyag 'tshal sreg pa'i mtha' sbyar ba/ /lhor gnas lha mo 'phrog byed ma'i(nye/ /sa bon du ni rab tu grags/ /khu tshur gnyis ni bcings nas su/ /dbu ma gnyis ni brkyang nas kyang / /rtse mo phan tshun sprad nas ni/ /ye shes lha mor bstan par bya/ /lag gnyis phan tshun sbyar nas su/ /dbu ma dag ni mthe bong sprad8 / /cung zad cig ni bskyed gepar bya/ /shar phyogs rdo rje ma la bstan/ /khu tshur mnyam skyepar bcings dzi tshonas su/ /mthe bong gnyis ni brkyang byas la/ /byang gi phyogs nas brtsams nas su/ /rgya 'di drag mo la yang bstan/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings nas su/ /mthe chung gnyis ni brkyang bar byas1she/ / nub tu gnas pa'i ro langs ma'i/ /phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas su/ /gung mo gnyis 80—585

ni brkyang bar bya/ /dhilho phyogs su ni bshad pa ste/ /de ni phyag rgya bzhi pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /khro bo ②gnyis ni brkyang ①nas su/ /rtse mo sprad de gnas pa ni/ /mtshams bzhi yi ni phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis thal mo khar bcug nas/ /phu ④zhes bya ba sbyar bar bya/ /shar phyogs mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis thal mo kha (7sbyar nas/ /spyi bo ru ni gzhag par bya/ /byang du gnas pa'i 'bar ma la/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bstan par bya/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar nas su/ /kha ru gzhag ste hūm̐ zhes bya/ /nub phyogs lha mo 'jib byed ma'i/ /phyag rgya ru ni sbyar bar bya/ /lag gnyis kun tu bskor ⑥byas nas/ /sor mo rnams kyi rtse mor sbyar/ /gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag nas kyang / /lho phyogs 'phrog byed ma la bstan/ /phyag 'tshal dang ni sreg pa yi/ /dbus su hūm̐ zhes bya ba sbyar/ /lag pa kun tu brkyang la sogs/ /dri sngags phyag rgyar rig par bya/ /bdud rtsi (pero dang thig ler bcas/ /phyag 'tshal dang ni sreg pa mtha' / / dri yi (kyephyag rgya (9)brkyang nas su/ /khro bo dang ni mthe bong sbyar/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /thams cad rig pas thams cad dbul/ /sde tshan dang po'i dang po ni/ /phyag 'tshal thog ma sreg byed mtha'/ /phyag rgya de nyid sbyar nas su/ /dbu ma'i sor mo bsgreng bar bya/ /bdug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /lha rnams thams cad mchod par bya/ /dgu mtha' yi ni sa bon gzung ⑩/ /phyag 'tshal dang ni sreg byed mtha'/ /khu tshur bcings nas mthe bong bsgreng tunya/ /mar me'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /lha rnams thams cad mchod par bya/ /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pa gzung (7/ /sgra dang thig ler sbyar ba dang / /phyag 'tshal dang ni sreg byed mtha'/ /gtor ma'i phyag rgya dang ni 80—586
