'di dag nyid/ /shar la sogs par ji bzhin bsam/ /dbus kyi bcu gsum sgo nga ru/ /ye shes lha 6)ni thim par bya/ /pad+ma brgyad la lha mo brgyad/ /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin du/ /zhags pa lcags sgrog sgrol ma ste/ /de ltar lha mo bzhi po dag /de bzhin phyogs bzhir rol pa yin / /mtshams kyi cha ni rnam pa bzhir/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsam bya ba/ /skul (mibyed rin chen sgrol ma dang / /rdo rje lcags sgrog ming can de/ /gzhan gyis mi thub zhes bya ste/ /mtshams kyi 'dab (nyam kun la dgod/ /rtse mo lnga ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /snga ma ji bzhin bsam par bya/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du drag mo zhes bya ste/ /nub tu de bzhin ro langs ma/ / lho yi 0phyogs su gtum (5)mo (tshiganas/ /dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje de kho na yi lha/ /mkhas pa yis (7ni shes par bya/ /cha gsum gsal bar gzung ba la/ /ska (gyirags kyis ni shin tu brgyan/ /ut+pal 5)ku mu da ⑩ltar mdzes/ /rin chen pad+ma yang dag gnas/ /phyogs la sogs pa brgyad dang ni/ /dbu ma'i sangs rgyas nyid dang dgu/ /rtse mo 37dgu yi lha nyid de/ /lha dgu yis ni byin gyis brlabs//chu srin las ni byung ba ni3ste/ /rtse mo 'od zer zla bar (steganas/ /rtse mo dgu pa zhes bya ba/ /ye shes rdo rje 'gro ba sgrol/ /rdo rje tsode nyid gang yin pas/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i bdag nyid bsam/ /rdo rje'i 7snying po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje yi ni sems su bya/ /rdo rje dag pas brtan byas nas/ /chos rnams rdo rje las gzhan med/ /thams cad rdo rje de nyid yin/ /rdo rje las kyi snying po'oyi/ /rdo rje 'pho 7ba sbyor ba'i bdag /rdo rje 'khor ba sgrol bar byed/ /rdo rje 'gugs 1 pa sbyor ba'i bdag /rdo rje bcings ()pa'i sbyor bar ldan/ /bdun pa 80—604

de bzhin nyon mongs ldan/ /rnam shes bcas pa'i sgron ma ni/ /ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas su/ /phyogs kun tu ni snang bar byed/ /rdo rje'i sgrub pa la sogs kun / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid blta 0)bar bya/ /chos kyi 'ching ba rdo rje ste/ /thar pa mchog 'bad rdo rje'o/ /rdo rje pad+ma bzung nas ni②/ /de nyid thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje pad+mor zhugs pa ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya /dril bu yi ni mtshan nyid rnams/ /nyon cig rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /shes rab sgra yi de nyid ni/ /thos pas srid pa las sgrol ba'i/ /nam mkha'i (kyekhams kyi mthas gtugs par④/ /byang chub snying por 3)rnam par gnas/ /thams cad rigs ⑥pas phyogs kun tu/ /gnas pa'i 'jig rten khams mthar thug /phyogs brgyad zhes ⑦ni bya ba rnams/ /lha mo brgyad du rab tu grags/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sa bon ni/ /phyogs brgyad du ni dgod par bya/ /shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/ /byang gi phyogs su gos dkar mo/ /nub kyi phyogs su mā ma khri(8nye/ / lho yi (9)phyogs su sangs rgyas spyan/ /mdog bzang dbyangs snyan mdzes pa dang / /bzhi pa rdo rje phreng ⑩ba mo/ /dbus su nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /gzugs kun rdzogs shing shin tu mdzes/ /pad+ma rgyas la yang dag 'byung / /gzugs med gnas kyi phyogs su ni/ /shes rab bdud (1rtsi bum pa 'dra/ /shes rab bdud rtsi gnas dag la/ /de yi dbus kyi stan dag la/ /shes rab pha rol phyin lha mo/ /gzugs mdzes yon tan rnams kyi gnas/ /steng gi pad+ma rdo rje rnams/ /snga ma bzhin du bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi ye shes dbyug pa ste/ /thams cad spro dang sdud pa po'o/ /ā li kā yosheli'i rab sbyor gyis(ge/ /phyogs brgyad du ni bskyod par bya/ /ā li kā yili'i rab sbyor bas/ /'khor ba thams cad gcod pa ste/ /80—605

rdo rje dril bu'i thabs yin te/ /thabs kyis rdo rje'i dbus gnas so/ /g.yas par nyi ma bsams nas su/ /g.yon pa ru ni zla ba dgod/ /lag pa gnyis ni brkyang nas su/ /pad+ma'i rnam pa lag tu bskor/ /lus rnams la ni thabs dang sbyaram/ /rang 'dod lha rnams bsam par bya/ /rdo rje gsor bas sgrol ba ste/ /'khor ba sgrol ba yang dag byung / /hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i glu yis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rjes chags bya/ /rdo rje gsor bas 4)mdzes pa yis/ sems can thams cad mdzes par bya/ /rnam thar chos su bya ba ste/ /rdo rje shin tu snying po mchog /o badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ho (na rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi duta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ ④pra ra ṇi ta/ sab bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā (5li te/(6) pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā dā gsu bhā ba ⑧na /po) badz+ra dharma ṣ+ṭṛ 7da ya a ba sarnyo ṣa ṇi47/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ a a a swā hā/ shes rab thabs kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /shes rab thabs kyis dkrol ⑫bar bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi chos kyis ()ni/ /'gro ba rnams kyis rtags ④bya 'am / /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi / /sems can don phyir dkrol ⑩bar bya/ /rdo rje de kho na yis bzung / /chos kyi dril bu (rtedakrol bar bya/ /sems can don byed rnal 'byor pas/ /shes rab thabs su blta 3)bar bya/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /glang chen dril bu'i sgra dang mtshungs/ rnal 'byor de nyid dman pa yi/ /dngos grub ring bar shes par bya/ /de nas gsang dang phra 6)ba yi / /rdo rje'i mtshan nyid gzung ba ste/ /yang dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed pa/ /dbu ma'i tshig ni bskor ba la/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje cha gsum bya/ /de nyid kyi zhi )ni cha gcig gis( nya/ /phra ba'i rdo rje rab tu brtag /spyi gtsug lag pa la sogs pa/ /rtag tu dag byed khu tshur bcang /80wa 606

slob dpon rdo rje brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /'dod don thams cad sgrub pa'i mchog/bgrang phreng ①la sogs gzung ba ni/ /yang dag ji bzhin rdo rjes ②nyon/ /yang dag cho ga gang gis ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom ①med/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /gzhan yang nor bu dkar po sogs/ /zhi sogs las la khyad par gyirtsi/ /bgrang phreng gi ni khyad nyid ni/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /pad+ma sa bon khyad par du/ /rgyas pa yi ni bgrang phreng ste/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bgrang (snyebar bya/ /gur kum ⑥la sogs dri zhim pa'i/ /dri rnams kun gyi khyad par las/ /ril bur byas te dmar por btsos/ /dbang du sdud ⑦par rab tu grags/ /ru dāk+ṣa (kyedang lung tang dang / /mi yi rus pa de bzhin te/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /mngon spyod du ni rab tu grags/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag la/ / pu tra dzi po)ni las kun byayi / /sngags sgrub pa la lnga bcu ste/ /dbang la de yi 4)phyed du bya/ /zhi la brgya phrag gcig yin te/ /rgyas pa la ni brgyad lhag pa'o/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu'oti/ /las kyi bye brag gis ni sbyar/ /las kyi bye brag ji bzhin du/ /bgrang phreng dag ni brtag ⑩par bya / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams brgyad dang yini/ /dbu ma nyid dang sangs rgyas dgu/ /lha dgu yi ni skud pa la/ /lha dgus 'byin gyis brlab par bya /gzugs rdzogs shin tu mdzes pa dang / /gtsang zhing dad ldan snyan par smra/ /de yis bkal ba'i bgrang phreng gis/ /grol ba'i dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /skud pa rnams ni 8sangs rgyas tshul/ /ril bu rnams ni dgra bcom yin/ /'og ma mchod rten du ni bstan/ /steng ma chos kyi dbyings yin no/ /mchod rten chos kyi dbang po'o/ /lag par nyi ma bsams nas su/ /dbyangs kyi dang 80—607

po yi ge ni/ /lag pa yi ni dbus dag tu/ /dmar po la ni dmar po ①bsgom/ /g.yon pa zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge bsam bya ba/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /kha dog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /g.yas pa'i sor mo rdo rjer bsam(mi/ /g.yon pa pad+ma'i 'dab (gumar bsgom/ /rdo rje pad+ma sbyor ba yis/ /kha sbyor dbus su phreng bzhag la/ /de nyid thams cad bsgoms pa yis/ /bgrang phreng byin gyis brlab par bya/ /sor mo dag gi bye brag gis/ /de nas sngags pas bzlas pa ④bya/ /rdo rje ma dngos g.yon pa ste/ /g.yas pa rdo rje'i ngo bo'o / /dkar po dud pa (5)dung dang ni/ /pad+ma g.yas kyi sor mo ste/ /gi wang dri gsum 'jigs pa dang / /sa gdugs g.yon par dgod pa dang / /ye shes rnam shes mthe bong gnyis/ /lag la sogs pa'i las can ma/ /zhi ba la ni khro bos bgrang / /rgyas pa la ni gung mo ste/ /srin lag la ni dbang du bstan/ / tha mas (6)mngon par spyod pa ste/ /mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu ni/ /lha nyid dgug pa'i bsam pa yin/ /mnyam par gzhag (7ste bzlas bsgoms na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom (8)med/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de nyid med pa'i sngags bzlas dang (9/ /de nyid med pa'i rdo rje dril/ /phyag rgya de nyid med 'byung ba/ /rnal 'byor pa yis grub pa med/ /rnal 'byor de nyid dmigs na ni / /de nyid thams cad kun bya'o/ /yi ge'i 7rgyu las byung ba'i dngos/ /sngags kyi snying po mdzes pa ste/ /rang bzhin med pa'i grangs (1bzlas na/ /rnal 'byor ma yi snying po 'grub/ /bram ze rgyal rigs dmangs (nyarigs gcig /rnal 'byor ma yi dra ba 'grub/ /o pa de pa de ma hā pa (stede dz+nyā na sarba bud+dha 7ma hā bhā 'be/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ āḥsaswā hā/ sngags 'di yis ni sbyang byas na( sna//80—608

bgrang phreng gi 0)ni lha rnams 'grub/ /las rnams thams cad 'grub 'gyur te/ /mi gsal ba ni ring bar 'gyur/ /ye shes de dag bye brag (5)dag /yang dag rdo rje chen pos nyon/ /ye shes bye brag ring du gnas/ /thun mong ①ye shes brjod pa ste/ /dman dang rab dman dman pa can/ /gnod sbyin lha min grub pa po//klu dang byol song gsang ba pa/ /lto 'phye dang ni mi 'am ci/ /mi dang yi dgas mkha' 'gro ma/ /dmyal bar 'tshad ④pa'i sems can dang / /byol song gzugs su brjod pa ste/ /phra mo sgo nga gzung mi nus/ /chu dang me dang rlung dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni sa yi khams/ / brtan pa de nyid (5)thams cad dang / / rtsa dang 'dab ⑥ma phra ba dang / /bong ba rdo dang brag la sogs/ /thams cad ye shes byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes med na skye mi 'gyur/ /ye shes thams cad kun rig pa'o/ /ye shes thar par gang gis ni/ /ye shes thun mong byin brlabs ⑦pa/ /bye brag gzhan ni ji lta bu/ /lha las rol mo nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum lha yi (8)gnas/ /gong nas gong du gnyis ⑨'gyur te/ /'dod pa lnga yi 7ye shes dag /gong ma'i ye shes ye shes 'phel/ /gsang ba'i ye shes reg pa ste/ /lha min ye shes khro bo'o( spe//yi dgas ye shes zhen pa ste/ /dmyal ba'i ye shes 'jigs shing ngu tu / /byol song ye shes glen pa ste/ /brtan tu pa rnams ni sems med pa'o/ /mi rnams ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /bye brag tu ni shes par bya/ /glen pas sgribs yidang lkugs pa dang / /bud med ye shes slu brid do/ /byis pa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /ye shes de nyid bye brag dag /rnal 'byor bstan bcos kyis sbyangs pa/ /skye ba bye ⑫ba stong phrag du/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bskul yin/ /rnal 'byor bstan 80—609

bcos rjes 'brangs nas/ /'bad de dad pa 6)bskyed par bya/ /sgra sgrogs phyi rol bstan bcos ni/ /gar gyi ②gnas dang mtshungs pa ste/ /blo ldan rnal 'byor bstan bcos kyis/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras bu thob/ /snying po snying po bstan bcos te/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i rim yin no/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba dang po'o// //'khor los sgrub pa'i khyad par dag /de nyid ji bzhin rdo rjes nyon/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang rnams dang / /bsrung ④dang mngon par spyod pa dang / /re'u (7mig dgu sogs 'khor lo ni/ /phyi rol mu khyud bskor bar bya/ /'khor lo las kyi kha dog gis/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta ༅re tu re swā hā/ sa bon de dag thams cad ni/ /phyag 'tshal tha ma dbus su bya/ /dbus su ⑦ming dang bsrung ba yis98)/ /tshig kyang de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /mnyam nyid stong pa'i rang bzhin chus/ /bdag gi las po)ni bkru ⑩bar bya/ /mnyam nyid thams cad rig pas gnas/ /srung (7ba'i 'khor los bsrung bar bya//ye shes can gyis bsrung 62bsgoms na/ /'jigs pa kun las ring bar 'gyur/ /sems can dngos po med pa ru/ /sbyor ba'i dngos pos 8'jigs pa la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni bsam par bya/ /sgrol ma'i rgyud du bsgoms pa yis/ /bdag gi lus yini rnam par sprul/ /oṃ tā re swā hā / mgo la'o/ /oṃ tut+ta re swā hā/ mig la'o/ /oṃ tu re swā hā/ sna la'o/ /oṃ tu swā hā/ rna ba la'o/ /oṃ re swā hā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ tā re ni swā hā/ snying gar 7ro/ /yan lag drug tu rtag tu dgod/ /'phags ma sgrol ma bsam bya ba/ /80—610

phyag ①gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung (mibacas/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis ni bklubs / /kun tu mi 'jigs ⑧sbyin pa dang / /gzhan gyi rna drung li.ut+pal bsnamasal/ /thams cad 'od zer rnam ⑤bsgoms nas/ /khyad par du ni sngags bzlas bya/ /thams cad yon tan can du bsgom/ /oṃ tā yire tut+ta re tu re swā hā/srung ⑦ba'i las thams cad kyi sngags so/ /rgyal po'i btson ra dgra phyogs dang / /nyam nga'i lam du 'gro ba dang / /yan lag sna tshogs rims sridang ni/ /chu dang dug gis 'chi ⑨la sogs/ /gang dang gang du 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /de dang der ni bsam par bya/ /shes rab zhan dang le lo kyisogs/ /'khor lo bris nas bcang bar bya/ /srung (nyab bzang po 'di yis ni/ /'jigs pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /srung snyib 'di dag thams cad ni/ /de nyid sbyor bas bsgrub (nyapar bya/ /'khor lo 'dab ④ma brgyad pa la/ /phyi rol mu khyud bskor nas su/ /dbus su thog ma tha ma ste/ /bzlas pa thams cad gzhag par bya/ /mu khyud dbyangs kyis 8bskor nas su/ /'khor lo dkar po bsam par bya/ /yan lag thams cad phye ba yis/ /mnyam nyid stong par bsams yinas su/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa yis/ /sngar bstan bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ /'khor lo 'di ltar bsgom ⑩pa yis/ /las 'dis shes rab 'bar bar 'gyur/ /o prasto prasto ma hā pralha hūm̐ tu)swā hā/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar bas su/ /dngos po bsgom ⑪pas bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /shes rab bdag nyid bsgoms nas su/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung zhu )bcas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu 'bar/ /shes rab dngos po bsgoms nas su/ /sa bon 'di ni bzlas byas nas/ /shes 80—611

rab myur du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /glen dang snyom 6)las blun po yang / /sbyor ba 'di yis shes rab 'phel/ /snying po re'u (mimig dgu ru bya/ /de bzhin bar ma bcu gnyis te/ /phyi rol re'u ①mig bcu drug go/ /mthar thug mu khyud de bzhin te④/ /phyag 'tshal sreg pa'i mthar sbyar ba'i/ /dbus su bdag gi (shesems gzhag la/ /sgra dang thig le ldan pa yis(nya/ /yi ge brgyad po snying por dgod(7 / /bcu gnyis po (nyal dbyangs sa bon/ /ma ning spangs pa bri bar bya/ /sde tshan gsum gyi yi ge rnams/ /yi ge lhag ma 6)gcig dang bcas/ /sgra dang thig ler ldan pa dag /bcu drug gnas su gzhag par bya/ /gsod pa'i yi ge mu khyud la/ /thams cad rig pas kun tu bskor/ /dang po dkar por bsam bya ste/ /gnyis pa ser por bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa dag ni dmar po ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa sngon po'o/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid ldan pa yis/ /mnyam nyid stong par yang dag gnas/ /mnyam nyid lta ba bskyed yinas su/ /'khor lo 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /mnyam gzhag dngos po bsgoms pa yis(skye/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /kun nas thams cad 'bar ba ste/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /bdud rnams thams cad sreg 7par byed/ /ye shes 'khor lo bsgoms kyisapa yis/ /kun nas nyon mongs g.yogs pa yang 7/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob 7par 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed nas su/ /bdag nyid nam mkha' bsgom (7byas la/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yis7/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ / de yi yi dbus su sa bon ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzung (7bya ste/ /sde tshan dang po gang yin pa'i/ /yi ge dang po bzung nas su/ /lcags kyu yis 7ni gzir bya ba/ /rtsa bar re pha sbyar bya ba/ /bdud 80—612

rtsi'i thig le ①steng du dgod/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba ni/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa (kyebasgom/ /rgyal po rgyal po'i pho brang dang / /yid can gyis ni bsam par bya/ /yi ge nyis (mi'agyur thigs pa dang / /rtsa bar sgra ni sbyar bar bya/ /bdud rtsi'i mtha' zhes bya ba ste/ /'bum phrag gcig gis dbang du sdud/ /bu mo rnams kyis 4)gang bsams pa/ /ming dang bcas nas bsgrubs nas ni/ /bsam ⑤pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur//ngas bstan pa la the tshom med/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid thams cad ni/ /sngar bzhin du ni stong (6)pa nyid/ /thams cad bdag nyid bsams nas su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /bdud rtsi kun rig phyi mor bcas 'od zer sna tshogs rnam par 'phro/ /'od zer ser po shin tu mdzes/ /gzugs sdug 'od zer 'phro bar bsam/ /rin chen la sogs gang 'dod pa/ /thams cad rang gi dbugs kyis ri7)dgug /sgrub pa po yi (8)lus la ni/ /de yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rlung gi sa bon gyis bskor ba'i/ /lcags kyu'i yi ge bsgom par bya/ /kha dog la sogs dmar bsams shing (9)/ /gzugs kyang kha dog dmar por bsgom/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bsgom par bya/ /gzugs mdzes shin tu rdzogs pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs7/ /g.yon pa lcags kyu'i tshul gyis ni/ /yid ni 'gugs pa bsgom par bya/ /lcags kyu'i yi ge bsgoms pa yis/gle/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu bskyod par bya/ /yi ge nyis sna 'gyur thigs pa dang / /rtsa bar sgra ni sbyar bar bya/ /bdud rtsi'i mtha' zhes bya ba ste/ /'bum phrag gcig gis dbang du 'grub/ /de ltar bsgom zhing bzlas tshostenas su/ /sor mo yang ni bskyod 80—613

byas na6)/ /bsgrub bya'i yid ni bskyod 'gyur bar/ /'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /'khor lo 'dab (snyem med pa la/ /mu khyud kyis ①ni bskor bar bya/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge thams cad kyis/ /mu khyud mkhas pas ④bskor bar bya / /sde tshan lnga pa gang yin pa/ /yi ge gsum pa bzung nas su/ /i dang re pha sbyar nas su/ /'bad pas dbus su bzhag nas kyang ⑤/ /ye shes can gyi sa bon 'di/ /sgra yi bdun pa dang sbyar la/ /'dab ⑥ma rnams la'ang ⑦de nyid bya / /'dab ⑧mar 6)'di nyid gzhag par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma yi grub 'dod pas / /'od zer sna tshogs rab 'bar bas/ /gser gyi mdog tu bsgom par bya / /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid ldan pa ru/ /sngar bstan bzhin du mkhas pas bsgom / /de 'og lha mo nor rgyun gyi/ /gzugs su bdag nyid bskyed ⑩par bya/ /gzugs mdzes shin tu yongs su rdzogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs / /thams cad lag g.yas mi 'jigs sbyin/ /g.yon pa 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams/ /dbus su bstan pa'i sa bon ni/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg 7pa'i mtha' sbyar te(/gye/ /de ltar bsgom 1)zhing 8bzlas pa yis/ /rgyas pa'i sbyor ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha mo nor ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /rgyas pa ru ni grags pa yinate/ /bdag nyid bye brag gzhan dag tu/ /rnam gzhag thams cad de bzhin no / /bdag nyid sngon gyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /stong pa'i de nyid 8bsgoms nas su / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / sa yi ⑩dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes rnam shes dngos po bsgom/ /'dab hu tshom brgyad pa'i 'khor lo yonyeni/ /dbus su sa bon bsgoms nas su16/ /phyi rol 'khor lo'i mu khyud la/ /dbyangs kyi sa bon bskor bar bya/ /80—614

phyogs kyi 'dab 6)mar bdud rtsi ②bzhi/ / gug skyed nikun dang sbyar bar bya/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ④ma bzhi la yang / /sangs rgyas lnga yis mngon par brgyan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba can/ /rin chen bdun gyis phyimadzes pa ste/ /rang gi lus la bsgom par bya/ /gang 'dod yid ni rtog ⑥bya'i phyir/ / de yi ⑦'od zer sbyar bar bya/ /'jigs pa med cing 'tshe med pas/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /rmugs dang glen dang snyom (nyalas dang / /shes rab zhan cing lta ngan rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa yis khyaskad cig la/ /snyom 7las la sogs ring du spong / /mnyam gzhag cung zad bltas yinas su/ /rdul phran dkar po spro bar bya/ /phyogs bcur song ste khyab nas ni/ /thams cad rim pas kun snang bya/ /ye shes sems la tsobaltas nas ni/ /rnal 'byor pha rol sems shes 'gyur/ /sems ni mnyam par bcings nas su/ /mnyam gzhag 'khor lor blta ⑩bar bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mthong ba yis/ /'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol chabar 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sa bon gyis sprul tesnyi/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa yisatso/ /kha dog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung ⑩bcas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs pa ste/ /phyag gnyis phyag rgya che bcings nas/ /snying ga'i yinyephyogs su 'tsher 7bar mdzad/ /kha dog dkar po mdzes pa yi/ /'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni rnam par spro/ /spro ba sna tshogs mi zad pas/ /sems can khams ni sgrol bar mdzad/ /shes rab rdo rjes 'gro sgrol ba/ /dbyangs yig dang po mchog sa bon/ /mtha' ru tsheg drag sbyar bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal sreg 80—615

pa'i mtha' dang ldan/ /sa bon 'di ni bsgoms 6nyenas su/ /mnyam gzhag dngos por bzlas ②nas ni/ /byang chub rim pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi (khurab tu byed pa las rim par phye cirab gnyis pa'o// //byin brlabs (5)sbyor ba'i ngo bo dag /gang gis sems can rnams la bstan//byin brlabs (6)rim pa ji lta bu/ /lha las gzigs mo nyan par 'tshal sems can rmongs pa gso ba'i phyir/ /byin gyis rlob lnga)pa'i chos bstan pa/ /yang dag 'khor ba sgrol ba yi/ /de nyid ji bzhin rdo rjes 'astenyon/ /snying gar 6)zla ba bsams minas su/ /hūm̐ gi sa bon dbus su bsam(ha/ /'od zer me ltar 'bar zhing gsal/ /nyi ma'i dbus su gzhag par bya/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ / me yi 12dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /gnas rnams thams cad 'bar ba yis/ /kun nas thams cad bsregs nas su/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid bstan pa yi/ / dang po yi stong pa nyid du bya/ / me yi chadakyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni bsam par bya/ /dbyug pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon/ /gya gyu phyag na rdo rje ste/ /lus ni 'jam pa'i mchog yin no/ /mgo dang bum pa byams pa ste/ /steng du 'bar ba'i ma yig ni/ /'khor ba thams cad sgrol ba po(tsha/ /'jig rten gsum gyi grub 'dod na/ /sa bon de ni bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma'i stan nyal gnas pa yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms 1 7nas su/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid ye shes kyis bsrung 918ba/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung bcasanyu) kha dog dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /steng gi rdo rje cod pan la/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis 80—616

rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba ru/ /dbugs mi 6)g.yo bar bsgom par bya/ /sde tshan gsum pa gang yin pa'i/ /rdo rje dbyug pa gug skyed (gebacas / / lu gu rgyud rtsil sogs pas dkri/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg (7pa'i mtha' dang ldan/ /'bum phrag gsum ni bzlas nas su/ /gnyis med gtor ma'i las kyis ni/ /de yi 'og tu las rnams bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa la/ /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas par bya/ /cho gar ldan pas sbyin par bya/ /de yi mod la 'bab par 'gyur/ /babs (5)nas rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /rdo rje'i (6)glu ni blang bar bya/ /rol cig rol cig rdo rje khyod/ /zhan dang drag po sbyor ba (7)yis /thams cad kun nas khyod kyis gsol/ /skad cig 'khor las bdag mnyam bsgral / /glu 'di yis ni gar byed de/ /rdo rje dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha yo ga (nyam hā gro dha rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ 'di ni tshim bya thams cad bya/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bstan par bya/ /dman dang bar dang mchog rnams la/ / de yi 9)'og tu chos bstan bya/ /o yo ga ā 0be sha ya/ shin tu mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor pas / /'di yis 47sngon du bsnyen par yi bya/ /gnyis med gtor ma ldan pa yis//rnal 'byor pa yis yungs kur dang / /hūm̐ gi sgra ni 'jigs pa yis/ /sgrub pa po yis 'dis gdab bya/ /sngar gyi smos pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bdag nyid ji ltar 'dod bzhin byed/ /oṃ ma na ghu ru ghu ru/ sgri 1 ste tsi li tsi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/rnal 'byor pa yis 'bum bzlas mun/ /bltas pas 'bebs pa 'grub par 'gyur / /mchod cing gang la bltas pa yi/ /mthong bar byas te gar byed do/ /oṃ ma la ma li hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gsum gyis 'grub 'gyur te/ /'gro ba 80—617

thams cad 'bebs par 'gyur/ /oṃ ma hā tsi li tsi li hūṃ rtsu phroṃ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag gcig ①ni bzlas pa yis/ /skyes sogs ring po nas kyang 'bebs o ba ta li ba ta li ②rgyu phaṭa/ rnal 'byor 'bum phrag gsum du ni/ /bzlas pas sngon du bsnyen pa bya/ /yi dgas 'byung po gsang ba ①sogs/ /lha rnams thams cad 'bebs ④par byed(ge/ /o pa ta ni ⑥pa ta ni hūṃ phaṭa/ rnal 'byor pa yis 'bum phrag gcig /bzlas pas sngon du bsnyen pa bya/ /chu dang bong ba rdo dang ni/ /shing rnams 97)kun la 'bebs par byed/ /dkyil 'khor sngon du slob dpon gyis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas ni/ /shin tu dul zhing brtags pa yis/ /de 'og dkyil 'khor de nyid bsam/ /lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid la ni co 'dri yin/ /o be ta li rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ r+ghaṃ phuḥniphaṭa/thal bar lan bdun bar du ni/ /mngon par bzlas te ro la gtor/ /nyin zhag bdun du bzhag na yang / /cis kyang za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /oṃ phu ru phu ru/rma tre dzaḥrgyu phuḥ6)phaṭa/ skud pa dmar la brgyad brgya ru/ /yongs su bzlas dang ldan pa yi7/ /gang gi mgrin par bcings gyur na/ / ce spyang bzhin 7tu 'khyam par 'gyur/ /skud pa dang ni (/gebral gyur na/ /bdag nyid 'dod pa bzhin du byed/ /byin rlabs 9/gerim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bsgom zhing bzlas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsam bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /'od zer sna tshogs shin tu 'bar/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par8/ /mngon du bsgrub pa tsobya bar bsam/ /rkang mthil gnyis su rlung gi ni/ /sa bon stan du bsgom par bya/ /sgra dang thig ler ldan pa ni/ /rlung gi sa bon dbus gnas 80—618

par / /rlung gis bskor ba hu)snying gar ②gzhag /thams cad kha dog sngon por bsam / /rang gi dbugs kyi rtse mo yi/ /rlung gi brda (8)ru sbyar bar bya/ /o yī ④pre ta bā ⑤yu a mo ka su yī phaṭa/ rnal 'byor pa yi (6)gsang sngags 'di/ /brgyad brgyar bzlas na ⑦'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro ba la sogs bzung nas su/ /dug dang khrag gis bri bar bya/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni bzung nas su/ /thams cad gnas nas bri bar bya/ /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas pa yis(8)/ /skud pa dmar pos dkris nas ni/ /shing gi rtse mor gdags par bya/ /rlung gis sbur bar bsgom pa ste/ /gang du rlung ni gzhol 'gyur ba/ /de yi phyogs su 'gro bar 'gyur / /rnal 'byor pa yis bskrad pa 6)ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma tshubasams te/ /bdag gi yilus ni bsgoms nas su/ /blo dang ldan pas sngags bzlas na/ /gnyis med gang ba'i gtor ma ni/ /de yi dbus su sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī de sha mā kusgo ya ā /sgo ya oṃ hrīḥrgyu dze phrung phuḥshi phaṭa/ maṇ+ḍal dmar por (3byugs nas ni/ /seng ldeng phur bu brgyad kyis gdab/ /dbus su ming ni bris nas su/ /gtor ma yongs su gang bar ldan/ /skud pa dmar la bzlas nas kyang / /lan bdun bskor bas drang tshubar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyus drangs linas su/ /gsang sngags 'dis ni bzlas byas na/ /dpag tshad brgya yi phyi rol nas/ /las 'dis bzlog yinas 'gugs par 'gyur/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi ni dbus dag tu/ /las 'dis 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /mkha' 'gro drag mor tu bsam bya ba/ /rang gi lus ni rnal 'byor mar/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgoms nas su/ /nya mo gcig ni 80—619

bzung nas su/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i ming bris la/ /nya yi kha ru bcug nas ni/ /rkang pas mgo ni rab mnan ①la / /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas par bya/ /oṃ s+t+waṃ s+t+waṃ/ a mu ka ②su mu khaṃ brnya brnyal/ ṭhā trī trī / sum̐ khyiphaṭa/ de ni bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ /bya ba thams cad bcing bar 'gyur/ /thams cad chu la bya ba ste/ /las gzhan cho ga bshad par bya/ /sngags 'di rab tu sbyar nas ni/ /bag zan gyis ni dril bar bya/ /gang du nya ni gnas pa yi/ /nya yi kha ru gzhug par bya/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma byin brlabs (gete/ /ril bu brgyad brgya byas nas ni/ /lan re bzlas te zar bcug na/ /bya ba thams cad bcings par 'gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /bdag nyid tsaṇ+ḍa lī (6)yi gzugs/ /gzugs rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /me ltar 'bar ba bsams nas su/ /gnyis med gtor ma'i las rnams ni/ /de yi dbus su rab tu bya/ /lci bas pad+ma'i gzugs byas pa(3na/ /ming dang sngags kyis gzhag par bya/ /oṃ stam bha ya stam bha ya hūṃ/ bhasgo mu ṭ+wāṃ (8)phu (9 rgyu phaṭa/ gsang sngags 'di dang ming ⑩dag ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas su/ /lan grangs brgyad brgyar bzlas nas su/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom 37med/ /chung ma shin tu g.yon can rnams/ /las 'di yis ni gdul bar 12bya/ /mthar ni chu dang 'o ma yis/ /bkrus na (3bcings pa las grol 'gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lha mo rdo rje ma ru bsgom/ /kha dog sngon po shin tu mdzes/ /'od zer me dang mtshungs par 'bar/ /yongs su rdzogs shing mdzes par ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs pa ste/ /yi dgas kyi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /ha har bzhad pas 80——620

'jigs su rung / /gnyis med gang ba'i gtor ma yi/ /las ni de ru byas nas kyang ske/ /'bras phye la sogs khyad par las/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs ni byas nas su/ /khyi yi spu yis dgang bar bya/ /ming dang sngags su sbyar nas su/ /gnyis med gtor ma'i las rnams ni/ /las der byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ kro dhe shwa ri phru 6)rgyu phaṭa/ brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas nas su/ /rdo rje gsang bar gzhug par bya / /las 'di sbyar zhing gzir ba yis/ /bha ga dag ni bzlog par 'gyur/ /las 'dis shin tu 'grub pa ste/ /phyung na de las thar bar 'gyur/ /chung ma shin tu gdul dka' la(mi/ /las ni de ltar sbyar bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /lte bar bdud rtsi'i yi ge bsgom/ /rtsa rnams kun las drangs nas su/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni 'dzag par bya/ brtu'i (5)me tog rgyas pa yi / /dbus su lcags kyu'i (geyi ge ste/ /kha dog dmar po shin tu 'bar/ /gsang zhing gsang bas bsgom par bya55nye/ /khro 55)bo'i sor mo rtse (7)mo ru/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge bsams nas ni/ /sor mo 'di yis bskyod par bya/ /sbyor ba gsum ni bsams pa yis/ / de yi 58)dbus kyi gnas rnams su/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni 'dzag par bya/ /chung ma shin tu gdul dka' la/ /'di yis bha ga brtag par bya / /'od zer can dang bla mar bya/ /smyo byed yan lag lnga dang bcas/ /gu gul chen po'i cha dang bsrel)/ /mar nag chen pos bskol sna )bar bya/ /sngags pas bdud rtsi'i chu dang ni/ /lce yi dbang pos myang bar bya/ /'dir ni smyo 'gyur the tshom dzistemed/ /mar zos pas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /yi dgas gos ni ma lhung bas/ /mar me yi ni sdong nyu bu bya/ /klu dbang gi ni gong du gzung / /rkang gi (nyamar gyis sbar bar bya/ /gtor ma yi ni gnas dag tu/ /mkha' 'gro 80wa 621

ma yi snying sngags kyis/ /du ba dag ni dbab par bya/ /dur khrod du ni gtor byin la/ /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas nas su/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor shing gcig drung / /gang ①la du ba byugs pa des/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun mthong bar 'gyur/ /lhag ma'i snod ni gnyis gzung tshul/ /dur khrod kyi ni sol ba yis/ /tsha ba'i rdzas la sbyar nas ni/ /bya rog sgro rtsas bri bar bya/ /oṃ ki ri ki ri kro dhe a mu rka phruḥnirgyu phaṭa/ snod ni ④gnyis la so so ru/ /gzugs gnyis ming dang bcas bris ⑤la/ /gnyis med gtor ma byin nas ni/ /khro bos bkang ste ⑥drud par bya / /⑦sla ka 6)li brta li brta 6)li kro dha mu khe a mu kyika su hi li hi li badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha mu khi s+t+waṃ yiphro phroṃ phaṭa/ brgya phrag gcig tu bzlas ⑩nas ni/ /myur du 'thab rtsod 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnyis med gtor mar ldan pa yi/ /dbang bskur na ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi tunyerab tu dbye 7ba las rim par phye ba gsum pa'o// //gnyis med sbyor ba'i snying po ste/ /gnyis med ming gis brjod pa yin/ /sbyor ba ji ltar brtsam bgyi ba/ /rol mo dag ni nyan par 'tshal/ /gnyis med sbyor ba de nyid kyi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dag /so sor gzung ⑩ba'i de kho na / /yang dag ji bzhin rdo rjes nyon/ /de nyid ji bzhin bdag nyid dang / /chos kyi dril bu lha mo'o/ /kha sbyor sbyor ba phyag rgya ste/ /thabs ni de ru thim pa'o /dang por re zhig yirnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje thal mo dam bcings nas/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse yibs/ /dag pa rnam gsum brjod par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥyo su bhā ba shurnyo3rta(7/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3rta(3 /80—622

oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā ①yo ga shurnyo3rtacha/ gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol bas/ /sbyin pa'i ra bas sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /thams cad rtsa bzhin blta ②bar bya/ /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /'gro rnams brtse ④bar mi bya sogs/ /sems can don ni dgag mi bya/ /steng du tshul khrims dra ba'o/ /gzhan la gnod pa 'gog la sogs/ /bzod pa'i phur ⑤bu 'og tu gdab/ / phur bu yir ba dra ba yis/ /sdang ba'i bdud dang dgra rnams bskrad/ /bdud ni bdud du 'char mi 'gyur/ /rang gi sems kyis ⑦bsdams pa'o/ /rang gis (nyarang sems btul ba na/ /bdud kyis 'tshe bar ga la 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid sems kyi dri yis ni/ /gru bzhi pa ru byug par bya/ /lus la ste 'jog tsan+dan byug⑨ /sems ni mnyam par gzhag ⑩pa ste/ /bzod pa'i me tog rnal 'byor pas/ /'bad dang ldan pas dgram 7par bya/ /mnyam nyid bsgoms pa'i bdug pa yis/ /rang bzhin dag pas bdug par bya/ /shes rab mar me'i snang ba ste/ /khams gsum gyi ni mun pa rnams/ /mar me 'di yis bcom nas su/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin snang bar bya/ /sems kyis mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung bya/ /mchod pa'i dus dang khyad par du/ /gtor ma'i dus su rab tu sbyare/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas su/ /bdag nyid rdo rjer bskyed ()nas ni / /shes rab dril bu zhes byar sprul/ /bar du khru gang bzhag nas su/ /mnyam nyid lta tsobs blta bar bya/ /snying gar 8rgyu ni bsgom byas la/ /thams cad rig skipas kun stong bya/ /khams gsum zad par byas nas ni/ /thams cad nam mkha' ⑩yang dag gnas/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /80—623

mnyam nyid stong par bsams nas su/ /pho brang yangs par ci 'dod pa6)/ /ri rab rtse mor bsam par bya/ /lha ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad ldan/ /rdo rje sngon du bstan pa bzhin/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /hūm̐ gi thig le las byung ba/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /mi g.yo rdo rje bsgoms nas su/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag gi lus ni sprul par (9bya/ /yi ge'i dgod pas bkod nas su/ /mkhas pas go cha byas nas hūṃ/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis brgyan pa ste / /gangs dang kun+da zla ba'i mdog /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung phyibacas / /rgyan (4)rnams kun gyis bklubs pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen po snying por bcas / /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba la/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni rnam par 'phro/ /dngos po bsgom pa bsgoms (5)nas su/ /hūm̐ gi sgra yis dgang bar bya/ /rang nyid ji ltar 'dod sems kyis/ /ye shes sa bon bzlas par bya/ /btso tsho rima'i gser ltar shin tu 'bar/ /sems can kun gyi don la chags/ /de nas stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid bdag nyid can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid kun rig pas/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum lha rnams kyis/ /dril bu'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba las/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni rnam par spro/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i lus rnams ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mas bskyed / /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung 77bcas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs/ /kha dog cung zad 'dres pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis mngon par brgyan/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sngags rnams ni/ /yan lag brgyad du dgod par bya/ /phyag gnyis phyag rgya chen po ste/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgom 80—624

par bya/ /ā li kā li las byung ba'i/ /de yi sa bon bzlas par bya/ /'dod chags sems kyi 6)stobs kyis ni/ /btso (gyim gser gyi 'od dang bcas/ /sems can bsgral ③phyir kun tu 'khyud/ /nu ma 'khyud (gecing zhal gnyis 'jib(5) / /rdo rje sor mo'i rtse mor ni/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge bsams nas ni/ /lha mo'i g.yon gyi cha ru ni/ /bstan pa'i rtse mor gzung bar bya/ /bcu dang brgyad kyi gnas rnams ni/ /kun nas bdud rtsi gang gnas pa/ /mdzub mo 'di yis bskyod pa yis/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /gnyis kyi kun sprod (5)btang nas su/ /shar gyi phyogs su blta zhing bskyod/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis lha mo ni/ /rdo rje rkang pa'i stabs kyis mnan/ /dril bu g.yon gyi rlung gnon ⑨pa/ /nu ma lag pa gnyis kyis (shugazir/ /sgeg cing bzhad pa'i bzhin can te/ /'og ma (9)gnon pos btsir 7bar bya/ /dril bu lag gnyis gsang bar (stesbyor/ /de bzhin sa bon gnyis med bzlas/ /shar phyogs su ni bskyod pa yinayis/ /sems can pha rol sgrol bar 'gyur sna / /lha mo g.yon pa bskyod nas su/ /lho ru kha ni blta bar bya/ /rdo rje yang ni bskyod nas su/ /rkang mthil gnyis ni 8de bzhin btsiratso/ /dril bu'i tshalag pa gnyis kyis ni/ /rked pa bsdams te btsir kyi bar bya/ /rdo rje g.yas kyi nu ma dang / /de bzhin gsang bar rtse yo bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i lus dag ni/ /yang dang yang du sprad par bya/ /sa bon gnyis ni bzlas pa yis/ /lho phyogs sems can sgrol bar 'gyur / /nub phyogs snying po'i rkang stabs kyis/ /lha mo nub tu blta bar bya/ /rdo rje yi ni phyogs gcig gis/ /g.yas kyi brla ni mnan par bya/ /mgrin 4)pa'i rgyab nas gnyis 'khyud de/ /dril bu'i lce ni bskyod nas su/ /rdo rje lce la 80—625

reg par bya/ /de bzhin sbyar nas gnyi ga ①bzlas/ /rdo rje mnyam pa'i dbus su ni/ /lag pa gnyis kyis bsdam pa'o/ /dril bu'i lag pa gnyis kyis kyang / /rna ba'i drung bar gzugs ②par bya/ /gnyis ku'i mchu ni kun sbyar nas/ / de yi chabadud rtsi btung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sngags bzlas nas/ /rdo rje dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cigadu /kun kyang 'tshe ⑤ba med par shog /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /skad cig tshul gyis yirnal 'byor dang / /skad cig tshul gyis phyag rgya gcan/ /kun nas kun tu skad cig steni/ /skad cig gis ni gsang sngags 'don⑨/ /dril bu lha ru sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya /yi ge brgyad kyi sngags dag ni/ /gnas rnams kun gyi lha nyid de/ /rang nyid lha mor bsam par byakyi/ /slar yang 'di nyid rab tu bya/ /rang gi 7rjes su chags pa'i sems/ /de nas rdo rje kun tu 'khyudakyi/ /de nas bdag nyid rdo rje ru / /ka ra nar bcas bsam lhonyepar bya/ /rdo rje yi ni nga rgyal gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag ces brjod/ /chu las byung ba'i me tog ni/ /gsang ciba'i nang gi mtshan nyid las/ /rtsa ba myu gu me tog ste/ /brtu ka ni rgyas pa 'dra/ /thong ga chaganyis kyi sa bon rnams/ /sa dang rlung dag nyid yin no/ /'og tu chu yi rang bzhin la/ /myu gu me yi sa bon no/ /sde tshan gsum pa gang yin pa'i/ /yi ge gsum pa bzung nas su/ /dbyug pa phyi mo rdo rje can/ / ska bo che ⑩la sogs pas ⑩dkritunye/ /lha mo'i gzugs su bsams nas su/ /sa yi nang du thim par bya/ /dus me'i yi dgas mer sbyor cing / /yi dgas me dang dus me sbyorayi//lag pa gnyis kyis kha sbyar ba/ /mtheb ( nyachung mthe bos mnan nas su/ /gsum 80—626

po dag ni rtse mor sbyor/ /phyag rgya gnyis kyis ①mgor btsugs nas/ /bdud rtsi bza' ba'i bsam pa yis/ /gnon pos 'og ma btsir bar bya/ /bcu dang brgyad kyi lam dag nas/ /dril bu'i bdud rtsi ②bskul bar bya/ /g.yon gyi cha na dubs ka /chu 'dzag pa yi ⑦cha byad can/ /chu 'dzag bya mchu'i dbyibs lta bu / /mkha' 'gro ma yi tshul dag la/ /der ni phyag rgyas bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje g.yas kyi chu dag ni/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i tshul du bya/ /thong ga ⑤la sogs gnas kun tu/ /de nas sor mo gdab par bya/ /de nas rdo rje'i ⑨rtse mo ni/ /phyag rgya glo ru sbyar nas bya/ /gnyis ka kun tu sbyar nas ni/ /rdo rje pad+mo bskul bar bya/ /hūm̐ gi sgra yis bkang nas su/ /lha mo thams cad tshim par bya/ /dril bu yi ni dngos po yis/ /ā li sa bon kun tu sbyin/ /ye shes sa bon rdo rje rtse/ /bdag gi ⑦lha ni mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu lus yin te/ /phyag rgya kha sbyor sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /de kho na yis (kyeso sor gzung / /rdo rje de kho nas 6)bskyod la/ /dril bu rang dgar dgrol bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sbyor te/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid sbyor ba yin/ /lus ni gnyis ka mnyes pa ⑩yis / /sems can pha rol sgrol bar 'gyur/ /gnyi ga yi ni bdag nyid sems/ /chu de byin gyis brlab par bya/ /sgeg cing bskyod par gnas pa ste/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rdo rje rol pa'i rkang pa ste/ /dril bu g.yon gyi brla yis rol/ /lag g.yon 'khyud ⑩cing nu ma gzung / /g.yas kyi 8rdo rje gsor bar bya/ /bzhad cing khro dang sgeg 8pa yis/ /yang dang yang du spro bar bya/ /dril bu bskyod ④pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /brla yi stan la 'dug nas su/ /rkang pa g.yas pas dkris nas ni/ /dku 7yi gnas su gzhag par bya/ /mgrin par ⑩80—627

gcig gis 'khyud nas ni/ /g.yon pas dril bu gsil hu)bar bya/ /ngo mtshar ②bcas bzhad sgeg pa yis/ /yang dang yang du sprad par bya/ /de nas rdo rje glu blang zhing / /sna tshogs hūm̐ zhes bya bar 'dod/ /bdud rtsi'i chu ni bzung nas su / /slar yang glu ni (5)blang bar bya/ /'khor lo stong pa snying po med pa ni/ /snying po dag ni shin tu bsags 4pa ste/ /rnam par thar pas rab tu bsgral ba ste / /dngos (snyelas rnam par grol ba rab tu 'grub/ /phan tshun kun tu 'khyud zhistepa'i sbyor byas pa/ /de yis don ni yang dag byed par 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i snying po dag ni med pa la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ⑦dbus su snying po bsgrub(kye/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sgrar bcas pas/ /de nas de ltar glu blang bya/ /mnyam bzhag 6)sgom zhing bzlas pa yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom 7med/ /las ni gang zhig bsams (1pa rnams/ /de yis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sman la sogs pa'i khyad par rnams/ /bskyod pa'i sbyor bar ldan par bya/ /gur gum ⑫dang ni gi 1rtewang dang / /ka ra sbrang rtsi 97pa la sha /yung ba ru rta cha mnyam pa/ /sbyor ba'i gnas su gzung tshabar bya/ /rdzas de dag ni bsgos yinas su/ /rtag tu thig le byas gyur na7/ /rgyal po blon po pho brang bcas/ /thams cad du ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /dbang po lag dang ru rta dang / /rmongs byed ma dang rengs byed ma/ /bdag gi lnga dang yan lag lnga/ /lnga po thams cad cha bsnyams (shel17te/ /bza' dang btung dang so rtsi dang / /zhib tu btags te sbyar la sbyin/ /thams cad du ni dbang 'gyur te/ /'chi ba na yang gtong so )mi 'gyur/ /khrag ni gtor ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbang la sogs pa'i las rnams 'grub/ /sngags ni 'bum du bzlas pa yis/ /'gro ba thams cad rmongs par 'gyur/ /bdag 80—628

gi ①lus la gshegs gsol ba/ /bdag nyid ji ltar dga' bar bya(mi/ /sems can don phyir blo ldan pas/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs bram ze'i nye du mos/ /zhi ba'i las ni skye bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po bla ma gsang ba mos/ /rgyas pa'i las ni sbyar bar bya/ /rje'u (mirigs dmangs mo thams cad kyis/ /dbang gi las ni bsgrub par bya/ /lham mkhan shan ④pa nya pa mos/ /mngon spyod du ni rab tu grags/ /kla klo gdol pa tshos mkhan mas(3) /sbyor ba'i dngos grub bshad pa yin/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos gzung bar bya/ /gzhan yang rkang stabs bcing bar bya / /sems can bsgral ba'i gnas yin te/ /gnyis ni kun tu 'dus nas bskyod / /de nyid phyag rgya zhes bya bcing (phyir/ /mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang /dbye ba'i stabs dang / blum po'i stabs dang / gsum gnon po'i stistabs dang / rus dusbal gyi stabs dang / g.yas brkyang dang / g.yon brkyang dang /gnas gcig pa dang / 'dug pa dang / bung ba'i tshogs dang / rgya mtsho po)rlab 7pa dang / ri bo dpung pa dang / /sterkang pa'i 'phen pa dang /mchod sdong gi tshul dang / pus mo btsir ba dang / bsdu ba'i tshul dang /mnyam du gnas pa dang / dus kyi me /rnyedang / snying po dang / dga' bas gnas pa 4)dang / gcig tu bsdu tshuba'o/ /rkang stabs bskyod 8pa bcwa yibargyad ni / /mchod pa'i dus su sbyar bar bya/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas / /rnal 'byor pa yis mtshon par bya/ /snying gar /zhebatsir ba dang /rkang pa sbyar ba dang / phreng ba'i tshul dang / nu ma'i tshul dang / gnyi ga (smesbyar te bza' ba dang / phyed kyis 'khyud pa dang / lag pa gnyis sbyar ba 80wa 629

rnams la gnod mi bya/ /srog chags gsad ①par mi bya ste/ /de bas shi bar 'gyur ①kyang blag/ /rab tu 'bar me mtshungs pas na/ /gzhan gyi nor la reg mi bya/ /dngos la srid ④pa'i blun po rnams/ /bdag nyid srid pa mi bzad ltung / /rags dang phra mo tsam la yang / /rnal 'byor pa yis brdzun ⑤bsrung ⑥ngo —/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /de la brdzun ⑦smra yod pa min⑧/ /spyod pa legs par bsdams pa dang / /bza' bca' sogs la'ang legs par bsdam / /dga' dang rtse la'ang legs par bsdamakhya/ /gtor ma'i dus su'ang legs par bsdamatso/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub 'dod pa rnams/ /sems can dga' bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig kun shes slob ma la/ /sems can spro ba bstan par bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed nas ni/ /thams cad mnyam par blta bar bya/ /rtag tu mnyam par spyod par bya/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan 'bad par bya/ /sems can dman (nyupa srid pa'i gzhis/ /tshong 0byed myu gu 'phel 'gyur te/ /de yi myu gu ljon shing gis/ /'gro ba'i 'bras lam 'gog 8par byed/ /mtho ris longs spyod 'dod pa yisatso/ /lus can rnams ni byams pas na/ /dga' zhing rtse ba'i chos spyod kyis/ /bdag nyid srid par ltung bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya zhing / /glegs bam bklag snyipar mi bya'o/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing zhing / /sngags kyi yi ge tsobazla mi bya/ /bstan bcos dag ni rnyed 7sla ste/ /de yi sbyor ba rnyed par yonyedaka'/ /slob dpon dag gi lung gis (7ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni blta bar bya/ /bdag gi lha dang gzhan las ni/ /bdag gi lha ni lha yi mchog /bdag gi gzugs su mi nus pas/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bri bar bya/ /gsang ba'i gdan gyi rab 80—638

tu byed pa ①las rim par phye ba dang po'o// //der ni sbyor ba rnyed dka' ba/ /nyon cig rdo rje rgyal po gtso/ /de nyid med pa'i sngags pa rnams/ /srid pa 'phel byed 'og tu ltung / /lus po ngo mtshar skyes gyur pas/ /de nyid chos ni bstan ②du gsol/ /rnal 'byor kyi ni tshad ma ci/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ji lta bu/ /chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyis②/ /lus kyi tshad ni ji ltar lags/ /rnal 'byor pa yi ④gtor ma'i las rab tu sbyar ba'i tshad ma gang / /gang gis 'gro ba bsgrub ⑤pa yi/ /mtshan nyid tshad ma ⑥ji ltar lags/ /mtshon bya'i ⑦lus dang sems kyi tshad/ /ji bzhin de nyid rdo rjes nyon/ /bdag gi khams ni mi brtan pasal/ /gtor ma'i las dang ⑨bzlas pa dang / /dkyil 'khor me dang chu yi las/ /phyag rgya gdugs sogs mchod pa yi/ /'bras bu thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'ang / /srid pa'i rgya ⑩mtshor ltung bar 'gyur/ /phyag na rdo rjes yang gsol ⑩pa/ /srid pa so sor 'byung ba rnams / /gang gis de yi tshad ma ste/ /sems ni ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ /yid ni the tshom skyes par gyur/ /'khor ba khyod kyis dris pa nyon/ /sems ni yid kyis bkrus nas su/ /rang dga' ye shes dngos med pa/ /mkha' 'gro rlung gis bcings pa yis/ /sems ni gzugs dang gzugs med par/ /bsam gtan dmigs pas (nye'agrub par 'gyur/ /'dod lha la sogs 'dod can rnams / /rtag tu 'dod yon spyod pa ste(9/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i 8mi rnams ni/ /rang 'dod sa la 8sogs pa 'grub/ /de las sgrol ba'i dngos po rnams/ / de yi don ni gang yin pa/ /nga yis legs par bshad par bya7/ /rdo rje 'dzin 80—639

gyis mdor bsdus nyon/ /rnal 'byor can gyi rnam shes dang / /lhan cig 'gro bas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes rnam par shes pa yis/ /phyogs kun gyis ni gsal bar 'grub4)/ /sems kyi ngo bo the tshom pas/ /bcom ldan de yang bshad du gsol/ /shes rab rnam shes dngos rang bzhin/ /mi shes ye shes ji ltar lags / /rnam shes ye shes mtshan nyid kyis/ /the tshom gyur pa nyan par 'tshal / /shel dang mtshungs pa dag pa'i sems/ /sems la skyon dang yon tan med / /yul rnams dang ni sprad pa yin(na/ /srid pa'i skyon gyis gos pa yin/ /gang gis 'di yi srid pa'i dngos/ /yul gnas pa yi zhi gyur nas/ /ji ltar gnas bzhin rab sbyor ba/ /bu ga'i sgo ru gzir bar bya/ /de yi dbus su shes bya ba/ /rtag tu rnam shes nam mkha' 'dra/ /kha dog med cing thams cad mtshon(5) / /mi ldan lus can ldan pa ste/ /gzugs med pa ni kun gyi gzugs/ /de bzhin thung ngu ring po min/ /sems kyi de kho na nyid kyis/ /dngos med rdzu 'phrul 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mtshan nyid thams cad ster 4)ba'o/ /dngos po med par bsgom (5)pa yis/ /bsgom pa dag ni mtshon par bya/ /gzugs dang stong pa'i dbus su ni/ /sems ni mkhas pas shes bya ste/ /thams cad kun nas dmigs pa yis/ /rnal 'byor lus ni skyon med pa'o/ /gsang las gsang ba gsang chen po/ /rnam shes ye shes gsang ba dag /bstan bcos klog la sogs sbas shing / /yul gyis 6)mtshan nyid las kyang ring / /mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid de nyid ni/ /bla ma'i lam gyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /sems dang lus su bcas mnyam zhing / /sems kyang gdung bar mi bya'o/ /lus ni gdung bar mi bya'o/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs 80—640

su / /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas nas ni/ /sems dpa'i0) skyil krung (kyebacas nas ni/ /lag gnyis gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag /mig ni sna rtser bltas nas su/ /dbugs ni lte (7ba'i rtsa bar bzung / /thong ga 4)kun tu spangs pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor lta bur sbyar bar bya/ /'bad de mnyam nyid sems kyis ni/ /de nyid rang bzhin dag byas la/ /yid kyi dri yis byug pa dang / /yid kyi me tog mchod par bya/ /rang bzhin dri yis byugs nas su / /shes rab sgron mas 5snang bar bya/ /bdud rtsi'i gtor mas tshim pa'i lus / /kun nas drangs te bza' bar bya/ /kha dog ser po 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ka sha gnyis 'gyur yi ge ste/ /drag mor ldan pa'i sa bon nyid/ /tshangs pa'i sgo ru shin tu bsrung (6)/ /thams cad gzugs kyi 'jig byed pa/ /dril bu chu yi yi ge ste/ /stong par ldan pa'i sa bon ni/ /sna dang rna ba dag la dgod/ /bdud rtsi'i (7)chu yi sa bon ni/ /lce dbang rtse mor gzung bar bya/ /seng ge'i sa bon brtsegs pa yis/ /rgyas pa'i sgo ni bsrung bar bya/ /stag mo'i sa bon brtsegs 98pa yis/ /thong ga (9)kun tu gzung bar bya/ /ce 1 spyang r+sā/ bon brtsegs pa ni/ /snying ga'i (nyaganas su gzhag par bya/ /lte ba'i tshigs 4 ni gdan gyi sgor/ /phyugs kyi sa bon gyis bsrung sna ngo / /lha mo brgyad du sbyar nas ni/ /sa bon brgyad po gzung bar bya/ /de yi mdog ni dkar mo ste/ /lus kun tu ni shin tu 'bar/ /steng gi mche ba gnyis las ni/ /dngul chu'i rgyun dang 'dra bar dbab / /'o ma'i chu zhes bya ba yin/ /'jug pas brlabs 1 pa'i mdog lta bu/ /steng gi mche ba gnyis kyi ni/ /lce yis bsten gepa'i bdud rtsi'i chu/ /lce chung gsang ba'i nang du dbab/ /dpral ba'i sde tshadang sna dang ni/ /rna ba gnyis kyi 80wa 641

rgyab dag tu/ /kha zas lta bu'i dngos po ni/ /kun nas drangs te gzhag par bya / /mchod rten sgo ru sa bon ni/ /rtsu zhes bya ba dbang phyug mchog /bdud rtsi'i chu yis bkrus nas su/ /lhag ma 'og tu thim par bya/ /'og tu rlung gi sa bon gyis/ /'khrul 'khor lta bur kun nas drangs/ /chu ni mjug ①do rtsib ②logs dang / /de bzhin mchan ②khung gnyis dang ni/ /dus dang yi dgas me ④rkang pa/ /tshigs rnams kun dang snying ga ⑤nas/ /bdud rtsi btung ba gang yin pa / /ba lang mig par thim nas ni/ /sgo ⑥gcig ⑦nas ni sgo dgur gzhag /lus kun la ni gnas pa yin)/ /bdud rtsi gang gis shes pa dag /lus rnams thams cad skye 'gyur bas/ /de yi rnal 'byor brtags pa yin/ /snying dbus zla ba bsam ⑨bya ba/ /mdangs ldan shin tu mdzes shing gsal/ /gangs dang kun+da ⑩zla ba 'dra/ /zla ba de dbus 'o ma'i rgyun/ /bdud rtsi'i kun rig gug skyed bcas/ /bdud rtsi'i 9/te'od ni shin tu bsil/ /ma ning rnams ni spangs pa yis / /dbyangs kyi yi ge thams cad kyis/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos rnams kyil/ /gnas rnams kun tu bskor bar bya/ /ba lang mig pa'i steng du ni/ /rtag tu bdud rtsi bzhag nas su/ /gzugs dang kha dog mdzes pa yi8 ye shes lus su bsgom par bya/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ba med pa ru/ /dngos pos tsodangos po bsgom byas la/ /'o ma'i zla ba sa bon dag /phyag 'tshal bsreg pa'i mtha' ldan pa/ /mnyam gzhag dngos pos bzlas byas nas8/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom 8med/ /dbang po rnams kyi sred pa dang / / bkres skom la tsosogs med par 'gyur/ /lo ni brgya phrag du mar 'tsho(nye/ /gzugs dang gzi brjid na tshod ldan/ /rims dang dug la sogs pa dang / /grang dang tsha sogs gnod pa 80—642

rnams / /ye shes can gyi ye shes lus/ /yan lag kun la gnas mi 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi'i rtsa ba dmigs pa yis/ /myu gu skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dang de ni 'phel 'gyur bas/ /gzugs dang ye shes bdag nyid che/ / de yi 6)rnal 'byor gnas rnams ni/ /stong pa'i brag la sogs par brten②/ /bdud rtsi gang gis shes pa yis/ /bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ster chabar 'gyur/ /ji ltar bdag nyid kyi ni sems/ /ye shes can gyis ④de kho nas/ /dag bya 'khor ba'i pha rol mtshan/ /ye shes dbang las nyan par 'tshal(snye/ /gnyis med sngon gyi sems kyis ni/ /'dod chags nyon mongs rgya mtsho yi/ /rang gi lus ni bkru bya ba / /ye shes sems dpa' mnyan par gyis6)/ /rgya mtsho zab mo lta bu yi/ /stong nyid ye shes de nyid kyis/ /phyi nang dri ma bkrus pas na/ /lus ni shel dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /shel dang 'dra ba'i lus kyi dngos/ /dri med dung dang kun+da ⑦'dra/ /ye shes dbang po sna tshogs kyi/ /chos kyi tshon gyis btso bar bya / /rang bzhin gyis ni rnal 'byor pa/ /nyes byas legs byas las byung ba/ /gang gis rang bzhin las rgyal ba/ /ye shes kyis ni snang bar bya/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid stong pa yis(nye/ /'gro ba'i dngos kun zad par bya/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bskyed pa yis/ /gzugs sogs thams cad zad pa na/ /de gnyis dbus su bsam bya ba/ /zla ba dzi)'o ma'i sa bon te/ ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ / de yi yidabus su btu (sprebar bya/ /de yi sa bon de nyid kyis/ /'od zer phreng ⑫ba bsam par bya/ /sa bon de nyid gang gis ni/ /myur du ye shes snang bar 'gyur / /gzugs mdzes yongs su mdzes pa yis(3/ /ye shes sku ru de nas bsgom / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams su ni/ /sangs rgyas sprin rnams spro 80—643

bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg pa'i mtha' ldan pa'i/ /sa bon gang zhig bzla ba ni / /sde tshan gsum pa gang yin pa'i/ /yi ge gsum pa gzung bar bya/ /dbyug pa spyi bo 1rdo rje dang / /ska 5)bo che la dasogs pas dkri/ /sems ni mnyam nyid bsgoms nas su/ /rnal 'byor can gyis bzlas par bya/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ba med pa ru/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom byas la/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan la 'bad pas/ /'og min la casogs snang bar bya/ /'od zer 'phro ba spros pa yis/ /sa 'og rim pa bdun yang bsam/ /rnal 'byor snang bar 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu sems kyis bsgom par bya/ /snying ga'i 5dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba dbang phyug mchog /sngon gyi mtshan nyid kun rig pas/ /thams cad kun nas zad par bya/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /ye shes sa bon de dbus bsam/ /de las byung ba'i ye shes lus/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bdag nyid de / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /pad+ma'i stan la bzhugs pa ste/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid kun rig pas/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i skur bsgoms la/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba 'o ma'i sa bon bsam/ /kun nas mnyam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rtag tu de nyid bsgom par bya/ /kha dog dkar po 'od 'bar las/ /kun tu rdul phran dkar pos dgang / /pha rol dngos po dmar po ru/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /pad+ma'i stan la bzhugs pa yi/ /rdo rje sems dpar 7bsams nas su/ /gang gi snying gi dbus su ni/ /de yi rnam shes gzung bar bya : zhes bya ba'i phyogs brgyad du/ /kha dog dmar po bsams nas 8ni/ /rtag tu 80—644

mnyam nyid lta ba yis/ /blo ldan pha rol sems shes bya/ /kun nas dpag tshad phyi rol du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni gang bsams na/ / de yi 91)bsam pa thams cad ni/ /yi ge de yis ston par 'gyur/ /gal te pha rol cha yis ni/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid shes 'dod pas/ /gzhan gyi sems ni rig rin)pa yis/ /kun nas thams cad shes byas la/ /dpa' bo sems can kun don phyir/ /rnal 'byor 'di yis sbyar bar bya/ /de nas me yi las kyi bdag /sbyor ba ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /ye shes me yi bdag nyid la/ /sbyin sreg mtshan nyid ji ltar lags//thams cad sems kyis byin brlabs na pas/ /skye bo'i lus can ye shes me/ /thams cad ye shes byin brlabs 4pa/ / me yi 5de nyid mnyam 67par gyis/ /bdag nyid sems kyis bsregs pas ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis sbyin sreg bya/ /mdud pa'i lte ba'i dbus nyid kyi/ /dngos su sor ni bdun pa ste/ /me yi thab 7kyi gnas yin la/ /klu dbang 'khyil ba'i bskor ba yin/ /yi ge thams cad 'bar bar bya/ /de dbus pad+ma rig pa yis/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes lus ni 'bar bar 8gzung / /mdud pa'i me 9la dkar 1 po ru/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro thim par bya/ /g.yas kyi cha yi logs su ni/ /drag po (17thim bya me dang 'dra/ /lte ba dmar po 'bar ba la/ /lha mo'i rtse mo ro langs ma/ /g.yon phyogs cha ni sngon po la/ /drag tu 'bar ba gtum mo ste/ /me lnga yi ni bdag nyid rnams/ /gzugs mdzes mthe bo'i tshad du blta/ /chu dang me dang rlung dang ni/ /sa dang ye shes rnam 15pa lnga/ /lha mo lnga yi bdag nyid la/ /sbyin sreg cho ga'i mchog yin no/ /bcu dang brgyad kyi rtsa rnams nas / /dus su bdud rtsi dmigs par bya/ /ba lang mig pa'i dbus su ni/ /80wa 645

'dzag pa der ni thim par bya/ / me yi (1)dbus su bsreg pa'i gzhi/ /dbyangs yig dang po sogs sa bon/ /'di ltar de kho na bsgoms nas/ /bdag nyid rgyas phyir bsreg par bya/ /cung zad bza' dang btung la (gesogs/ /rung bar byas nas bza' bar bya/ /'di ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa(5)/ /bu lon du yang mi 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// //spre'u 'dra bar mi gnas pa/ /mnyam nyid gang gis sbyar bar bgyi/ /lus kyi sbyor ba'i ma tshan nyid rnams/ /lha la rol mo nyan par 'tshal/ /'byung ba yi ni 4khyad par dang / /gsang ba rdo rje chen pos nyon/ /sems ni mnyam par gnas pa ste/ /nye bar zhi nas ka 5)lir 'jug /lus las spu rnams skye ba ni/ /kun tu chu yi tshad ma ste/ /chu la lus ni ma yin te/ /lus la chu yi tshad ma yin/ /lus kun las (6ni khyab pas na/ /blo ldan chu ni tshad ma'o/ /lus ni rdo rje lha mo yin / /lus kyi yan lag thams cad la/ /me 'bar lta bur dro ba ste/ /kha zas smin pa'i tshad ma yis / /me ni tshad mar rab tu grags/ /yan lag thams cad khyab pa yi/ /me ni kun rig dmar yin pas/ /lus ni drag mor bstan pa ste / /bdag nyid tshad mar rab tu grags/ /bu gar zla ba 'dra gnas pas/ / rlung gis 8lus kun khyab pa ste/ /dbugs rgyu ba yi tshad ma yis/ /mkhas pas sems ni tshad mar grags/ /lus la brten 997pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbugs ni gang gis shes nas su/ /thams cad lha mo ro langs mar/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /sa ni kun gyi gnas yin te/ /gzugs sogs dbang po yon 80—646

tan ldan/ /gzugs la sogs pa snang ba na6)/ /sa ni tshad ma'i gnas yin no/ /mdzes ma zhes bya rab tu grags/ /de ni lha mo gtum mo ste/ /kun gyi gtso mor rab tu grags/ /yid ni the tshom gcod pa ste/ /byed po sdud po za po'ang yin/ /dbang po kun gyi sems rnams kyi(2/ /mtshan gzhi (gumatshan nyid shes par bya/ /dbang rgyal nyer sbyor rgyalongs spyod pa/ /yul la sogs pa nyer spyod kyi/ /rnal 'byor tshad ma mkhas pa yis/ /lus la ye shes bsten (5)par bya/ /sems las chu ni byung bas na/ /rnam shes chu ru gyur pa ste/ /gal te chu ni gzhan yin na(6)/ /ci phyir zhe na chu mi 'byung / /lus la nges par drod yod na/ /chu yi (7nang du bying mi 'gyur/ /lus la tshad ma lnga yod pas/ /lnga po gcig (8)gi bdag nyid 'gyur / /mtshan nyid gcig tu shes byas nas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'gro ba (9pebartag / de yi 7mtshan nyid shes bya'i phyir/ /dge ba'i bshes (lhaganyen bsten par bya/ /de nyid rnal 'byor grogs kyis 12ni/ /'khor ba'i pha rol rgal yo bar 'gyur / /yul dang dbang po'i ye shes ni/ /gzir dang bcas pas sdom par 'gyur / /sgong skyes khyim gyi gnas su ni/ /dbus 57su gnas pa bcing bar gebya//'byung dang 'byung min sems kyis yoni/ /g.yo ba'i dngos po bskor bar bya/ /bcing ba'i gnas dang stan dag ni/ /rnam shes pad+ma'i stan la'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de yi phyir/ /rnam shes rang bzhin mtshon par bya/ /gzugs zhes nyu 7bya ba'i dngos po yis(snye/ /rnal 'byor grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin zhes bya'i dngos por 'gyur/ /lte bar chu shing me tog ni/ /snying gar ()yang ni 'greng ste gnas/ /rtag tu stong pa'i sgo yin te/ /mkhas pas rtag tu bzlog par bya/ /ge sar dang ni ldan pa yi/ /rtag tu 'dab ri )ma brgyad du 'gyur/ /80—647

de dbus rtag tu gsungs pa ni/ /ye shes rnam shes sbyor ba ste/ /sbyor ba yi ni shar phyogs char/ /de dang mthun 1pa'i sor drug pa'o/ /mdud pa yi ni nub phyogs char/ /'og tu sor ni lnga pa'o/ /zhing de la ni sa bon dang / /'od zer 2tshogs kyi myu gur 'gyur/ /sa bon de yi 'od zer gyis/ /chu shing lta bur bskor bar bya/ /rgyas pa lnga yi sa bon la/ /lto la yi 'og nas dgar (5)bar bya/ /pad+mo mdzes pa bkas 6pa yis/ /'dab 7ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /pad+mo de yi stan la ni/ /sgong skyes ye shes gnas dag la/ /dbus su shel ltar dag pa yis/ /ye shes rnam shes dbu ma nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sa bon rnams / /phyogs kyi 'dab namar gnas pa ste/ /dbyangs yig dang po sogs sa bon / /mtshams su sen 9 mo la sogs pa'i/ /ma ning yi ge sngar tsho bstan bzhin//snying gar 11dngos po dngos po yis/ /snying gar 15yi ge blta bar bya/ /ba lang mig pa'i steng du ni/ /sgo dgu pa yi 1 bdud rtsi yis/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu bkru/ /yi ge dkar po brgyad po rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i (7yi ge dkar po yi / /'od 'bar ba spu'i khung nas spro/ /rnal 'byor can gyis thams cad du/ /'gro dang 'chag dang 'dug pa dang / /nyal ba la sogs dus kun tu/ /ye shes rnam shes sa bon bzlas15/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sems kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis bsgoms 1 smobazlas na/ /ye shes las byung rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor ba'i pha rol rgal 1 bar 'gyur/ /g.yo ba med cing 'tshe med par/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /gong du 'pho ba'i sbyor mtshan nyid/ /ji bzhin rdo rjes mnyan par gyis/ /lam bzang po yi rnal 'byor pa/ /'gro ba mdzes pa blta bar bya/ /sgo dgu po ni ji lta bu/ /ye shes sgo yi bye brag gis/ /yon tan 863—648

skyon rnams ji lta bu/ /ye shes dbang las nyan 1par 'tshal/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshad ma rnams/ /yang dag rab /sbyor mnyan par gyis/ /lam bzang dpo yis mdzes pa'i gnas/ /lam ngan srid pa'i skyon gyis gos/ /thig le lte ba spyi gtsug dang / /mig dang sna dang rna srid sgo/ /chu dang chu min sgo yin te/ /sgo dgu yi ni mtshan nyid yin/ /lte ba 'dod can lamatho 5ris te/ /thig les 6gzugs khams kyi 7lus can/ /steng nas steng 8du gnas de ru/ /mi gdung la sogs de ru 'gro/ /sna nas gnod sbyin gnas su ste9/ /rna ba dag gis grub pa'i lha/ /gal te mig las ye shes 'gro/ /mi rnams kyi ni bdag por 'gro/ /srid pa'i sgo yis yi dgas te/ /de bzhin gci bas 1 dud 'gro'o/ /chu min rnam shes myur ba ru/ /dmyal ba brgyad du shes par 11bya'o/ /sgo rnams kyi ni bye brag gis/ /'khor ba'i bye brag 'byung ba yin/ /de bas sgo yi bye brag las/ /sgrub pos lam ni bzang po ste/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma ston pa dang / /'chi ba'i dus la bab lha pa na na/ /rims la sogs pas ma phog ’ par/ /gong du 'pho ba sbyor ba'i mchog /sngon du bum pa brtsams pa yis15/ /sgo rnams thams cad bcing bar bya/ /rgyas pa lnga yi mchod rten gyis/ /sgo ni dgag pa bsgom bya ste/ /de la 'og gi sgo ru ni/ / chu yi 1gyis bon dkar po bsam/ /chu dang chu min sgo la ni/ /me yi sa bon 'bar ba ste/ /de la shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /dbugs ni bum pa can du bsgom/ /lus ni rlung gi mdog tu ste/ /sems ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /rtsa ba rlung gi sa bon no/ /rlung gi mtha' ni rtsa ba can / /thig le sgra dang ldan pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i sa bon drang bar bya/ /rdo rje'i sa bon drag mo yis/ /lcags kyu la 1 sogs sbyar bar bya/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig 80—649

dbugs rnams kyis/ /gnas nas drag tu drang bar bya/ /gnas dang ①gnas nas steng du dbye(she/ /tshigs dgu las ni steng du bya/ /steng du smin pa'i sa bon dang / /yi (2)ge phyed dang gnyis kyis sbyang / /drag mo'i nga ro ④brjod bya ste/ /brgyad kyi (5)mtha' yi sa bon la/ /sde tshan dang po'i dbang 6)po ni/ /yi ge phyed du sbyar bar bya/ /'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /sgra yi dbye bas bskul bar bya/ /rlung gi sa bon ldan pa yi/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig gnas rnams nas/ /gong nas de bzhin steng gnas gsu/ /rnal 'byor pa yis smin byas la/ /steng gi rtsa la (7bzla bar bya/ /tshigs dgu las ni steng gzhan gyis/ /mod la 'pho bar shes bya ste/ /nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang ske/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /rku 'phrog 'dod la spyod pa dag /lam 'di yis ni dag 'gyur te/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i skyon las ring du 'gro/ /ji ltar 'dam nas skyes pa yi/ /pad+ma dri med yid 'ong ba/ /de bzhin lus kyi 'dam las ni/ /ye shes sku ni 'dod bzhin 'gro/ /dus la bab na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /de bas lus la mtshan ma rnams/ /mthong nas mkhas pas sbyor ba brtsam/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub 99pa'i khyad par gyis/ /de nyid ji bzhin rdo rjes nyon/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid kun rig pas/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bsgom par bya/ /snying ga'i tunyadakyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi sa bon bsam/ /de 'od nyi mar 'bar ba yis/ /gzugs rnams zad par bsams nas ni/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid ldan pa yis12/ /sngar bstan stong nyid bsam par bya/ /gzugs sogs thams cad bcom nas ni/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba gnas par bsam sa bon 80—650

gyis ni bskyed 6)bya ba/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa(5)/ /pad+ma'i stan la bzhugs pa yi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bdag nyid ni/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /spyan gsum cod (5)pan gyis brgyan zhing / /bzhad dang khro dang sgeg pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs pa yi/ /kun+da zla ba ltar dkar zhing / /shin tu mdzes pa'i na bza' mnabs(4ri/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung (5)gnas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas sprin rnams spro ba mdzad/ /g.yas kyi dang po mda' yin te/ /gnyis pa yis ni lcags kyu bsnams(6)/ /gsum pa na ni rdo rje nyid / /g.yon pa khro bo'i (7) sdigs mdzub 58)ste/ /gnyis pa 'jigs pa'i zhags pa thogs/ /go cha'i gzhu ni steng na bsnams/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba ru//dbugs mi g.yo bar bsgom par bya/ /yan lag brgyad du rab 'bad nas/ /sa bon brgyad kyi yi ge dgod/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /sa bon ji bzhin btu bar bya/ /'od zer ldan pa'i sa bon rnams/ /kun tu kha dog dkar por bya / /chu shing me tog pad+mo la/ /snying gar smyo sgong skyes gzhag par bya/ / de yi tshedabus su rnam shes dang / /ye shes lhan cig ldan par ni/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ba med pa ru/ /dngos pos /nyadangos po bsgom par bya/ /de nas phyi rol sbyor ba ni//mkhas pa yis ni gzung bar bya/ /gnas gnyis dag ni bsams pa ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su me yin te/ / me yi zhu dbus su nyi ma la/ /ā li kā lir ldan pa yi/ / de yi /nyes bon dmar por dgod/ /rnal 'byor pa yis khyad par du/ /'byung dang 'jug pas yobazlas par bya/ /'byung ba ye shes sa bon gyis/ /dbus su bsnun tsodang ldan par bya/ /'jug pas snying gi rnam shes la/ /me tog lta bur bsnun par bya/ /'byung ba 'jug 80wa 651

min bzlas bya zhing / /'jug pa 'jug pa min la bzla/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'byung 'jug dang / /bdag nyid dang ni phyi rol bya/ /'byung ba'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa dang / /'jug pa yis ni mtshon byas la/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 6)'byung 'jug dag /de kho na nyid mnyam par bsgom/ /mnyam gzhag dngos po bsgoms nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni 5)the tshom med/ /de nas phyi rol lus la ni/ /sgrub pa po yis rnam par sprul/ /pha rol sems dang rjes mthun (5)par / /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /bsgom (4)dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyi(de//shin tu mnyam par gzhag ste bsam/ /gang gis (6)lam nas bsams nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom med/ /gsang ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa las rim par phye ba gsum pa'o// //gsang ba'i 7gdan gyi gsang ba nyid/ /sems dang ye shes 'dres pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim ci 'dra/ /ye shes dbang las nyan (khupar 'tshal/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba chos kyi don/ /byang chub rim pa 9)rdo rje nyon/ /'dod chags la 9sogs rim 1 spangs 12nas/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bskyed par bya/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas nas ni/ /khams dang sems ni bde ba yis/ /snying rjes phan pa bsam par bya/ /yang dag bstan bcos de nyid thos/ /slob dpon lung gi 12rjes 'gro zhing / /gsang chen de nyid don sgom pa/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud de nyid can/ /thams cad sngon bzhin mtshon byas nas/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du bya/ /dri ma bkrus pa'i lus la ni/ /byang chub rim pas btso bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus 80—652

gnas par/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bsam byas te/ /zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yi//kun+da zla ba ltar dkar mdog /zhabs 6)gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung (gebacas/ /pad+ma yi ni stan la bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis brgyan pa ste/ /phyag gnyis phyag rgya che bcings nas/ /nyid kyi thugs mar (gu'atshir bar mdzad/ /gzugs mdzes shin tu rdzogs pa ste/ /ye shes sems dpa' bdag ces brjod/ /chu shing me tog lte ba nas/ /snying gi bar du 'greng gi)ste gnas/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid kyis bzlog nas/ /sngon bzhin pad+ma rgyas (5)par bya/ /ge sar dang ni lte bar bcas/ /'dab (6)brgyad shin tu mdzes pa ste/ /dbus kyi sgong skyes la gnas par/ /yi ge'i dgod pa dgod par bya/ /kha dog dkar (7)po dag cing gsal/ /dbus su bsgom bya zhu ba'i gtso / / de yi 98)dbus su rnam shes dang / /ye shes dag ni sbyar bar bya/ /shar du byams par ldan pa yis(9)/ /mi bskyod pa yi 1 )sa bon bsam/ /lho yi sgo ru snying rje ste/ /rin chen sa bon de nyid do1gle/ /nub kyi kyi sgo yi (1ge'adab yim la/ /'od dpag med kyi sa bon dgod/ /byang gi cha yi 'dab 12ma la/ /don yod gtso bo bsam par bya/ /dbyangs yig thog ma sogs sa bon/ /thig le dbyug tsopar ldan rim bzhin/ /'od zer dkar pos brgyan pa ste/ /yi ge bzhi 1 ni dgod par bya/ /phyogs mtshams dag ni bzhi po ru/ /sngon du bstan pa'i ma ning dgod/ / de yi yinadabus su de yi 19sems/ /yi ge ru ni mtshon par bya/ /stong pa mtshan nyid med pa las/ /ji ltar yi ge sbyar bar bgyi/ /sems ni ya mtshan skyes par 'gyur )/ /bcom ldan bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa las/ /chu 80—653

shing snye stima'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /snying po med pa'i snying por gyur/ /de nyid ji bzhin rdo rjes nyon/ /dbus na gnas pa ye shes te/ /ye shes rang bzhin gzugs med cing / /mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /dri ma med pa'i ye shes sku/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /yi ge'i (migazugs ni yi ge med/ /gzugs dang stong pa'i dbus su ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis de nyid gzugs / /gang gi mtshan nyid shes byas nas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes shes pa ④dang —/ /de yis (snyerdzogs pa'i byang chub lam/ /myur ba nyid du mthong bar 'gyur / /bla ma nyid kyi lam gyis ni/ /ye shes rnam shes rang bzhin nyid/ /bstan bcos la ni mtshan nyid bstan/ /de kho na nyid dpa' bos bshad/ /'od zer dkar pos rgyas pa ru/ /'di ni kun tu bsgom par bya(6)/ /rgyas pa ⑦lnga yi mchod rten te/ /bdud rtsi'i nas bon bsams nas ni/ /'od zer dkar po gsal ba'i mdangs/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'dzag pas bkru/ /thigs pa'i dbus su sa bon ni/ /mthe (9)bo nyi tsam gyi zlum por bya/ / de yi (1dbus kyi sa bon ni/ /ā li kā li dag las btu/ /kha dog 7dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /zla ba'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro/ /de yi dbus kyi sa bon ni/ /thig le bsam par rab tu grags/ /skra yi rtse mo brgya 1 yi cha/ /rdul phran gzugs su kun tu bsam / /rnam par shes pa'i dngos po yi/ /mtshan nyid mtshon pa'i ye shes can / /sems kyi mtshan nyid mi shes pas/ /thig le gnas kyi go 'phang ltaski/ /snying dang tshangs pa'i sgo skong ni/ /thigs pa'i lam gyi sgo dag tu/ /bla ma'i lung la gus pa yis/ /rnam shes ye shes gzung bar bya/ /phyi rol gyi ni lam dag dang / /bstan bcos las kyang ring ba yin/ /bstan bcos dag ni rnyed sla ste//80—654

de yi hu)sbyor ba rnyed par dka'/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur la gus pa'i/ /thabs dang ldan pa sgrub ②pa po/ /bla ma'i lung gi lam gyis ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni blta ③bar bya/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ④ba med pa ru/ /mnyam par gzhag pas dngos po bsgom / /chos kyi sngon 'gro yid yin te/ /yid kyis 'jug cing yid kyis 'dag⑤ /de bas thams cad yid rang bzhin/ /blo ldan yid las 'byung zhes bya / /gal te bzlas 'dod rnal 'byor pas/ /snying gi sdom pa bsam par bya/ /sa bon gyi ni rgyur gyur pa/ /de kho nar ni gzugs min no/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sa bon ni/ /de kho na nyid mthong ba min/ /gzugs sogs srid pa'i longs spyod la/ /sa bon dmigs shing bzlas par bya/ /kun nas kun tu 'jug pa dang / /'og dang sti'og min yang dag gnas/ /rtsa bar rtag tu gzer bar bya/ /ye shes rnam shes sa bon ni/ /thig le sgra dang yang dag ldan/ /srid pa'i longs spyod 'dod pa yis/ /phyi rol ngag ni spangs nas su/ /yid kyis bzlas ⑦dang ldan par bya/ /rtag pa chos kyi dbyings nyid kyis/ /mi g.yo go 'phang rgyun du gnas/ /rtag tu phra zhing gos med pas/ /ye shes la ni rnam shes thim/ /rnam shes ye shes nyid gyur nas/ /byang chub rim pa mthong bar 'gyur / /mar me lta bu nithams cad du/ /snang 'gyur 6)mtshan ma dang po ste/ /srin bu me khyer lta bu'i rdul/ /mthong ba yimatshan ma gnyis pa yin/ /gsum pa la ni rnal 'byor pas/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i mtshan ma ste/ /rdul phran dkar po'i tshul gyis ni/ /de bzhin phyogs bcur mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa lha yis (7longs spyod rnams/ /sems kyis mthong ba bzhi pa ste/ /mtho ris gzugs kyi lha rnams ni/ /sems kyis mthong ba lnga pa yin/ /gzugs med 80—655

longs spyod drug pa ste/ /bdun pa chos kyi sa la'o/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu brgyad pa ste/ /rnal 'byor pa ni rang dgar spyod/ /mchod rten gzugs kyi khyad par las/ /dbyibs kyi gzugs ni ji lta bu/ /lha yi rnam dag bsgoms pa rnams / /bcom ldan 'das la nyan par 'tshal/ /lus can rnams la yang dag blta / /yang dag de nyid shes nas su/ /de nyid sbyor ba brtsam 0)pa yi rab sbyor rdo rje mnyan par gyis/ /snying gar ༷5)zla ba bsams nas su/ /dbus su hūm̐ ni bsgom par bya/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer gsal/ /spyi gtsug dkar por yang dag ldan/ /me lce 'bar bas bcom nas ni/ /thams cad kun nas zad par bya/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid de kho nas/ /de nyid stong pa nyid du bya'i/ /de nas zla bar sa bon ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsams nas su/ /mchod rten pho brang gnas nyid ni/ /de la nasems kyis bskyed par bya/ /gya gyu sa zhes brjod pa ste/ /phyogs brgyad dag ni khams yin na/ /dril bu nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa / /lhun po'i lha yi 5gnas nyid do/ /'dod na spyod pa'i lus can rnams / /bre ru nges par brtag par bya/ /'og dang steng dang dbus nyid kyi/ /dbus su gnas pa bdag med chos/ /gzugs khams zhes bya'i mtho ris rnams//'khor lo'i phreng bas 6rnam par brgyan/ /gzugs can bcu dang brgyad po (77ni/ /go rims 2ji bzhin rnam par gnas/ /gzugs med srid pa'i sems can ni/ /chos kyi srog shing nyid du thim/ /lha rnams kun gyi pho brang ni/ /gzugs su mchod rten bskyed par bya/ /steng gi sgong 9skyes gnas su ni/ /bdag gi sems ni mnyam bya ste/ /sems dang ye shes 'dres pas na/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gzugs dang stong pa'i mtha' dang ni/ /de bzhin dngos dang 80—656

dngos med nyid/ /gzung zhi)dang 'dzin pa la sogs gzhan/ /legs byas dang ni bzlog pa rnams/ /mtshan gzhi (5)mtshan nyid (7ston pa'o/ /de yi dbus su bsgom par bya/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod sogs pa'i/ /sdos 'di yis ni mchod nas su/ /mi g.yo 'tshe ba med pa ru/ /dngos pos 9)dngos po bsgom par bya/ /mnyam bzhag dngos po bsgoms nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni the tshom (5)med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /de nyid bstan bcos lung la sogs / /rnal 'byor dmigs pa goms byas pa'i/ /slob ma chen po'i lus can rnams / /gdan bzhi 56)pa yi de kho na/ /bla ma'i man ngag ldan pa yis/ /rim gyis rang dgar longs spyod de/ /bdag med blta zhing myang (7)bar bya/ /bdud rtsi (0myong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ye shes sku ni myur du 'thob(9)/ /ye shes sku yi rnal 'byor pas/ /bdag dang gzhan don mchog tu 'gyur/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /gsang chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /de nyid de nyid mchog de nyid/ /gang gis byang chub lam gyur pa/ /bcom ldan 'das la nyan 7par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//dang por re zhig 417rnal 'byor pas/ /bdag nyid rang dgar byed pa yi/ /rta rgod lta bu'i sems de nyid/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsdam (12par bya/ /ji ltar bung ba me tog bsnyung ba yi/ /chang gis myos tsho shing sems ni brtan 7'gyur 15te/ /longs spyod zhugs shing sdug bsngal rmongs dang bral/ /de bzhin bsgom pa'i lam gyis yid bcing 4bya/ /yid bsdams pa 17ni 'grub 'gyur bas/ /dang por nyusheyid ni bsdam 19)par bya/ /yid kyis bsgrub pa'i bye brag gis/ /byang chub ye shes mtshon par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes mkha' 80—657
