༄ga /dpal gdan bzhi pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sngags kyi cha zhes bya ba/①༄༅na / rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsa tuḥbī ṭhā khyu ta tan+t+ra rā dzo man+t+ra i sa nā ma / bod skad du/ dpal gdan bzhi pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sngags kyi cha zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig la spyod pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gus par phyag 'tshal lo / /95)gdan bzhi pa yi tsho rgyud kyi ni/ /gsum pa yi ni dang po'o/ /de yi sbyor ba rnyed nas ni/ /sngags kyi de bzhin (4)khyad par nyid/ /snying po yi ni snying po'i chos/ /rab sbyor gsang zhing gsang (5)ba yi/ /de nyid de nyid de las mchog /snying po'i 96)de nyid bsdus pa'o/ /bla ma'i ma ning (7gnyis bzung la/ /rtsa bar bskor 8zhing mnan 9par bya/ /spyi bor 'od dang zla ba'o/ /sa bon 80—686

bskyed pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /zla ba dkar dang kun+da'i mdog /gtso bo'i sngon du sbyar ①bar bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa rdzogs bya zhing / /dbyangs yig mngon par mthong ba ni/ /las rnams gsum gyi sngon du ni/ /bla ma'i yi ge sngon du'o/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar po'o/ /bzhi pa dag ②pa ru ni brjod/ /myu ①gu'i gnas ni gtso bo nyid/ /srid pa mchog tu stisgrol ba'o/ /dbyangs yig dbyangs kyi bsgom (snyepa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis yimatshon par bya/ /don grub 'dod pas ⑦bzlas pa yi/ /bas ka yi me tog 'dra/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la rtag tu/ /de nyid du na rnam par 2thim/ /dkar po zla bas mnan pa yi/ /gnyis ka bsgoms pas bkru bar bya/ /pad+ma rdo rje zla ba dang / /bdud rtsi yis ni bkru bar ldan/ /dang po'i sa bon gtso bo yis/ /dbyangs yig kun la khyab pa'o6)/ /dkar zhing dag la mnyam ⑩pa'i 'od/ /gsum pa'i las kyi sa bon ni/ /bzhi par nam yang ma yin no/ /ji ltar dang po mthar gnas pa'i/ /khyad par dbyangs yig sa bon nyid/ /mtha' yi sngon du sa bon nyid/ /de bzhin sngon du nyis ⑩'gyur ro / /bzhi po mnyam pa'i cha ru ni/ /mnyam pa'i (nyaganas su sbyar bar bya/ /bzhi pa gsum pa'i sa bon ni/ /mgo smos go ba'i lus nyid do/ /yi ge gsum gyi lus nyid ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dbyangs yig dngos(ste/ /lus dang lus sogs yi 8ge ni/ /lcags kyu yis ni mnan 8par bya/ /dmar dang gnag sogs sa bon ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi tsokhyad par du/ /lnga pa drug pa'i sa bon ni / /thams cad sgra yi yi ge'o/ /dkar dang ser la lci bar bshad/ /dmar dang sngon po de bzhin yang / /zhi rgyas dbang la yi sogs pa ni/ /kun kyang sgra tunyeyi dbye ba'o/ /thams cad las la sgra yis ni/ /kha dog bzhi ()ru rab tu grags//80—687

bdun pa brgyad pa'i sa bon gyis/ /skyes bu rang 'dod pa yi las nges par lus ni sdom pa dang / /gnyis pa'i sa bon gyis mnan pa'o/ /yang bas dmar dang gnag la sbyar/ /rnal 'byor pa yi khyad par du/ /mtshams ni bcad cing mnan (1)pa'i las/ /gnyis pa lcags kyu'i yi ge ni/ /rang bzhin yi ge ming gi ni / /de nyid las rnams 'gugs pa dang / /sa bon 'di ni dbye ba'o/ /kha dog dmar po mchog gi 'od/ /thams cad 'dres pa'i sa bon ni/ /dbyangs yig bskyed pa'i sa bon ni/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa'o/ /ma ning gis bskyed sa bon ni/ /brtan zhing rtag pa'i sa bon no/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa 'am / /'di nyid kun nas rab tu sbyar/ /sde tshan (5bzhi pa'i bzhi pa ni/ /tha ma bzhi ni rnam spangs pa/ /dkar dang kun+da (55zla ba'i mdog /nyi ma'i yi ge rnam par shes/ /tha ma bzhi ni (4)lnga pa dang / /sde tshan (5)drug pa yang dag ldan/ /kun nas mtshan mo'i stong par ni/ /khyad par du ni shes par bya/ /bdud rtsi chu yi sa bon ni/ /dkar zhing shel ltar mnyam pa'i 'od/ /de nyid kun gyi de nyid ni / /kun nas bdud rtsi'i 67grub pa'o/ /lha min grub pas 'gugs pa dang / /lha dang mi dang gnod sbyin dang / /thams cad las rnams grub pa ni/ /sa bon 'di ni khyad par nyid/ /sbom po ma ning gnyis kyis la/ /lcags sgrog ( bzhin du kha sprad pa / /rtsa bar yang ba nyis 'gyur ro/ /spyi bor bdud rtsi rnam par dgod / /steng du thig le 'bar ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas lnga yi 9)rang bzhin sku / /sa bon lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam bzhir phye zhing phye ba yis/ /lce rtsa nyu snalce rtser gsungs pa ni/ /kha dog dmar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /zhi dang chu yi bye brag la / /hūm̐ gi rnam pa rkan la sbyar/ /rtsa bar sgra dang 'od bral ba/ /bar ma yi ni 80—688

dbyangs su gsungs/ /gal te 'dod na lha yi lus/ /khyad par du ni zhi ba'i las / /snying ga'i tsa)rtsa bar gsungs pa ni/ /kha dog ser po'i 'od mnyam pa/ /sbom po'i sgra dang thig le dang / /rgyas pa dang ni me yi las/ /lte bar sgra dang 'joms pa ni/ /kha dog dmar po 'od mnyam pa/ /sbom po'i sgra dang ldan pa'i 'od / /dbang gi las la rab tu sbyar/ / sna rtser sbrid (5)pa gsum pa ni/ /kha dog sngon po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /yang ba'i sgra yi 'od du ni/ /ldam/ par blo dang ( rildan par bskul/ /bskrad dang gsad (4)dang bcing ba dang / /mnan dang gdug ( sogs bskrad pa dang / /gtor ma la sogs nag po'i las/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa sbrid (6)par sbyar/ /de nyid de nyid bzhi par ni/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa nye bar mtshon / /sa bon thams cad 'byin mdzad pa/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa dbang phyug mchog /thams cad 'byin pa'i ngo bo bas/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge mchog gi lha/ /stong nyid yi ge'i (7)rtsu gyur pas/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stong pa'i gzugs dang rab ldan pa/ /dngos dang dngos med 'byin mdzad pa/ /btso ma gser dang 'dra ba'i mdog /sgra dang thig le yang dag ldan/ /ri rab rgya mtsho ri ni grags/ /(8)brtan pa dang ni g.yo bar ldan/ /lha dang lha min grub pa dang / /mi dang gnod sbyin rnal 'byor pa/ /lha rnams kun nas g.yo ba ni/ /gsungs pa'i sa bon gyis 'gugs byed/ /sde tshan dang po'i sa bon ni/ /rtsa bar re pha mnan pa dang / /lcags kyus mgor ni rnam par dgod/ /steng du zla ba'i 'od dang bcas/ /kha dog dmar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyu yis ni snying po bsgrubatso)/ /lcags kyu yi ge sa bon bzhin/ /lcags kyu yis ni kun 'gugs pa'o/ /stong par rlung gi sa bon ni/ /sde tshan brgyad kyi dang po la/ /80—689

rtsa bar sgra yis dkri bar bya/ /spyi bor zla tshes thig le dang / /rlung gi kha dog drag po yis/ /lus can kun ni bskul bar bya/ /bskul ba'i las kyi yonyes bon gyis / /sa bon de nyid kun tu sbyar/ /lnga pa sde tshan gnyis pa yil/ /gsum pa'i yi ge gzung ②byas la/ /yi ge gsum pas mnan par bya/ /re pha rtsa ④bar sbyar ba dang / /steng du bdud rtsi'i thigs pa'o/ /kha dog dkar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /dgyes pa la sogs sa bon gyis/ /lha tshogs (nyekun nas mnyes par byed / /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pa ni/ /gsang ba'i sgra ni rtsa bar ro/ /steng du bdud rtsi'i thig le dang / /dkar zhing yid 'ong shin tu 'bar/ /mchod pa'i sngags kyi dus dang ni/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg yiphyag rgya sogs/ /rgyas pa'i las ni thams cad la/ /rgyas pa'i sa bon du ni grags/ /dang po'i sde tshan bzhi pa la / /rtsa bar re pha sgra dang ni/ /spyi bo'i steng du 'bar ba'o/ /kha dog dmar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /zhi ba'i las ni rnam spangs pa/ /las rnams kun gyi sngon du'o / /rmongs shing lus kun rmongs byed pasal/ /rmongs pa'i sa bon du ni grags / /sde tshan lnga pa'i gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa'i sa bon blang byas pani/ /mtha' ru stong pa gnyis kyis so/ /kha dog dkar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba sogs/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i gnas su gzhag6) /bzhag pa'i las la rnal 'byor pas/ /blo ldan yi ge 'di yis gzhag /stong pa'i sde tshan ⑩la spyad la/ / de yi 9/mebazhi pa gzung bar bya/ /rtsa bar ma ning sbom po dang / /steng du bdud rtsi'i nastethig le'o/ /'jigs pa bsrung (geba'i las nyid la/ /kha dog dkar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rnal 'byor de nyid 'dod pa yi/ /sa bon 'di nyid kyis bsrung mingo / /bsreg 7pa'i yi ge sngags nyid ni/ /dbye ba rnam 80—690

pa gsum du bshad/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar sogs kyi/ /las gsum gyi ni mtha' ①ru'o/ /bdun pa yi ni mtha' bzung la/ /brgyad pa gnyis pa yi ni gdan / /bdud rtsi yi ni gdan du chu/ /kha dog dkar po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /ma ning sde tshan gyis bskyed pa'i/ /me ltar dmar ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ /logs su dbyangs yig dbyug pa'o/ /zhi ba la ni bsreg ②pa'i mthar/ /bdud rtsi'i sa bon kha dog ser/ / chu yi dus bon dkar ba'i ④gdan/ /logs (gesu dbyangs yig dbyug pa'o/ /brgyad kyi mtha' ma kun nas 'bar/ /rdo rje 'od bzhin 'bar ba'i me/ /sa bon 'od bzhin 'bar bcas pa/ /dbyangs yig dbyug pa'i sreg ⑥pa'o/ / rgyas pa'i sreg ⑦pa'i mtha' mar ro/ /de yi bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i ni/ /brgyad mtha'i logs su dbyug pa'o/ /kun nas dmar dang dmar ba yi/ /mthar ni dbyug pa lcags kyu'o/ /dbu mar drang ba'i sems kyis ⑧ni/ /dbyug pa'i dbugs kyis bzla ⑨bar bya/ /chags pa'i las la rnal 'byor pas/ /sreg ⑩pa'i yi ge rnam pa gsum/ /rnam pa bzhi las don gnyer bas / /'joms pa'i yi ge gnyis su shes/ /bskrad dang bsad yidang dbye ba dang —/ /mnan 'dang nye bar bzlog pa la/ /stong pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa ni/ /dbyug pa glo ru rnam par sbyar/ /nyi ma'i 8sde tshan gsum pa las/ /dang po gnyis pa'i glo ru'o/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /'od zer me bzhin kun nas ldan/ /rdo rje sa bon mnyam 'bar las/ /lus kyi dbus su dbug par bya/ / bsad dang gdug pa snyibaskrad la sogs/ /drag po'i las ni thams cad la/ /dngos grub 'dod pa rnal 'byor pas/ /'joms pa'i yi ge mtha' ⑫mar ro/ / de yi yis bon ldan pa ni/ /sngon gyi dbyug tshogs rnam par spangs/ /80—691

dang po dbu yi steng rnams su/ /kha dog sngon po rab rno bas/ /gsad 6)dang dbye dang gdug pa ni/ /khro bo'i (gelha yis bskrad par bya/ /'joms pa'i yi ge'i mtha' mar ni/ /sa bon 'di yis sbyar bar bya/ /dkar po'i zhi)sde dang sde tshan gyi ni/ /dang po'i dang po blang byas la/ /kun nas rdo rje'i sa bon gyis/ /sa bon yi ge phyed dang gnyis/ /'pho bar sbyor ba'i sngon dus su/ /rnam shes gong du bskul ba'i/ /lte bar rtsa ba'i phyogs nas ni/ /yi ge phyed dang gnyis kyis 5)drang / /brgyad pa'i mtha' ni sngon du'o/ /ma la ta (6)yi sbyor dus su/ /'pho bar sbyor bas sngon du'o/ /'pho ba'i dus kyi sngon du ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rab tu spyad/ / u la (7)pa li ta sa bon/ /sbyang bya'i 58)yi ge phyed dang gnyis / /dngos dang dngos med sa bon las(1)/ /sgra dang thig le rnam par sbyar / /rlung gi rtsa ba'i gnas su ni/ /sgra dang sgra yis bstan pa'o/ /chu shing me tog lte bar gnas/ /sa bon 'di yis bsgyur bar bya/ /sngon du sbyor ba'i bsam gtan 7dang / /mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyis bcing / /bdun pa'i mtha' yi sa bon ni/ /bdud rtsi'i sa bon sa bon gyis/ /bzlog byas rgyas pa'i gnas su ni/ /chu shing me tog lta bur gyis/sto/ /ji ltar sde tshan gsum pa ni / /yi ge gsum pa gzung byas la/ /dbyug par phyi ma'i sa bon dang / / 'og pag 12gis ni sngon dkris 62pa/ /de nyid de nyid kun dang ni/ /sa bon sa bon mchog gi gtso/ /theg pa rnam gsum dag byed pa/ /ā mili'i sa bon rab tu grags/ /sde tshan brgyad pa'i gnyis pa la/ /lcags kyu yis ni spyi bor mnanaska / /spyi bor zla tshes thig le dang / /kha dog dmar po mchog gi 'od/ /sems can kun nas rmongs byed pas/ /yid dbye ba la kun nas sbyar/ /kun 80—692

g.yul nyid ni/ /gang zhig thabs dang shes rab ldan/ /dag ni dngos po gang du gnas/ /le lo gnyid dang 'dod pa dang / /khro dang rmongs pa sred pa dang / /khro ba yis ni yan lag gzir/ /thabs kyis bdud 1)ni rnam par spangs/ /le lo nyes skyon kun gyi gnas/ /gnyid kyis dge ba rnam par 'joms/ /khro ba yis ni srid pa 'dren/ /'dod pas dran pa rnam par nyams/ /rmongs pa yis ni gnyid kyis non/ /sred 5)pa yis ni 'khor bar 'jug /bkres pas dman (gezhing sdang ba yi/ /bdud bdun po ni yongs su spangs/ /kun nas bdud kyis 'bigs mapa yi/ /lus ni nyon mongs sdug bsngal gnas/ /rang 'dod pa yi sems kyis ni/ /dul bar bsrubs shing (5) mnan par 6)bya/ /gang dang gang gi lam du ni/ /rang 'dod sems kyi (chu 'bad pa (8yis/ /thams cad snying po bsdus nas ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni brtsam par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /smon lam bla med rgyu yi ni/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa (9)rtswa ba shurnyo3rta1 / yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā yi17yo ga shurnyo3rta12/ badz+ra shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3rta1 / smon lam kun mchog don du ni/ /lha nyid dmigs par 7bya ba yis/ /rnam shes rang 'dod par byas pas/ /sred dang rmongs pa rnam par spangs / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /bdag nyid lus ni rnam par brgyanabo/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod 7pan can/ /dung dang kun+da mnyam pa'i 'od / /bdag nyid sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 1 / /phyag na rdo rje dril bu dang / /sku la rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje me 'od rab 'phro ba/ /'jigs pa med cing 'tshe med par/ /dngos po dngos por bsgom par bya/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /sa bon sa bon byung ba yi/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg 18pa mthar 80wa 704

bzhag pa/ /rang 'dod pa yi 1)sems kyis bzla/ / rim bzhin 'gags (5)pa'i phyi nas ni/ /bdag med shin tu mnyam par gzhag /gzugs kun rnam par dbug (minas ni/ /khams gsum du ni mi rtog go/ /zla ba la sogs bdag nyid med / /kun nas thams cad stong par rig /stong nyid stong pa stong chen dang / /dngos med dngos por bsgoms pa yis/ /bsgoms nas lhag ma'i mtha' ru ni/ /rnam shes sgron ma (4)lta bur 'bar/ / de yi 55ni'od zer snang ba yis/ /khams gsum mun pa bsal (67nas ni/ /'bar zhing rab tu phra ba'o/ /rnam shes ye shes snang ba nyid/ /dngos dang dngos po med pa'i dbus/ /gzugs dang gzugs med dbus nyid dang / /'du shes 'du shes med par ldan/ /yud tsam lta bar rig ri7)pa'o/ /gzugs dang stong pa la sogs dbus/ /'di yi mtshan nyid mtshon pa nyid/ /'gog pa'i sbyor ba'i rim pa ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag (8)pas bsgom9/ /yan lag gzir ba med pa 1 )dang / /sems kyi skyo ba med pa yis/ /rim dang rim pa tsam (11byas nas/ /'khor ba gcod cing gcod sa pa'o/ /rtag tu nyid kyi nyu sems kyis ni/ /yang dag byang chub rim pa bstan / /shin tu bcad cing bltas nas ni/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni blang bar bya/ /oṃ bha nyu cita li bha ta li kyipe ta mu khi 9rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor gyis / /brgyad brgya ru ni bzlas par bya/ /gzugs kun rdzogs shing mdzes pa yi / /btso ma'i gser dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'od zer kun nas 'phro/ /ye shes sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags pas 'bum phrag gsum bzlas 1 na/ /'dod dang grol ba rgya chen po'i/ /phyis ni las rnams brtsam par bya/ /dur khrod thal ba sogs blangs la/ /snod la 80wa 705

dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / de yi 0)sol ba'i phye ma yis/ /gang du dkyil 'khor sprul pa yis/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan②// de yi (gedabus su pad+ma bri/ /thod pa brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan④/ /dri dang bdug pa mar me dang / /gtor ma'i de nyid de nyid dang / /kun nas nya phyis dngos po yi(5)/ /sna tshogs mchod pa rgya chen po/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dgug pa ni / /pho nya bzhi dang kun tu ldan/ /seng ge stag mo ce (7spyang dang / /'ug ⑦pa mo ni phyogs bzhir ro/ /thams cad kun nas kun tu ni(9/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi sems kyis mchod/ / de yi porashar gyi gnas su ni/ / me yi ⑩las ni rab tu bya/nya / /dur khrod shing gi lhag ma dang / / de yi tu)shing gi ba dan gsum/ /de 'am 'on te gdol ni ba'i mes/ / 'bad pas 8me ni rab tu sbar/ /rdo rje lcashes kyu rgya chen po/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres tsobyas pas/ /mchog gi sngags ni bzla bya zhing / /bsregs pas lha mo tshim par 'gyur/ /thams cad gnas dang phyogs nas ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni 'jigs pa dang / /mi bzad ku co rab sgrogs tson/ /'jigs par mi bya 'joms par 'gyur/ /dpung gi tshogs ni yan lag bzhi/ /rgyal po myur du 'ong 'gyur na/ /de la tsham ngam ⑩sbyin par bya / /ri rab ri la sogs pa dang / /sa gzhi yonye'ur 'ur 'gul ba dang / /sna tshogs mi 16bzad dri dang ni/ /'dren pa'i sems ni 'jig ( )mi bya/ /sems can chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /khri phrag gcig tu bsreg ( nyabyas na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bdun nyid ni/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom 6 med/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i 2 bya ba dang / /gtor ma'i las dang las nyid dang / /lus la ltos pa med pa yis/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom ( tshomed/ /phyi nas ye shes lha mo ni/ /80—706

me yi dbus su ston par byed/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /gtor ma dang ni ar+gha 6)dbul/ /zab cing rgya cher sgrogs pa yi/ /de la lha mo tshig tu brjod/ /sems can chen po ci zhig 'grub/ /gang 'dod dngos grub rab tu smros/ /de la sgrub pos smras pa ni/ /dngos grub chen po 'grub (mildan pa'i/ /gal te mchog gi dngos grub 'dod/ /grub pa brgyad ni gsol ba gdab/ /bdud dang nyon mongs gza' sogs kyis / /gal te yid gnyis skyes nas ④ni/ /til mar chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /lcags kyu chen po sbyin sreg (55bya/ /rdo rje sems dpas (6)gsungs pa bzhin/ /'grub par (pe'adi la the tshom (8)med/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster 5nyeba'i/ /mchog gi lha mo bsgrub tu )pa ni/ /lus dang srog la mi ltos par/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas ye shes de nyid mchog /shin tu phra la rab zhi ba/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /'byung ba kun la 'dis khyab pa/ /'od sna kyi bdag nyid gnas pa'i mi ma rig nyon mongs gcod byed pa/ /srid pa la sogs nyon mongs rnams/ /gang du gnas kyi rnam pa 'byung / /lus la sems shing sems pa (snyedang / /bcu gnyis dus kyi gnas su yang / /gzugs med sems kyi longs spyod pa'o/ /rmongs pa'i gnas dang gnas su ni/ /srid pa'i ngo bo nyid du mchod/ /rmongs pa gcod sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /srid pa'i yi 'dam sogs rgal dka' ba/ /dag pa'i chos kyi sgron (skum yis/ /sgrib tshupa'i mtshan ma 'joms pa yi7 chos dag pa yi thabs kyis ni/ /dag pa'i lus ni skyon med pa'o/ /dngos dang dngos med ldan pa yis/ /legs byas nyes byas 'du shes can/ /'dod chags la tu sogs nyon mongs dag /rgya mtsho lta bur gting dpag dka'/she/ /bcu 80wa 707

gnyis lus kyi bdag nyid can/ /rmongs pa ye shes rnam par gnas/ /dag pa'i chos kyi chu yis ni/ /lhan cig gnas pa'i dri ma 'khru/ /rang bzhin pad+ma'i dbye ba yis/ /nyon mongs la sogs gdung ba gcod/ /rnam rtog 'jigs (1)pa chen po ni/ /srid pa'i rgyu ste me bzhin no/ /de phyir rnam rtog ring du spang (gu/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'gro ba rtogs/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bskyed byas nas/ /kun nas thams cad mnyam par bltan)/ /rab tu mi gnas ming can la/ /las dang las kyi mtshan nyid med/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi 'arang bzhin yang / /bdud rtsis 5lus ni tshim par bya/ /rtag tu bdud rtsis mchod pa'o/ /dngos su med na rnam par brtagatsi /lcags kyu rnam pa lnga drangs nas/ /thams cad kun nas rim pas mchod/ /sbyor bas mkha' 'gro la sogs ni/ /bdag nyid dbang du myur du 'gyur/ /rtag tu de nyid kyis bza' zhing / /med na gzhan las rnam par brtag /gsher ba'i bdud rtsi kun nas bsam/ /bza' ba yang na sha nyid du/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i ngo bo yis/ /rtags 8dang rnam rtog rnam par spangs / /rang bzhin dag pa'i dpa' bo ni/ / dag pa'i 9)lus su gdon mi za//rtag tu rnal 'byor pa spangs pa/ / bgrod dang bgrod 7min rnam par spangs/ /lo ma'i dang ni 'dab 3lhama'i rgyu/ /snod la thams cad myu gu'o/ / de yi yo pad+ma rgyas byed pa/ /dag pa'i mtshan ma dang po'o/ /kha dog ngan zhing dri mi zhim/ /btung ba dro ba rnam par spangs3lha/ /dag pa'i ngo bo gcod byed pa/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan mar bstan sapa'o/ /kun la dga' zhing byams pa dang / /gnod pa nam yang mi byed cing / /sems can kun la snying brtse ba/ /gsum pa'i mtshan ma nyid du bstan/ /rtag tu stong pa'i blo ldan pas/ /zab cing rgya che'i sems 80—708

kyis ni/ /thams cad rtsa bzhin du ni stong / /bzhi pa'i mtshan ma nyid du bstan / /dag cing brtan (1)pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /lus gcig la ni rab ltos pa/ /rtag tu gsang sogs za ba ni/ /lnga pa'i mtshan ma ru ni gsungs/ /brtson 'grus kun nas ldan pa dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /bsam ②gtan mchog tu brtan byed pa/ /drug pa'i mtshan ma ru ni brtag /bzo dang sgyu (5)rtsal nyan pa dang / /rtag tu mnyam pa'i sems dang ni/ /rtag tu sems can don la brtson/ /bdun pa casayi ni mtshan mar bstan/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi blo rtogs byed/ /srid pa yang dag byang chub lam / /mtshan ma brgyad pa ru ni bstan/ /'ga' yang nam du mi smod cing / /rdzas dang rdzas min rnam rtog bcas/ /gdug pa'i bdud dang bgegs sogs dang / /rnam par rtog (5 pas srid par ltung / /dka' thub sdug bsngal mi bzad pas/ /bsnyen pa 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /lus ni dka' bar spyod pa yis / /'khor zhing srid pa'i mtha' ru'o/ /rnam rtog med pas mnyam par bya(6)//dngos po mtshan ma'i sems dang bcas/ /sbyor ba grub pa'i don du ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis bza'/ /bsgrubs (7)pa rang 'dod snying po ni/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo dngos grub rgyu/ /chos kyi snying po snying po nyid/ /sems ni ye shes rang bzhin ldan/ /sbyor ba'i bstan bcos cha nyid ni/ /de nyid de nyid khyad par ro/ /sbyar dang bsam gtan byas pa yis/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar 58)bar bya / /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor las 'das gnas chen po/ /las bzhi dang ni rab ldan pa'i/ /ye shes kyis 59)ni 'khor ba sgrol/ /dang por bskyed rim skospyod pa dang / /dbugs kyi sbyor ba rim sogs dang / /80wa 709

las la sems shing sems pa (1)dang / /dang po'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /me bzhin du ni za (geb dang / /mnyam pa'i nyi ma bzhin du blta5)/ /rna dbang rlung gi rang bzhin du/ /rna ba sgra ④yi mchod par ldan/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs mchod pa'o/ /gtor mas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /gnyis pa shin tu sbyor ba'o/ /dngos dang dngos med mnyam byas nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yang dag sbyar/ /phyag rgya chen po yi ni thabs / /sbyor ba las 'das 'di nyid 97do/ /rang bzhin gyis ni legs spyad na / /thams cad bdag med pa las byung / /lus sogs stong par rtogs pa ni//bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /'di rnams mtshan nyid ldan pa ni/ /chen po'i sems kyi sdom pa'o/ /rtag tu bya ba der 'jug pas/ /'byung zhing 'khor bar sgrol ba'o/ /spyan ni pad+ma ltar yangs shing / /bzhin ni me tog rgyas pa 'dra/ /'dod pa lnga po nye bar bsten/ /bde bar spyod cing bde bar reg /'dod pa kun dang nyer ldan pa/ /bde ba'i sems kyis bsgrub par bya/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /srid par 'khor zhing 'jug pa'o/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rang bzhin ldan pa'i las kyis ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /zla ba nyi ma kha sbyar nas/ /sor mo 'brel par byas nas ni/ /dri med gsum dang dud pas sbrel/ /sems ma rdo rje rab tu grags/ /tsham tsho tshongam phur bu ra ba dang / /dra ba thams cad las nyid do / /'bar ba'i phreng 77ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ / 'di yi ( phyag rgyar bstan (9)par bya / /kha ga'i phyogs gzhan nyid dang ni/ /rtsa 1 bar rlung dbang gnon pa dang / /spyi bor 'bar ba'i re pha dang / /mtshan ma'i mnga' bdag gis brgyan (1cing / /80—710

rtag tu zhi zhing mchog gi gnas/ /'bar ba'i phreng 6)ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ /'di ltar sa bon mdor byas pa/ /thams cad las ni bsgrub ②pa'o/ /lus la sgra ②yis kun tu dgang / /gzugs la ④sogs pa zad par byed/ /sa bon lus kyi bdag nyid ni/ /sa bon lhag ma bsam par bya/ /go cha'i bsrung (snyeb dang bral zhing ⑥/ /thams cad yan lag drug gi (7)las/ /stong pa'i de nyid snying po ni/ /sngon dugyi mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /smad 6)pa dang ni bstod pa'ang med/ /ci 'byor dag pa'i bza' ba dang / /dbang po yul dang longs spyod ni/ /mnyam pa nyid du ⑩sems kyis 1nyabya/ /sngon du rig 8pas smon lam rnams/ / bsgrub bya bsgrub 8pa'i 'bras bu rtogs/ /gang zhig yid la 'dod spyod pa/ /de yi thabs ni rdo rje'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rked pa'i phyogs su bzung nas ni/ /rtsu gi dbyangs kyis kun bkang cozhing / /grub pa'i glu yis mnyam par bya/ /dza dza dza dza/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub bzhugs pa'i bdag po khyod / /ha ha ha ha/ rtsu yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ba ba ba ba/ rdo rje sgrog gi gsang chab las byung sku 'dzin pa/ /a a a a a ho mgu ba'i rdo rje ā yili gcig tu thim par hūm̐/ /'di ltar gsang ba'i glu chen pol/ /rnal 'byor ma kun tshim byed pa/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor sems bcas pas / /khu byug skad ltar snyan pa'i sgras/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa/ /khams gsum snying po'i dbus su ni/ /rlung gi nam mkha' ltar dag pas/ /sems nyid rlung bzhin nam mkhar tunyebarjod/ /rlung gi (shedakyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ / de yi 6)dbus su rab mdzes pa'i/ /ā khri )li sa bon 'od dang bcas/ /las kyi sa bon mdog tu ni/ /80—711

mnyam par gzhag pas bsgom 1)par bya/ /'byin dang sdud cing gcod mdzad ma / /ā 2li'i sa bon rab tu grags/ /ji ltar sde tshan gsum pa yi/ /yi ge gsum pa bzung byas te/ /glo ru dbyug ( )pa rdo rje dang / / 'og pag (5)gis ni dkri bar bya/ /'di ltar rnal 'byor mchog bsgom (6)pa/ /'khor ba thams cad gcod par byed/ /phyi nas bdag nyid lus po ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'dzin / /kun nas chu yis gang bar ni/ /phyogs brgyad du ni mnyam par ro/ /de yi dbus su rab mdzes pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po yid 'ong ba'i/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'o ma zla ba'i sa bon 'dzin/ /(7)gdugs dkar po yis 8mngon par bkabalta / /'od zer 'bar ba rnam mang po'i de yi 11sa bon las skyes pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 12bdag nyid ni/ /kun+da tunyedakar dang zla ba'i mdog /phyag gnyis pa la mdzes pa'i brang / /dbu rgyan sangs rgyas lnga yi dngos/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 'gis bzhugs/ /rdo rje snying gar mtha' tsha'adzin cing / /g.yon pa 7dril bu dku ru brten3 rmo/ /sgeg cing spro ba'i rang bzhin dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis kyi/rnam par brgyan/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam 19mang po/ /dngos po'i tshon gyis btso 2 )bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis rab rgyas pa'i/ /rdo rje rnon po'i 'od 'phro ba/ /'jigs pa med cing gnod 21med par/ /dngos pos 32dngos po bsgom par bya/ /bzlas 'dod pa yi na rnal 'byor pas/ /spro ba'i sems kyis mnyam par bsgom rme/ /dbus su mchog gi sa bon dang / /phyag 'tshal ā 25lir mthar bzhag pa/ /yi ge drug pa'i sngags chen po/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa'o/ /zlos dang bsam gtan rnal 'byor pas/ /rang 'dod las ni mngon par 'grub/ /'bum phrag 863wa 712

gsum du bsnyen pa yis/ /de nas de yi mngon du 'grub/ /de nas kun gyi snying po ni/ /skye dang 'jig (1)dang rnam bral ba/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor pas / /'dod bzhin ye (5)shes gnas rnyed pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu de nyid dang / /ye shes sku ni gnyis kyi gzugs/ /rdo rje g.yas brkyang gnas nas ni/ /dril bu mnan pa'i rkang pas gnonatsho / /pad+ma rdo rje sbyar byas nas/ /phyag rgya 'ching bar sne rimachog tu brtson/ /dril bu lag gnyis kyis mgrin (5)par/ /rdo rje gcig gis (6)nu mar reg /g.yon pas gzhung tshigs mtha' ru'o/ /tshems kyis 97)ma mchu btsir mdzad cing / /gnyis kyis sems kyi rinarimachog brtson par/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /steng dang 'og dang dbus gnyis dang / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas par/ /thams cad stong pa'i de nyid ni/ /sems kyis rab tu spyad par bya/ /mthar ni sgron smyosama'i rnam pa'o/ /dbus su ā li'i nyu sa bon ni/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rab tu 'phro/ /khams gsum kun gyi cha dang bcas / /phyis ni gzugs nyid yongs rdzogs pa/ /gnyis ka yid 'ong gzugs mdzes pa'o/ /dbyig pa rdo rje 'jam pa'i mgon/ /'od dpag shes rab kyi ni gzhi(1lha / /rdo rje dril bu rab sbyor bas/ /mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje gsang bas nyu mtshan nas ni/ /gnyis ka 'khyud 1rinas bzlas par bya/ /phyag 'tshal bsreg pa mthar bzhag nas/ /dbus su ā li'i 1 sa bon ni/ /rtag pa mchog tu phra ba nyid/ /bde ba'i sems kyis bsgrub par bya/ /yid kyi mchod pa'i cho ga yis/ /kun nas yid kyis bsgrub par bya/ /shes rab rdo rje yang dag par sbyor ba'i le'u rdzogs som// //80—713

de nas thams cad snying po ni/ /mchog gi gtso bo 0)bsdus pa'o/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /gus pa yis ni gzung bar bya/ /shel gyi rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dag pa'i dngos por bza' bar bya/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /dag pa'i ngo bor bsgom ②pa nyid/ /de nas rtog pa mi rtog pa / /bza' dang bza' min mnyam pa nyid/ /btung dang mi btung nirang 'dod du'o/ /'khor ba'i pha rol rgal ( na'adod pas/ /sngon du dbang bskur dpa' bo rnams/ /'bad pas brtul zhugs gzung (5)bar bya/ /rim pa bzhin du zla ba dang 96)/ /nyi ma 'am ni lo dus su/ /brtul zhugs mtshan nyid bzhi pa'o / /yon tan de yi yongs su bza'/ /bcwa 4)lnga dang ni bcu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni tshes brgyad la'o/ /brtul zhugs rim pa 'di nyid ni/ /nan tan gyis ni gtor ma sbyin/ /de yi las rnams thams cad ni/ /ye shes de nyid 'bras bu sogs/ /de ltar bden pa'i sngags kun gyis/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom (8)med/ /bza' sogs ston mo'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zla ba tha ma'i nyi ma gzung po)/ /rang 'dod chos ni rab brtags na/ /thams cad sngags ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs ldan pa nyin re 'am/ /gal te ma 'byor pa na yang / /dbyar zla 'bring po'i tha ma ni/ /lo yi nyi ma gzung 7bar bya/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /skyon med sngags kyis sbyin byas nas/ /de yis dus rnams thams cad du/ /dpal dang phun tshogs mdun (/nyan gnas/ /rnal 'byor chos sogs la dga' bas/ /gnyis med grogs mchog rab ldan pas//de yis chos la brten 32nas ni/ /mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ /stong nyid kyis ni gzugs 'jig cing / /blangs pa'i chos rnams zad par byed/ /80—714

thams cad sdom pa nam mkha' ni/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas bsam/ /thams cad nam mkha'i gnas su ni/ /'o ma zla ba'i sa bon bsam/ /'od zer 'bar ba mang po ni/ /dkar dang kun+da zla ba'i mdog /ā 6)li'i sa bon mchog gtso bo/ /dbugs mi g.yo bas bsgom par bya/ /skad cig rnam par sbyor ba yis / /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag nyid ni/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa nyid/ /kha dog sngon po mnyam pa'i 'od/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ci gis bzhugs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan (13pa/ /steng du rdo rje cod pan dang / /sangs rgyas lnga yis dbu la brgyan(gi)/ /rgod (5)dang khro dang sgeg pa dang / /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan67/ /smad g.yogs glang chen pags 4)pa dang / /mi yi pags (kyepa rab tu gsol/ /mi yi (9)yan lag lnga rus pa'i4 )/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rab tu brgyan(nya/ /skra yi rtse mo rab 'jam zhing / /me 'bar ba dang mnyam pa'i 'od / /dang po'i phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gnyis pa na ni dgra sta bsnams/ /gsum pa na ni rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa sdigs tshamadzub zhags pa dang / /gnyis pa thod pa khrag gis bkang ⑫/ /ral gri'i 'phyag ni steng du'o/ /rdo rje 'od zer dri ma med//sangs rgyas sprin ltar rab 'phro ba/ /sa yi dbus su rnam rol par/ /dngos pos snyidangos po bsgom par bya/ /'ug pa ce 7spyang seng ge dang / /stag mo phyogs su rnam par bsgomatu tsho/ /bya rog ce 12spyang bya rgod dang / / tsa li ka yi hurtematshams su dgod/ /'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs mche ba gtsigs/ /ha hūm̐ rnam par 'jigs par byed/ /'di ltar mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang ma/ /bdag nyid sems kyis bsgom par bya/ /rang gi dbugs las phyung nas ni/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs dgod par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 6 )bris sku sogs/ /de yi gnas su 80—715

kun tu bsam/ /'dod dang grol ba'i go 'phang gnas/ /gnyis med gtor ma'i lha nyid yin/ /sbyor ba'i sgo nas sgrub (2)pa pos/ /'di yi mchod pa'i cho ga bshad / /bza' dang ston mo de nyid dang / /gsang ba'i mchod pas rab tu mchod / /snying ga'i (midakyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sems kyis rgyas gi sa bon las/ / de yi gzugs la ④sogs bskyed pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid dgod/ /bza' ba la (5)sogs khyad par nyid/ /dag pa'i dngos por bsgoms nas ni/ /bsgrub 4)pa shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /yud tsam gyis ni sbyor ba yis/ /oṃ ha ho hrīḥ(7)swā hā/ oṃ gyis 'bar bar bsam pa dang / /ha yi rnam pas so sor rtogs/ /sa bon ho yis snang bar byas/ /hrīḥ(kyeyi rnam pas dri ma sbyong / /lus kyi 99)lha nyid tshim pa'i phyir/ / a yi rnam par 7rtogs par bya / /sa bon lnga yis lha nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga nyid mngon par thim tsha rdza r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ 11rtsu a swā hā/ bza' ba la sogs khyad par nyid/ /sngags 'di yis ni gzung 12bar bya/ /o gyis rnam pas lus dang ni/ /dzi gyis rnam pas gzung 0steb dang / /r+ghaṃ gyis rnam par lto ba dang / /ṭ+wāṃ 'gis rnam par dri med lus/ /hūm̐ gis sarnam pas saspyad par bya/ /sems kyis snying gar yo 7yi ge adziste/ /de nyid rtag tu mchod byas na/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sdig sbyang bya/ /dri dang mar me me tog dang / /lha bshos dang ni gtor ma yis19/ / glu yi ( 7dus su dbyangs snyan 81dang / /pi wang na gling bu la sogs sbyar/ /rtag tu de dag gis mchod cing / /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid brjod/ /'gro dang nyal dang 'dug pa dang / /'chag dang thams cad dus nyid du/ /rtag tu sems shing sems pa k+ṣ-i geyis rdo rje sems dpa' bsam par bya/ /oṃ a mu hūm̐ swā hā/ ye shes gzugs brnyan 2 80wa 716

sbyor ba yis/ /sa bon 'di ni bzlas byas na0)/ /sdig pa thams cad thag bsrings shing / /rang 'dod las (mini 'grub par 'gyur/ /'byung ba lnga las gyur pa'i sdig /gang gis gsang ba dbye byas pa'ang / /rtag tu bsgom zhing (5)bzlas byas na/ /sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /oṃ ka ra ka ra pradz+nyā ma hā tīk+ṣa ④pañca oṃ budhe ha/ oṃ kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ a a a mu mu mu swā hā/ sngags chen po yi (snyes bon 'di/ /sangs rgyas sems ni mdor bsdus pa'o/ /skyon med sbyor ba'i sgrub pa pos/ /thams cad ldan pa'i sa bon ni/ /mtshan mo yi ni mtha' nyid dang / /dang por ro hi ta dus la(6)/ /nya phyis snod du chu dang ni/ /ma ga dhā ⑦ni srang gnyis nyid/ /kun nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /bdud rtsi'i dbus su yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi bsam pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor pas/ / lan bdun (8)mngon par bsngags 6)byas pa'i/ / de yi tu )chu ni btung byas na/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig pa dang / /ye shes bdud rtsi ye shes sku/ /yid gzhungs (1shes rab rno ba dang / /rlung dang gzi brjid dpal 'phel zhing / /kun nas skal ldan dag dang ni/ /thos dang shes rab nor dang ni/ /rlung mkhris / dug dang bad kun dang / /'dus dang glo sogs kyis tu zhigazer dang / /mig dang yan lag gzer ba ni/ /chu 'di yis ni nad kun 'phrog /oṃ ra ta a brta ni/ sarba pā paṃ yiha ran+tu mo hūm̐/ bi kṛ ta ()kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di yi sngags ni sngags chen po/ /bsrung 7ba kun gyi bla na med/ /sngon gyi dus su gzhag byas nas/ /rnal 'byor lus ni bsrung ( 7ba'o / /lan bdun mngon par bsngags yinabyas la/ /gnas lnga ru ni lan gsum mo / /sangs rgyas lnga ni mngon bsam 1rtenas/ /spyi bo'i steng du bskur byas nas/ /80—717

rgyal po seng ge dgra 4)sogs dang / /rkun mo dang ni me dang chu/ /rlung dang mkhris pa la sogs nad/ /'jigs byed 'jigs pa 'joms par byed/ /oṃ bi mo ha ni saṃ (gemo ha ni/ sarba pri ye ti hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ 'di yi sngags ni sngags chen pos/ /'gro kun rmongs par byed pa dugasungs/ /mi byams byams pa skye ④byed cing / /kun nas mdza' bar gyur pa'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa yi ni chus(snye/ /snga dro'i dus su kha bkrus nayi/ /rnal 'byor pa ni grub 'dod pa/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas sbyor ba mchog tu bshad/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog /rdo rje la (7)sogs bsgom par bya/ /gnyis su med par mnyam par 'dres/ /yan lag 'di yis tha dad bsgom98)/ /dug med pa yang dug gis bsnun/ /shin tu mi bzad 6)rmongs pa yis/ /rmongs pa rnal 'byor bdag nyid 'jigs/ /'bad pas chos kyi thabs kyis ni/ /dag pa'i lus ni rnam dag byed/ /dag pa'i sgron ma bltas pa yis/ /nyon mongs la 7sogs mun pa 'joms/ /nam mkha' rdo rje rdo rje la/ /sems dang sems ni rnam par thim//gcig sogs dngos po bsgom 4)pa ni/ /'di yi rnal 'byor mtshan nyid do/ /me yi lhag ma sogs lhags 12pa/ /dbus dang dbus su 1 rnam par 'tsher/ /de yi 'od kyis nam mkha'i khams/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas blta/ /sa bon 'di yi myu gu las/ /ā li kā li rnam par 'byung / /sa bon sa bon rab 'phro ba / /nam mkha'i khams su yang dag gnas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /ro langs ma yi tshadabus su bsam/ /pad+ma'i gdan la rnam par bzhugs / /gdugs dkar po yis mngon par g.yogs/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ske/ /kha dog dmar po 'od mnyam payi/ /lcags kyu zhags 80—718

pa sdigs mdzub ①dang / /spyan gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan(snye/ /sgeg pa'i nyams kyis blta ba dang / /na bza' dmar po mngon par g.yogs/ /mchog gi sems dang sems pa tshul/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge rnam par bsam/ /lcags kyu'i rtse mor yi ge r+ghaṃ/ /bzlas shing 'di yis drang bar bya/ /gzugs brnyan gyis ni yid bskyod cing / /rang gi dbugs kyis dgang bar 4)bya/ /oṃ rā ga ta rā ga ta bha ti hūm̐ māṃ (miswā hā/ lcags kyu'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'dod bzhin drang / /rmongs chen shin tu rmongs pa ni/ /mnyam par gzhag nas rab tu bsgrub/ /gdan bzhi pa yi rgyud kyi (6)ni/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi stigasum pa las/ /grub pa'i snying po bsdus pa ni(kye/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsdus pa'o/ /de nas ye shes lus la ni/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor pas / /bza' dang bza' ba'i bsam pa yis/ /sbyang dang rtogs par (9)spyad par bya/ /dngos por smad 7pa ma yin tu/zhing / /gang yang brtag 7par mi bya'o / /mtho dang dma' ba'i rigs la sogs/ /mnyam nyid lha ni lnga pa'o/ /gang zhig skye ba po sogs pa/ /sems kyis gnod par mi bya'o/ /gal te gnod pa byed sems na/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa ring bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig che dang phra ba yi/ /gzhan rdzas rang gir byed pa yis(rte/ /rku ba'i sems ni mi bya'o/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa ring ba nyid/ /brdzun yidang tshig rtsub phra ma dang / /'khyal pa'i ngag ni ring du spang / /gzhan gyi sems la gnod byas pas/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa 8ring ba nyid/ /don dang ling ga gyurab sbyor hunyebs/ /sbyor ba'i chos kyi snying po nyid/ /rmongs pas log dkris ngag sogs kyis/ /de yi rab sbyar smad (nyapa nyid/ /legs par byas pa'i las kyis ni/ / bde ba bskyed pa'i lus kyis 80—719

sogs 'ching ba dang / /lus dang kha dog 'bar ba ru/ /snang ba mtha' yas mnyam par gzhag /ha yi rnam pa'i sa bon ni/ /yi ge mchog gi 6)dga' bar byed / /ho yi rnam pas lus dang lus/ /rnam snang mnga' bdag lha nyid do/ /sems dang sems pa bsgoms pas ni/ /lha nyid du ni yongs su grags/ /thams cad lus dang lus can gyi/ /srog dang sems ni 'phrog pa'o/ / hrīḥyi (nasarnam pa'i sa bon ni/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /oṃ gyi rnam pa gsal bar 'phro(gyi / /kun nas sems ni rtogs mdzad pa'o/ /a yi rnam pa des (4)tshim byed//blo dang ldan pas yongs su bsten(5)/ /bdud rtsi chu yi lha mo ni/ /de yi (6)shes bya rtogs pa'o/ /bdud rtsi gang gis myangs ri7napa yis/ /bdud rtsi yi ni 'bras bu thob(8) / /de bzhin gshegs dgyes (9)lha mo ni/ /gzugs mdzes mchog tu yid 'ong ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi pa bcing bar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bsgrub 7'dod na/ /gnyis ni gnyis su med par bsgom/ /gnyis ni dngos po dngos med pas/ /ye shes ldan pas yongs su gsal/ /nga rgyal chen pos bcings pa ni/ /spros pa'i sems dang ldan pas bcings/ /sgeg 11dang khro ba'i zhu tshul gyis ni/ /lha mo'i snying po nyid du thim/ /nyi ma'i lag pa'i gdan la ni/ /zla ba'i lag pas reg yi byas la/ /de yis 'khyud cing 'khyud nas ni/ /lha mo'i ye shes nyid du thim/ /sto ba'i ye shes me yi lha/ /de yi 'chiganas su tshim par bya/ /shes rab thabs la thim pa yis/ /gnyis med sbyor bas tshim pa nyidal/ /oṃ ha ho hrīḥyos/ sa bon chen po'i sa bon ni/ /'di yis sa bon bsam par bya/ /rim nyu pa 'di yis mchod pa ni/ /sman gyi rgyur ni ma yin no/ /lha mo bkres 1 dang sdug bsngal 'phrog /sgeg cing snyan par smra yigeb 80—721

rgya yis/ /rang 'dod las ni rab tu byed/ /'bum phrag gcig zlos rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /phyis ni me la sogs pa'i las/ /gnyis med gtor ma'i las kyis so/ /me thab kha ran gsum par 0)ni/ /snang byed shing ni rab sbar la/ /lha mi'i (mime tog rgyas pa ni/ /sbrang rtsis bsku (bzhing sbyar byas la/ /bdud rtsi'i chu dang kun nas bsre/ /gang gi ming nas yang dag bzung / /brgyad brgya liru ni bsreg byas na(kye/ /nges par dbang du 'gyur ba'o//me yi yilha sogs thal ba dang / /bdag nyid khu ba lan lnga ru/ /bdud rtsi dbus su sbyin byas na/ /bdag nyid 'dod bzhin dbang du byed/ /smyo byed sbrul ni 6)lnga pa dang / /u dza'i shing ni cha mnyam pa/ /bdud rtsir ldan par byin byas na/ /myur du smyo bar 'gyur ba'o/ /nim pa la sogs rtse mo la/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /me tog bdug pa dri sogs dang / /gnyis med gtor ma'i las kyis ni/ /arga dkar po'i rtsa ba las/ /'bad pas me ni rab tu sbar/ /pad+mo zhib mo phye ma ni(kye/ /'o ma dang ni bdud rtsis bsku59)/ /brgyad brgya ru bsreg (7byas pa yi/nya/ /lhag ma'i tshithal ba bsgos tu)pa'o/ / tsi tra ka yi 'a)rtsa ba'i chus / /lan bdun bsgos yil grib mar bskam/ /mchod pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pas/ / de yi tsothal ba bdud rtsi tshonachus/ /myur ba nyid du bsgos 6shepa ni//kha ba kun+da 'o ma ru/ /lus ni rmongs pa'i gzugs dang ni/ /shin tu rmongs shing rmongs pa'i dri/ /pho nya brgyad kyi lha mo ni/ /stobs dang gzi 4)brjid don med pa'o / /rnam rtog rmongs pa'i sems can la/ /'di yis ( skulas kyis rab tu sbyar / /rmongs pa spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'gro ba myur du rtogs par 'gyur / /'di yis phye ma ( nyablangs byas la/ /dzā sa ti mar khu lan gsum sbang / /80—723

bdud rtsi mchod pa'i dus su (1)ni/ /thal ba lhan 9kyecig bsres byas nas/ /thig le lce yis myangs pa yis/ /pho nya sribargyad kyis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /pho nya'i mtshan ma yongs rdzogs pa/ /smyo zhing rgyags shing rgyags pa'o/ /smyo byed shing ni yang dag blang / /'bad pas me ni rab sbar la/ /me tog sbrang rtsi bdud rtsir ldan / /brgya brgya ru ni bsreg par bya/ /de yi thal ba blangs stinas ni/ /rab tu sbyor ba la 5sogs bya/ /bdud rtsi bskyed pa'i gnas su ni/ /thal ba de yis byugs byas na(6ci/ /chu yis 3)mdog ni gzhan du dang / /de yi ro (8)ni gzhan du 'gyur / /sbrang rtsi 'o mar ldan pa yis/ /de gzugs snga ma bzhin du 'gyur/ / de yi (9thal ba blangs byas la/ / sku gsum ⑩pa yi cha dang bsre4nya/ /bdud rtsi yi ni cha bdun dang / /ma ru tse tu yi cha brgyad nyidakyi / /mchod pa'i dus su chang la ni/ /de yi thal ba blugs byas na/ /gang la byin pa tsam gyis ni/ /bdud rtsi kun nas rang 'dod rig /gang dang gang gis tso)lam gyis ni/ /de dang de yi rmongs pa rnams/ /sems can don du rmongs bsal phyir/ /rtag tu lam ni bstan par bya/ /gzhan gyi don la brtson par bya/ /rang gi 'dod 'di bsdus pa'o / /sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba yang / /shes rab dman skil sogs pas dman / /gdan bzhi pa yi 7rgyud kyi ⑩ni/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i las kyi yo ni/ /dngos grub 19snying po btus pa ni/ /de yi dngos po bsdus pa'o/ /sngags sgrub pa yi don du ni/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mchog gi gzugs brnyan 2 rab sbyar bas/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis rim pas bsgrub/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /gsad ( rkedang bskrad dang dbye ba ni/ /gzugs brnyan gyis ni thams cad 'grub/ /gzugs brnyan mtshan nyid ldan par bya/ /80wa 724

pa dang / /de yi dpal yang ring ba nyid/ /rje ngar zhabs 6)dang mkhur ④tshos ni / /de gsum sbom pa nyes pa che/ /nges par sgrub (gupo'i bdag nyid ni/ /bdud dang bgegs dang dpal ring ngo / /'gram pa brang dang rtsib stilogs ni/ /de gsum dma' na 2skyon che'o/ /yun mi ring ba myur du ni/ /nor ni brlag par 'gyur ba'o/ /nu ma rna ba dpral ba ni/ /de gsum yo na skyon che'o/ /'thab mo dang ni dgras (7'tshe bar/ /myur du sgrub ④po 'gyur ba'o/ /brang dang lus dang brla gnyis ni/ /de gsum dma' na skyon che'o/ /dgras ni 'jigs par 'gyur ba dang / /'chi (kyebar yang ni the tshom 6)med/ /sna zhom mig ni yo ba dang / /rna ba mchu dang dpral 7ba ni/ /bgegs dang bdud dang mes 'jigs shing / /dngos grub ring bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /gyen du lta ba'i dbu (nyadang ni/ /gdan ni yo ⑩zhing tha dad pa/ /brang dang mgrin tunyepa yan lag ni/ /nyes skyon grangs ni med par grags/ /'od zer yo zhing tha dad dang / /phyag rgya phyag mtshan nor bas ni/ /mya ngan gdung bas sdug bsngal bar/ /sgrub po'i gzugs brnyan nyes skyon no/ /rgyab yol gdugs dang ba dan yini/ /rnam gsum dog pa'i nyes pa ni/ /'chi zhing dpal nyams brlag pa dang / /mi mdza' mdza' ba 'joms pa'o/ /de ltar nyes skyon laskyon chen pos/ /dul zhing dul la bzod pa dang ske/ /sems ni shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /rnam par brtag cing rab tu dpyod⑩ / /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /mdzes pa'i tshul gyis mchod par bstan/ /sngags grub rgyu yi don dang ni/ /dbang dang dgug pa yi ni lha/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i tshul/ /drag la drag cing 'jigs su rung / /dpa' zhing dpa' ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /dgod tu cing khro dang sgeg 4shepa dang / /khro 80—727

pas khro bo mchog gi ste/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa'i sku/ /chags pa'i gos dkar mnabs 0)pa nyid/ /ba spu nas ni rdo rje 'phro/ /gdugs dkar po yis mngon g.yogs pa'i/ /'di ltar rdo rje dbang phyug rgyal/ /pad+ma'i lus can rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje shar gyi cha ru ni/ /mo gzugs ri mor bris pa ni/ /gzugs kun la sogs rab rgyas pa'o/ /gnod sbyin mo ni rgyal dbang 'di/ /rin chen gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /phyag na gtor ma'i snod sogs (nyapa/ /phyogs kyi mdog tu btso ( ribar bya/ /dngos grub kun ster lha mo ni/ /lus ngan gyi ni sring mo'o/ /phyag 'tshal tshul gyis 'dud pa ni/ /lha mo bsgrub rgyapa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rdo rje byang gi cha la ni/ /lha mo snyan par smra ba ni/ /de ltar rdo rje dbang phyug rgyal/ /pad+ma'i lus can ye shes 'dzin/ /snyan pa'i gser btso ma yi mdog /bzang po'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyanas)/ /gnyis kyi phyag na bdud rtsi'i snod/ /sgeg pa'i nyams kyi lta ba ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /ye shes nub kyi cha la ni / /lha mo snyan pa'i dbang phyug ma/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog dang ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan ri/ /thams cad mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /lha mo gzhon nu grub pa ni/ /lcags kyu lnga sogs snod kyis ni/ /gnyis pa'i phyag ni rnam par brgyan(7)/ /rdo rje lho yi cha ru ni/ /'byung mo'i ming ni ska 58)rags can / /sku mdog sngon mo gzugs mdzes pa'i/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam par brgyan(9 / /bdud rtsi'i bum pa phyag gnyis na / /gzhan gyi sgeg pa'i yan lag dang / /gshin rje yi ni sring mo nyid/ /dngos grub kun ster 11lha mo ni/ /thams cad kun la gzugs mdzes par/ /rnam par brtags te ri mo 12bri/ /80—729

rdo rje dril sogs rim par yang / /dbang ldan la sogs rim par sbyar/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 6)/ /phyag ni phyag rgya mtshan ma sogs/ /de ltar rdo rje dbang phyug rgyal/ /rol pa'i 'khor lo bsam par bya/ /lha rnams dmigs pa dang bcas pa/ /sngags dang phyag rgya gtor mas mchodaphyi/ /oṃ sarba sidhi bku ru hūm̐/ nye bar spyod pa'i sngags sodu/ /oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi ma'i lag pa rab brkyang nas/ /ye shes kyi ni pad+ma mnan/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya'o / /de yi sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /yan lag drug tu bsrung bar bya/ /ye shes khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni sa gdugs bsgreng / /'khyil 6)par sa gdugs 'khyud byas la/ /dkar po'i 6)lcags kyus spyan drang ngo //oṃ badz+ra yaṃ ku sha dzaḥ(3) phyag rgya de gnyis ⑧brtan bcings la/ /dkar po dang ni gi 67wang sbrel/ /zhags ⑩pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya yis(nya/ /kun nas lha mo bzhugs par ldan/ /oṃ badz+ra pā (gesha hūm̐/ phyag rgya 6)de nyid dam bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /gsang zhing gsang ba'i lcags sgrog gis/ /lha rnams kun nas mnyes rngupar bya/ /khu tshur de nyid dam bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu yang dag ldan/ /sa gdugs 7pad+ma sbrel byas la/ ci/kun nas lha nyid tshim byed pa'o/ /spos kyi phyag gnyis rab ldan pas/ /sor mo gnyis yika bsgreng 1 tshobyas la/ /zla ba nyi mar bzhugs byas la/ /snying rje chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ su ra ta badz+ra hūm̐ dza/ khu tshur gnyis ni bcings byas la/ /nyi ma'i steng du kha sbyar la/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi lha mo ni/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ shri ye ba ti hūm̐ phu swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid 1snyedam bcings te/ /ye shes dang ni rnam shes bsgreng po/ /oṃ su kri ye smyo )rtsu phu swā hā/ byang gi phyogs kyi lha mo ni/ /snying 80—730

po sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid dam bcings nas/ /dkar po dang ni gi wang bsgreng ①/ /oṃ su ru su ru ma du re hūṃ phu swā hā/ nub kyi phyogs kyi lha mo ni/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid dam bcings nas/ /sa gdugs pad+ma'i kha sbyin bya/ /o pri yo (2)me khā la ①rgyu phu swā hā/ lho phyogs lha mo rgyal dbang gis/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /gnyis med cho ga'i sngags kyis ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /bdug pa me tog sogs glu dang / /mkhas pas mchod pa nyi shus mchod/ /'dod dang thar pa dge ba'i gnas / /las rnams thams cad grub gobyed pa/ /rdo rje chos kyi bde spro ba/ /rnal 'byor sngags kyis sgrub (5)par byed/ /de nas kun gyi snying po ni/ /khro bo gnod yibyed khro mo ni/ /dbye ba rnam gsum sku rang bzhin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yan lag bzhi/ /khros pa'i khro bo'i mchog tu spro/ /'jigs pa theg pa rnam pa gsum/ /lha mo'i lta 4)bas 'jigs (kyepar byed/ /bdud dang 'byung po gcod byed cing / /bdud dang gdug pa skems 5)pa dang / /gnon 7cing yul nas skyod (1pa dang / /'dod dang thar pa'i go 'phang bsgrubatuste/ /tshangs pa mnan cing nyed pa dang / /tsa muṇ+ḍi tu ni drag pos 'gugs/ /'jigs byed kun nas bsgrubs ④pa yang / /mkhas pa yi tsho ni bsgrub par bya/ /re zhig yidang po bris pa'i sku/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /bye ba bcu bzhi'i tshogs dang ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can bzhin ngan pa/ /lha mo dka' zlog yo gdan du ni/ /rgyab tu kun nas rnam par mnan/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnam par sprul/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa nyid / /'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i zhal/ /rol pas (she 'phen pa'i kyi gdan la 80—731

ni / /tshangs pa'i mgo ni zhabs kyis mnan/ /spyan gsum khro la nga rgyal can/ /dmar zhing dmar ba'i spyan dang ldan/ /'khyil zhing rnam par gyes ①pa yi/ /dbu skra dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /rus pa'i thod pa'i phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mi bzad 6)cod pan no/ /bgegs kyi mgo bo bsam pa yis(ba klu gnyis kyis ni rnam par brgyadago/ /shin tu rgod ⑤cing mche ba gtsigs6)/ /zhal gsum kha dog gsum pa'o/ /glang chen pags 4)pa bsnams pa'o/ /mi yi pags 98)pa rab tu gsol/ /rgyan brgyad kyi ni gnas nyid du/ /dkar zhing rab 'bar rus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mgo bo'i phreng ba dang / /mche ba rno zhing sor mo 'bar / /steng 6)gi phyogs su mda' dang ni/ /gnyis pa la ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gsum pas rdo rje gsor ba'o/ /g.yas pa sdigs 0mdzub tunyezhags pa dang / /gnyis pa la ni thod pa'o/ /gsum pa gzhu dang kun nas ldan/ /rgan byad 8drag mo 'jigs su rung / /zhags pas bcings shing rnam par brgyan(rte/ /drag mo mnan cing mche ba gtsigasayi/ /khrag 'dzag pa dang brgyal ba ni/ /so sor dbus su brgyan 7pa yi7/ /so so'i pho nya rab tu bsgrubatu 1/ /tshon bdun gyis ni gos pa yi17/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu spro/ /khro bo mche ba gtsigs ()pa'i lus / /'bar ba'i 'od zer rdo rje can/ /mi yi keng rus keng rus dang / /gdugs dkar po yis mngon par g.yogs/ /ye shes khro bo dbang phyug bdag /drag cing shin tu drag pa 'dul( )/ /bdud rnams thams cad gnon mdzad pa/ /shin tu gdug 37pa'i sems can rnams/ /zhi bas 'dul bar mi 'gyur bas/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis( dzā/ /khro bo'i gzugs la sogs pa bstan/ /khu ne dang 'ug pa bya rgod dang / /ce dzo spyang srin po khyi la ne sogs/ /'jigs pa'i ku 80—732

cho yo)rab sgrogs dang / / mi yi ②kong rus kyis ①bkang ④ba'i/ /de ltar gzugs brnyan ⑤rab sbyor bas/ /'dod dang thar pa don gnyer dang / /thams cad khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa'i/ /sngags pas gzugs brnyan bsgrub par byam/ /oṃ ta hūṃ ma tha ma tha duṣ+ṭan bhā ⑥ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ba dan gsum sogs phyag rgya yis/ /las rnams kun nas rab tu byed/ /spos dang bdug pa la sogs dri/ /rgyas ⑦pa'i mchod pa kun ldan pas/ /dpa' bo mchod sogs yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mthong ba yis/ /cho ga'i yan lag sbyin sreg (shelasal/ /gtor ma'i las ni khyad par nyid/ /ma brtags 6)pa yi sha dang ni/ /khrag gis kyang ni de nyid las/ /gang gang dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /de yi rnam pas tshim par bya/ /oṃ bi trin+ti nā yim (stom hā gro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba nyi ma brkyang 8nas ni/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /dkar po gi tu)wang sbrel byas nas / /sa yi gdugs yidang pad+ma sbrel/ /de nyid snying po phyag rgya dang / /sngags de nyid ni rnam par sbyar7/ /phur bu ra ba tsham 'angam dang / /dra ba go cha mtshon cha rnams/ /las kyi gnas su dgod pa ni/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rab tu grags / /phyag rgya 'di nyid snying gar tu)bcing / /ye shes dang ni rnam shes sbyar/ /oṃ gro dha yonyeni hūm̐ a/ snying po mchog gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgya de nyid rnam par bya / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /chen po'i sems kyis bsgrub par bya/ /drag cing rno ba'i lha mo ni/ /rno ba'i sems kyis bsgrub par bya/ /cung zad zhi ba'i lha mo ni/ /thabs cig 5)gis ni mtshan nyid do/ /chu yi 'gram gyi sa phyogs su / /sngon du bsnyen pa la sogs bya/ /'bum phrag lnga ni bzlas ( )pa dang / /phyis ni 'bum phrag gcig gis so/ /zhi ba'i mchod pa phul nas ni/ /me yi las 80—733

la sogs pa bya0)/ /nag po ra yi sha dang ni/ /khrag dang rnam par bsres nas ni / /bris sku la sogs gzugs brnyan mdun②/ /rdzogs pa'i cho gas sbyin sreg ②bya / /gtor ma sbyin sreg ④gis tshim bya/ /thams cad las ni 'grub par 'gyur(5) / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag dang / /mngon par spyod pa la ⑥sogs 'grub / /dri zhim chu yis bkang ba yis/ /bum pa rgya cher mchod pa yis/ /nad kyi yan lag gzir ba la/ /sngon du dbang bskur byin byas nas/ /nad kun dang ni bral ba dang / /de bzhin gza' ⑦yis gnod pa nyid/ /skal ba dman dang mi byams pas(she/ /thams cad zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /ser po'i tshon kyichodang spra tshil las/ /log 'dren lha yi gzugs brnyan nyid/ /mnyam pa'i gdan la thal mo sbyar/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par spras9/ )/ /mche ba gtsigs pa 17yan lag rgyas/ /pad+ma'i snod la gnas pa ni/ /rtse gsum dang ni bza' ba'i snod/ /dgra sta la phug phyag na'o/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad du ni/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /bris sku'i gzugs brnyan mdun (stedu ni/ /'khrul 'khor 'di ni bri bar bya/ /gro ga 'am 4)ni shing shun la/ /gi 8wang dang ni gur gum gyis/ /sgrub pa po yi rmugazugs brnyan bri/ /gzugs dang rnam pa kun ldan pa/ /snying gar 7ming ni bri bar bya/ /g.yo dang lhung dang srog 'dren pa/ /lcags kyu kun nas ldan pa dang / /dpral bar drangs nas gzhag par bya/ /bgegs kyi dbang po yi 7ni gdan/ /snying gar tunyemanan nas gzhag par bya/ /me tog bdug pa sogs pas mchod/ /nan tan gyis ni gtor ma'i las/ /don 'dod 'bras bu don gnyer ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pas ni (7sngags yig bzlas//oṃ tram̐ tha tha tha hūm̐ dza swā hā/ me tog dkar po la bzlas shing / /re re zhing ni 80—734

brdeg par bya/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du yongs rdzogs na/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom ①med/ /sngags 'di yis ni sbyor ba yis/ /sgrub ②pa po yi yid g.yo zhing //myur du 'gugs shing lon pa'o/ /rgyal po'i dbang po dbang phyug sogs/ /rgyal po dang ni rgyal tshab dang / /phyug ①po'i byis pa la sogs dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i bdag nyid lus/ /sha tsi budang ni brgya byin sogs/ /gal te kun nas 'dod tsam ⑤gyis/ /sgrub ⑥pa po yi dbang du 'gyur/ /ji srid lus ni 'tsho ba'i bar / /dus rtag tu ni rnam par (pe'adud/ /nga rgyal yan lag gtso bo bas nga rgyal gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /khro bo'i lus ni bstan pa yis/ /las dang las ni myur du 'grub/ /khro bo'i lus rnam par bstan pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so(nya// //spyod pa'i chos can kun bsdus pa/ /brtul zhugs mtshan nyid bstan po)pa'o//ye shes longs spyod 'bras 'dod pas7/ /spyod pa'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /mi bzad 'khor ba 'jigs pa ni/ /chags pas srid par ltung ba'o/ /chags pa spangs pa'i lus kyi tunyeni/ /rgyun du brtul tunyezhugs yang bzung ngo / /dben par shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pa'o/ /chags pas srid par ltung ba dang / /zhen pas 'khor bar 'jug par byed/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid ring du spangs/ /sems can don du chos bstan phyir/ /sems can don byed gyur pas kyang / /brtul zhugs dka' thub mi bzad tu pas/ /dben par sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /chags pa'i nyes pa rgya mtshor 'khor/ /bdag nyid nyon mongs las rgyal phyir/ /sems can don blo 'ba' zhig go/ /sems can don 'gyur dus su ni/ /spyod dang sdom pa'i sngon bzhin no/ /'du 80—735

'dzi dang bral dben pa ni/ /dga' ba ru ni lus bsrung 6)ngo / /dang po re zhig (mirnal 'byor pas/ /bstan bcos tshig ①rnams blangs byas nas/ /sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan/ /rab tu rno bas chos spyad do/ /gnas dang gnas la'ang mi gnas pa'i/ /nam du yang ni mi gzung ④ngo / /bza' dang bza' min bar rtog ༷5)pa'i/ /dman (6)sogs nges par mi bya'o/ /'bad pas rtag tu dga' ba yis/ /lham mkhan nya pa shan (7dpa dang / /bram ze dmangs rigs rgyal rigs rnams/ /mnyam pa'i sems kyi lam gyis ni/ /rtag tu slong (nyamo bslang bar bya/ /gal te gong du spyod pa'i tshe/ /gang zhig bza' ston zos pa dang / /mal cha ras dang mchil lham yang / /longs spyod longs spyod yid 'ong ba'i / /brtul zhugs la gnas tsam gyis ni/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa ring ba nyid/ /spyod pa spyod dgur rnal 'byor pas/ /bsod nams lag tu blang bar (9)bya/ /thams cad bslangs 7kyang nyes med de/ /dngos po yang ni mi gzung (1ngo / /sems ni rnam par dag pa yisam/ /thams cad bza' zhing bza' ba nyid/ /dag cing gus bcas nga rgyal gyis/ /de yi (snyeganas ni yongs su spangs nyi 7/ /dad pas dkyil 'khor 'dri thub dang / /yang na gtor ma'i las la ni/ /bsags ⑩pa'i rdzas kyi dngos po ni/ /de yi gnas su dbul bar bya/ /chos gos gsum gyi lhag ma ni/ /slar yang gus pa yis yo ni gzung 1nya/ /spyi bor ngur smrig mtshan ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yan lag dang / / rnying pa'i 17tshem ber chos gos gsum / /steng du rdo rje dbyug pa dang / /lhung bzed mchan (na /khung chu tshags bcas / /de ltar 'dzin pa'i lus la ni/ /glegs bam la sogs gzhan yang med / /grog mo la 21sogs bsal ba'i phyir/ /rnga ma'i chun po bsngags pa yin/ /80—736

sangs rgyas byang chub yan lag dang / /chos don rtsa ba snying rje nyid/ /de nas bslab par bya ba ni/ /bla ma'i tshig gi sdom pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rdzu 'phrul che / /mchog la skyabs dang skyabs su mchi/ /rdo rje dbang phyug mchog gi lus/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lha mo shes rab sbyor rang bzhin/ /mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ a mu ka sa ma yo haṃ sa zhi)ma ya/ a (gyesu ka sa ma yo/ oṃ a mu ka sa ma yo/ haṃ sa ma ya / oṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra badz+ra/ kā ④ya su pa ra/ hi hi hi/ ho ho ho/ rtsu na ni ba ta rda/ 'di yis (geslob ma rab tu gzung (7/ /brtul zhugs rdo rje rdo rje can/ /gnyis pa'i las kyis bsgrub par bya / /sbyor dang gsang (7ba'i sngags rig (8)pas/ /thams cad dus dang dus nyid du/ /tshigs bcad gnyis ni brjod par bya/ /gang zhig pha dang gang zhig ma / /gang zhig mdza' po)ba'ang mi rtag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lus ni sgyu khri )ma nyid/ /rtag tu chos kyis yongs su skyob/ /kye (nyum stong pa nyid kyi (nyemathus/ /dngos kun rnam par mnan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu rab ster tunyeba'i/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzung yibar bya/ /rmongs pa bcad skopa'i don du ni/ /dus gsum du ni tshigs 7bcad brjod/ /'chag dang nyal dang 'gro ba dang / /'dug dang 'gro ba thams cad du/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba brtan tsho tshobyas nas/ /sems dang sems kyis tsha/shenyal bar bya/ /skye /snyadang skye bar brgyud pa yi/ /'byung ba lnga yi lus kyi sdig /nyin mtshan gnyis kyi spyod pa yis/ /lus kyi dri ma dag pa nyid/ /zla ba drug tu spyad byas pas/ /rang 'dod lha ni 'grub pa'o/ /brtul zhugs spyad ru )pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi shes pas kyang ye shes 'thob/ /de ltar yon tan rang bzhin zhing / /brtul zhugs spyod pa yi ni rgyu/ /brtul zhugs sbyor ba sbyor 80—737

ba yis/ /thams cad rmongs pa rnam par spangs/ /thabs kyi mtshan nyid mtshon pa yis/ /mnyam nyid lta ba rdzogs byas nas/ /rnam dag lta ba 'ba' zhig go/ /kun nas stong pa mnyam pa'i ros/ /dngos po kun gyi mtshan nyid med/ /kun nas stong pa nyid kyi mthar/ /rnam par rtog pa ji lta bur/ /rmongs pas brtags shing rnam brtags pa'i/ /dag pa'i sems dang sems par 6)bcas/ /rmongs pa nyon mongs rgya mtsho'i lus/ /'dod pa khro bo'i gzhi (mide ni/ /rno ba'i sems kyis rmongs pa ni/ /ye shes ldan pa'i lus kyi ①dbye/ /snum pa'i bza' dang 'jam pa'i gos/ /sna tshogs dbang pos reg pa yis/ /gti mug chags pas go bzlog pas/ /srid par ltung ba'i las su 'gyur/ /las ni bya ba'i dbang por rdo 'gyur/ /rmongs pa ye shes mi rtag pa'o/ /'dod dang khro dang nga rgyal 'joms/ /srid par 'ching ⑤ba'i bza' ba'o/ /'byung po 'byung la brtse ⑥ba dang / /kun nas sdig pa mi brtag rtso)go/ /mgon med sdug bsngal phongs pa la / /nor pas mnar med gyur pa bzhin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni rma 'bebs dang —/ / mtshang 'dru ⑧ba ni mchog tu gtso/ /theg pa che la legs bslabs pas / /ngan 'gro'i dngos por yang ma yin/ /kun nas bza' dang legs bza' bas/ /yang dag dga' bas lus bsrung (7)ngo / /rnying 7pa'i bza' ston ngan pa yis/ /nges par bdag nyid dga' bar bya/ /sngon gyi bslab sogs bslab pa dang / /sngon du thams cad bsdam (1pa nyid/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mnyam gzhag pas/ /mnar med dmigs pa med pa'o/ /sngon gyi mtshan nyid mtshon pa yis/ /sngon du bslab sogs bslab par bya/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mnyam gzhag pas/ /bslab pa gus pas bslab par bya/ /bud med 'jigs 80—738

gzugs drag mo ①nyid/ /skra ni 'dzings shing 'khyil ②pa dang / /ngur smrig dmar po 'jam pa nyid/ /phra mo'i rdul gyis 'jam pa bgo①/ /mi yi rus pas byas pa yang / /bud med rgyan du rnam par brgyan/ /rnying ④pa'i tshem ber dmar po ni/ /mi yi pags pas g.yog (nyapar bya/ /snod chen po ni gnyis pa ru / /bzung stil dbang po lnga ni gzung 4)/ /steng du rdo rje'i dbyug pa ni/ /mi yi yan lag rus pas brgyan(9/ /ba dan dril bu phreng ba ni/ /dbyug pa lag pa g.yon ⑨pas gzung / /de ⑩ltar bsdus pa'i lus kyis ni/ /'bad pas brtul zhugs spyod (nyepar bya/ /'di ltar rdzas sogs dngos po ni/ /me bzhin 'bar bas reg mi bya/ /bza' dang btung ba la sogs gzhan/ / dang po bsdu bar tunyeyang mi bya/ /snying rjer phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /kun nas dga' zhing bza' bar bya/ /thams cad gnod pa don med pas/ /dngos po kun nas yongs su spang / /lus ni bsrungs (stepa tsam gyis ni/ / slong mo'i yibaza' ba bslang bar bya / /stong pa'i khyim dang dur khrod dang / /bas mtha' dang ni dgon par gnas / /mtshan mo kun nas bgrod par ni8/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan mchog tu brtsonatso/ /'chag dang nyal dang 'dug pa 'am/ /shel gyi rnam pa'i sems dang ni/ /rang bzhin yongs su dag pa nyid/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan 'ba' zhig go/ /de yis thams cad 'grub 'gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa nyid/ /sdig spangs rnam par spyod pa yis/ /'khor ba ru ni mi gnas pa'o/ /thams cad dngos po dngos med par/ /rtag tu sems kyis blta yi ba nyid/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas rgyu ru ni/ /de nas tshigs tu bcad gnyis ni brjodarka/ /sbyin pa chos kyis bsrung ba (leni/ /tshigs bcad gcig gis gnang 80—739

bar bya/ /e ma'o rmongs pa yi ni mthus/ /lus can kun nas dbang du byas/ /'dod sogs chos sogs mi bzad pas/ /mkhas pa yis ni yongs su spangs/ /dngos med dngos po yang ma yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi rtogs yo)pas/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las rgal zhing / /dmigs pa med pa'i bde ba 'thob/ /gzhan gyis brtags pa'i longs spyod sogs/ /nyal dang 'chag par dus gsum du / /rnal 'byor tshigs bcad gcig gis ni/ /rnal 'byor rmongs pa gcod (mibyed pa'o/ /sems chen po yi sems kyi ni/ /rnying 95)pa'i ras ni bsags pa yis / /de yi (4)gos su rab tu bgos/ /keng rus kyi ni yan lag kun/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i dbyug 5pa bzung / /pa ṭa (6)ha yi chos kyis brdung ⑦/ /rdo rje'i glu ni blang ba nyid/ /sems can sgrol ba'i rgyu ru (gyini/ /grong nas grong du kun tu 659 / /dmigs pa med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas ⑩mnyam par gzhag /dag pa'i sems ni mi dmigs pas/ /dga' ba yis ni bsrung bar bya / /spyod pa yis ni rgyur gyur pas/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa don gyi rgyu/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam bsal 47zhing / /nyes pa kun nas rnam spangs la/ /brtul zhugs zla drug spyad pa yiXsnye/ /rang 'dod ye shes 'grub par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnam par bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba rdzogs so(ste// //de nas thams cad snying po ni/ /de nyid kun gyi don bsdus pa/ /'khor bar brtan sa/dang g.yo bcas 7pa'i/ /kun gyi 7snying por rab sbyor ba'o/ /dang por re zhig 1 rnal 'byor pas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /sngon du bsnyen 1nyapa la sogs bya/ /rdo rje'am shes 80—740

rab rnal 'byor gyis/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas byas nas/ /phyis ni rang 'dod pa yi las/ /'grub par 'di la the 6)tshom ②med/ /spra tshil las ②ni gzugs brnyan bya/ /tsha ba'i mar khus byugs ④byas rgyal/ /snying gar duming ni bzhag pa dang / /tshigs dang tshigs su tsher ⑦mas dgang / /skyur po tshwa ⑧dang ma ru tser/ /gzugs brnyan dang ni yang dag ldan/ /snod du bsres la yang dag gzhag /ye shes lus la lus kyi dzi)ni/ /rkang pa g.yas pas mnan par bya/ /rno ba'i sems kyis bzlas byas pas/ /mtshan mo gcig gi mtha' ru ni/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom yimed/ /smin pa'i me la gzhag byas natunye/ /rgyal po myur du gdung bar 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa la/ /las 'di yis ni sbyar bar bya/ /hrīḥtsos mo gha si si da ha da ha groṇ+ḍi hūm̐ hrīḥtu)phaṭa/8 snga dro nyi ma shar dus la/ /me tog dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal yidang / /spos dang mar me'i cho ga yis/ /zhi ba'i las ni rnam par bya/ /chu dang 'o ma bsres pa'i snod⑩/ /der ni gtor ma sbyar nas ni/ /sngags ni brgya tu)rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /rgyal po nad dang bral bar 'gyur/ /oṃ a mṛ ta bha re de ()rtsu hūm̐ rtsu/ a a a/ thams cad las ni bsdus byas la/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun la bskur/ /rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so(7// //de nas rab sbyor snying po 'di/ /sngags pas rab tu rnam par spyad/ /yungs kur las ni gzugs brnyan bya/ /snying gar zhu )ming ni rnam par sbyar/ /rdo dang tsher ma lte bar ro/ /rkang pas mnan cing bzlas par bya/ su tīk+ṣa ṇa shu la (1rtsu dza phaṭa hrīḥ( she me la bsro zhing gdung ba dang / /lhag par bzlas shing 80—741

gzhag par bya/ /'di ltar mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /mod ①la gzer bas yang 'dzin to/ /zhi ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga las/ /'o ma dang ni sbrang rtsis ②bkru / /chu bo'i rgyun la bskur byas na/ /gzer zhing gzer ba'i nad dang bral/ /oṃ sarba ka ri hūm̐ dza swā hā/ gzer ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags gso/ /de nas thams cad snying po yis/ /gzhan gyi las kyi khyimatshan nyid ni/ /sngon du bsnyen sogs bsten byas pas/ /las kun 'grub par 'gyur ba'o/ /nag po'i mtha' dang tha ma la/ /ba skam gyi ni lci ba las/ /bsgrub bya yi ni ming dang gzugs / /dmar po'i ⑤tsan+dan gyis ni bskuyi/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni kun nas gzhag /seng ldeng phur pas mig 'bras la/ /g.yon pa'i rkang pas mnan nas ni / /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas byas shing / /me la bdug cing ⑦bdugs pa yis /mig ni gzer (8)bas 'dzin par 'gyur/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu ma li ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di yi sngags dang sngags kyis ni/ /'grub par 'di la po)the tshom 7med/ /zhi ba'i mchod pas mchod byas nas/ /oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa ḍā (nyaya hūṃ swā hā/ lan bdun mngon par bsngags yo byas nas/ /de yi 'o rgyun la bkrus nas(nye/ /bsgrub bya'i nad dang gnod pa sel/ /mig 'bras rno zhing gsal (stebar 'gyur/ /mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i kyicho ga'o/ /lhang tsher las ni bsgrub par bya/ /mkhas pas khrag gis bri tshaba'o/ /dug dang dur khrod sol ba yis/ /mig gi yi'abras bu byugs byas la/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas ni/ /brgya ()rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ krohā piṅga li rtsu khaṃ 37phaṭa/ 'di yi (rte sngags dang (1sngags kyis ni/ /bdag nyid lci bas bran par bya/ /de ltar mtshan nyid kun ldan pas//bsgrub bya myur du long bar 'gyur/ /sbrang rtsi mar gyis bsku byas nas/ /bsgrub 80—742

bya'i nad dang gnod pa sel/ /brgya 6)rtsa brgyad du mngon par bzlas/ /oṃ a mṛ ②ta lo tsa ne a swā hā/ long ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /gzhan yang bsgrub bya sgrub pa pos/ /las ①ni shin tu rnam par spyad/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /bag zan las ni pad+ma'i dbyibs/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni dbus nyid do④/ / khyi yi laspu yis bug pa dgang / /tsha ba'i mar khus bskus byas la/ /g.yon pa'i rkang pas mnan nas ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par byayi/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ke hūm̐ phu phaṭa/ me la bsro gzhing bsros pa yis/ /bha ga myur du bzlog par ⑧bya/ /shin tu gdug pa'i chung ma ni/ /'di yi 6)las kyis rab tu sbyar/ /lan bdun du ni mngon bsngags ⑩nas/ /sbrang rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun gyis bkru/ /oṃ su ko bha bi yirgyu he swā hā/zhi bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /'jim pa'i snod ni blangs byas la/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs kyi rnam par bya/ /rno ba'i til mar yungs kur 8gyis/ /bug pa dgang zhing sbyar bar bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas ni/ /seng ldeng phur pas ⑫brdung bya zhing / /sngags ni brgyad brgya rab bzlas yin/ /bha ga gzir zhing gzir tsobar 'gyur/ /hri pi la ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di yi sngags dang sngags kyis ni/ /bha ga gzir ba'i las nyid do/ /chu dang 'o mar bkru bya zhing / /sngags kyang ⑩mngon du sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ sarba sho dha ni swā hā/ 'di yi sngags dang sngags kyis ni / /bha ga gzir sogs las grol lo/ /gzhan yang las kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /shin tu rnal 'byor pas spyad do/ /rgyal po lam gyi sa rdul blang / /thonayang na bzhi mdo'i sa rdul las/ /pad+ma'i mtshan nyid mtshan nyid ni/ /bha ga'i snying po khrag dang ni/ /yi dgas phyag rgya phyag rgya yis(she/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par 80—743
