de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sbyor ba'i zas sman zhes bya yod/ /'dab 4)ma 'o ma 'dzag pa dang / /de bzhin me tog a (midza ga /dri ni dri zhim rnam par 'byed(gu/ /mdog ni ljang dang ser ba nyid/ /rtsa ba gcig gi dbang nyid dang / /ji ltar me bzhin 'tsher ④ba'o/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge sgom (9pa yis/ /mchod dang bzlas pa'i cho gar sbyar/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi mnyam pa'i char/ /srang ni re re bza' ba nyid/ /brgya dang de bzhin brgyad cu nyid/ /mkhas pa yis ni bza' bar bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis lo brgya ru/ /dben pa'i ri la gnas na ni/ /ye shes can gyis ye shes lus/ /nges par yongs su rgyas par 'gyur / /dbang po rnams kyi sred pa dang / /bkres pa la sogs med par 'gyur / /gnas ni nges pa nyid kyi mchog /rtsa ba rnal 'byor sbyor bar (6)bcasari tshoske/ /de ltar thos pa'i bdag nyid che/ /sbyor ba'i (8)bstan bcos skyon med pa'o/ /tha mal 'gro bar nges pa 6)ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang 'dzin / /de ni yang sos rnal 'byor pa/ /ye shes can gyis ye shes rtog7 /lnga pa'i lnga pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste (1bcu drug pa rdzogs so// //mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan shes rab dbang po sbas pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khams su snang bar mdzad/ /dngos po du ma'i khyad par bsags pa'i rab rib gang gi mthu yis 'jig mdzad pa/ /rtag tu kun nas rngubs pa'i nga rgyal mi mthun dgra yi ni dus dang dus su g.yul 'gyed pa'o/ /chags med ye shes ri bo mnyam nyid 1 mnyam pa'i sa bon chen po gcig gis 80—842

mdzad / /hūm̐ gi rnam pa 'byin byed dngos/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa mchog gi lha/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa stong gyur pa/ /yi ge hūṃ la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi ge brgyad kyis (1)ngo bo nyid / /spyod bcas mi spyod gsang ba dang / /chu dang me dang de bzhin rlung / /sa ni mig gi yi ge'o/ /sgo bzhi dang ni phung po bzhi/ /sgong skyes dza lar tshon gnas pa nyid/ /bzhi po riXnyon mongs ming dang ni/ /yi ge bzhi pa de bzhin du//rmongs pas sa dang nyon mongs dang / /sngon du phyugs ni mnyam pa dang / /chu ñcashing (5)me tog pad+ma ni/ /'di yis 6sgong skyes stan 7)nyid do/ /ba lang mig pa'i steng du ni/ /bdud rtsi brgyad kyis 8rnam par dbye/ /shel bzhin du ni dag pa yi(9) / /snying po yi ni snying po'i mchog /lce la chu ni 'di nyid dang / /nam 1 mkha' rna ba sna dag la'o/ /sa ni mig la sbyar bya 11ste/ /tshangs par me ni de bzhin 'bar/ /rmongs pa yis ni mgrin 1 par ro/ /g.yo ba'i snying la gnas pa dang / /thams cad nyon mongs brang dang ni/ /phyugs ni lte ba'i rtsa bar ro/ /yan lag brgyad la dgod pa yis/ /'di yis lha nyid yang dag shes/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sngags 'di tu ni/ /phyag rgya brgyad du rab tu grags/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /gnag cing 'bar ba'i las la ni/ /las rnams bzhi la lha mo yisa'i/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag gsum du bzlas/ /ye shes dbang phyug snying po nyid/ /mchog tu rtag cing zhi ba dang / /phra zhing rags pa'i 'gro ba kun / /las dang las kyi 8rnam par grolas/ /thams cad chu yi dbyibs 1 dang ni / /mnyam par 'jig byed me sna dang yang / /ji ltar rtag pa rlung dag dang / /dad pa'i tu)don dang sa dbang po/ /lhag ma sa bzhin brtsegs rna pa ni/ /bzhi pa 21yi ge drug pa'o/ /'gro ba'i don phyir yi ge brgyad/ /lha brgyad du ni yongs 80—843

su grags/ /mnyam gzhag bzlas pa'i ngo bo yis/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom med / /ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /sngon du reg cing reg pa nyid/ /'jig rten 'dir ni bde ba dang / /rtag tu mchod pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i dus su ye shes ni/ /gzugs med srid par rab tu gnas/ /bdag gi de nyid mnan pa yis/ /ji ltar sngags 'di 'grub par 'gyur/ /de phyir nan tan thams cad kyis/ /sbyor ba'i 1 bstan bcos rtogs par bya/ /dri zhim rab grags me tog kun nas gnas 90pa dang / /nag po'i a ka (5)ru dang gu gul ④mar me dang / /gnyis med gtor ma gcig gis yid ni (5༄ldan pa yis/ /lha mo ma mo rnam pa ( rikun nas rab tu mchod/ /yi ge brgyad pa'i le'u zhes bya (7ste dang po'o// //de nas gsang ba'i yan lag gi/ /thig le la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum skyes pa zad 8)byas nas/ /ye shes dngos po gnas pa bzhin/ /lha yi dngos po dbyer med pas/ /steng dang 'og dang dbus su ni/ /thams cad kun nas stong pa nyid/ /ri rab gling gzhan zad byas nas/ /mnyam nyid sbyor ba kun du bsam/ /thams cad sdom pa'i dbye ba yis/ /de yis 9me tog thig le yi/ /thig le'i dbus su gsal ba'o/ /ye shes rdul ni rnam par thim ye shes blo dang ldan pas shes/ /kha dog med cing mtshon kun dngos/ /gzugs med ye shes gzugs bzhin no/ /ring ba ma yin thung ba min/ /mi ldan pa dang ldan pa nyid/ /gzugs dang 1 stong pa'i de bzhin dbus/ /lhan cig ye shes gzung 1stobar bya/ /nyon mongs de bzhin mun pa ni/ /rnam shes lhan cig snang 80—844

ba'o / /ye shes rdo rje (1)bcom byas nas/ /snang ba'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ / me yi (5)dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'o/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de dbus ji skad gsungs pa yi/( ri /ye shes dang ni rnam shes sems/ /'jig 54)pa med cing 'tshe 5gemed par/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /ye shes kyi thig le'i (6)sbyor ba'i le'u zhes bya ste 57)gnyis pa'o// // ka ba gcig dang sgo gsum gyis/ /ye shes dbus su thim pa nyid/ /bzlog par bya ba'i sa bon nyid/ /sbyang bya'i yi ge phyed dang gnyis/ /brgyad kyi mtha' la gsum pas drang / /sa bon 'di ni drag po'i me/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ /(8)sngon gsungs mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ /sngon du lhan cig bsgoms pa yis/ /dkar pos lus ni bsdam 5)par bya/ /mnyam pa'i gnas su 'bar ba yis/ /ji skad sngon du gsungs pa'i rlung / /dbus su mchod rten sbyang bar bya/ /rlung dang me yi bdun bodon la/ /rdo nyu7rje'i sa bon bsgom byas la / /sgra 'dang thig les rnam tsho par brgyan/ /char gyi rgyun zhes bshad pa yin/ /rgyas pa lnga yi sgo nyid la/ /kha dog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /sgo gnyis mngon par bstan pa ni/ /de bzhin chu dang chu min gnyis/ /yi ge nyis 7)'gyur thigs pa dang / /rtsa bar sgra ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di yis lus ni bsdam bya zhing //me ni sgo ru bsam par byas/ /sems 'di yis ni dmigs par bya/ /steng du tshangs pa'i sgo 'di ni/ /tshigs dgu yi ni mchog gi gdan/ /lus med sems 80wa 845

kyi ngo bo yis/ /dngos pos ①dngos po bsgom par bya/ /dus la bab na 'pho bya ste / /dus min lha rnams gsod pa nyid/ /sdig gis kun nas mi gos te/ /'khor ba'i pha rol mchog tu sgrol/ /'pho bar sbyor ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste gsum pa'o// //sngon gsungs mtshan nyid ldan par ni/ /sngon du stong pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ / de yi nalus ni sbyang bar bya/ /sbyor bas (mibasgom pa'i lus can ni/ /dngos po med par bsgom pa'i dngos/ /gang zhig dngos po (gernam rtog pa'i/ /dngos por bsgom pa'i sa bon gyis/ /stong pa'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /dgod bya'i yi ge rnam bkod pa/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis mngon par brgyan/ /dbyig (snyepa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis(6ni/ /zhabs skyed phyag na rdo rje dang / /lus ni dril bu 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /de bzhin mgo ni byams pa dang / /ma yi rnam pa (7)steng 'bar ba/ /'khor ba rnam par grol bar mdzad/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam mang por/ /kun nas stong pa'i dbus su bsam/ /rnam shes ye shes sa bon gyis(8rdzo/ /dbus dang dbus su rnam par dkris/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan mchog brtson pas/ /rlung (9tshogi steng du bsam par bya/ /dang po yidakar po kun nas bsam/ /gnyis pa de bzhin ser po'o/ /gsum par gang zhig dmar po dang / /bzhi pa la ni sngon po nyid/ /mnyam bzhag 4lhabazlas pa'i ngo bo yis / /'grub par 'di la the tshom kyi med/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi ming zhes pa/ /gsang zhing gsang ba gsang chen po/ /bdag gi gdan gyi le'u zhes bya ste 1snyebazhi pa'o// //80—846

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /tsha ba'i sa bon bye brag ni/ /lto ba'i thab khung 'di yi me/ /lto ba'i me ru shes par bya/ /shar gyi cha ni dkar po'o/ /byang gi de bzhin ser po nyid/ /nub kyi phyogs su dmar po ste/ /lho phyogs su ni nag por grags/ /dbus su mnyam pa'i kha dog nyid/ /me lnga ru ni bsam par bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ming zhes pa/ /shar gyi mer ni rab tu brtag /drag mo 0)mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba/ /byang gi phyogs su rnam par brtag /ro langs ma zhes bshad pa ni/ /nub kyi phyogs su rab tu dgod(mi/ /mkha' 'gro gtum mo ⑧zhes bya'i ming / /lho phyogs kyi ni me yi (༄ming / /dbus su ye shes me (nya'adi ni / /ye shes mkha' 'gro zhes bya'i (5)ming / /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs 6)pa ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan cing / /lag na rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /me 'bar ba dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /gzugs ni mthe (kyebo'i rnam pa tsam/ /khro bo'i gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /na li las ni yi ge 5)brgyad/ /'phyang ⑩ba po yi sgor 5nyeni thim/ /mkhas pas phyis ni bdag nyid lngas/ /gnas lnga ru ni sbyin sreg 4)bya/ /sems kyis dbugs ni rab bsdams nas/ /dngos pos dngos po bsgom par bya/ /gang zhig cung tsho zad bza' btung rnams/ /sbyin sreg 7tu brtags bza' bar bya/ /dang po sgra yi yi ge dang / /de bzhin gnyis pa gnyis 'gyur gnyis/ /gsum pa glo ru re pha dang / /bzhi nga/'i steng du thig ler bcas / /lnga pa steng 7du 'bar ba nyid/ /sa bon lnga la bzlas shing bsregatso /de ltar bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rgyas pa'i sbyor bar grags pa'o/ / sbyin sreg gi le'u ste dang po'o/ // //80—847

de nas dag pa rnam gsum bya/ / swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyo3lha/badz+ra shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3rta/ yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo3nya0)/ de ltar spyod pa'i sbyor bas ni/ /yid ni dag par byed pa'o/ /thams cad kun nas stong nyid kyis/ /der ni chu 'di (gebasam par bya/ /kun nas chu yi gzugs dang ni/ /de yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /rgya chen yid la 'dod bzhin du/ /gser gyi grong khyer 'byung ba ni/ /rin chen bdun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /seng ge gdan gyis gdan gyi (3)ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa/ /dbus su ye shes bsam pa ni/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i ming nyid de/ /kha ṭī ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /rab tu bzhad ④pas 'jigs par byed/ /na bza' dmar po gtsigs pa'o/ /dbu skra sil bu rab tu drag(5) /ye shes mkha' 'gro zhes bya'i ming / /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung (6)gis bzhugs/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i phyi rol du/ /de yi gzugs kyi logs gnyis su / /ji ltar phyogs kyi mdog nyid ni/ /kun nas de yi phyag rgya rigs8)/ /lnga pa'i bdag nyid bsgoms nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod dang gtor ma dbul/ /chu nya yi ni bdag nyid rnams//chu dang me dang de bzhin g.yo(97/ /ji ltar rlung du du ba bzung / /ye shes rdo rjes dkris pa ni/ /lnga pa'i lha nyid 'byung ba ni/ /lnga pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /gi 7wang gnyis ni mā ma khri1lha/ /de yi gcig ni bdud rtsi'o/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /gnyis kyi 12de nyid rab tu bya/ /ā 12li zhes bya 'bung bar gsungs / /kā li de bzhin gshegs ma nyid/ /ji ltar sde tshan gsum pa 97yi/ /yi ge gsum pa gzung 7byas te1 / /rdo rje yis 1 ni dbyug pa nyid/ / 'og pag 6980—848

sogs pas dkri bar bya/ /sa bon he ni mchog bsam pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sdig pa gcod6)/ /pad+ma'i dbang phyug sku ni gser gyi mdogs /dri yi ngo bo shin tu snang mdzad dang / /ro ni rdo rje (8)dbang phyug rdo rje'i phyag /lha gsum dag gi cho ga shes par bya/ /ha zhes bya bas kha dog 'phrog /ho zhes bya bas dri med cing / /dpa' bo hrīḥzhe yis 'joms pa ni/ /rim pa 'di bzhin shes par bya/ / thabs shes sbyor ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o5ci// //de nas gzhan yang gzhan gyi ri nigadan/ /dang por (7 re zhig (8mtshan nyid kyis / /bdag nyid rab tu sbyar (9bar bya/ /ji ltar me yis thams cad mnyam par bsreg 7pa dang / /ji ltar nyi mas khyab par 'cha ra bar ston pa dang / /ji ltar rlung gis dri ni mnyam par len pa ltar/ /rnam rtog ring du spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon gsungs mtshan nyid ldan par ni/ /nyi ma'i dbus su chu dkyil 'khor/ /chu yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /rab 'dod pad+ma bsam par bya /gzhal yas khang ni mdzes pa'i dngos/ /rin chen bdun gyis 11rnam par brgyan//seng ge'i gdan gyi nyagegadan la ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa'o/ /na bza' sna tshogs rab tu 'phyang / /gdugs dkar po yis mngon par g.yogs/ /dgod bya'i yi ge rnam par bkod/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su yang / /dbus su ye shes rnam shes ni/ /gzugs la yon tan dbang pos brgyan/ /dang po'i sgra dzo1geyig dang po dang / /de bzhin gnyis par 7nyis 'gyur nyid/ /gsum la logs su re pha dang / /bzhi pa'i steng du thig ler bcas/ /phyogs kyi mdog tu dgod pa ri'ini/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam mang po/ /mtshams su yi 80—849

dgas gdan la 91 ni/ /ma ning yi ge bzhi pa nyid/ /dbang ldan seng ge zhes bya ba / /de bzhin me ru stag mo dang / /bden bral 'ug pa r+ghaṃ sgrogs pa/ /ce ⑧spyang rlung du dgod par bya/ /dbugs kyis dudangos po thams cad dang / /de yi phyag rgya'ang ④brtag par bya/ /dngos pos phyidangos po bsgom ⑥pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro brgyad kyis rnam par bskor/ /logs su lnga pa'i bdag nyid dang / /dbus su'ang ye shes rnam par dgod/ /bdag nyid lus kyi lus can ni/ /gnyis med mchod pas mchod par bya/ /yid kyi 57)me tog dgram (8)pa dang / /yid kyi 〈snabadug pas bdug pa dang / /yid kyi tsobyug pas mngon par byug /yid kyi kyirtomar me sbar bar bya/ /sngon du rdzas ni lnga pa la/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis byin gyis brlabs/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ /dpa' bo'i tsolus la gzung 3 ribar bya/ /lcags kyus lha rnams thams cad ni/ /bdud rtsi'i yi ge tshim par bya/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor las / /dpa' bo'i dbus su byin gyis brlabs / /ā tshalir shes pa mā ma tī/ /skyes bu rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /lha mo g.yon pa la brten 7cing / /skyes bu'i rkang pa hūm̐ byas pa/ /de yi rdzas ni rab bstan 1 pas/ /dpa' bos thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /bdag nyid lnga yi lus la ni/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni rnam par thim/ /'dod la dga' nyid ma yin zhing / /longs spyod phyir yang brten mi bya/ /gnyis med gtor ma ldan pa yis / /dus kun tu ni mchod par bya/ /gzhan gyi gdan zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gsum 18pa'o// //de nas phyi yi 19gtor ma bshad/ /snying po'i gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /de 80—850

bzhin byang du 'bar tu)byed ma/ /'jib byed ma ni nub tu gsungs/ /ngag 'phrog lho phyogs rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor pho nya bzhi po ni/ /drag po'i gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni sbyin bya zhing / /dam pa'i spyod pas mchod par bya/ /mnyam nyid lta ba'i ye shes kyis/ /mkhas pas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje khu ②tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni sbrel byas nas/ /sdigs rigumadzub gi)gnyis ni bsgreng 'a/byas nas / /'di ltar gsang ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni kun gyi'o/ /ba dan gsum pa'i snying gar (6)sbyin/ /steng du khu tshur thams cad bcas/ /'di ni pho nya'i phyag rgya'o/ /brgyad mtha' dang po'i sa bon dang / /dgu yi mtha' ni ( 7dbyang du shar/ /shar dang nub kyi sa bon dang / /lho yi gsum par mngon par gzung / /pho nya bzhi yi sa bon 'di/ /sgra dang thig ler sbyar bar bya/ /shar du bdud rtsi drag po yi(she/ /sa bon dbus su sbyar bar bya/ /ji ltar las la 5)sogs sbyar ba/ /'bum phrag gsum gyis mngon par 'grub/ /tshes ⑩ grangs med cing rgyu skar med/ /smyung /stobar gnas pa'ang med pa'o/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /rtag tu 'bad pas mchog tu bsgrubatso/ /dam tshig la gnas dpa' bo che/ /'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs bcomatshon/ /dag pa'i chos la dmigs pa yis// /dag pa'i dbyangs ni lam po che/ /chos chen po ni legs par 'ongs/ /ro mchog mchog tu zhim pa'o/ /srid pa'i mgon po rgya che ba/ /sangs rgyas gang kyil phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis dbul bar bya/ /sbyor ba'i gdan gyi 9bdag nyid lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'di nyid tshe la 'khor ba gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis blang bya zhing / /80—851

tshigs bcad 'di yis rab tu zed0)/ /②pad+mar bsgyur ba'i gdan la ni/ /steng du rdo rje bstan par bya/ /dbus su bdud rtsi ri rab kyis bsrubs nas/ / mthe mdzub /gnyis ni sa yi (bsteng du 'thor 'thung dbul/ /rgyas pa'i mchod rten lnga la ro yis (bulan lnga ru/ /bdud rtsi chu yis mchod rten dbus su bsam par bya/ /gzhan gyi gdan 96)gyis bdag nyid dbye ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bzhi rtsodapa'o// //gzhan yang gtor ma'i las bshad pa/ /logs su gru gsum bya༄8) ba ni(9)/ /khrag sogs kyis ni bya ba 'am/ /g.yon pa 1 )khu tshur bcings 11byas la/ /dbu ma khro bo brkyang bar bya/ /dbus ma yi ni gsum pa la/ /sdigs (nyamadzub yi bkug la sbyar bar bya/ /du ba'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /oṃ ā tsokar+ṣa ya / ā 8kar+ṣa ya/ ma hā pū dza bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /kun nas gtor ma rdzogs byas la/ /lnga pa'i rdzas kyis sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ shing gcig 6medang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag 68dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi mdo dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khyim stong nyid/ /shing chen shing gi bdag po dang / /khyad par du ni chu mig 17nyid/ /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / /khyad par sa steng gdol khyim gnas )/ /nag po sa1drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten ‘ 2pa dang / /nag po gtsigs byed 'jigs da byed pa/ /dga' las 'das pa bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byed mo dang drag 2 mo dang / /'jigs byed ma dang u sums bstod/ /rgyal mo rnam par rgyal mo dang / /thub chen gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen 80wa 852

mo / /nag mo nag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang byed ma dang zla ba mo/ /drag mo sdang ba'i lam pa ki/ /'phrog byed ma dang me mar ma/ /'jib byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen po/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma/ / thod phreng thod pa'i phreng can ma/ /①kha ṭī ga ma rdzu 'phrul che / /ral gri dgra sta'i lag pa dang / /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i de nyid che(mi/ /las kun rjes su sgrub( no byed pa'i(4)/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen po(5)/ /rdo rje dbang phyug de bzhin gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo/ /gos med sbyor ba'i lha byed ma(6)/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma ka (7)yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'gugs (2)pa'o/ /oṃ ā (94)kar+ṣa ya/ ā ⑩kur+sha ya/ sarba de ba lo ki ni na kuk+ka ka tshonyuḍa (12ni/ /bas kha tshogeḍa yini/ basba ⑫brnya ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sha dang nya yis sbyar ba yis/ /oṃ gyis spyan drangs yigator ma sbyin/ /ji ltar las la tu tshosogs brtsam pa/ /bcwa yinyelnga dang ni bcu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni tshes brgyad la'o/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nan tan du ni gtor ma sbyin/ /ye shes can gyi 5)dpal 'dod pas/ /lhag ma'i so )gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /oṃ hi li hi li brdzu/ ma tha ma tha ( 1yo gi nī hūm̐ dzaḥs gzhan gyi gdan gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste lnga ( shepa'o// //sngags kyi yi ge yi ge ni/ /yid kyi nu )sprul pas bsgrub par bya/ /snying po'i sems ni rnam spangs nas/ /nyams pa'i gzugs brnyan rnam par bsgom/ /sngags ni 5dur dur zhes brjod pa/ /e ma sems can nyon re mongs/ /des na yid la mngon 'dod pa'i/ /sngags kyi yi ge mchog nyid ni/ /'gro ba rmongs 80—853

pas 1de nyid med sngags dang / /log par smra zhing gzugs brnyan sems dang bral / /sngags kyi ri rabadag nyid blo ldan gyis shes ④bya/ /las bzhi'i ⑤rnam par yongs su grags pa nyid/ /skyes pa du ma'i gzugs dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa//nus mthu'i mtshan nyid kun nas thams cad ni/ /g.yo zhing 'thab pa phra zhing gos pa med/ /sngags dang rgyud (6)kyi bdag nyid mchog gi yi ge'o/ /gzugs la (7sogs pa kun 'jig napas/ /thams cad nam mkha'i 59)bsgom pa'o/ /khams drug dang ni dbang po drug /dbus ma'i khams nyid 'jig pa dang / /stong pa bcwa khobargyad blo ldan gyis bsgom pa/ /sems can bsgom pa'i dngos po yis/ /stong pas thams cad 'jig pa'o/ /shar du kha dog dkar po dang / /byang phyogs su ni ser po'o/ /rin chen nyi ma'i 'od 'bar ba/ /lho phyogs su ni sngon po nyid/ /dbus su mnyam pa'i (1gnas su yang / /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /ā li kā lir nyidarab sbyor ba/ /de yi sa bon dbyung bar bya/ /nam mkha'i dbus ni mchog nyid du/ /gang zhig dbus su zla ba dang / /zla ba'i dbus su sa bon ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba bsgom par bya/ /tshon sna bdun ni sna tshogs pa/ /'od zer 'bar ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ /gong du bla ma'i yi ge dang / /tha ma bsreg 1 pa'i yi ge dang / /dbus su sa bon gzhag byas pa/ /mnyam bzhag skabazlas 15su 'ong ba yis/ /'bum phrag gsum du mkhas pas bzla/ /sbyor ba'i gdan las 7shes rab kyi pha 1 rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba le'u dang po'o12// //sngon gsungs mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ /sngon bshad stong pa nyid kyi 80—854

gzhisti / /ye shes can gyis mnyam bzhag ②pas/ /gzugs la chasogs pa gzhig (gepar bya/ /kun nas stong pa'i dbus su ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni blta ⑤bar bya/ /'khor lo nyi ma 'dra ba bzhin(6)/ /'od zer kun nas yang dag gnas/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams kun tu/ /dpag tu med par gzhag ⑦par bya/ /thig le thig le phra ba'i gnas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten kun mkhyen bcas/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ / me yi ⑧dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'o/ /me yi yonadakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de dbus ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /rnam shes ye shes sems dpa'o7/ /spyi bor thams cad bsam pa'o / /yi ge yi ge steng du bcas/ /smra ba'i sa bon thams cad ni/ /de ni rgyal po zhes su brjod/ /ye shes dang ni rnam shes dbyibs/ /rlung gi dbus su btung yonyebar bya/ /sa bon de yi zhu sbyar bya ba/ /sgra ni steng dang steng du'o/ /de ltar sa bon mchog bsam pa/ /ye shes rnam shes ming nyid do/ /'od zer 'bar ba rnam dmar po/ /zla ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /bdun pa'i mtha' ni yang dag blang / /gang gis bdud rtsi sa bon bzhin/ /gang zhig bzlas pas dkris pa ni/ /kha dog dkar por 1 bsam par bya/ /sgra yig dang po yiblang byas la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis dkris 8pa'o/ /dgu mtha'i sa bon yi ge ni/ /logs su me yis sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan du rlung gi sa bon dang //rlung gi ngos 7su mngon par bsam/ /thams cad kun nas bsgom pa ni/ /ye shes thig le zhes bya'i yo ming / /sdig byed blun po'i sems can rnams/ /sbyor ba 'di yis dag par bya/ /sa bon las ni rdo rje tu bskyed/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i 80—855

mtshan nyid shes/ /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad lus/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i na bzas 1brgyan/ /'di ni bsgoms (gepa tsam (bgyis ni/ /ting 'dzin kun nas yang dag gnas/ /dbus su 'di gzugs (0bsam par bya/ /rin chen 'bar bas 'bigs gepa yi/ /mgrin par re pha'i (6)thig le dang / /bsgrub bya'i mdun du bsgom bya ba/ /lan bdun pa yis ri7༄'byed pa ni/ /mda' yi (7rtse mor sa bon bsam/ /kha dog dkar po ka sha bzhin/ /mda' 'dren pa yis dbyig 9 pa yis/ /sngags pas sa bon bzlas par bya/ /phyag rgya'i rnam pa bcing ba dang / /sa bon sems kyis bzla bar bya/ /'bum phrag gcig bzlas rnal 'byor pas/ /de bzhin myur du mngon par 'gugs6 )/ /yi ge gnyis 'gyur thig le dang / /rtsa bar nga ro sbyar bar bya/ /de ni bdud rtsi yid 'ong ming / /'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /'byung po bzhin du dri za dang / /mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin ma bshad pa/ /gnod sbyin yi dgas grul bum yostedang / /rdo rje lha mo rnal 'byor ma/ /gal te 'dod na phran tshegs minyurte/ /sbyor bas myur du 'gugs par byed/ / sbyor ba'i gdan las 12dmar po chen pos kun tu rmongs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste (7gnyis pa'o// //gzugs kun zad par byas nas ni/ /gzugs ni mi gnas zad par 'gyur / /skar ma'i rnam pa'i dbyibs su ni/ /dang por stong pa mngon bsam bya / /mnyam nyid lta ba skabaskyed byas nas/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /dbyug pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon/ /gu gul phyag na rdo rje dang / /yan lag 'jam dbyangs dril bu mchog /byams pa zla ba'i ri mo nyid/ /ma zhes bya 80—856

ba steng 'bar ba/ /rnam par 'khor ba sgrol bar mdzad/ /sa bon 'di yis 0)'bras bu ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su yang / /'od zer 'bar ba rnam mang por(mi/ /lha nyid lnga ni bsgom par bya/ /ri rab rtse ru gzhal yas khang / /rin chen kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gdan du me tog sngon po 'di98)/ /bung ba'i zas su za ba nyid/ /me tog myur du za ba rnams/ /sbrang rtsi mnyam pa'i gnas nyid do/ /steng du 'phro tsho ba'i yi ge ni/ /sangs rgyas kun du 'thon /5)pa'o / /chu dang nam mkha' rlung gi ni/ /sa bon bzhi yis lha nyid do/ /dbyibs ni ban (67du ka ltar gyis/ /kha dog li khri'i (7)sems kyis ni/ /lha mo mā ma khrir sbyor bas/ /ri rab rtse mor bsam par bya/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dbang phyug mgon / /lha rnams kun gyi 8bdag nyid do/ /phyag rgya gnyis dang mngon ldan pa'i / /rtse mo gsum gyis kun 9'jig pa'o/ /sa ni gnas su gnon pa ni/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis rnam par mnan/ /tshems kyi sna rim mchu btsir nas ni/ /gzugs dang gzugs la lta ba nyid/ /hūm̐ gi glu yi tsho rnam pa dang / /sgra yang de ru sbyar bar bya/ /bdud rtsi re pha thig le dang / /lcags kyu yis ni rtse 1gebar bya/ /lha mo sngags kyi kun nas zlos/ /rdo rje can dang pad+ma'i gdan/ /ji ltar sde tshan gsum pa yi/snye/ /yi ge gsum pa bzung gebyas la/ /glu 5ru rdo rje dbyug pa dang //gnyis par 'og pag 17gis ni dkyi1 / /sngags pa mchog gi sa bon 'di/ /kun nas bzla zhing sngon du gzung 18/ /lha rnams kun nas mnyes byas nas/ /'di yi rdzas ni bza' bar bya/ /rgyal pos spro zhing brten 19pa yis/ /dbang gi las ni mngon du brtsam/ /rab min dman pa'i rigs la ni/ /mngon du las ni sbyar bar bya/ /mnyam pa'i rigs kyi me tog la/ /rgyas pa'i las ni bya bar bya/ /80—857

bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs kyis/ /zhi ba'i las ni de las mchog /las bzhi mngon par sbyor ba yis/ /rigs kyi bye brag brtsam yo)par bya/ /bdud rtsi'i ② gsang ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rdzas gzhan dag ni bsgom par bya/ /dbang po'i ③lag pa shu dag ru rta dang / /rmongs byed dang ni de bzhin gur gum dang / /ku tan tsa ri 4)zla ba dung nyid kyis/ /'di nyid kyis ⑤ni rab tu sbyar bar bya /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa la/ /gnyis med gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /sdug phongs 4)la ni rjes brtse bas/ /sems can don du las brtsam bya/ /'dod la dga' nyid ma yin te/ /longs spyod phyi ru bsten ⑦pa min/ /khro med rmongs pa med pa yis/ /sems can don du sbyang bar bya/ /sbyor ba'i gdan las dbang du byed pa (8)zhes bya ba ste le'u gsum pa'o// // cilce la chu (91ni rnam par sbyar/ /nam mkha' rna ba sna gnyis la/ /sa ni chu la yang dag gsungs/ /mgrin par rmongs pa'i sa yidang ni/ /g.yo ba snying la gnas pa'o/ /nyon mongs kun nas thong ka dang / /phyugs ni lte ba'i rtsa bar ro / /yan lag brgyad la dgod pa ni/ /lha nyid dang ni sbyar bar bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bsam bya ba/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rab tu brgyan/ /lus (1)kyi sa sogs 12rab sbyar (1steb/ /kha dog gcig pa'i rnam par bya/ /mtheb timo sum cu rtsa gnyis tshang / /rnam par shes pa'i nang du 'pho/ /phyi rol nyis 'gyur yis dag la/ /dbugs kyi las la 7sogs pa bya/ /lto bar me yi lha bsam pa4me/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i ming nyid do/ /dbugs la bdud rtsi yang dag thimayonya/ /kun nas sngon gyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /lha rnams la ni sreg blugs 17dbul/ /80—858

sngag /dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpa' bo gcig pa zhes bya ba/6)༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ e ka bī rā khya shrī tsaṇ+ḍa phyim hā ro ṣa ṇa tan+t+ra ⑧rā dza ④mā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpa' bo gcig pa ⑤zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gtum po (6)khro bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa gdus gcipo/ na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi snying po rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor pa dang / rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyang ngo / /'di lta ste/ mi g.yo 50ba dkar po'i rdo rje rnal 'byor pa dang / mi g.yo ba ser po'i rdo rje rnal 'byor pa dang /tsar mi g.yo ba dmar po'i rdo rje rnal 'byor pa dang / mi g.yo ba ljang gu'i nyu )rdo rje rnal 'byor pa dang /gti mug rdo rje ma'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / phra ma tshonardo rje ma'i rdo rje rnal 80wa 889

'byor ma dang / 'dod chags rdo rje ma'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / phrag dog rdo rje ma'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / de lta bu la 6)sogs pa'i ②rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma bye ba khri brgya stong rnams so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' mi g.yo ba nag po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di nye bar gsungs so/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba'i/ / gcig pu de ni dga' bzhi'i (khumachog /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs pa'i/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nga / /rmongs pa gang gis nga mi shes/ /lus dang ngag rnams kun la ④gnas / /nga ni de rnams phan don phyir/ /rnam pa lnga yis yang dag gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma zhe sdang rdo rje ma'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di nye bar gsungs so/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /lha yi ⑤'dod pas bde bar gnas/ /bdag ni kun rtog rnam par bral/ /spros pa med cing g.yo ba med/ /bud med gang gis nga mi shes/ /bud med kun gyi zhulus la gnas/ /bdag ni de rnams phan don phyir / /rnam pa lnga yis yang dag gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba nag po la bcom ldan 'das ma zhe sdang rdo rje mas dam du 'khyud nas tsum par ⑦mdzad de gsol ba btab (87pa dang / lha mo lha mo dga' chen mo/ /gsang ba shin tu'ang rnyed dka' ba/ /snying po las snying mchog gi gtso/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis legs gsungs pa/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po dbang phyug mchog /dga' ma rgyud chen mnyan (9par gyis/ /dpa' bo gcig pu zhes bya bas/ /sems can dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la/ /rgyud 'di rab tu bstan mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la'ang / /rgyud 'di 7 80—890

bstan par mi bya'o/ /gang zhig gtum po khro bo yi/ /dkyil 'khor rab zhugs mnyam gzhag ①cing / /dad dang brtson 'grus mchog ldan la/ /gtum po'i rgyud 'di bstan par bya/ /bla ma la gus snying rje can/ /sngags kyi theg par mchog tu gzhol/ /gtum po'i dbang phyug la rtag gus/ /de la rgyud 'di bstan par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa gang la la zhig /'dod brkam sangs rgyas slu ②byed pas/ /gtum po'i dkyil 'khor ston ①byed cing / /bla med rgyud ni ston byed na/ /de ni nad chen gyis gzir nas/ /bshang ④gci'i dri mas gos par byed / /zla ba drug gi nang du ni/ /de ni 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ⑤'gyur/ /de phyir gshin rje'i pho nyas bzung / /dus kyi zhags pa'i dbang du 'gyur/ /gang tshe sdig can dmyal bar 'khrid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsrung dumi nus/ /lo ni 'bum du de sdug bsngal/ /gal te myong 'gyur ⑦las zad kyang / /gal te mi ru skyes na yang / /rdo rje'i gnam lcags kyis de 'jig /sngags rig dubartul zhugs can gyis ni/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor legs bris nas/ /de nyid sngon du yongs brtags pa'i/ /slob ma bzang po rab gzhug bya/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba'i/ /rgyud ni de phyir bstan par bya/ /gang yang ma thos rgyud 'chad pa/ /de yang 'og tu 'gro 'gyur zhing / /gal te sangs rgyas dang mtshungs kyang / /de yi gdong du rnam smin 'gyur/ /slob ma dad pa dman pa dang / /the tshom za bas 6)nyan byed tshen/ /mgo bor rdo rje'i thog ltung ba/ /char 'bab dus su the tshom med/ /mchog gi zhal mnga' lha mo la/ /bdag gis 'di ni bden par bshad/ /dpa' bo gcig nyid rgyud 'di ni/ /gtum po khro bo shin tu gsang / zhes pa ni dpa' bo gcig pa nyid du gsungs pa'i/80—891

dpal khro bo gtum po chen po'i rgyud las rgyud la 'jug pa'i rim par phye ba zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das ma zhe sdang rdo rje mas/ gtum po chen po khro bo la dam du 'khyud ①nas gsol pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni bya ba la/ /gang gi tshad kyis bri bar bya/ /de bzhin de dbus bri bya ba②/ /gang yin gtso bos bdag la gsungs / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dkyil 'khor tshad du gang gyur pa/ /khru gang dang ni khru do dang / /khru gsum pa dang (7khru bzhi pa/ /khru lnga'i tshad las lhag mi bya/ /gang du de yi rdul tshon (genyid/ /kha dog sna tshogs kyis byas pa/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyanal / /sgo ni brgyad cha nyid du ni/ /de yi tshad du rab tu brtag /sgo yi tshad kyis yisgo khyud dang / / de yi mephyed kyis 'gram dang ni/ /logs dang de bzhin stegs bu dang / /dra ba dra phyed snam ①bu rnams/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi phyi rol dul/ /de yi phyed kyi 6)rdul tshon sa/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba nyid dang ni/ /ka ba brgyad ldan brtag par bya/ /sgo yi sum kyi'agyur nyid kyis ni/ /sgo yi rta babs mchog tu bya/ /mchog tu sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ /rdo rje'i ra ba khor yug ldan/ /dpag bsam shing sogs dang ldan pa/ /khro bo gtum po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa la/ /'phar ma gcig tu pa nyid du bya/ /de yi shar phyogs 8phyogs brgyad la/ /sna tshogs pad+ma yang dag bri/ /dbus ma dang dgu de dbus su/ /ral gri nya sngon po rdo rjes mtshan/ /rdo rje gri gug thod bcas 'og /shar du 'khor los mtshan pa yinya )/ /ral gri kha dog dkar po bri/ /lho ru kha dog 80—892

ser po yi/ /rin chen dang bcas yang dag bri/ /nub tu kha dog dmar po yi /pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa dang / /byang du ral gri rkyang pa yi0)/ /kha dog ljang khu ⑧yang dag bri/ /'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa yi③/ /gri gug me yi khyimatshams su bri/ /rin chen ser pos rab mtshan pa/ /bden bral du ni bri bar bya/ /pad+ma dmar pos rab mtshan pa/ /rlung du de bzhin bri bar bya/ /dbang ldan kha dog ljang khu ⑤yi/ /ut+pal ༅sngon pos mtshan pa bri/ /zla ba nyi ma'i steng gnas pa'i / /mtshan ma thams cad rab tu brtag /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs 'di/ /bdag gis 'jig rten don phyir bshad/ /yang na dkyil 'khor bri bya ba/ /ras ris tshul du bri bar bya/ /sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor bri 7byas nas / /dbus su mi g.yo mthing nag bri/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mas 'khyud ⑧pa/ /shar du mi g.yo dkar po bri/ /mi g.yo ser po de bzhin lhor/ /nub tu mi g.yo dmar po bri/ /byang du mi g.yo ljang khu po)bri/ /me mtshams gti mug rdo rje dkar//bden bral phra ma rdo rje ser/ /rlung du 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lha mo dmar mo yang dag bri/ /dbang ldan phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /ljang bri ras bris dkyil 'khor la / /de nas dkyil 'khor mul sngags kyis lhag par gnas par bya ba ni/ oṃ shrī tsaṇ+ḍa (dzom hā ro ṣa ṇa sa 4)pa ri wā /ster sa hi tali/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha dzaḥ: baṃ hoḥ a tra tsomaṇ+ḍa le/ a dhiṣ+ṭha rna 'aku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis kun nas dgug pa dang / rab tu gozhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas te mchod par bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyi mchod par gyur pa ni/ oṃ krohā 1 tsa la puspri pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shī tā tsa la puspri pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/she/ oṃ t+pā 17tā tsa la pusgo pra tīts+tsha rtsu phaṭa'o rte/ oṃ rak+ta ཿtsa la dur+bha pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭadun/ oṃ byā ( ri mā tsa la dur+bha pra tīts+tsha — 80—893

hūṃ phaṭa6)/ oṃ dwo ṣa brdzu ⑤puspri pra tīts+tsha nirgyu phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha brdzu dupu/ pra tīts+tsha ju phaṭa/ oṃ bi shu na (gebardzu yis4 pra gtīts+tsha rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga brdzu ⑤puspri 0pra tīts+tsha rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ khrin+t+ra brdzu ⑩phu4 pra tīts+tsha rtsu phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ dī paṃ dang /dhū tu)pe/ ga:/ ne+e be 58/ de lta bu'i nye bar spyad tunyepa lngas dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o/ /gang tshe dbus su mi g.yo dkar/ /gti mug rdo rje ma dang bcas / /de yi dkyil 'khor nyid du shes/ /de bzhin mi g.yo ser la sogs/ /rnal 'byor lnga yi rab dbye bas/ /dkyil 'khor lnga ru brtag par bya/ /sems nyid rtse gcig gyur pa yis/ /sngon du bsnyen pa brtsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor rab bzhugs 7rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor dang ni yang dag ldan/ /phan tshun du ni phyag byas nas/ /bza' ba sha dang chang yang bya/ /zhes pa ni dpa' bo gcig pa nyid du gsungs pa'i dpal khro bo (stegatum phonyepo chen po'i rgyud las/dkyil 'khor gyi rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ /slob ma ji lta bu nyid la/ /rgyud 'di rab tu sbyar bar (/mebya/ /the tshom 1nyamed par bya ba nyid/ /khyab bdag chen po bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dang por skyabs su 'gro ba gsum sbyin par bya'o/ /bslab pa lnga dang gso sbyong dag kyang ngo / /de nas 37dbang lnga dang 92 rmo/ gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas skal ldan slob ma la/ /rgyud kyi de nyid bstan par bya/ /gzhan dag ring du spang bar bya/ /gzhan du gus bcas gyur kyang spang / /de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'o/ /ji srid snying po byang chub par/ /80—894

sangs rgyas la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dang / /de la bslab pa lnga'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/srog gcod ma byin len 0)pa dang / /gzhan gyi chabud med rdzun ②smra rnams/ /spang bya kun la 'phags bzhin bya/ /lnga pa chang gi btung ba nyid/ /de la 'dir gso sbyong gi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bdag gis sems can gsad ④mi bya/ /pha rol nor ni dbrog ⑤mi bya/ /bdag ni tshangs par spyod pa 0spyad/ / rdzun gyi ⑦tshig kyang spang bar bgyi/ /myos byed chang gi btung ba ni/ /bdag gis gang du'ang btung mi bya/ /gar dang glu dang rgyan rnams dang / /rgod bag rnams ni spang bar bya/ /khri stan mtho dang khri stan che/ /dus min kha zas spang bar bya/ /de ltar gso sbyong yan lag brgyad/ /dgra bcom rjes su bdag gis bslab/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs ltar/ /rnam dag bdag gis gzung ⑧bar bgyi//de yis g.yon can khyabadud las rgyal/ /bla med sangs rgyas mchog thob bya/ /'dir ni srid pa zhi gyur nas/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs gyur te/ /'khor ba ji srid de srid par/ /skyes bu bde bar gshegs par skye/ /skye bo bzang po dang 'grogs 'dir/ /blo ldan 'jig rten la phan dga'/ /de la 'dir chu'i dbang ni / slob ma dri ma dang bral zhing shel dag pa bzhin du bsams yinas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa nas chu blangs te/ lo ma dang bcas pa'i lag pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 7a bhi ṣe ka ta (/shes ma ya shri tu ye hūm̐/ zhes pa 'dis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la 'dir dbu rgyan gyi nyu skadabang bskur ba ni gos la sogs pa la byas pa'i dbu rgyan 8rin po che kun las grub par bsams nas/ slob ma yang tso'akhor los sgyur lib ltar bsams nas/ mgo bor dbu rgyan sbyin par bya'o/ /80—895

sngon bzhin du dbang bskur 6)bar bya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa la.ā bi sha ā bi sha a su skṛ da yaṃ ni/ phaṭa/ de la ral gri'i dbang bskur ba ni/ lcags la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las ral gri de'i ④lag pa g.yas su byin nas/ sngon bzhin du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ ha na ha na/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba sha hūm̐ (mitshwa na khan tshoni)rtsu phaṭa/ de la 'dir 9)zhags pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/zangs ma la sogs pa las ⑧byas pa'i zhags pa de'i 6)sdigs mdzub ⑩dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yon par byin nas/ sngon bzhin du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍathem/ ka ha ka ha/⑫ kusgyu ku: sarba duspya pā she na brnya brta(sri/ ma hā tsos t+ya te dharma 7te swā hā/ de la 'dir ming gi dbang ni/ slob ma khro bo gtum po chen po'i phyag rgya ru nye bar bkod nas/ de'i yirnam par sems kyis dmigs te/oṃ he shrī 1 smabha ga ba tsho/shen yo: tsa la sidhe s+t+waṃ 466 phaṭa/ de nas sngon bzhin du dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du zhu )sgrub ( 17pa pos nag po la sogs pa'i dbye bas/mi g.yo ba rnam pa lnga'i ming gis dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba 6)ni dbang lnga'o/ snye/ /bud med rnams kyi dbu rgyan gyi 3 dbang bskur ba bzhag nas/sin dhu ra'i dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya'o/ /rgyal srid kyi lha mo chen /rdugemo'i tshul du slob ma dmigs te 7/ oṃ bha ga wa tī ( ā bi sha ā bi sha a su skṛ da yaṃ so rtsu phaṭa/lcags la rtesogs pa'i gri gug de'i lag pa g.yas su sbyin ri )par bya'o/ /oṃ kurti ke sab mā rā tsā māṃ si kārta ya kārta 1ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yon du nu mi'i thod pa'am / rdza ra las byas pa sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sasba sha tru tsā ralti dhā ra ya dhā tshor ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag rgya ru rnam par bkod nas/ de'i rnam par dmigs te/ oṃ he shrī de ṣa badz+re sidhe s+t+waṃ dmirtsu phaṭa/80wa 896

de bzhin du bud med ni nag mo la sogs pa'i kha dog gi dbye bas rnal 'byor ma lnga po rnams kyi ming gi 91dbang bskur (7bar bya'o/ /'dir shes rab kyi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su thabs kyi dbang bskur (5)ba sbyin par bya'o zhes so/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur (gerabar gyur pa 5)ni bla ma la slob mas gos la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ de la rang yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs dang / lang tshos brgyan pa'i shes rab ma dbul bar bya'o/ /khyod la 'di ni 'bul lags kyisang sku/ /'dod kun bde bar rab tu stsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don phyir/ /mgon po khyod kyis brtse 57༄bas zung / /de nas bla ma la phyag 'tshal nas slob ma phyir byung ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa (8)kho hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas shing gnas par bya'o/ /yang bla mas chang dang sha la sogs pa rnams kyis bdag nyid mchod nas/ shes rab kyang tshim par byas te(9)/ yang dag par sbyor ba las nye bar byung ba'i dkar dmar lo ma'i skyong bu la sogs par bzhag nas slob ma bos te/ de'i lce la mthe bong dang ming med kyis 'irdzas bzung nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nyu1yi ge bri bar bya'o/ /de nas/ a ho su khaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas 'di brjod par bya ste/ de ring bdag gis 4nyasangs rgyas kyi ye shes bskyed par bya yis12/ gang gis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur gyisang/ 'on kyang khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du 'di smra bar mi bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i snying gar 7ral gri bzhag nas/ 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ gal te smras na de yi 9tshe/ /shin tu rno / ba'i ral gri 'di/ /khro bo gtum po'i phyag na gnas/ /gang gis dam 80wa 897

tshig 'jig ①byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu gcod/ /skye ba bye ba stong rnams su/ /mi rnams ral gri lag phyar ②bas/ /yan lag kun gcod ②mgo bo ni / /'di yis mchog tu gcod par byed/ /gal te dam tshig 'di nyid kyis/ /khyod kyis 'jigs pa ④thob par 'gyur/ /de nas slob mas brjod par bya ste/de ltar nges zhes so/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bcings nas/ dkyil 'khor du me tog dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bsal phyinas/ dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /gang dang gang gi ⑥mtshan ma de nas bstan par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma la shes rab ma de sbyin par bya'o/ /gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis / /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /de stinas dga' ba bzhi'i rnam par dbye ba bla mas rna bar smra bar bya'o/ /de nas ⑧bla ma phyi rol du byung nas / shes rab gcer bur po)tsog pus gsang gnas mdzub mos bstan nas/ci ste bu khyod 'di spro 'am/ /nga las mi gtsang ba dang ni/ /bshang gci rak+ta 0za ba dang / /bha ga'i gnas la 'o byed dam/ /sgrub pa (nyapos smra bar bya ste7/khyod las mi gtsang bza' ba ni/ /ci yi phyir na bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gis mi mo yonakun gus bya/ /des kyang / a ho bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas sten 7byed na/ /bdag ni dngos grub stsol mdzad ma/ /blo ldan brtan 8par rab sbyor bas/ /pad+mar tsobya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /rang nyid khro bo gtum po chen ⑫por gnas pas bde ba chen po ste/ de nas sgrub pa po bdag nyid khro bo gtum po chen po'i rnam par bsams la/ shes rab kyang zhe snang rdo rje ma'i tshul gyis yang 80—898

dag par sbyor bas/ dga' ba bzhi ①mtshon par bya'o/ /de nas yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bla ma la sogs pa la chang dang sha la sogs pa'i tshogs ②kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dbul bar bya'o zhes pa ni shes rab kyi dbang ngo zhes pa ni dpa' bo gcig pa nyid du gsungs pa'i dpal khro bo gtum po chen po'i rgyud las/dbang bskur ba'i rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ ji ltar sgom ①pa po yi ④phyir/ /khro chen gtum po bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa ji ltar bya/ /dbang phyug dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yid dang mthun ṭa pa'i sa phyogs ni/ /bar du gcod ⑥pa kun bral bar/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i stan gnyid la/ /de la mnyam gzhag brtag (0par bya/ /dang po byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par snying rje bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa la ni dga' ba bsgom/ /kun gyi mtha' la btang snyoms so/ /de nas rang gi thugs ma'i sa bon las pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis mdun du bsam gtan gyi 6)khro bo gtum po bsams nas yid kyis mchod pa bya 4 )ste/mkhas pas me tog la sogs pas/ /yid kyis de rnams mchod par bya/ /de mdun sdig pa bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams la yang rjes yi rang / /gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ /bskul zhing gsol ba rab tu 'debs/ /bdag nyid yongs su 'bul ba dang / /bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bya/ /de nas smon lam btab nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed ⑩par bgyi/ /de nas phyag ni btsal 7byas la/ /'od zer rnams kyis slar yang bsdu/ /mkhas 80—899

pas stong par bsams pa ni/ /sngags 'di nyid ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu yo)rgya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rtal/ rab tu 'bar bas ②rgyu yig ni/ 'od zer de yis bsregs par bsam/ /ga bur bsregs pa ji bzhin bsam/ /'od zer la yang rnam mi rtog /thams cad nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /skad cig dugis ni rnam par bsgom(sri/ /dri med dag pa'i shel bzhin du/ /rang lus rnam par bsgom par bya/ /sngon du bsgom bya phyi nas ni/ yo ram̐ bam̐ lo bzhi rnams lasasku / /yongs gyur bsgom bya rlung dang ni/ /me dang chu dang sa rnams so/ /r+ghaṃ yig de las bsgom 57)bya ba/ /gzhal yas khang du rab tu bsgom/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /de yi dbus su bsam bya ba / /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad ldan/ /paṃ (8)yig sa bon las byung ba/ /de yo)la i yig las byung zla/ /raṃ 7yig las byung nyi ma ste/ /de hunyesteng hūm̐ yig las kyang slar/ / des bskyed 32mi bskyod pa ru bsam/ /mā ma tī bcas tunyeyang dag sbyor / /de la rim bzhin rnal 'byor dbang / /de yi spyi bo la thim nas/ /skar mda' ji bzhin sbyor ba yis/ /mā ma tī yi bha gar bsam/ /de las khu ba ro mnyam gyur/ /ltung 'gyur de yi bha ga'i nang / /gtum po'i gzugs su gyur nas ni/ /bha ga'i mtha' las nges byung nas/ /mi bskyod pa la tsoral gri yis/ /bsnun nas phyi nas rab tu bza'/ /mā ma khris 7kyang de las de'i/ /sha za bar ni rab tu bsam/ /de phyir mā ma khris bzung yi rmonas/ /ma dang yang dag rab 'dod bya/ /des kyang 'khyud khri par bsam bya ba/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ma yi gzugs/ /phyag g.yas na ni ral gri phyar39/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dang bcas pa'i/ /sdigs ( )mdzub 21kyis ni sdigs snyepar byed/ /so yis ne ma mchu yang dag bsdams( )/ /80wa 900

rkang g.yas brdegs 0)pa'i stabs kyis ni/ /bdud bzhi rnam par nyed par mdzad / /pus mo g.yon pa sa la btsugs②/ /'jigs byed 'khyog por ①gzigs pa can/ /nor 'dzin la ni sdigs zhi)mdzub bstan/ /pus mo g.yon pa'i rtse mos gnas/ /mi bskyod sngon pos dbu rgyan mdzad/ /rin po che yi ⑤cod pan can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan gyur pa'i/ /gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /brgyad gnyis lo yi rnam pa can/ /spyan gnyis dmar po gtso bo yi / /sems nyid brtan par yibasgom par bya/ /bdag nyid khro bo gtum grub nas / /de nas srub 57)pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /shar du mi g.yo dkar po spro/ /me mtshams gti mug rdo rje ma/ /ston ku'i zla 'od dang mtshungs spro/ /lho ru mi g.yo ser po spro/ /phra ma rdo rje bden bral ser(ge/ /mi g.yo dmar po nub tu spro/ /rlung du 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /mi g.yo ljang khu dzi)byang phyogs su/ /dbang ldan phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /phyi tso nas shes rab dang bcas des/ /rang gi mgrin (1pa las byung ba'i/ /lha mo rnams kyis glu yis (rtebaskul/ /pa hu mi ṭī du bi brdzi a ho mā shun+da sa hā ba totshu bī o e phib mi sam nyunyedza/ ga hi ba bhā tshub/ gti mug rdo rje mas so/ /mā ka ru ḍā matsi a yis yinyi pa hu mā ho hi tu shun+da mā motshu ⑩de ha/su dukhri a hu i dzī (nyeb bi hunaḥ/) phra ma rdo rje ma yis so/ /tī sa ( )tu ha ri sa bi ho ( —stenyi a shun+da hi ru ka ra si ( nyepa be sha / totshu ni man+t+ra ṇa ka ri a maṇ+ḍi ats+tsha i lo ā shi sgosteg/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma'i 'o/ /dzo ba na mkhyu u pa khi a niṣ+ṭha la shun+daḥ(nye a ḍiṭi( tshozhe/ shun+da sa hā ba bi go i a ka ra hi tu mo e nams ma snyiḥ/phrag ru dog rdo rje ma'i'os// /khyab bdag byams pa rnam spangs nas/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin du ma mdzad/ /khyod dang rnam bral bdag 'gum pas/ /'gro kun 80wa 901

stong par ma mdzad cig /gti mug rdo rje mas so/ /snying rje'i sems bral bdag 'gum pas/ /khyab bdag stong par ma mdzad cig /bdag gi ①lus ni sdug bsngal bas/ /'tsho ba dang bral ma mdzad cig /phra ma rdo rje mas so/ /ci ste mkhas pa khyod nyid ni/ /dga' ba spangs nas stong par 'jug /'jig rten ma lus pa rnams dang / /bdag gi ②yid ni khyod la sdodani/ /'dod chags rdo rje ma yis so/ /lang tsho ④dang ldan btang snyoms pa'i/ /mig ni stong pa 'bral med can/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la mnyam nyid sbyor bar mdzod/ /phrag dog rdo rje mas so/ /'di ni rmi lam ltar thos nas/ /khu ba las 'khrungs skad cig gis/ /sngon ma'i gzugs bzhin bsam par bya/ /bdag nyid yang dag sbyor de las/ /mi g.yo dkar po la bsnun nas/ /gti mug rdo rjer rab 'dod bya/ /mi g.yo dkar po'i gzugs su bya/ /mi g.yo ser po slar bsad nas/ /'dod bya phra ma rdo rje mar/ /bdag nyid mi g.yo ser por bya / /de bzhin mi g.yo dmar po bsad/ /'dod chags rdo rje mar 'dod bya/ /mi g.yo dmar por (5)bdag nyid bya/ /mi g.yo ljang khus yibasad nas kyang / /phrag dog rdo rje mar 'dod bya/ /mi g.yo ljang khur (7bdag nyid bya/ /lha mo bzhi la rjes chags pas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag bsdu/kye/ /bdag nyid gcig tu yang dag sbyor/ /'bad pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /de las 5steng rgyal byas pa yis/ /bdag la dngos grub the tshom 7med/ /kha dog nag phyir rnal 'byor pa/ /gang bsgom de ni mi g.yo nag /kha dog dkar phyir rnal 'byor pa / /gang bsgom de ni mi g.yo dkar/ /kha dog ser phyir rnal 'byor pa/ /gang bsgom de ni mi g.yo ser/ /kha dog dmar phyir rnal 'byor pa/ /gang 80—902

nas / /de la gan rkyal bsgyel ①bar bya/ /lag pa g.yas pas de nyid du/ /pad+mar rdo rje nges gzhug bya/ /de yi pus ②mo'i 'og bzung nas/ /gru ②khugs steng du sbyar bar bya/ /phan tshun lag pa gnyis kyis ④ni/ /bung ba'i dra ba zhes su shes/ /de yi rkang pa zung dag ni/ /phrag pa'i steng du nges par byin/ /bcing ba 'di ni 'khrul ⑤'khor zhon/ /'bebs shing 'bebs pas rab tu sbyor//de yi rkang g.yon phrag pa la/ /g.yas g.yon brla yi rtsa ba las/ /de yi rkang g.yas g.yon pa las/ /g.yas pa yi ni rtsa ⑥ba ru/ /'dir ni rkang pa steng bcings ⑦pas/ /yang dag bde bas sdug bsngal 'joms/ /de yi rkang pa'i mthil la ni/ /brang gi dbus su mnyam du sbyar/ /lag pa gnyis kyis btsir ⑧bar bya/ /pus ⑨me rus sbal bcing bar gsungs/ /de yi rkang pa'i mthil la ni / /mig dang rna ba mgo bo sbyar/ /bcing ba 'di ni kun du bzang / /'dod kun bde ba rab tu ster⑩/ /tsi tra ji srid skyil krung (nyubyas/ /kun nas sna tshogs pa yi ni/ /khro bo gtum tsopo sbyor ba yis/ /kun nas rnam pa sna tshogs pa / /ji srid 'dod pas yang nas yang / /de yi kha la 'o bya'o / /mig ni zim bus gdong du blta/ /ji ltar 'dod tshig smra ba yi/ /gdong la lce yis 'jib par bya/ /de yi kha nas byung ba'ang btung / /so yi dri ma'ang za zhing 'jib/ /bde bar rnam par bsgom par bya/ /cho ga shes pas cung zad du/ /so yis lce dang mchu ni bsdam/ /lce yis sna tu yi bu ga dang / /mig bi zur kyang sbyang bar ⑫bya / /so dang mchan khung las byung ba'i/ /dri ma kun kyang bza' bar bya /mgo dang mig dang mgrin pa nam/ /logs dag rked pa nu ma lag /'os ⑩'jib sen mo sbyin par bya/ /mig gnyis spangs tshonal bud med la/ /lag pas 80—911
